paras.zh: - 华硕 Marvelous Mesh 路由器：华硕 ZenWiFi BT10 售价 450 美元（优惠 240 美元）

paras.en: - Samsung’s Most Powerful Smartphone: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra for $980 ($420 Off)
paras.zh: - 三星最强大的智能手机：三星 Galaxy S26 Ultra 售价 980 美元（优惠 420 美元）

paras.en: - Apple’s Rarely Discounted MacBook: Apple MacBook Air for $1,099 ($200 Off)
paras.zh: - Apple 很少打折的 MacBook：Apple MacBook Air 售价 1,099 美元（优惠 200 美元）

paras.en: The flagship Apple AirPods Pro 3 are its best wireless earbuds, and they're at the lowest price since June. Music sounds great, noise cancellation works well, and they offer excellent call quality. Apple added more ear tips for a better fit for small ears, new tools like heart rate sensing and live translation, and enhanced support for folks with hearing loss. If you use an iPhone, these are the wireless earbuds for you.
paras.zh: 旗舰级 Apple AirPods Pro 3 是其最好的无线耳机，而且价格是 6 月份以来的最低价格。音乐听起来很棒，降噪效果很好，并且通话质量极佳。苹果增加了更多耳塞，以更好地贴合小耳朵，添加了心率感应和实时翻译等新工具，并增强了对听力损失人士的支持。如果您使用 iPhone，这些无线耳机就是适合您的。

paras.en: The Nothing Headphone (1) is one of our favorite pairs of over-ear headphones. With an attractive and distinctive design that combines a transparent look with tactile controls like a volume wheel and media control paddle, these headphones make a real statement. They also boast top-notch battery life. This is the best discount we’ve seen on them so far.
paras.zh: Nothing Headphone (1) 是我们最喜欢的耳罩式耳机之一。这些耳机采用引人注目且独特的设计，将透明外观与音量轮和媒体控制拨片等触觉控制相结合，真正彰显个性。它们还拥有一流的电池寿命。这是迄今为止我们见过的最好的折扣。

paras.en: Prime Day is a great time to pick up older models at deep discounts. The Sonos Beam Gen 2 is a great example, having coming out originally in 2021. It's since been supplanted by the Sonos Beam Ultra, but that model is hundreds of dollars more (even while on sale!), and the Sonos Beam Gen 2 has never been cheaper. Our own audio expert, Harry Rabinowitz, used this model in his own home as his primary soundbar and found it to be a particularly good fit for smaller homes.
paras.zh: Prime Day 是以大幅折扣购买旧型号的好时机。 Sonos Beam Gen 2 就是一个很好的例子，最初于 2021 年推出。后来它被 Sonos Beam Ultra 取代，但该型号的价格贵了数百美元（即使在打折期间！），而且 Sonos Beam Gen 2 从未如此便宜过。我们自己的音频专家 Harry Rabinowitz 在自己家里使用了这款型号作为他的主要条形音箱，并发现它特别适合小型家庭。

paras.en: Phones, Wearables, and Accessories Deals
paras.zh: 手机、可穿戴设备和配件优惠

paras.en: The Samsung S26 Ultra was the pick of the bunch this year, with a cool privacy screen, blazing performance, long battery life, and an excellent camera, but all three of Samsung’s S26 phones are on sale right now. These are the lowest prices they’ve been so far.
paras.zh: 三星 S26 Ultra 是今年的最佳选择，它拥有炫酷的防窥屏、出色的性能、超长的电池续航时间和出色的相机，但三星的三款 S26 手机目前都在销售。这是迄今为止的最低价格。

paras.en: The Moto G Stylus is our pick of the best cheap phones under $400, and is is as low as it has ever been right now. If you miss a headphone jack and microSD card slot, this could be a winner. This is the 2025 model, but Motorola increased the price by $100 for the 2026 Moto G Stylus, and, apart from the upgraded active stylus, there’s little to justify the extra cost.
paras.zh: Moto G Stylus 是我们挑选的 400 美元以下最便宜的手机，而且价格是目前最低的。如果您缺少耳机插孔和 microSD 卡插槽，那么这可能是一个不错的选择。这是 2025 年的型号，但摩托罗拉将 2026 年 Moto G Stylus 的价格提高了 100 美元，而且除了升级的有源手写笔之外，没有什么理由证明额外的成本是合理的。

paras.en: This is a solid smartwatch, and an especially great choice if you have a Samsung Galaxy phone. You can save yourself a significant sum by opting for last year’s model and Samsung’s Galaxy Watch9 is only a modest upgrade over the Watch8, considering it’s $120 more expensive.
paras.zh: 这是一款坚固的智能手表，如果您拥有三星 Galaxy 手机，那么这是一个特别好的选择。选择去年的型号可以为自己节省一大笔钱，三星的 Galaxy Watch9 只是比 Watch8 稍稍升级，考虑到它贵了 120 美元。

paras.en: Anyone with a trio of Apple gadgets (iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods) will benefit from snagging one of the best Apple 3-in-1 wireless chargers for their nightstand, and this is my top pick. The wide base keeps it steady, enabling you to remove your iPhone from the magnetic wireless charging pad one-handed, the Watch pad lets any strap dangle, and the base has a spot for AirPods, too.
paras.zh: 任何拥有三件苹果产品（iPhone、Apple Watch 和 AirPods）的人都将受益于在床头柜上购买最好的苹果三合一无线充电器之一，这是我的首选。宽大的底座使其保持稳定，让您可以单手从磁性无线充电板上取出 iPhone，手表板可让任何表带悬挂起来，底座还设有一个可放置 AirPods 的位置。

paras.en: This power bank does it all. I love the translucent design, offering a peek at the electronic innards. It has a handy display with comprehensive stats, and it supports just about every fast charging protocol going. It packs 24,000 mAh of power and can charge at up to 140 watts, so it will juice up anything from a laptop down. It’s even IP66 rated for water and dust resistance.
paras.zh: 这款移动电源可以满足这一切。我喜欢半透明的设计，可以看到电子内部结构。它有一个方便的显示屏，具有全面的统计数据，并且支持几乎所有的快速充电协议。它的电量为 24,000 mAh，充电功率高达 140 瓦，因此它可以为笔记本电脑等任何设备供电。它甚至达到了 IP66 防水防尘等级。

paras.en: Want a hard-wearing, fast charging cable to keep your gadgetry juiced? This Anker cable from the best USB-C cables is our pick. It can deliver 240 watts, has a tough, braided nylon exterior made from 100 percent recycled plastic, and comes with a lifetime warranty. Anker promises this cable will last a century and it can operate in temperatures from -40 degrees to 176 degrees Fahrenheit. The ribbed cuffs make it easy to grip, and it’s USB-IF certified, too.
paras.zh: 想要一根耐用的快速充电线来让您的小工具保持电量充足吗？我们选择了来自最好的 USB-C 电缆的 Anker 电缆。它可提供 240 瓦功率，具有由 100% 再生塑料制成的坚韧编织尼龙外壳，并提供终身保修。 Anker 承诺这款电缆可以使用一个世纪，并且可以在 -40 华氏度到 176 华氏度的温度下工作。罗纹袖口使其易于抓握，并且还通过了 USB-IF 认证。

paras.en: The M5 MacBook Air got a serious price hike at the end of June, bringing it up to $1,299. But this week, everyone’s favorite laptop dropped to $1,099, which is the lowest price it’s been at in months. It comes with 16 GB of RAM and 512 GB of storage, so you’re getting a really solid configuration that should last you many years. The 15-inch model is also $200 off if you need a larger screen to work on. Regardless, this is the best laptop can buy at the price price I’ve seen it at in a while.
paras.zh: M5 MacBook Air 在 6 月底大幅涨价，达到 1,299 美元。但本周，大家最喜欢的笔记本电脑价格跌至 1,099 美元，这是几个月来的最低价格。它配备 16 GB RAM 和 512 GB 存储空间，因此您将获得真正可靠的配置，可以使用很多年。如果您需要更大的屏幕来工作，15 英寸型号还可享受 200 美元的折扣。无论如何，这是我一段时间以来能以这个价格买到的最好的笔记本电脑。

paras.en: Interesting in dipping your toe in the world of local, agentic AI? I know that will sound cringey to some—and trust me, I get it. But there's no denying the increasing interest in using the Mac Mini for just that, and the latest M6 is particularly good at it, as I learned in my own testing. Of course, the M6 Mac Mini has a broader appeal too, and it's great to see it on sale so soon after launching. If you need even more performance for your AI curiosity, you'll need the Mac Studio, which also received its first discount since launching, coming in at $150 under its retail price.
paras.zh: 有兴趣尝试一下本地代理人工智能的世界吗？我知道这对某些人来说听起来很尴尬——相信我，我明白。但不可否认的是，人们对使用 Mac Mini 的兴趣与日俱增，而最新的 M6 尤其擅长这一点，正如我在自己的测试中了解到的那样。当然，M6 Mac Mini 也具有更广泛的吸引力，很高兴看到它在推出后这么快就上市。如果您需要更高的性能来满足您的 AI 好奇心，您将需要 Mac Studio，它也获得了自推出以来的首次折扣，售价比零售价低 150 美元。

paras.en: Gaming laptops have gotten far too expensive recently, so I was delighted to see that one of my favorite gaming laptops to recommend has a huge sale. The price on this has fluctuated wildly over the past few months, but never has it dropped to just $1,100. This is the model that comes with the entry-level RTX 5050, but it has a better display than every other gaming laptop in this price range. Also consider the RTX 5060 model for $1,499 at Walmart, which really takes performance to the next level.
paras.zh: 游戏笔记本电脑最近变得太贵了，所以我很高兴看到我最喜欢推荐的一款游戏笔记本电脑进行了大促销。在过去的几个月里，这款产品的价格波动很大，但从未跌至 1,100 美元。这是入门级 RTX 5050 附带的型号，但它的显示屏比该价格范围内的所有其他游戏笔记本电脑都要好。另请考虑沃尔玛售价 1,499 美元的 RTX 5060 型号，它确实将性能提升到了一个新的水平。

paras.en: If you don’t want another subscription in your life, the Asus ZenWiFi BT10 is the best mesh system for you. You get three bands of stable Wi-Fi 7 coverage for your home. A two-pack will cover most properties (up to 6,000 square feet), there are two high-speed 10 Gbps ports (alongside a Gigabit LAN and USB 3.0), and security software, parental controls, and extras like VPN support are included.
paras.zh: 如果您不想再订阅一次，华硕 ZenWiFi BT10 是最适合您的网状系统。您的家可以获得三个稳定的 Wi-Fi 7 频段覆盖。两件套将覆盖大部分房产（最多 6,000 平方英尺），有两个高速 10 Gbps 端口（以及千兆位 LAN 和 USB 3.0），并包含安全软件、家长控制和 VPN 支持等附加功能。

paras.en: You won't find a better cheap monitor than this. That's always true of the Dell 27 Plus S2725HSM, but it's especially true at $130, which is the cheapest I've ever seen it at. It's just a basic 1920 x 1080 resolution, but the fully adjustable stand and great image quality gives this a major step up over every comparable monitor I've seen. If you've got some more cash to spend, I'd also recommend the upgraded 4K model, which is also on sale at a new low price.
paras.zh: 您找不到比这更好的便宜显示器了。 Dell 27 Plus S2725HSM 的价格始终如此，尤其是 130 美元，这是我见过的最便宜的价格。它只是基本的 1920 x 1080 分辨率，但完全可调节的支架和出色的图像质量使其比我见过的所有同类显示器都有了重大进步。如果你手头还有钱的话，我还推荐升级版的4K型号，而且现在也以新的低价出售。

paras.en: A tidy, affordable pair of PC speakers, Edifier’s M60 is a bargain at its usual price, so this discount is not to be sniffed at. These speakers produce a surprisingly rich, clear sound that persists when you crank the volume, and there’s a thump of bass. They also come with angled stands, and connect via USB-C, 3.5 mm, or Bluetooth 5.3.
paras.zh: 漫步者 M60 是一款整洁、价格实惠的 PC 扬声器，按其通常的价格来说很便宜，所以这个折扣不容小觑。这些扬声器会产生令人惊讶的丰富、清晰的声音，当您调高音量时，这种声音会持续存在，并且会发出重低音。它们还配备有角度的支架，并通过 USB-C、3.5 毫米或蓝牙 5.3 连接。

paras.en: The best iPad for most people, if you don’t already have the iPad (11th-generation, A16), now is the time to buy. The 11-inch screen is perfect for kicking back on the couch with a book, game, or movie. It has a pair of 12-megapixel cameras, and Touch ID in the power button. It’s also handy for keeping the kids amused.
paras.zh: 对于大多数人来说最好的 iPad，如果您还没有 iPad（第 11 代，A16），现在是购买的时候了。 11 英寸屏幕非常适合您坐在沙发上看书、玩游戏或看电影。它有一对 12 兆像素摄像头，电源按钮上有 Touch ID。它也很方便让孩子们开心。

paras.en: Fancy an e-reader that can also serve as a digital notebook? Amazon’s third-generation Kindle Scribe has you covered. It’s slim, with an 11-inch screen, smart stylus, and a bunch of AI features. It’s a go-to choice for note-takers and students. While we recommend the older model in our best Kindles guide, that’s mainly due to the lower price, and this is a better option when it’s on sale. Such as right now.
paras.zh: 想要一款也可以用作数字笔记本的电子阅读器吗？亚马逊第三代 Kindle Scribe 可以满足您的需求。它很薄，配备 11 英寸屏幕、智能手写笔和一系列人工智能功能。这是记笔记者和学生的首选。虽然我们在最好的 Kindle 指南中推荐旧型号，但这主要是因为价格较低，而且在打折时这是更好的选择。比如现在。

paras.en: If you’re looking for an easy security system and you don’t mind paying a pricey subscription ($10 per month or $96 a year for a single camera, $20 per month or $216 a year for unlimited cameras), Arlo is the way to go. This outdoor camera captures 2K video, has a 160-degree field of view, two-way audio, and direct Wi-Fi connection. It’s the best of the best outdoor security cameras. The Arlo app is fast, with rich notifications and two-factor authentication, so you can log in with your fingerprint or face, phone permitting.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻找一个简单的安全系统，并且不介意支付昂贵的订阅费用（单个摄像头每月 10 美元或每年 96 美元，无限摄像头每月 20 美元或每年 216 美元），Arlo 是您的最佳选择。这款户外摄像机可拍摄 2K 视频，具有 160 度视野、双向音频和直接 Wi-Fi 连接。它是最好的户外安全摄像机中的最好的。 Arlo 应用程序速度很快，具有丰富的通知和两步身份验证，因此您可以在手机允许的情况下使用指纹或面部登录。

paras.en: Combining a white noise machine, sunrise alarm light, and clock into a single device designed to help lull you to sleep and wake you gently, Hatch’s third generation Restore is an all-in-one way to establish a healthy sleep routine. It also enables you to leave your phone outside the bedroom. It’s annoying that you need a subscription to unlock all the content, but if it helps you get a better night’s sleep, it’s worth it.
paras.zh: Hatch 的第三代 Restore 将白噪音机、日出闹钟和时钟组合到一个设备中，旨在帮助您入睡并轻轻唤醒您，是建立健康睡眠习惯的一体化方式。它还使您可以将手机留在卧室外面。您需要订阅才能解锁所有内容，这很烦人，但如果它可以帮助您获得更好的睡眠，那么这是值得的。

paras.en: If you like to stay organized, this 27-inch smart calendar could be for you. You can sync calendars, organize your meal plans, create to-do lists, and see your family’s day-to-day laid out in a clear format. Smart calendars might not be worth it for everyone, and some features require a subscription (digital photo frame functionality, smart assistant, rewards), but this is a decent discount on the biggest model.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢保持井井有条，这款 27 英寸智能日历可能适合您。您可以同步日历、组织膳食计划、创建待办事项列表，并以清晰的格式查看家人的日常安排。智能日历可能并不适合每个人，而且某些功能需要订阅（数码相框功能、智能助手、奖励），但这对于最大的型号来说是一个不错的折扣。

articles.title: 7 Best Prime Day Kindle Deals (2026): Save Up to $150
articles.author: Nena Farrell

paras.en: There’s no better time to shop for Amazon’s e-readers than during one of its own sale events. Prime Day Kindle deals are here, but they aren’t as impactful as they used to be.
paras.zh: 购买亚马逊电子阅读器的最佳时机莫过于在亚马逊自己的促销活动期间。 Prime Day Kindle 优惠来了，但影响力不如以前了。

paras.en: That’s because Amazon raised prices on almost all Kindle e-readers back in August, along with other products it makes. Buying during Amazon’s fall Prime Big Deals Day is one of your only chances to avoid paying the new price tag. Not all the deals are huge discounts, but if you’re set on a new Kindle, this is your moment.
paras.zh: 这是因为亚马逊在八月份提高了几乎所有 Kindle 电子阅读器及其生产的其他产品的价格。在亚马逊秋季 Prime 大优惠日期间购买是您避免支付新价格标签的唯一机会之一。并非所有优惠都是大幅折扣，但如果您准备购买新 Kindle，现在就是您的好时机。

paras.en: It’s also worth noting that Amazon announced new Kindles last week. There’s a new 2026 version of the Kindle, Kindle Paperwhite, and Kindle Colorsoft, plus Kids versions of all three. Each has an aluminum version, something Amazon has never offered before. So far, only the Kindle is available now, with the rest of the lineup to come. It’s up to you if you want to wait to see how the new models compare to the old before buying, or snag one of these on-sale models before they eventually disappear.
paras.zh: 还值得注意的是，亚马逊上周发布了新的 Kindle。有新的 2026 版 Kindle、Kindle Paperwhite 和 Kindle Colorsoft，以及这三款设备的儿童版。每个都有铝制版本，这是亚马逊以前从未提供过的。到目前为止，只有 Kindle 可供购买，其他产品也将陆续推出。如果您想在购买之前先看看新型号与旧型号的比较，或者在这些特价型号最终消失之前抢购其中一款，这取决于您。

paras.en: Check out all the Prime Day Kindle deals below, from the best deals to my favorite models, regardless of price (plus a couple of great Kindle accessories!) Also, browse our roundup of the Absolute Best Prime Big Deal Days Deals, plus my full guide to all of Amazon’s on-sale devices and whether the sales are any good.
paras.zh: 查看下面所有的 Prime Day Kindle 优惠，从最优惠的价格到我最喜欢的型号，无论价格如何（还有一些很棒的 Kindle 配件！）此外，请浏览我们的绝对最佳 Prime Big Deal Days Deals 综述，以及我对亚马逊所有在售设备以及销售情况是否良好的完整指南。

paras.en: Updated TK TIME October 7, 2026: I've checked prices are all accurate as we head into day two of Prime Day, and added a few Kindle accessory deals.
paras.zh: TK TIME 更新于 2026 年 10 月 7 日：在 Prime Day 第二天，我检查了价格是否准确，并添加了一些 Kindle 配件优惠。

paras.en: - A great price for a color Kindle: Kindle Colorsoft for $190 ($100 Off)
paras.zh: - 彩色 Kindle 价格实惠：Kindle Colorsoft 仅需 190 美元（优惠 100 美元）

paras.en: - The new Kindle Scribe is truly worth it at this price: Kindle Scribe (3rd Gen) for $380 ($120 Off)
paras.zh: - 新款 Kindle Scribe 确实物超所值：Kindle Scribe（第 3 代）售价 380 美元（优惠 120 美元）

paras.en: - The biggest Kindle discount: Kindle Scribe Colorsoft for $480 ($150 Off)
paras.zh: - Kindle 最大折扣：Kindle Scribe Colorsoft 售价 480 美元（优惠 150 美元）

paras.en: - A version of our favorite Kindle: Kindle Paperwhite Signature (12th Gen) for $170 ($80 Off)
paras.zh: - 我们最喜欢的 Kindle 版本：Kindle Paperwhite Signature（第 12 代）售价 170 美元（优惠 80 美元）

paras.en: - The cheapest Kindle: Kindle (11th Gen) for $104 ($46 off)
paras.zh: - 最便宜的 Kindle：Kindle（第 11 代）售价 104 美元（折扣 46 美元）

paras.en: - A handy pillow stand: Lamicall Tablet Pillow Stand Holder for TK
paras.zh: - 方便的枕架：TK 的 Lamicall 平板电脑枕架

paras.en: One of the best discounts on a Kindle is on the Kindle Colorsoft. It’s $100 off, making it just $20 more than my usual recommendation, the Paperwhite, also on sale for $170. For the small splurge, it’s worth buying instead of the Paperwhite. The Colorsoft adds color on top of almost everything else you’d get with a Kindle Paperwhite: a 7-inch screen and an adjustable warm light, plus an auto-adjusting light and wireless charging if you upgrade to the Signature model. It’s also ad-free, while you have to pay extra to skip the ads on a Paperwhite or base Kindle.
paras.zh: Kindle 的最佳折扣之一是 Kindle Colorsoft。它有 100 美元的折扣，只比我通常推荐的 Paperwhite 贵 20 美元，Paperwhite 的售价也为 170 美元。对于小额挥霍来说，值得购买它而不是 Paperwhite。 Colorsoft 为 Kindle Paperwhite 的几乎所有其他功能增添了色彩：7 英寸屏幕和可调节暖光，如果升级到 Signature 型号，还可以自动调节光和无线充电。它也没有广告，但你必须支付额外费用才能跳过 Paperwhite 或基础版 Kindle 上的广告。

paras.en: New versions of the Colorsoft are coming out as well, including an aluminum-backed Signature version in new colors and an upgraded display. But I don’t expect to see the new versions on sale this year.
paras.zh: Colorsoft 的新版本也即将推出，包括新颜色的铝背 Signature 版本和升级的显示屏。但我预计今年不会看到新版本上市。

paras.en: Amazon’s Kindle Scribe line doubles as both an e-reader and a digital notebook. The newest third-generation Scribe is good, but not great for the price, especially given that the older model is still around, has most of the features, and retails for only $400. But right now, the Kindle Scribe (3rd Gen) actually costs less than its previous generation for once, making it worth choosing over my old favorite. There are second-hand versions of that second-gen model on sale, though.
paras.zh: 亚马逊的 Kindle Scribe 系列既可以作为电子阅读器，也可以作为数字笔记本。最新的第三代 Scribe 不错，但价格并不高，特别是考虑到旧型号仍然存在，具有大部分功能，零售价仅为 400 美元。但现在，Kindle Scribe（第 3 代）的价格实际上比上一代要低，这使得它值得选择而不是我以前最喜欢的。不过，第二代型号也有二手版本在售。

paras.en: There’s a new homepage design, a bigger screen, and new connectivity and AI features compared to the older model. I don’t love the AI features, but I do love that I can connect this device to Google Drive and Microsoft OneDrive, making it a more powerful digital notebook. It also didn’t raise in price in August, so this is a legitimate sale with no price changes inflating it.
paras.zh: 与旧型号相比，有新的主页设计、更大的屏幕、新的连接和人工智能功能。我不喜欢人工智能功能，但我确实喜欢我可以将此设备连接到 Google Drive 和 Microsoft OneDrive，使其成为更强大的数字笔记本。八月份它也没有涨价，所以这是一次合法的销售，没有价格变化导致价格上涨。

paras.en: Color finally arrived to the Kindle Scribe line last year with the Kindle Scribe Colorsoft. It has all the same features and look as the third-generation Scribe, but with a color screen. That addition racks up the price a lot, hitting $630 compared to the $400 to $500 of previous models.
paras.zh: 去年，Kindle Scribe Colorsoft 终于推出了 Color。它具有与第三代 Scribe 相同的功能和外观，但配备彩色屏幕。这一附加功能使价格大幅上涨，达到 630 美元，而之前型号的价格为 400 至 500 美元。

paras.en: It’s too much, in my opinion, especially to only add color. But if you’re set on color coordinating your notes and highlights, then this is the best time to buy, given the Kindle Scribe Colorsoft has a serious discount right now that makes it much, much more worth the splurge. There’s also no new models planned for the Kindle Scribe line, so you don’t have to worry you’ll want the new model coming out.
paras.zh: 在我看来，这太多了，尤其是仅仅添加颜色。但如果你决定用颜色来协调你的笔记和亮点，那么现在就是购买的最佳时机，因为 Kindle Scribe Colorsoft 现在有很大的折扣，这使得它更值得挥霍。 Kindle Scribe 系列也没有计划推出新型号，因此您不必担心您会希望新型号问世。

paras.en: If I were shopping for a Kindle for a kid, this is the one I’d get during Amazon’s sale event. Kids’ books use color much more often than adult books, so I feel they’re better suited to getting a Colorsoft than we grown-ups. Plus, the Kindle Colorsoft Kids comes with a full year of Kids+ content, which is like Kindle Unlimited but for kids, while the other on-sale Kids models only come with six months. It also comes with a fun cover designed with kids in mind and to help it survive the inevitable drops.
paras.zh: 如果我要为孩子购买 Kindle，这就是我在亚马逊促销活动期间购买的一款。儿童书籍比成人书籍更频繁地使用颜色，所以我觉得他们比我们成年人更适合使用 Colorsoft。另外，Kindle Colorsoft Kids 附带一整年的 Kids+ 内容，就像 Kindle Unlimited 一样，但针对儿童，而其他在售的 Kids 型号仅附带六个月。它还配备了一个有趣的外壳，专为儿童设计，可帮助其承受不可避免的跌落。

paras.en: New Kindle Kids versions are coming to match the new Kindles, but most kids won’t notice it’s not the newest one. This Kindle also went up in price in August, so this is the best time to buy if you want one.
paras.zh: 新的 Kindle Kids 版本即将与新的 Kindle 相匹配，但大多数孩子不会注意到它不是最新的。这款 Kindle 在 8 月份也涨价了，所以如果你想要的话，现在是购买的最佳时机。

paras.en: Other Recommended Kindles That Are on Sale
paras.zh: 其他在售的推荐 Kindle

paras.en: None of these Kindles are bad, and on sale is the best way to buy. I’ve liked all of these Kindles for different reasons, but the sales aren’t quite as good after the price hikes. Here’s a quick breakdown.
paras.zh: 这些 Kindle 都不错，打折是最好的购买方式。我出于不同的原因喜欢所有这些 Kindle，但价格上涨后销量不太好。这是一个快速细分。

paras.en: If you want the best e-reader Amazon makes, it’s the Kindle Paperwhite. The Paperwhite has a 7-inch screen with adjustable warm light, plus up to 12 weeks of battery life and snappy screen performance. There’s also the Signature version on sale, which has an auto-adjusting front light and wireless charging.
paras.zh: 如果您想要亚马逊制造的最好的电子阅读器，那就是 Kindle Paperwhite。 Paperwhite 配备 7 英寸屏幕，可调节暖光，电池续航时间长达 12 周，屏幕性能出色。还有 Signature 版本在售，它具有自动调节前灯和无线充电功能。

paras.en: The Paperwhite and Paperwhite Signature did raise in price in August, so the sale isn’t as good as it used to be; the Paperwhite was previously $160, so you’re still paying more even after the Amazon Prime Big Deals Day discount kicks in. This is still the time I’d recommend buying it, though, since $10 more is better than $40. The Paperwhite Signature has a much bigger discount, so I’d go for that one right now. As mentioned above, if you can swing an extra $20, I would also consider the previous version of the Colorsoft, which is currently on sale for $190.
paras.zh: Paperwhite和Paperwhite Signature在8月份确实涨价了，所以销量没有以前那么好； Paperwhite 之前的售价为 160 美元，因此即使在亚马逊 Prime Big Deals Day 折扣开始后，你仍然需要支付更多费用。不过，我仍然建议购买它，因为多 10 美元比 40 美元好。 Paperwhite Signature 有更大的折扣，所以我现在就买那个。如上所述，如果你可以多花 20 美元，我还会考虑以前版本的 Colorsoft，目前售价 190 美元。

paras.en: New versions of both the Paperwhite and Paperwhite Signature are also coming soon, with the Signature getting an aluminum backing and new colors, but then you’re stuck paying full price (and waiting on pre-order for now).
paras.zh: Paperwhite 和 Paperwhite Signature 的新版本也即将推出，Signature 具有铝制背衬和新颜色，但随后您就必须支付全价（并暂时等待预订）。

paras.en: I’m sad to say there isn’t a sub-$100 Kindle anymore, even during a major sale event like this one, but this Kindle is at least on sale for just over $100 instead of its hefty new price tag of $150. After Amazon raised its Kindle prices, the base Kindle went up $40, but it’s still a (very small) discount on the original price right now. It has a 6-inch screen and no warm light option, but it otherwise performs well and comes in a fun matcha green color.
paras.zh: 我很遗憾地说，已经没有低于 100 美元的 Kindle 了，即使是在像这样的大型促销活动中，但这款 Kindle 的售价至少刚刚超过 100 美元，而不是 150 美元的新标价。亚马逊提高 Kindle 价格后，基础版 Kindle 上涨了 40 美元，但目前仍比原价有（非常小的）折扣。它有一个 6 英寸的屏幕，没有暖光选项，但它在其他方面表现良好，并有有趣的抹茶绿颜色。

paras.en: It’s the cheapest Kindle you can get right now, though the new version (not on sale) is also available if you want to upgrade.
paras.zh: 这是你现在能买到的最便宜的 Kindle，不过如果你想升级的话，也可以购买新版本（不打折）。

paras.en: Amazon’s Kindle Kids takes a Kindle and gives it a few extras. You’ll get six months of Kids+, a subscription full of books designed for kids aged 3 to 12, plus a fun cover made for kids. You can technically turn on Kids mode with any Kindle, but it’s nice to get their own, especially when it’s on sale. It is on sale for barely under its original price before the August hikes, which is a bummer.
paras.zh: 亚马逊的 Kindle Kids 提供了 Kindle 并为其提供了一些额外功能。您将获得六个月的 Kids+ 订阅，其中包含专为 3 至 12 岁儿童设计的书籍，以及专为儿童设计的有趣封面。从技术上讲，你可以用任何 Kindle 打开儿童模式，但最好能拥有自己的，尤其是在打折的时候。它的售价仅低于八月涨价前的原价，这真是令人失望。

paras.en: This pillow stand holder is made for tablets, but Kindles fit just as nicely into the prongs so you can read hands-free. There's two containers in the holder that I like using for my phone and my mug of tea, but you could also stick a bag or bowl of snacks in there for reading sustenance.
paras.zh: 这款枕头支架专为平板电脑设计，但 Kindle 也同样适合插脚，因此您可以免提阅读。支架上有两个容器，我喜欢用它们来装手机和茶杯，但你也可以在里面放一袋或一碗零食作为阅读食物。

paras.en: If you wish holding your e-reader was easier but aren't a fan of PopSockets, these e-reader straps from Strapsicle are easy to snap on and off any e-reader, Kindle or not. I love the fun colors they come in and how comfy they are to secure to my hand.
paras.zh: 如果您希望更轻松地握住电子阅读器，但不喜欢 PopSockets，这些来自 Strapsicle 的电子阅读器背带可轻松扣在任何电子阅读器（无论是否为 Kindle）上。我喜欢它们有趣的颜色，也喜欢它们握在手上的舒适感。

paras.en: If you're worried about scratching your Kindle in a bag or backpack, I love this shell Kindle case that protects your e-reader with a hard shell exterior. It has a soft interior side so that your Kindle's screen isn't subjected to the harder material.
paras.zh: 如果您担心放在包或背包中的 Kindle 被划伤，我喜欢这款 Kindle 外壳，它采用硬壳外壳保护您的电子阅读器。它具有柔软的内侧，因此您的 Kindle 屏幕不会受到较硬材料的影响。

paras.en: If you’re curious, here’s all the price changes we saw for Kindle devices at the end of August:
paras.zh: 如果您好奇，以下是我们在 8 月底看到的 Kindle 设备的所有价格变化：

paras.zh: - Amazon Kindle（2024 年，第 11 代）：150 美元（上涨 40 美元）

paras.zh: - Amazon Kindle Paperwhite Signature（2024 年，第 12 代）：250 美元（上涨 50 美元）

paras.zh: - 亚马逊 Kindle Colorsoft：290 美元（上涨 40 美元）

paras.zh: - Amazon Kindle Colorsoft Signature：320 美元（上涨 40 美元）

paras.zh: - 亚马逊 Kindle Kids（2024 年，第二代）：180 美元（上涨 50 美元）

articles.title: Jack White Criticizes Trump After Iran Remarks About L.A. & San Diego: ‘The Worst American of All Time’
articles.author: Alicia Urrea

paras.en: Jack White is speaking out after President Donald Trump made controversial remarks about Los Angeles and San Diego during a campaign rally in Nebraska.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统在内布拉斯加州的一次竞选集会上发表了有关洛杉矶和圣地亚哥的有争议的言论后，杰克·怀特发表了讲话。

paras.en: In an Instagram post on Tuesday (Oct. 6), the White Stripes co-founder directly addressed Republicans and conservatives living in the two Southern California cities, asking how they felt about Trump supposedly suggesting that Iran could attack them.
paras.zh: 在周二（10 月 6 日）的 Instagram 帖子中，这位白色条纹联合创始人直接向居住在南加州两个城市的共和党人和保守派人士发表讲话，询问他们对特朗普暗示伊朗可能袭击他们的看法有何看法。

paras.en: “Hey republicans and conservatives that live in L.A. and San Diego; how do you feel about your Fuhrer recommending that the cities you live in get attacked?” White wrote alongside a screenshot of Trump’s remarks. “Click the video I reposted and watch for yourself. Listen to the cult members CLAPPING and cheering for this.”
paras.zh: “嘿，居住在洛杉矶和圣地亚哥的共和党人和保守派人士；你对你的元首建议攻击你所居住的城市有何感想？”怀特在特朗普讲话的截图旁边写道。 “点击我转发的视频，亲自观看。听听邪教成员为此鼓掌欢呼的声音。”

paras.en: White then anticipated how Trump supporters would respond to his statement, writing, “Let me take a wild guess: it was a joke, owning the libs, insert cult rhetoric here, etc.”
paras.zh: 怀特随后预测了特朗普的支持者将如何回应他的声明，他写道：“让我大胆猜测一下：这是一个笑话，拥有图书馆，在这里插入邪教言论等等。”

paras.en: “The allegiance these people have to this corrupt felon is so laughable and ignorant,” he continued. “That’s right, a U.S. ‘President’ that recommended that two major cities in our country be bombed because they don’t give total allegiance to his ego.”
paras.zh: “这些人对这个腐败重罪犯的效忠是如此可笑和无知，”他继续说道。 “没错，一位美国‘总统’建议轰炸我们国家的两个主要城市，因为它们不完全效忠于他的自我。”

paras.en: Trump made these remarks on Monday night (Oct. 5) during a campaign rally in Grand Island, Nebraska, while discussing the ongoing U.S. conflict with Iran and the impact of the war on prices. Trump described the economic consequences as “a small price to pay for keeping the world safe, keeping our country safe” before saying, “They can take out a city. Let them take out Los Angeles. Let them take out San Diego. This is a very small price to pay.” The crowd could be heard cheering following the comments.
paras.zh: 特朗普于周一晚间（10 月 5 日）在内布拉斯加州格兰德岛举行的竞选集会上发表了上述言论，同时讨论了美国与伊朗持续的冲突以及战争对价格的影响。特朗普将其经济后果描述为“为维护世界安全、维护我们国家安全而付出的微小代价”，然后说道，“他们可以摧毁一座城市。让他们摧毁洛杉矶。让他们摧毁圣地亚哥。这是一个非常小的代价。”评论后可以听到人群欢呼。

paras.en: The White House has pushed back on the interpretation of Trump’s remarks. Communications director Steven Cheung and the administration’s rapid-response accounts argued that Trump was discussing the potential threat Iran could pose if it were able to develop a nuclear weapon, rather than advocating for an attack on American cities.
paras.zh: 白宫对特朗普言论的解释进行了反驳。通讯主管史蒂文·张和政府的快速反应账户认为，特朗普正在讨论伊朗如果能够发展核武器可能构成的潜在威胁，而不是主张对美国城市发动袭击。

paras.en: White, however, rejected that framing in his post.
paras.zh: 然而，怀特在他的帖子中拒绝了这一框架。

paras.en: “Imagine any other President or elected official in history saying this,” he wrote. “False flag incoming anyone? Just wait till next month when he begins enacting illegal measures to not allow democracy at the polls to prevail when the right lose badly in the midterm elections.”
paras.zh: “想象一下历史上任何其他总统或民选官员都会这么说，”他写道。 “虚假信号即将到来？只要等到下个月，当右翼在中期选举中惨败时，他就会开始制定非法措施，不允许民主在民意调查中占上风。”

paras.en: “I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again: The Worst American of All Time,” he concluded, adding the hashtag #TWAAT.
paras.zh: “我以前说过，现在我还会再说一遍：有史以来最糟糕的美国人，”他总结道，并添加了#TWAAT 标签。

articles.title: Bruno Mars Soundtracks Lakers Star Ziaire Williams’ SoFi Stadium Proposal With Live ‘Marry You’ Performance
articles.author: Alicia Urrea

paras.en: There isn’t a more fitting song to propose to than Bruno Mars‘ “Marry You,” — and Los Angeles Lakers forward Ziaire Williams took full advantage of the timing.
paras.zh: 没有比布鲁诺·马尔斯的《嫁给你》更适合求婚的歌曲了，洛杉矶湖人队前锋齐艾尔·威廉姆斯充分利用了这个时机。

paras.en: During Mars’ Oct. 2 concert at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California, Williams got down on one knee and proposed to his longtime girlfriend, model Paris Timan, while the singer performed his 2010 wedding staple.
paras.zh: 10 月 2 日，Mars 在加利福尼亚州英格尔伍德 SoFi 体育场举行的音乐会上，威廉姆斯单膝下跪，向他交往已久的女友、模特帕丽斯·蒂曼 (Paris Timan) 求婚，同时这位歌手表演了他 2010 年婚礼上的主打曲目。

paras.en: As Mars sang “Marry You,” Williams presented Timan with a ring as confetti fell around the couple. Timan was visibly emotional as she said yes, and the newly engaged pair embraced as the crowd erupted. The couple also appeared on the stadium’s massive video screens during the celebration.
paras.zh: 当马尔斯唱着“嫁给你”时，威廉姆斯向蒂曼赠送了一枚戒指，五彩纸屑落在这对夫妇周围。蒂曼答应的时候显然很激动，这对新订婚的情侣在人群爆发时拥抱在一起。庆祝活动期间，这对夫妇还出现在体育场的巨大视频屏幕上。

paras.en: SoFi Stadium later shared footage of the proposal on Instagram, writing, “It really was a beautiful night,” followed by a teary-eyed emoji and a ring emoji.
paras.zh: SoFi Stadium 随后在 Instagram 上分享了求婚的片段，并写道：“这真是一个美丽的夜晚”，随后还发布了一个泪眼汪汪的表情符号和一个戒指表情符号。

paras.en: The heartfelt moment came during the second of Mars’ five shows at SoFi Stadium as part of his The Romantic Tour, which supports his fourth solo album, The Romantic. And while the proposal was quite the surprise to Timan, the soundtrack was about as on-the-nose as it gets.
paras.zh: 这个感人的时刻发生在 Mars 在 SoFi 体育场举行的五场演出中的第二场，这是他的浪漫巡演的一部分，该巡演支持了他的第四张个人专辑《浪漫》。虽然这个提议让蒂曼感到相当惊讶，但配乐却很吸引人。

paras.en: Released in 2010 as part of Mars’ debut album, Doo-Wops & Hooligans, “Marry You” became one of the singer’s most recognizable romantic songs. The track peaked at No. 85 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 2011 and has since become a fixture of wedding playlists and proposal videos.
paras.zh: 《Marry You》于 2010 年作为 Mars 首张专辑《Doo-Wops & Hooligans》的一部分发行，成为这位歌手最知名的浪漫歌曲之一。这首歌在 2011 年 Billboard Hot 100 排行榜上最高排名第 85 位，此后成为婚礼播放列表和求婚视频的固定曲目。

paras.en: More than 15 years later, Mars is still experiencing some amazing career moves. He continues to make an appearance on the charts despite being absent for almost a decade: The Romantic debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, which was his first solo release since 2016’s 24K Magic. Its lead single, “I Just Might,” also debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100, giving Mars his 10th leader on the chart and his first No. 1 debut.
paras.zh: 15 年多过去了，玛氏仍在经历一些令人惊叹的职业变动。尽管缺席近十年，他仍然继续出现在排行榜上：《The Romantic》首次亮相就在 Billboard 200 上排名第一，这是他自 2016 年的 24K Magic 以来的首张个人专辑。其主打单曲“I Just Might”也首次登上 Billboard Hot 100 排行榜第一名，这使得 Mars 在该排行榜上第十位领先，也是他的首次首秀。

paras.en: Mars has continued adding to that run with “Risk It All,” the opening track from The Romantic, while “Dance With Me” — the album’s closing track and music video that stars Karol G — debuted at No. 42 on the Hot 100.
paras.zh: Mars 凭借 The Romantic 的开场曲《Risk It All》继续为这一势头添砖加瓦，而专辑的片尾曲和由 Karol G 主演的音乐录影带《Dance With Me》首次亮相就在 Hot 100 排行榜上排名第 42 位。

articles.title: The Next Chapter of Spotify’s Audiobooks Speaks Volumes About Where the Streamer Is Heading
articles.author: Elizabeth Dilts Marshall

paras.en: “We’re building products that help people discover new books, that give them more chances to enjoy them, and that weave stories into every single part of their day, because nobody ever regrets time spent with a good book,” Smith said during a press briefing the company held on Monday (Oct. 5).
paras.zh: 史密斯在周一（10 月 5 日）公司举行的新闻发布会上表示：“我们正在开发的产品可以帮助人们发现新书，让他们有更多机会享受新书，并将故事融入他们一天中的每一个部分，因为没有人会后悔花时间读一本好书。”

paras.en: Page Match has “quickly become one of our most consistently used and highest performing product launches,” Owen Smith, Spotify’s global head of books, said at the May investor day. “We are creating healthy reading habits and high-value behavior that becomes even more powerful when it sits inside the broader Spotify ecosystem.”
paras.zh: Spotify 全球图书主管欧文·史密斯 (Owen Smith) 在 5 月份的投资者日表示，Page Match 已“迅速成为我们使用最频繁、表现最好的产品之一”。 “我们正在创造健康的阅读习惯和高价值行为，当它融入更广泛的 Spotify 生态系统时，它们会变得更加强大。”

paras.en: The company also shares data about audiobook consumption and marketing information with authors and publishers through Spotify for Authors. It has also invested in Spotify Audiobooks Selects, which gives independent authors the tools to make professional-grade audiobooks and offers an additional AI voice-over tool that uses ElevenLabs’ technology.
paras.zh: 该公司还通过 Spotify for Authors 与作者和出版商共享有声读物消费和营销信息的数据。它还投资了 Spotify Audiobooks Selects，该公司为独立作者提供制作专业级有声读物的工具，并提供使用 ElevenLabs 技术的额外 AI 配音工具。

articles.title: David Ellison (Again) Says He Plans to Combine HBO Max and Paramount+
articles.author: Anthony Maglio

paras.en: Perhaps Casey Bloys did not get the memo.
paras.zh: 也许凯西·布洛伊斯没有收到备忘录。

paras.en: On Tuesday, Skydance Chairman and CEO David Ellison told reporters that “long term,” he plans to “bring [HBO Max] and [Paramount+] together” as one streaming service.
paras.zh: 周二，Skydance 董事长兼首席执行官大卫·埃里森 (David Ellison) 告诉记者，“从长远来看”，他计划“将 [HBO Max] 和 [Paramount+] 整合在一起”作为一项流媒体服务。

paras.en: “It’ll take a period of time to do that,” Ellison said, referring to merging the two tech stacks. “So I think in the immediate you will see them operated separately.”
paras.zh: “这需要一段时间才能做到这一点，”埃里森在谈到合并这两个技术堆栈时说道。 “所以我认为你很快就会看到它们分开运作。”

paras.en: “Given the way AI technology and other things have progressed, we think we can actually accelerate how quickly we accomplish that goal,” he continued, adding that “bundling” the services will be available “in the relatively short term.”
paras.zh: 他继续说道：“鉴于人工智能技术和其他技术的进步，我们认为我们实际上可以加快实现这一目标的速度。”他补充说，“捆绑”服务将“在相对较短的时间内”实现。

paras.en: Ellison said he could not be more specific today on the bundle options.
paras.zh: 埃里森表示，他今天无法就捆绑选项提供更具体的信息。

paras.en: Just last week, Bloys, who will head up all of streaming at the combined Paramount/Warner Bros. Discovery, now simply called Skydance, said he believes HBO Max and Paramount+ will remain separate services with the option to be packaged together.
paras.zh: 就在上周，布洛伊斯将负责合并后的派拉蒙/华纳兄弟探索公司（现简称为 Skydance）的所有流媒体业务，他表示，他相信 HBO Max 和派拉蒙+仍将保持独立的服务，并可以选择打包在一起。

paras.en: “I would say that I don’t want to comment on what is going to happen or anything like that, but I would point to the HBO Max-Disney bundle, which has been very successful,” Bloys said at Bloomberg’s Screentime event.
paras.zh: 布洛伊斯在彭博社的 Screentime 活动上表示：“我想说，我不想评论即将发生的事情或类似的事情，但我会指出 HBO Max 与迪士尼的捆绑销售，它非常成功。”

paras.en: “So could you see something like that happening? That would make a lot of sense,” he asked and then answered.
paras.zh: “那么你能看到类似的事情发生吗？这很有意义，”他问道，然后回答道。

paras.en: Well, there’s a new plan, Casey. And actually, it’s kind of the old plan.
paras.zh: 好吧，有一个新计划，凯西。事实上，这是一种旧计划。

paras.en: In March, Ellison signaled to Wall Street that he plans to combine his main streamer with WBD’s.
paras.zh: 今年 3 月，埃里森向华尔街发出信号，表示他计划将自己的主播与 WBD 合并。

paras.en: Ellison reiterated that statistic at Tuesday’s press conference, adding that the instantaneous doubling (basically) in DTC subs allows Skydance to “compete with the Disneys and Netflixes and Amazons and anybody in the world.” (Tuesday was day one of operations for the new Skydance.)
paras.zh: 埃里森在周二的新闻发布会上重申了这一统计数据，并补充说，DTC 订阅人数的瞬时翻倍（基本上）使 Skydance 能够“与迪士尼、Netflix、亚马逊以及世界上任何一家公司竞争”。 （周二是新 Skydance 运营的第一天。）

paras.en: The HBO brand will continue to “operate with independence,” Ellison promised on the March call. “Casey [Bloys] and his team do absolutely a remarkable job at HBO. We do plan for that to be able to operate with independence, so that HBO can, candidly, do what it does incredibly well. Our viewpoint is HBO should stay HBO. They built a phenomenal brand. They are a leader in the space, and we just want them to continue doing more of it.”
paras.zh: 埃里森在三月份的电话会议上承诺，HBO 品牌将继续“独立运营”。 “Casey [Bloys] 和他的团队在 HBO 的工作绝对是出色的。我们确实计划能够独立运营，以便 HBO 能够坦率地把自己擅长的事情做得非常好。我们的观点是 HBO 应该保持 HBO 的风格。他们建立了一个非凡的品牌。他们是该领域的领导者，我们只是希望他们继续做得更多。”

articles.title: David Ellison Says He Doesn’t Have an Especially Close Relationship with Donald Trump
articles.author: Steven Zeitchik

paras.en: He sat at the Kennedy Center with Donald Trump, he attended a UFC fight on the White Lawn that his company streamed, he hosted a springtime dinner honoring the president and he just dined at a state dinner Trump hosted for Chinese President Xi Jinping that CNN was barred from. But David Ellison says he is not unusually close with Trump nor has he been playing politics in the last year as he sought to get a Warner Bros. deal approved.
paras.zh: 他和唐纳德·特朗普一起坐在肯尼迪中心，他参加了他的公司在白色草坪上直播的 UFC 比赛，他举办了一场向总统致敬的春季晚宴，他刚刚在特朗普为中国国家主席习近平举办的国宴上用餐，而 CNN 被禁止参加。但大卫·埃里森表示，他与特朗普关系并不异常密切，去年在寻求华纳兄弟交易获得批准时也没有玩弄政治。

paras.en: “We have a good relationship with this administration. We also had a good relationship with the Biden administration,” the Skydance chief told reporters Tuesday afternoon, also citing a “good relationship with Gov. Gavin Newsom.”
paras.zh: “我们与本届政府有着良好的关系。我们也与拜登政府有着良好的关系，”这位 Skydance 负责人周二下午告诉记者，并提到了“与州长加文·纽瑟姆的良好关系”。

paras.en: “It’s important to talk to everyone on both sides of the aisle,” he said. “We don’t want to politicize.”
paras.zh: “与两党的每个人交谈很重要，”他说。 “我们不想政治化。”

paras.en: The mogul was responding to a question at a press event on the Paramount lot — on the day his deal to buy Warner Bros. Discovery officially closed — on whether he believed he was unhealthily close to the Trump administration. Ellison cited the presence of other entertainment figures like Ari Emanuel and various tech execs at the UFC fight, though of course they have come under fire themselves for excessive coziness with the president. Trump, meanwhile, cited the Ellisons and larger team at Skydance as “terrific people” in Washington on Tuesday, according to a White House pool report. Earlier in the day, at a Town Hall on the Warners lot, Ellison also saluted Makan Delrahim, the former Assistant Attorney General at the Justice Department in Trump I. Delrahim helped guide Skydance through the regulatory process of the WBD acquisition.
paras.zh: 在他收购华纳兄弟探索公司的交易正式结束的当天，这位大亨在派拉蒙影城举行的新闻发布会上回答了一个问题，即他是否认为自己与特朗普政府的关系不健康。埃里森提到了阿里·伊曼纽尔（Ari Emanuel）等其他娱乐界人物以及 UFC 比赛中的各种科技高管的身影，尽管他们自己也因与总统过度融洽而受到批评。与此同时，根据白宫的一份报告，特朗普周二在华盛顿称赞埃里森夫妇和 Skydance 的更大团队是“了不起的人”。当天早些时候，在华纳大厦的市政厅，埃里森还向特朗普一世司法部前助理总检察长 Makan Delrahim 致敬。Delrahim 帮助指导 Skydance 完成了 WBD 收购的监管流程。

paras.en: Historically, media executives, at least in the C-suite, have tried to maintain good ties with both parties given how quickly the winds in Washington can shift. But that has become harder as both left-wing advocates have called on executives to take a stand while Trump, FCC chair Brendan Carr and others aligned with the administration have singled out entertainment leaders they don’t approve of.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，考虑到华盛顿风向的转变速度有多快，媒体高管，至少在最高管理层中，一直试图与双方保持良好关系。但这变得变得更加困难，因为两位左翼倡导者都呼吁高管表明立场，而特朗普、联邦通信委员会主席布伦丹·卡尔和其他与政府结盟的人则挑出了他们不认可的娱乐业领导人。

paras.en: While there has been much worry in press circles about the thumb that Trump could put on the scale at CNN after Ellison takes over, the mogul said that nothing about his track record should give people pause.
paras.zh: 尽管新闻界非常担心埃里森接任后特朗普可能会在美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）上大肆宣扬，但这位大亨表示，他的往绩记录不应让人们停下来。

paras.en: “We haven’t talked to any political party about news,” Ellison said, though that might depend on how the term “we” is defined — a Guardian report last November said Ellison’s father Larry, a major bankroller of the WBD deal, discussed with Trump the possibility of axing a pair of CNN hosts. David Ellison said Tuesday that any conversations with politicians have only been about how “we want to be in the truth business and the trust business.”
paras.zh: 埃里森表示，“我们还没有与任何政党谈论过新闻”，不过这可能取决于“我们”一词的定义。去年 11 月《卫报》的一篇报道称，埃里森的父亲拉里是 WBD 交易的主要出资人，他与特朗普讨论了解雇两名 CNN 主持人的可能性。大卫·埃里森周二表示，与政客的任何对话都只是关于“我们希望如何从事真相业务和信托业务”。

paras.en: The younger Ellison also said his trips to DC have been about working towards a federal film tax credit and cited his relationship with South Carolina senator Tim Scott (R) who has been pushing for the idea, even if Ellison’s role in the ongoing effort is debatable with much of the credit going to Hollywood ambassador Jon Voight, including from the White House itself.
paras.zh: 小埃里森还表示，他前往华盛顿的目的是为了争取联邦电影税收抵免，并引用了他与南卡罗来纳州参议员蒂姆·斯科特（右）的关系，后者一直在推动这一想法，尽管埃里森在正在进行的努力中所扮演的角色存在争议，因为大部分功劳都归功于好莱坞大使乔恩·沃伊特，包括来自白宫本身。

paras.en: Political backbiting wasn’t entirely far from Ellison’s mind, though. In a remark that seemed aimed at former Paramount controlling shareholder Shari Redstone as well as a bevy of Warner Bros. executives dating back to before the AT&T days, he said when asked about his acquisitions, “Let’s just set the table for a second and like zoom out to how we got here, right? With all the respect in the world to everybody that has existed at these companies prior, how we got here to a place where Paramount could be acquired and Warner Brothers could be acquired is the businesses didn’t disrupt themselves over a decade ago.
paras.zh: 不过，埃里森并没有完全想到政治诽谤。在这句话中，他似乎是针对派拉蒙前控股股东莎莉·雷石东以及华纳兄弟的一群高管（可追溯到 AT&T 时代之前），当被问及他的收购时，他说道：“让我们先把话题放一放，然后把镜头拉远，看看我们是如何走到这一步的，对吧？尽管全世界都对这些公司之前存在的所有人表示尊重，但我们如何走到了派拉蒙可以被收购、华纳兄弟可以被收购的地步，这是企业所不知道的。”十多年前就扰乱了自己。

paras.en: “They allowed Netflix to disrupt their business. They allowed Amazon Prime Video to come and disrupt their business. They they didn’t transform and they they held on to the past for too long, and you know it is a certainty that if you don’t disrupt your business, somebody else will do it.”
paras.zh: “他们允许 Netflix 扰乱他们的业务。他们允许 Amazon Prime Video 扰乱他们的业务。他们没有转型，他们太久没有改变过去，你知道，如果你不扰乱你的业务，其他人肯定会这么做。”

paras.en: He added, “I think if you’re being intellectually honest, you need to zoom out and to see that the symptoms of this go back a long time.”
paras.zh: 他补充道，“我认为，如果你在理智上诚实，你需要缩小范围，看看这种症状可以追溯到很长时间以前。”

articles.title: Spotify to Expand Audiobooks Offering to More Than 180 Markets
articles.author: Caitlin Huston

paras.en: Spotify is making a bigger push into audiobooks.
paras.zh: Spotify 正在加大力度进军有声读物领域。

paras.en: Starting now through the end of 2026, Spotify is expanding the offering from 22 markets to more than 180. The expansion will also introduce new catalogs in Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Polish and more, with more than 120 languages in total.
paras.zh: 从现在开始到 2026 年底，Spotify 正在将服务范围从 22 个市场扩大到 180 多个。此次扩张还将推出西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、波兰语等语言的新目录，总共超过 120 种语言。

paras.en: Spotify has not revealed full financials on the audiobooks segment. But in the past year, Spotify says monthly audiobook listeners grew close to 40 percent and listening hours climbed more than 30 percent, with more than 800,000 titles in the catalog.
paras.zh: Spotify 尚未透露有声读物业务的完整财务数据。但在过去的一年里，Spotify 表示每月有声读物听众增长了近 40%，收听时间增长了 30% 以上，目录中的图书数量超过 800,000 种。

paras.en: This is one of the newer segments to join Spotify, which has also been expanding from podcasting and music into fitness, in a push to increase customer stickiness and the time spent on the platform. Additionally, Spotify has been making a big push into AI, which will include allowing premium users to create their own AI-generated covers and remixes.
paras.zh: 这是加入 Spotify 的新细分市场之一，Spotify 也一直在从播客和音乐扩展到健身领域，以提高客户粘性和在平台上花费的时间。此外，Spotify 一直在大力推进人工智能领域，其中包括允许高级用户创建自己的人工智能生成的翻唱和混音。

paras.en: “Books change how we see the world, and the people in it. For a lot of people, audiobooks arehow they find their way back to reading, on the commute, on a walk, or at the end of a long day. Bringing audiobooks to more than 180 markets means millions more people can discover that, and authors and publishers can reach readers they’ve never been able to reach before,” said Owen Smith, VP of Audiobooks, Spotify.
paras.zh: “书籍改变了我们看待世界和世界上的人的方式。对于很多人来说，有声读物是他们在通勤时、散步时或漫长的一天结束后重新开始阅读的方式。将有声读物带到 180 多个市场意味着更多的人可以发现这一点，而作者和出版商可以接触到他们以前从未接触过的读者。”Spotify 有声读物副总裁欧文·史密斯 (Owen Smith) 说道。

articles.title: Luxury developers flocked to the 'Hamptons of Hungary' — but some projects are stalling

paras.en: When Anikó Woods and her husband were looking to buy a vacation home close to Lake Balaton in central Hungary, finding even a modest, rural place within their budget was difficult.
paras.zh: 当阿尼科·伍兹 (Anikó Woods) 和她的丈夫想在匈牙利中部巴拉顿湖附近购买一栋度假屋时，在他们的预算范围内找到一处朴素的乡村住宅也很困难。

paras.en: It was 2022, during what Woods described as the "height of the pandemic-era property boom." Hungarians flocked to the shores and uplands around Lake Balaton — central Europe's largest freshwater lake — sending prices rocketing.
paras.zh: 那是 2022 年，伍兹将其描述为“大流行时代房地产繁荣的顶峰”。匈牙利人涌向巴拉顿湖（中欧最大的淡水湖）周围的海岸和高地，导致价格飙升。

paras.en: The couple widened their search area and eventually bought a former winehouse where grapes had been stored and pressed, close to the town of Sümeg in the Balaton Highlands about 20 kilometers (12.4 miles) north of the lake.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇扩大了搜索范围，最终买下了一座前酒厂，那里曾储存和压榨葡萄，靠近巴拉顿高地的苏梅格镇，距离湖以北约 20 公里（12.4 英里）。

paras.en: Fast-forward a few years and property prices remain high, with the average transaction value of a vacation home reaching 744,000 Hungarian forints (about $2,303) per square meter in 2025 — an almost fourfold increase on 2018's price of less than 200,000 forints per square meter, according to data from real estate brokerage Otthon Centrum.
paras.zh: 房地产经纪公司 Otthon Centrum 的数据显示，几年后，房地产价格仍然居高不下，到 2025 年，度假屋的平均交易价值将达到每平方米 744,000 匈牙利福林（约合 2,303 美元），几乎是 2018 年每平方米不到 200,000 福林价格的四倍。

paras.en: Vacationing around the nearly 200km shoreline of Lake Balaton has been popular with Hungarians for generations. During the Communist era of 1949-1989, when international travel was tightly restricted, it served as the ultimate working-class escape, where trade unions provided members and their families with heavily subsidized, affordable holiday lodgings.
paras.zh: 几代匈牙利人都喜欢在巴拉顿湖近 200 公里的海岸线周围度假。在 1949 年至 1989 年的共产主义时代，国际旅行受到严格限制，它成为工人阶级的终极逃离，工会为成员及其家人提供高额补贴、价格实惠的度假住宿。

paras.en: As Hungary is landlocked, the lake is sometimes known as the country's internal sea, measuring nearly 80km long and about 14km wide at its widest point. Balatonfüred, one of its most popular vacation towns, is a one-and-a-half-hour drive from Budapest.
paras.zh: 由于匈牙利是内陆国家，该湖有时被称为该国的内海，长近 80 公里，最宽处约 14 公里。巴拉顿菲赖德是最受欢迎的度假小镇之一，距离布达佩斯仅一个半小时车程。

paras.en: While the southern shores are famous for family-friendly beaches, parts of the northern coast have evolved into what some dub the "Hamptons of Hungary." According to Woods, who runs the website How To Hungary, this scenic northern stretch is highly sought after for its "expensive second homes, excellent restaurants, vineyards, sailing and a recognizable summer social scene."
paras.zh: 虽然南部海岸以适合家庭入住的海滩而闻名，但北部海岸的部分地区已经演变成一些人所谓的“匈牙利汉普顿”。据运营“如何前往匈牙利”网站的伍兹介绍，这片风景优美的北部地区因其“昂贵的第二住宅、一流的餐厅、葡萄园、帆船运动和著名的夏季社交场所”而备受追捧。

paras.en: Head to Tihany, a peninsula on the lake's north shore, and you might pay as much as 2.45 million euros (about $2.78 million) for an apartment with three bedrooms and three bathrooms, according to a September listing on Sotheby's website. Otthon Centrum analyst Gábor Soóki-Tóth said Tihany is one of the most expensive places in Hungary to buy a vacation property — with prices outstripping those in the nation's capital.
paras.zh: 根据苏富比网站 9 月份的挂牌信息，前往湖北岸的蒂豪尼半岛，你可能要花高达 245 万欧元（约合 278 万美元）购买一套三间卧室和三间浴室的公寓。 Otthon Centrum 分析师 Gábor Soóki-Tóth 表示，蒂豪尼是匈牙利购买度假房产最昂贵的地方之一，其价格超过了该国首都。

paras.en: Sotheby's described the upscale villas around Lake Balaton as a "prime opportunity" for investment, with "opulent" estates available "often at a fraction of the cost of comparable properties in more established, albeit less unique, European luxury markets."
paras.zh: 苏富比将巴拉顿湖周围的高档别墅描述为投资的“绝佳机会”，“华丽”的庄园“通常价格仅为更成熟但不那么独特的欧洲奢侈品市场中同类房产的一小部分”。

paras.en: But it's a nuanced picture. Prices are cooling from the highs of 2025, with the average transaction value of a holiday home around Lake Balaton currently around 712,000 Hungarian forints per square meter, down 4.3% on last year, according to Otthon Centrum.
paras.zh: 但这是一幅微妙的画面。 Otthon Centrum 的数据显示，价格从 2025 年的高点开始降温，巴拉顿湖周边度假屋的平均交易价值目前约为每平方米 712,000 匈牙利福林，比去年下降 4.3%。

paras.en: While a scarcity of waterfront and panoramic plots and the increasing number of high-end developments in Balatonfüred and other lakeside towns are pushing prices upward, higher financing costs and a growing supply of new apartments are moderating the trend, said Soóki-Tóth.
paras.zh: Soóki-Tóth 表示，虽然海滨和全景地块的稀缺以及巴拉顿菲赖德和其他湖滨城镇的高端开发项目数量不断增加正在推高价格，但较高的融资成本和不断增加的新公寓供应正在缓和这一趋势。

paras.en: Challenging market conditions mean construction is yet to start at Grand Balaton, an upscale residential development in Balatonakarattya at the eastern end of the lake, about an hour's drive from central Budapest.
paras.zh: 充满挑战的市场条件意味着 Grand Balaton 的建设尚未开始，这是位于湖东端 Balatonakarattya 的高档住宅开发项目，距离布达佩斯市中心约一小时车程。

paras.en: Spread across 25,000 square meters, plans for the site include 100 apartments priced between about 135 million and 419 million Hungarian forints, with access to gardens, a swimming pool, wellness and fitness areas and a co-working space. Buildings are designed to stay below the level of the tree canopy, while parking will be underground, meaning the development will be largely car-free.
paras.zh: 该场地占地 25,000 平方米，规划包括 100 套公寓，售价约 1.35 亿至 4.19 亿匈牙利福林，可通往花园、游泳池、健康和健身区以及联合办公空间。建筑物的设计高度低于树冠，而停车场将位于地下，这意味着该开发项目将基本上禁止汽车通行。

paras.en: Some Grand Balaton plots have already been reserved, but development director Gabor Kadas said it's unclear when construction can begin. "We have every permit. We are ready to start the project when the market conditions are right," he said. And, as is the case in other parts of Europe, the real estate market in Hungary is cyclical. "These days, we are not on the sunny side of the cycle," Kadas said.
paras.zh: 大巴拉顿湖的一些地块已经被预留，但开发总监加博尔·卡达斯表示，目前尚不清楚何时可以开始施工。 “我们拥有一切许可。我们准备在市场条件合适时启动该项目，”他说。而且，与欧洲其他地区的情况一样，匈牙利的房地产市场是周期性的。卡达斯说：“如今，我们并不处于周期的阳光面。”

paras.en: In August, the Hungarian government moved against two private luxury developments around the lake, saying it would terminate their national economic priority status and give locals more of a voice in the future, according to a translation of comments by national assembly speaker Ágnes Forsthoffer on Facebook. The priority status allows developers to bypass local regulatory plans, according to Soóki-Tóth. "I expect that some of these projects will be completely stopped as a result of removing the designation," he said.
paras.zh: 根据国民议会议长 Ágnes Forsthoffer 在 Facebook 上的评论翻译，今年 8 月，匈牙利政府对湖畔的两个私人豪华开发项目采取了行动，称这将终止其国家经济优先地位，并在未来给予当地人更多的发言权。 Soóki-Tóth 表示，优先地位允许开发商绕过当地监管计划。他说：“我预计其中一些项目将因取消指定而完全停止。”

paras.en: For Gabriella Weisz, who has run real estate agency BalatonHomes for 15 years, some of the area around Balatonfüred is like a "little Monaco," with its mix of four- and five-star hotels, golf clubs, and activities like horse riding. But she said locals are being priced out. "It's almost a switch in people who live here. They are more like Budapest families — the husband is a lawyer, they moved here with their children, and he goes back to Budapest to work," Weisz said.
paras.zh: 对于经营房地产公司 BalatonHomes 15 年的 Gabriella Weisz 来说，巴拉顿菲赖德周围的一些地区就像一个“小摩纳哥”，这里有四星级和五星级酒店、高尔夫俱乐部以及骑马等活动。但她说当地人的房价太高了。 “这对住在这里的人来说几乎是一种转变。他们更像是布达佩斯家庭——丈夫是一名律师，他们带着孩子搬到这里，而他则回到布达佩斯工作，”韦兹说。

paras.en: Woods and her husband split their time between a small apartment in Budapest and their Balaton winehouse. There's a different kind of life for locals around the lake, she said, in comparison to the activities that attract well-off tourists. Some areas remain more traditional. "People grow grapes, cut wood, maintain their land and worry about the weather," she said.
paras.zh: 伍兹和她的丈夫在布达佩斯的一间小公寓和他们的巴拉顿酒庄之间度过了时光。她说，与吸引富裕游客的活动相比，湖边当地人的生活是不同的。有些地区仍然比较传统。 “人们种植葡萄、砍伐木材、维护土地并担心天气，”她说。

articles.title: Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva

paras.en: SINGAPORE — The technology that investors and governments are counting on to lift the global economy is also adding pressure that threatens growth, the head of the International Monetary Fund said, urging policymakers to stop delaying painful choices on debt.
paras.zh: 新加坡——国际货币基金组织(IMF)总裁表示，投资者和政府指望提振全球经济的技术也在增加威胁经济增长的压力，并敦促政策制定者停止拖延痛苦的债务选择。

paras.en: Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva told the audience at a Wednesday event in Singapore that artificial intelligence is "rapidly becoming a key driver of countries' relative fortunes in the world economy."
paras.zh: 董事总经理克里斯塔利娜·格奥尔基耶娃 (Kristalina Georgieva) 周三在新加坡举行的一次活动上对观众表示，人工智能正在“迅速成为各国在世界经济中相对财富的关键驱动力”。

paras.en: But the triple forces of AI advancement, soaring energy costs and record public debt are challenging the already "underwhelming" growth this decade.
paras.zh: 但人工智能进步、飙升的能源成本和创纪录的公共债务的三重力量正在挑战这十年来本已“平淡”的增长。

paras.en: "Love it, hate it, or fear it, AI is here," Georgieva said.
paras.zh: “喜欢它，讨厌它，或者害怕它，人工智能就在这里，”格奥尔基耶娃说。

paras.en: Speaking ahead of a series of IMF and World Bank annual meetings that kick off next week, Georgieva framed the global economy as being tugged in two directions at once: a "negative energy supply shock" from the war in the Gulf, now in its eighth month, and a "positive demand shock" from the AI investment boom. The combined effect, she said, is "highly uneven across the world."
paras.zh: 在下周开始的国际货币基金组织和世界银行一系列年度会议之前，格奥尔基耶娃表示，全球经济同时受到两个方向的拉动：海湾战争（目前已进入第八个月）带来的“负面能源供应冲击”，以及人工智能投资热潮带来的“正面需求冲击”。她说，综合影响“在世界各地非常不平衡”。

paras.en: On the upside, global AI investment as a share of GDP will reach, and likely exceed, the amounts that went into building the railroads, electricity grid, or telecommunications network. AI hardware and related technology products already account for more than a tenth of world goods trade, she said.
paras.zh: 从好的方面来看，全球人工智能投资占 GDP 的比重将达到并可能超过用于建设铁路、电网或电信网络的金额。她表示，人工智能硬件及相关技术产品已占世界货物贸易的十分之一以上。

paras.en: The IMF estimates that AI could add up to half a percentage point to annual world growth if done right. "Going from 3% to 3.5% over a decade — that is like adding an economy the size of ASEAN to the world economy," Georgieva said.
paras.zh: 国际货币基金组织估计，如果做得好，人工智能可以为世界年度经济增长增加半个百分点。格奥尔基耶娃表示：“十年内从 3% 升至 3.5%，这就像在世界经济中增加了一个东盟规模的经济体。”

paras.en: But the benefits are likely highly concentrated. The boom largely bypasses economies less involved in the global AI supply chain, "increasing the risk of widening economic inequality across the globe," she said.
paras.zh: 但好处可能是高度集中的。她表示，这种繁荣很大程度上绕过了参与全球人工智能供应链较少的经济体，“增加了全球经济不平等扩大的风险”。

paras.en: The boom also feeds the inflation worry that has dogged policymakers from the U.S. to Europe and Asia. "The AI building boom is inflationary," she said, as are energy and food shocks, tariffs and defense spending.
paras.zh: 经济繁荣还加剧了对通胀的担忧，这种担忧一直困扰着从美国到欧洲和亚洲的政策制定者。 “人工智能建设热潮会引发通货膨胀，”她说，能源和食品冲击、关税和国防开支也是如此。

paras.en: Oil prices have stayed above $100 per barrel as the Middle East conflict dragged on with few signs of a diplomatic off-ramp. Retail diesel prices also rose to record highs as refining capacity squeezed energy supplies.
paras.zh: 由于中东冲突持续不断，几乎没有出现外交缓和的迹象，油价一直保持在每桶 100 美元以上。由于炼油产能挤压能源供应，柴油零售价格也升至历史新高。

paras.en: That inflation pressure flows straight into bond markets, as bond yields in the U.S., Germany, and Japan have surged to their highest levels in decades. Ballooning long-term private bond issuance by AI-related borrowers also competes with governments for capital, although part of the rise may reflect expectations of faster growth, Georgieva said.
paras.zh: 随着美国、德国和日本的债券收益率飙升至数十年来的最高水平，通胀压力直接流入债券市场。格奥尔基耶娃表示，人工智能相关借款人不断增加的长期私人债券发行也与政府争夺资本，尽管增长的部分原因可能反映了对更快增长的预期。

paras.en: Global public debt is near its highest level since World War II and on track to soon exceed 100% of GDP, with advanced economies the "worst offenders," Georgieva said. For 17 years, governments had "a relatively easy ride" because interest rates stayed below growth rates. "Higher interest rates now put an end to that."
paras.zh: 格奥尔基耶娃表示，全球公共债务已接近二战以来的最高水平，并有望很快超过 GDP 的 100%，其中发达经济体是“最严重的罪魁祸首”。 17年来，由于利率一直低于增长率，政府的发展“相对轻松”。 “现在更高的利率结束了这种情况。”

paras.en: The interest-to-growth differential is now "much less favourable" and "set to climb higher," she said, which means the growth needed to reduce debt ratios without fiscal effort is now "out of reach in the near term."
paras.zh: 她表示，利率与增长的差距现在“更加不利”，并且“将会攀升”，这意味着在不采取财政努力的情况下降低债务比率所需的增长“在短期内是无法实现的”。

paras.en: The strain is already visible in Europe, where spreads over German bunds are widening not just for France and Italy but for Ireland, Portugal and others that had reduced debt and deficits after the euro-area crisis.
paras.zh: 这种压力在欧洲已经很明显，德国国债的利差正在扩大，不仅是法国和意大利，还有爱尔兰、葡萄牙和其他在欧元区危机后减少债务和赤字的国家。

paras.en: After a string of shocks that have ballooned public debt and most countries' fiscal deficits remained above pre-pandemic averages, "fiscal space is crying out for replenishment," Georgieva said.
paras.zh: 格奥尔基耶娃表示，在一系列冲击导致公共债务激增、大多数国家的财政赤字仍高于大流行前的平均水平之后，“财政空间迫切需要补充”。

paras.en: Georgieva also pointed to a financial stability risk in the AI boom itself. Strong corporate earnings are driving share prices and wealth effects, she said, but "should earnings fall short, however, hyperscaler leverage and large and growing global holdings of U.S. equities could turn a disappointment into a far-reaching shock."
paras.zh: 格奥尔基耶娃还指出人工智能繁荣本身存在金融稳定风险。她表示，强劲的企业盈利正在推动股价和财富效应，但“然而，如果盈利低于预期，超大规模杠杆率以及全球大量持有的美国股票可能会将失望变成深远的冲击。”

paras.en: Citing Amara's Law, which holds that people overestimate a new technology in the short run and underestimate it in the long run, she said it is "somewhere in the transition between today's AI building boom and tomorrow's arrival of AI's benefits that we will traverse the period of maximum risk."
paras.zh: 她引用了阿马拉定律，该定律认为人们会在短期内高估一项新技术，而从长期来看会低估它。她表示，“在今天的人工智能建设热潮和明天人工智能带来的好处之间的过渡阶段，我们将经历最大风险时期。”

paras.en: Georgieva said the first line of defense is regulation and supervision. "Now may be a good time for a prudently hawkish bias in many countries' monetary policy," she said.
paras.zh: 格奥尔基耶娃表示，第一道防线是监管。她表示：“现在可能是许多国家货币政策呈现审慎鹰派倾向的好时机。”

articles.title: Jaguar unveils $130,500 electric vehicle two years after controversial rebrand

paras.en: Luxury carmaker Jaguar has launched its new all-electric vehicle, two years after the famed British company's controversial rebrand prompted a social media backlash.
paras.zh: 豪华汽车制造商捷豹推出了新款全电动汽车，两年前，这家著名的英国公司备受争议的品牌重塑引发了社交媒体的强烈反对。

paras.en: The automotive manufacturer, which is owned by India's Tata Motors, unveiled the Type 01 model on Tuesday at an event in New York City, describing it as the "most technically advanced" and "most powerful and aerodynamic" Jaguar ever.
paras.zh: 这家隶属于印度塔塔汽车公司的汽车制造商周二在纽约市的一次活动中推出了 Type 01 车型，并将其描述为有史以来“技术最先进”、“最强大和空气动力学”的捷豹汽车。

paras.en: It marks a radical new direction for the company, which was criticized in November 2024 when it revealed a series of changes ahead of becoming a fully electric brand.
paras.zh: 它标志着该公司的一个全新方向，该公司在 2024 年 11 月因在成为全电动品牌之前透露了一系列变化而受到批评。

paras.en: Jaguar posted a 30-second clip on X at the time which featured several models in brightly colored clothing and marketing slogans such as "live vivid", "delete ordinary" and "copy nothing."
paras.zh: 捷豹当时在X上发布了一段30秒的剪辑，其中有几位穿着色彩鲜艳服装的模特，并打出“生动活泼”、“删除平凡”和“不复制”等营销口号。

paras.en: Notably, the ad did not feature a car or the company's traditional cat logo. Among those to criticize the ad was Elon Musk, with the owner of the X social media platform asking: "Do you sell cars?"
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，该广告没有展示汽车或该公司传统的猫标志。埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)是批评该广告的人之一，X社交媒体平台的所有者问道：“你卖汽车吗？”

paras.en: Jaguar sought to defend the ad campaign, telling Sky News at the time that the company wanted "to be bold and disruptive."
paras.zh: 捷豹试图为广告活动辩护，当时告诉天空新闻，该公司希望“大胆且具有颠覆性”。

paras.en: Italy's Ferrari and Britain's Bentley have also launched their first EV models this year, seeking to test wealthy buyer's appetite for going electric as luxury carmakers seek to compete with cheaper Chinese car brands.
paras.zh: 意大利的法拉利和英国的宾利今年也推出了首款电动车型，在豪华汽车制造商寻求与更便宜的中国汽车品牌竞争之际，试图测试富裕买家对电动汽车的兴趣。

paras.en: Jaguar's Type 01 has a starting price of £130,000 (roughly $172,000) in the U.K. and around $130,500 in the U.S., according to multiple media reports, which is significantly higher than previous comparable models.
paras.zh: 据多家媒体报道，捷豹 Type 01 在英国的起售价为 130,000 英镑（约合 172,000 美元），在美国的起售价约为 130,500 美元，明显高于之前的同类车型。

paras.en: The four-door "Grand Tourer" has an ultra-long bonnet, low roofline, frameless doors and a camera instead of a rear window. It has a range of up to 450 miles and can accelerate from 0-62 miles per hour in 3.2 seconds.
paras.zh: 这款四门“Grand Tourer”拥有超长引擎盖、低车顶线、无框车门和摄像头（而不是后窗）。它的续航里程可达 450 英里，0-62 英里/小时加速仅需 3.2 秒。

paras.en: The launch of the model comes as Jaguar Land Rover continues its recovery from a cyberattack that forced the company to halt production last year, and one month after JLR announced it would cut 4,000 jobs as part of a major cost-cutting drive.
paras.zh: 该车型的推出正值捷豹路虎去年因网络攻击而被迫停产的情况中恢复过来，一个月前捷豹路虎宣布将裁员 4,000 人，作为重大成本削减举措的一部分。

articles.title: How the brain uses memory to imagine what might have been

paras.en: A month ago philosopher Felipe De Brigard received a strange phone call. “Are you in a private place where you can have a private conversation?” the voice on the other end asked.
paras.zh: 一个月前，哲学家费利佩·德布里加德接到一个奇怪的电话。 “你们是在一个可以进行私人谈话的私人场所吗？”那头的声音问道。

paras.en: He was on a work retreat surrounded by colleagues. “Just say you need to talk about your taxes,” the caller said. De Brigard excused himself to find a private space, panicking the whole time about his taxes—but it was actually the MacArthur Foundation on the line. De Brigard had been awarded a prestigious “genius grant,” an $800,000 fellowship with no strings attached.
paras.zh: 他正在一次工作静修中，周围都是同事。 “只要说你需要谈谈你的税收，”来电者说。德布里加德借口找了一个私人空间，一直对他的税收感到恐慌——但实际上是麦克阿瑟基金会打来的。德布里加德获得了一项著名的“天才补助金”，这是一笔价值 80 万美元、无任何附加条件的奖学金。

paras.en: “I just was floored. And I had to put everything back together and walk back in like nothing happened,” says De Brigard, who is a professor at Duke University and originally from Bogotá, Colombia. He is only the second philosopher to be awarded the fellowship in the past 30 years.
paras.zh: 来自哥伦比亚波哥大的杜克大学教授德布里加德说：“我简直惊呆了。我必须把所有东西放回原处，然后像什么都没发生过一样回去。”他是过去 30 年来第二位获得该奖学金的哲学家。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: De Brigard would be the first to tell you that his recollection of that day may be flawed. As a philosopher and cognitive scientist, he studies the fallibility of memory. Our brains don’t work like digital cameras recording our experiences to a mental hard drive, he explains. We store only some parts of our experience—gestures, stories, the gist. When we go to retrieve those memories, our brains need to fill in the gaps.
paras.zh: 德布里加德会第一个告诉你，他对那天的记忆可能有缺陷。作为一名哲学家和认知科学家，他研究记忆的错误性。他解释说，我们的大脑不像数码相机那样将我们的经历记录到硬盘上。我们只存储我们经验的某些部分——手势、故事、要点。当我们去检索这些记忆时，我们的大脑需要填补空白。

paras.en: De Brigard’s research shows just how intertwined our brain’s memory is with imagination. We use some of the same mental machinery to reconstruct the past as we do to imagine the future—and to imagine what might have been.
paras.zh: 德布里加德的研究表明我们大脑的记忆与想象力是如何交织在一起的。我们使用一些相同的心理机制来重建过去，就像我们想象未来一样——想象可能会发生什么。

paras.en: Scientific American spoke with De Brigard about why false memories form, why we dwell on the roads not taken, how forgiveness influences memory and whether we should worry about artificial intelligence becoming conscious.
paras.zh: 《科学美国人》采访了德布里加德，探讨了错误记忆为何形成、我们为何沉迷于未曾走过的道路、宽恕如何影响记忆以及我们是否应该担心人工智能变得有意识。

paras.en: [An edited transcript of the conversation follows.]
paras.zh: [经过编辑的谈话记录如下。]

paras.en: What big question about memory first intrigued you?
paras.zh: 关于记忆的哪个大问题首先引起了您的兴趣？

paras.en: I had the huge fortune of being in grad school at a moment in which there were some massive discoveries in episodic memory, or our capacity to remember specific experiences from our past. In 2007 there were three papers that sort of solidified a hunch that the renowned psychologist Endel Tulving had in the 1980s, which was that our capacity to remember the past is also needed for thinking about the future. Tulving had a very famous case report with a patient known as K.C. with hippocampal amnesia. When you asked him to remember an event that happened in his life, he drew a blank. But if you asked him to think about what he was going to do, say, next Christmas, he also drew a blank. It’s not that his imagination was broken across the board—he could imagine lots of things—but things that were part of his personal trajectory, both from the past and the possible future, seemed to be impaired.
paras.zh: 我非常幸运，在读研究生的时候，我们在情景记忆，或者说我们记住过去特定经历的能力方面有了一些重大发现。 2007 年，三篇论文在某种程度上证实了著名心理学家恩德尔·图尔文 (Endel Tulving) 在 20 世纪 80 年代的预感，即我们需要记住过去的能力来思考未来。图尔文有一个非常著名的病例报告，患者名叫 K.C.患有海马失忆症。当你让他回忆生活中发生的一件事情时，他一片空白。但如果你让他想想明年圣诞节他要做什么，他也会一片空白。这并不是说他的想象力被全面打破——他可以想象很多事情——但他个人轨迹的一部分，无论是过去的还是未来的，似乎都受到了损害。

paras.en: So these three papers basically solidified this idea that the hippocampus and the network that we use for episodic recollection are deployed when we think about possible futures. Now, my question was, this is a very asymmetric way of thinking about personal time. When you remember the past, that’s what actually happened. But when you imagine the future, you’re imagining lots of possibilities, right? I started thinking, what if the same mechanisms are required to think about not only what actually happened but also what could have happened in the past? I call that episodic “counterfactual” thinking because it’s contrary to fact. And sure enough, we did a bunch of experiments, and we realized that the hippocampus is required for imaginations about possibilities that pertain to oneself.
paras.zh: 因此，这三篇论文基本上巩固了这样的观点：当我们思考可能的未来时，我们用于情景回忆的海马体和网络就会被部署。现在，我的问题是，这是一种非常不对称的思考个人时间的方式。当你回想起过去时，这就是实际发生的事情。但当你想象未来时，你会想象很多可能性，对吧？我开始思考，如果需要相同的机制不仅要考虑实际发生的情况，还要考虑过去可能发生的情况怎么办？我将这种情景称为“反事实”思维，因为它与事实相反。果然，我们做了一系列实验，我们意识到海马体对于对与自己有关的可能性进行想象是必需的。

paras.en: Why would memory and imagination would be entwined? Why would we evolve that way?
paras.zh: 为什么记忆和想象会纠缠在一起？为什么我们会这样进化？

paras.en: So, two things: The first one is that you cannot store absolutely every detail of every experience. This suggests your brain needs to employ some computational shortcuts when it’s trying to remember the past. By filling in those gaps at the time of retrieval with the most likely possibility, your memory system can actually be quicker and be more flexible and work online in a timely manner.
paras.zh: 因此，有两件事：第一件事是你无法绝对存储每次体验的每个细节。这表明你的大脑在尝试记住过去时需要采用一些计算捷径。通过在检索时以最可能的可能性填补这些空白，您的记忆系统实际上可以更快、更灵活并及时在线工作。

paras.en: The second reason is that you want your memory system and your imagination of possibilities to be highly connected. To use an expression that the philosopher Karl Popper used, we generate hypotheses so that they can die in our stead. We want to imagine alternative ways in which past events could have happened or might happen in the future to hedge future uncertainty. And if we have them really closely connected to our memory mechanisms, then we can store those mental simulations.
paras.zh: 第二个原因是你希望你的记忆系统和你对可能性的想象高度相连。用哲学家卡尔·波普尔（Karl Popper）用过的一句话来说，我们产生假设，以便它们可以代替我们消亡。我们想要想象过去事件可能发生或将来可能发生的替代方式，以对冲未来的不确定性。如果我们让它们与我们的记忆机制真正紧密相连，那么我们就可以存储这些心理模拟。

paras.en: There are so many pieces of fiction that exercise this kind of counterfactual thinking, exploring what might have happened—like the alternate history of The Man in the High Castle or even in rom-coms such as Sliding Doors. What do you make of our tendency to dwell on these stories?
paras.zh: 有很多小说都运用了这种反事实思维，探索可能发生的事情，比如《高堡奇人》的架空历史，甚至是《滑动门》等浪漫喜剧。您如何看待我们沉迷于这些故事的倾向？

paras.en: I think one of the reasons why fiction is so important in life is precisely because it allows you to inhabit those possibilities and learn from them. Sometimes I give this talk that that I call “The Moral Demands of Imagination.” I think that we are required to employ imagination in all sorts of different tasks in life, and sometimes there are moral demands to imagine things properly. Suppose that you are in jury duty, and they ask you to imagine what the defendant could have done in a particular situation. Suppose that the defendant is like me, a middle-aged Latino who moved to the U.S. in his 20s, and he did something wrong. If they asked me as a juror to imagine what this person could have done instead of what they did, I’m going to have a ton of experiences that I can draw from to generate that mental simulation. By contrast, if someone asks me, “Can you imagine what this Iranian woman in the 1920s would have done?” I have no idea what it would be like to be her. Absent the actual experience, the next best thing is to read about it.
paras.zh: 我认为小说在生活中如此重要的原因之一正是因为它让你能够体验这些可能性并从中学习。有时我会做这样的演讲，我称之为“想象力的道德要求”。我认为我们需要在生活中的各种不同任务中运用想象力，有时道德要求正确地想象事物。假设您担任陪审员，他们要求您想象被告在特定情况下会做什么。假设被告像我一样，是一个20多岁移居美国的中年拉丁裔，他做了错事。如果他们让我作为陪审员想象这个人可以做什么，而不是他们做了什么，我将有大量的经验可以用来生成心理模拟。相比之下，如果有人问我：“你能想象这位 20 年代的伊朗女性会做什么吗？”我不知道成为她会是什么样子。如果没有实际的经验，最好的办法就是阅读相关内容。

paras.en: We’ve been talking about the brain a lot like a computer—it runs computations and makes inferences based on probabilities, like large language models do. Is that a superficial similarity to you, or is there a deeper likeness between our brains and AI?
paras.zh: 我们一直在谈论大脑，就像计算机一样——它运行计算并根据概率进行推理，就像大型语言模型一样。这是与你表面上的相似之处，还是我们的大脑和人工智能之间有更深层次的相似之处？

paras.en: It is actually a really great question because it’s something that I myself have struggled with. Twenty years ago, when I first started thinking about the mind as sort of like the “software of the brain,” I was convinced. I was absolutely convinced that neurons really computed, that they were like biological microchips and that you could sort of reverse engineer the mind like you could a computer.
paras.zh: 这实际上是一个非常好的问题，因为这是我自己一直在努力解决的问题。二十年前，当我第一次开始将思维视为“大脑的软件”时，我深信不疑。我绝对相信神经元确实可以计算，它们就像生物微芯片，并且你可以像计算机一样对思维进行逆向工程。

paras.en: Someone who has influenced me quite a bit here is a philosopher called Mazviita Chirimuuta. She wrote an extraordinarily beautiful book called The Brain Abstracted. It made me think about how many idealizations [such as the brain as a computer] are super helpful, even if they’re wrong. I think computational models to explain, among other things, memory retrieval are extremely helpful. Whether the model is actually capturing what the neurons do, I don’t know, and I think it actually probably doesn’t. I don’t think that neurons are the only thing that matters for cognition. And I think the jury is still out as to whether neurons are actually computing or if it is best to think of neurons as computers. But many of the computational models that we have are extremely useful—in fact, they are part of the inspiration that we have for AI systems.
paras.zh: 对我影响很大的是一位哲学家，名叫马兹维塔·奇里姆乌塔 (Mazviita Chirimuuta)。她写了一本非常漂亮的书，名叫《大脑抽象》。这让我思考有多少理想化（例如大脑作为计算机）是非常有帮助的，即使它们是错误的。我认为解释记忆检索等问题的计算模型非常有帮助。我不知道该模型是否真正捕捉到了神经元的行为，而且我认为它实际上可能没有捕捉到。我不认为神经元是对认知唯一重要的东西。我认为，关于神经元是否真的在计算，或者是否最好将神经元视为计算机，目前还没有定论。但我们拥有的许多计算模型都非常有用——事实上，它们是我们对人工智能系统的灵感的一部分。

paras.en: You’ve written a lot about consciousness, including criticizing a leading theory as pseudoscience. What do you make of the claims about AI consciousness?
paras.zh: 你写了很多关于意识的文章，包括批评一种主流理论为伪科学。您如何看待有关人工智能意识的说法？

paras.en: This is interesting. Last semester I taught a class on consciousness and AI, and I didn’t have a view one way or another. I am a little bit more worried about whether AI could be agential, as in agency. In almost everything that we see in the world, agency and consciousness are highly correlated. We tend to think of them together, but I think that they are separable. And it has become pretty clear that there are many AI systems that seem to exhibit something like agency, and that is going to require a set of regulations and rules and ways of interacting with them that are going to be challenging. Whether or not they’re conscious is a little bit irrelevant to the decisions that we have to make right away regarding their agency. I think that that’s the more urgent question.
paras.zh: 这很有趣。上学期我教了一门关于意识和人工智能的课程，但我没有这样或那样的观点。我更担心人工智能是否可以像代理一样具有代理性。在我们在世界上看到的几乎所有事物中，能动性和意识都是高度相关的。我们倾向于将它们放在一起考虑，但我认为它们是分开的。很明显，有许多人工智能系统似乎表现出类似代理的东西，这将需要一套法规和规则以及与它们交互的方式，这将是具有挑战性的。他们是否有意识与我们必须立即就他们的机构做出的决定有点无关。我认为这是更紧迫的问题。

paras.en: That makes sense—you don’t need to get bogged down in most the “hard problem” of consciousness and phenomenology to address the urgent questions involving AI right now.
paras.zh: 这是有道理的——你不需要陷入意识和现象学的大多数“难题”来解决目前涉及人工智能的紧​​迫问题。

paras.en: Exactly. I don’t know how apt this comparison is, but I grew up with bullfighting in Colombia, and it seemed like an extraordinarily violent spectacle. Of course the bulls were suffering. But imagine we discover that in order to experience pain you need to have a particular pain receptor, and for whatever reason, the bulls are the only animals on Earth that don’t have it. The whole thing wouldn’t be less monstrous.
paras.zh: 确切地。我不知道这个比喻有多恰当，但我是在哥伦比亚的斗牛场长大的，那似乎是一种异常暴力的景象。当然，公牛队正在遭受痛苦。但想象一下，我们发现，为了体验疼痛，你需要有一种特定的疼痛感受器，而无论出于何种原因，公牛是地球上唯一没有这种感受器的动物。整件事也不会那么可怕。

paras.en: I think that it is very hard to separate consciousness and subjectivity from agency, and I think that a similar thing would be probably an exercise that we have to do to understand what to do with AIs that are becoming agents.
paras.zh: 我认为很难将意识和主观性与代理分开，而且我认为类似的事情可能是我们必须做的一个练习，以了解如何处理正在成为代理的人工智能。

paras.en: Speaking of Colombia, you are currently working on a research project, following the peace agreement reached 10 years ago, on memory and forgiveness with victims of political violence there. Is that what you’ll use the MacArthur Fellowship funds for?
paras.zh: 说到哥伦比亚，继十年前达​​成和平协议之后，您目前正在开展一个研究项目，研究该国政治暴力受害者的记忆和宽恕。这就是你要用麦克阿瑟奖学金的目的吗？

paras.en: Yes, I think that the majority of the award is going to go toward the memory and forgiveness project in Colombia. So far, the evidence seems to support what we call the emotional fading account: namely that forgiving helps us to modify the [emotional] reactions that we have toward the memories of wrongdoings, without necessarily making us forget the details of the event.
paras.zh: 是的，我认为大部分奖项将用于哥伦比亚的记忆和宽恕项目。到目前为止，证据似乎支持我们所说的情绪消退的说法：即宽恕可以帮助我们改变对错误行为记忆的[情绪]反应，而不一定会让我们忘记事件的细节。

paras.en: This is very important, especially in the context of postconflict Colombia, because we don’t want to forget what happened. And part of what we are showing is that forgiveness does not involve the forgetting of the memory but the emotional reappraisal of the original memory. Our goal with this award would be to continue that research and to try to explore now strategies in which we can employ emotional reappraisal techniques to bring people closer to forgive and reconcile. I am also profoundly interested in the hippocampus in the brain, and for me it’s still a big puzzle to try to understand exactly how this structure in the brain brings together both space and time. So I have a number of hypotheses and experiments that I want to conduct to try to fully understand the functioning of the hippocampus.
paras.zh: 这非常重要，特别是在哥伦比亚冲突后的背景下，因为我们不想忘记发生的事情。我们所展示的部分内容是，宽恕并不涉及记忆的遗忘，而是对原始记忆的情感重新评估。我们获得该奖项的目标是继续进行这项研究，并尝试探索现在可以采用情绪重新评估技术来使人们更接近宽恕与和解的策略。我对大脑中的海马体也非常感兴趣，对我来说，试图准确理解大脑中的海马体结构如何将空间和时间结合在一起仍然是一个大难题。因此，我想要进行一些假设和实验，以尝试充分了解海马体的功能。

paras.en: This might seem like an obvious question, but why is forgiveness a good?
paras.zh: 这似乎是一个显而易见的问题，但为什么宽恕是一件好事呢？

paras.en: I don’t think forgiveness is good all the time. I think that I think that forgiveness is a really efficient strategy to regulate your emotions and your reactive attitudes toward the perpetrators of past wrongdoings. In the case of Colombia, and in particular in the regions of Montes de María, which is where I work, because of the peace process, many of the perpetrators are coming back to live in the same communities with the same victims that they once victimized. It’s very important that we explore ways in which the emotions can be sort of mollified. Forgiveness is an extremely good way of doing that, but it’s not the only way, nor is it mandatory. That also respects the wishes of the participants that would like to have that emotional change without feeling that they need to forgive, because I do believe that there are unforgivable offenses.
paras.zh: 我不认为宽恕总是好的。我认为宽恕是一种非常有效的策略，可以调节你的情绪以及你对过去不当行为的肇事者的反应态度。就哥伦比亚而言，特别是在我工作的蒙特斯德玛丽亚地区，由于和平进程，许多肇事者又回到了同一个社区，与他们曾经迫害过的受害者在一起。探索可以安抚情绪的方法非常重要。宽恕是一种非常好的方法，但这不是唯一的方法，也不是强制性的。这也尊重了参与者的意愿，他们希望情感上发生变化，但又不想感到需要原谅，因为我确实相信存在不可原谅的冒犯。

paras.en: Where the science of forgiveness has been the most explored is actually in couples therapy. There is this clinician, Everett Worthington, who has a therapy called REACH with steps that people can follow. But it’s very different to forgive your spouse with whom you have had a relationship as opposed to, say, the commander of the battalion of the paramilitary group that killed your brother. You didn’t have a relationship with that person, and you don’t want to have a relationship later.
paras.zh: 宽恕科学得到最多探索的地方实际上是在夫妻治疗中。临床医生埃弗雷特·沃辛顿 (Everett Worthington) 有一种名为 REACH 的疗法，其步骤可供人们遵循。但是，原谅与你有过关系的配偶，与原谅杀害你兄弟的准军事组织的营长，是非常不同的。你和那个人没有发生过关系，以后你也不想再发生关系。

paras.en: Contrary to popular belief, forgiveness is not exactly a situation that occurs in a relationship of two, a perpetrator and a victim. Two of my co-investigators in Colombia, Pablo Abitbol and Santiago Amaya, they think that forgiveness in postconflict Colombia actually is a three-party relationship that involves the community as well. It’s part of an ongoing investigation to try to fully understand: Does forgiveness have different concepts depending on the relationship? Is it the same phenomena? That’s what we’re trying to figure out.
paras.zh: 与普遍看法相反，宽恕并不完全是发生在加害者和受害者两人关系中的情况。我在哥伦比亚的两位同事，巴勃罗·阿比特博尔（Pablo Abitbol）和圣地亚哥·阿马亚（Santiago Amaya），他们认为哥伦比亚冲突后的宽恕实际上是一种三方关系，也涉及社区。这是一项正在进行的调查的一部分，旨在试图充分理解：根据关系的不同，宽恕是否有不同的概念？是不是同样的现象？这就是我们想要弄清楚的。

articles.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Georg Nagel and Peter Hegemann for work on optogenetics

paras.en: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine is awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Georg Nagel and Peter Hegemann for their discoveries underpinning the field of optogenetics, the ability to control cells using light and genetics.
paras.zh: 2026 年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖授予 Karl Deisseroth、Georg Nagel 和 Peter Hegemann，以表彰他们在光遗传学领域的发现，即利用光和遗传学控制细胞的能力。

paras.en: Optogenetics allows scientists to use light to switch cells on and off. Using light-sensing proteins called rhodopsins, optogenetics enables precise targeting of cells, such as brain cells, to understand what they do.
paras.zh: 光遗传学使科学家能够利用光来打开和关闭细胞。利用称为视紫红质的光传感蛋白，光遗传学能够精确定位细胞（例如脑细胞），以了解它们的作用。

paras.en: The technique has revolutionized neuroscience by opening up the brain’s activity to scientists in ways previously impossible.
