paras.en: “Central Asia is the arena of a new ‘Great Game’ between Russia, China and the United States, and Washington is courting the region harder than at any point since the 1990s, chiefly for its critical minerals. Kazakhstan alone holds about half of the minerals the US classifies as critical, including uranium and tungsten,” he said.
paras.zh: “中亚是俄罗斯、中国和美国之间新‘伟大博弈’的舞台，华盛顿比 20 世纪 90 年代以来的任何时候都更加努力地讨好该地区，主要是因为其关键矿产。仅哈萨克斯坦就拥有美国归类为关键矿产的约一半，其中包括铀和钨，”他说。

paras.en: “Sanctioning a Central Asian government for buying fuel from Iran would push them straight back into closer ties to Russia and China,” he noted.
paras.zh: 他指出：“制裁从伊朗购买燃料的中亚政府将直接促使他们重新与俄罗斯和中国建立更密切的关系。”

paras.en: “What I would expect instead are targeted designations of individual traders, rail and logistics operators and smaller banks, combined with quiet pressure on the region’s correspondent banks. That alone is enough to raise the cost and slow the trade, but will come at the price of these countries redoubling their efforts to decouple economically and financially from the US.”
paras.zh: “我所期望的是针对个体贸易商、铁路和物流运营商以及小型银行的指定，同时对该地区的代理银行施加安静的压力。仅此一项就足以提高成本并减缓贸易，但代价是这些国家加倍努力在经济和金融上与美国脱钩。”

articles.title: Yemen’s Houthis attack Aden airport; Saudi forces down missile near Riyadh

paras.en: Two Houthi missiles target Yemen’s Aden International Airport
paras.zh: 两枚胡塞武装导弹袭击也门亚丁国际机场

paras.en: Yemen’s internationally recognised government has accused the Houthis of firing ballistic missiles and drones at the main international airport under its control, as Saudi Arabia said it had intercepted another missile north of its capital, Riyadh.
paras.zh: 国际公认的也门政府指责胡塞武装在其控制下的主要国际机场发射弹道导弹和无人机，而沙特阿拉伯则表示在其首都利雅得以北拦截了另一枚导弹。

paras.en: In a statement on Wednesday, the Ministry of Transport said the Houthis targeted the runway and passenger terminal at the airport with at least two ballistic missiles and several drones.
paras.zh: 交通运输部在周三的一份声明中表示，胡塞武装用至少两枚弹道导弹和几架无人机袭击了机场跑道和航站楼。

paras.en: “One of the missiles landed near the runway minutes before the Yemeni flight from Cairo was to land,” it said. “We cancelled the landing of the incoming flight from Cairo [in Egypt] and diverted its route to Jeddah [in Saudi Arabia] to protect the passengers.”
paras.zh: 声明称：“其中一枚导弹在从开罗起飞的也门航班降落前几分钟降落在跑道附近。” “我们取消了从（埃及）开罗起飞的进港航班的降落，并将其航线改道至（沙特阿拉伯）吉达，以保护乘客。”

paras.en: The ministry also said it evacuated the airport terminal and removed two planes from the tarmac during the attacks.
paras.zh: 该部还表示，袭击期间已疏散机场航站楼，并从停机坪上移走两架飞机。

paras.en: It added, “This incident could easily have turned a civilian flight into a horrific humanitarian disaster, claiming the lives of dozens of innocent people in an instant.”
paras.zh: 声明补充道，“这一事件很容易将一架民用航班变成一场可怕的人道主义灾难，瞬间夺走数十名无辜者的生命。”

paras.en: Aden airport is the main international gateway for parts of Yemen outside Houthi control in the city that has been the seat of the government since the takeover of the capital, Sanaa, by the Iran-supported group in 2014.
paras.zh: 亚丁机场是胡塞武装控制之外的也门部分地区的主要国际门户，自 2014 年伊朗支持的组织接管首都萨那以来，该市一直是政府所在地。

paras.en: The Houthis said in a statement they targeted “Saudi military supplies” arriving at the Badr camp near the airport with ballistic missiles. Saudi Arabia backs Yemen’s government.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装在一份声明中表示，他们用弹道导弹瞄准抵达机场附近巴德尔营地的“沙特军事物资”。沙特阿拉伯支持也门政府。

paras.en: Separately, the Saudi-led military coalition fighting in Yemen said it intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile, launched by the Houthis, north of Riyadh.
paras.zh: 另外，沙特领导的在也门作战的军事联盟表示，他们拦截并摧毁了利雅得北部胡塞武装发射的一枚弹道导弹。

paras.en: In a social media post, Major-General Turki al-Maliki, the spokesperson for the Saudi-led coalition, said it was tracking the launch platform used in the attack via an intelligence system over Sanaa, and promised to destroy it.
paras.zh: 沙特领导的联军发言人图尔基·马利基少将在社交媒体帖子中表示，他们正在通过萨那上空的情报系统追踪袭击中使用的发射平台，并承诺摧毁它。

paras.en: The Houthis said in statements on Tuesday and overnight into Wednesday that they had targeted Saudi international airports in Riyadh and Abha.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装在周二和周三夜间发表的声明中表示，他们的目标是利雅得和艾卜哈的沙特国际机场。

paras.en: The intensified fighting in Yemen comes amid mounting regional tensions set off by the US-Israel war on Iran. The Saudi-backed government forces launched a counteroffensive against the Houthis to retake the Red Sea port of Mocha and areas around the Bab al-Mandeb strait.
paras.zh: 也门的战斗加剧之际，美国和以色列对伊朗的战争引发了地区紧张局势加剧。沙特支持的政府军对胡塞武装发动反攻，夺回红海港口摩卡和曼德海峡周边地区。

paras.en: Fighting has concentrated in the southwestern province of Taiz.
paras.zh: 战斗集​​中在西南部的塔伊兹省。

paras.en: Al Jazeera’s Yousef Mawry, reporting from Sanaa, described “all-out battles to take over the ground, the highlands and the mountains east of Bab al-Mandeb”.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台记者尤瑟夫·莫里从萨那报道，描述了“为夺取曼德门以东的土地、高地和山脉而进行的全面战斗”。

paras.en: “It’s a battle to take over the strategic western part of Taiz, and whoever controls the wider vicinity will overlook the region and have dominant military control,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这是一场夺取塔伊兹西部战略地区的战斗，谁控制了更广泛的周边地区，谁就将俯瞰该地区并拥有主导的军事控制权。”

paras.en: “For the Yemeni government to take control of Mocha and the strategic bases and locations along the Red Sea coast, it first has to drive the Houthis off the mountains east of Mocha.”
paras.zh: “也门政府要控制摩卡以及红海沿岸的战略基地和地点，首先必须将胡塞武装赶出摩卡以东的山区。”

paras.en: Pakistan and Turkiye on Monday agreed to activate “deterrence measures” under their mutual defence pact with Saudi Arabia and rapidly deploy forces to the Gulf kingdom to counter Houthi attacks.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦和土耳其周一同意根据与沙特阿拉伯的共同防御协议启动“威慑措施”，并迅速向这个海湾王国部署部队，以反击胡塞武装的袭击。

articles.title: Francis Halzen wins Nobel Prize in physics for work on high-energy neutrinos from space
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Francis Halzen wins Nobel Prize in physics for work on high-energy neutrinos from space
paras.zh: 弗朗西斯·哈尔岑 (Francis Halzen) 因对太空高能中微子的研究而获得诺贝尔物理学奖

paras.en: STOCKHOLM — Francis Halzen won the Nobel Prize in physics on Tuesday for his contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and his discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin.
paras.zh: 斯德哥尔摩——周二，弗朗西斯·哈尔岑 (Francis Halzen) 因其对冰立方中微子观测站的贡献以及对天体物理起源的高能中微子的发现而获得诺贝尔物理学奖。

paras.en: "Francis Halzen has led an international team of researchers and engineers who have provided us with a fantastic instrument. His tenacity and scientific vision has paved the way for a new kind of astronomy," Mark Pearce, chair of the Nobel Committee for Physics, said in a news release.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔物理学委员会主席马克·皮尔斯在一份新闻稿中表示：“弗朗西斯·哈尔岑领导了一支由研究人员和工程师组成的国际团队，他们为我们提供了出色的仪器。他的坚韧和科学远见为新型天文学铺平了道路。”

paras.en: Halzen spoke to the committee by phone from Italy on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 哈尔岑周二在意大利通过电话与委员会进行了交谈。

paras.en: "It was a great surprise and I obviously didn't expect it," he said.
paras.zh: “这是一个很大的惊喜，我显然没有想到，”他说。

paras.en: Halzen said it was predicted before that he would win the Nobel Prize but the announcement still made him feel "strange."
paras.zh: 哈尔岑表示，之前就有人预测他将获得诺贝尔奖，但这个消息仍然让他感到“奇怪”。

paras.en: Born in Belgium, the 82-year-old scientist is affiliated with the University of Wisconsin–Madison in the U.S. Efforts by The Associated Press to reach him were not immediately successful.
paras.zh: 这位 82 岁的科学家出生于比利时，隶属于美国威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校。美联社联系他的努力并未立即成功。

paras.en: The IceCube Neutrino Observatory is a research facility located at the South Pole in Antarctica, according to its website, and the University of Wisconsin–Madison is its lead institution.
paras.zh: 据其网站称，冰立方中微子观测站是位于南极洲南极的一个研究设施，威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校是其领导机构。

paras.en: Neutrinos are tiny cosmic particles with a mind-bogglingly small mass. Yet they are everywhere: they spew from stars like the sun and trillions zip through our bodies every second.
paras.zh: 中微子是微小的宇宙粒子，质量小得令人难以置信。然而它们无处不在：它们从像太阳一样的恒星中喷出，每秒有数万亿的粒子穿过我们的身体。

paras.en: Scientists can't glimpse the mysterious ghost particles zooming around on their own. Instead, they measure what happens when the tiny particles collide with other bits of matter, producing flashes of light or charged particles.
paras.zh: 科学家们无法看到这些神秘的幽灵粒子自行四处乱窜。相反，他们测量微小粒子与其他物质碰撞时发生的情况，产生闪光或带电粒子。

paras.en: Halzen studied a rare gang of neutrinos that scientists consider messengers from the cosmos, offering clues to how the universe evolved.
paras.zh: 哈尔岑研究了一组罕见的中微子，科学家认为它们是来自宇宙的信使，为宇宙如何演化提供了线索。

paras.en: His research into capturing neutrinos at the South Pole dates back to the 1980s.
paras.zh: 他在南极捕获中微子的研究可以追溯到 20 世纪 80 年代。

paras.en: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences announced the award in Stockholm.
paras.zh: 瑞典皇家科学院在斯德哥尔摩宣布了该奖项。

paras.en: The prize money this year is 12 million Swedish kronor (about $1.2 million), whether for an individual, a small group of laureates or an organization.
paras.zh: 今年的奖金为 1200 万瑞典克朗（约合 120 万美元），无论是个人、一小群获奖者还是一个组织。

paras.en: Last year, three scientists won the Nobel Prize in physics for research on the strange behavior of subatomic particles called quantum tunneling that enabled the ultra-sensitive measurements achieved by MRI machines and laid the groundwork for better cellphones and faster computers.
paras.zh: 去年，三名科学家因研究亚原子粒子的奇怪行为（称为量子隧道效应）而获得诺贝尔物理学奖，量子隧道效应使 MRI 机器实现了超灵敏测量，并为更好的手机和更快的计算机奠定了基础。

paras.en: The announcements of this year's prizes began Monday with the Nobel Prize in medicine being awarded to three scientists whose work led to a tool that uses light to help unravel how the brain works.
paras.zh: 今年的奖项公布于周一开始，诺贝尔医学奖被授予三名科学家，他们的工作成果是开发出一种利用光来帮助揭示大脑工作原理的工具。

paras.en: This week's awards continue Wednesday with the chemistry prize and literature on Thursday. After Friday's peace prize is awarded, the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences will be announced on Monday.
paras.zh: 本周的奖项将于周三继续，化学奖和文学奖将于周四颁发。周五和平奖颁发后，诺贝尔经济学纪念奖将于周一揭晓。

paras.en: The prize money this year is 12 million Swedish kronor (about $1.2 million), whether for an individual, a small group of laureates or an organization.
paras.zh: 今年的奖金为 1200 万瑞典克朗（约合 120 万美元），无论是个人、一小群获奖者还是一个组织。

articles.title: What voters in 6 key states could tell us about the 2026 midterms
articles.author: Majd Al-Waheidi

paras.en: What voters in 6 key states could tell us about the 2026 midterms
paras.zh: 6 个关键州的选民可以告诉我们有关 2026 年中期选举的哪些信息

paras.en: Four weeks from now, the midterm elections will help decide the balance of power in Congress. And ahead of Election Day, Morning Edition will be traveling to six states with some of the most competitive races to hear what voters say is shaping their decisions.
paras.zh: 四个星期后，中期选举将有助于决定国会的权力平衡。在选举日之前，《早间版》将前往六个州进行一些竞争最激烈的竞选，以了解选民的意见如何影响他们的决定。

paras.en: We already have some clues about where voters stand. The latest NPR/PBS News/Marist poll found registered voters favor Democrats for Congress over Republicans by 12 percentage points. President Trump is also very much on voters' minds, with 45% saying their vote for Congress is a vote against him, compared with about a quarter who say they are voting to support him.
paras.zh: 我们已经掌握了一些关于选民立场的线索。最新的 NPR/PBS News/Marist 民意调查发现，登记选民对国会议员的支持率比共和党高出 12 个百分点。特朗普总统也深受选民的关注，45% 的人表示，他们对国会的投票就是对他的反对，而大约四分之一的人表示，他们投票支持他。

paras.en: Across the political divide, one concern keeps rising to the top: the cost of living and what it means for people's economic futures.
paras.zh: 在政治分歧中，有一个问题不断上升：生活成本及其对人们经济未来的影响。

paras.en: But this year, some of the forces driving those costs are coming from far beyond voters' own communities. The war with Iran is affecting prices at the gas pump. Tariffs imposed in Washington are reaching the checkout counter. Foreign policy, economic policy and household costs are becoming harder to separate.
paras.zh: 但今年，推动这些成本的一些力量远远超出了选民所在社区的范围。与伊朗的战争正在影响加油站的价格。华盛顿征收的关税即将到达收银台。外交政策、经济政策和家庭成本变得越来越难以分开。

paras.en: Republicans and Democrats are both campaigning on promises to make everyday life more affordable. But voters are weighing more than their bills. Immigration and the rapid growth of massive data centers are also part of the conversation. So is the voting process itself, including new restrictions that are raising questions about how ballots will be cast, secured and counted.
paras.zh: 共和党和民主党都在竞选时承诺让日常生活变得更加实惠。但选民权衡的不仅仅是他们的账单。移民和大型数据中心的快速增长也是讨论的一部分。投票过程本身也是如此，包括新的限制，这些限制引发了人们对如何投票、确保和计票的疑问。

paras.en: And in several of these states, another question hangs over the races: What do voters want from their own parties, and do old political loyalties still hold? Those are some of the questions that Morning Edition will take on the road, using the six states as a window into an electorate that is changing.
paras.zh: 在其中几个州，另一个问题悬而未决：选民想从自己的政党得到什么，旧的政治忠诚是否仍然存在？这些是《晨报》将在路上提出的一些问题，以这六个州为窗口，了解正在发生变化的选民。

paras.en: Steve Inskeep is reporting from North Carolina and Georgia, two closely watched Southern states. North Carolina has an open Senate seat and newly redrawn congressional districts. Georgia has competitive races for Senate and governor after several elections in which voters have backed candidates from both parties.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·英斯基普从北卡罗来纳州和佐治亚州这两个受到密切关注的南方州进行报道。北卡罗来纳州拥有一个空缺的参议院席位和新重新划分的国会选区。佐治亚州在多次选举后展开了参议院和州长竞选，选民都支持两党候选人。

paras.en: "I am watching and listening for people who feel this election is personal," Inskeep said.
paras.zh: 因斯基普说：“我正在观察和倾听那些认为这次选举是针对个人的人。”

paras.en: He wants to hear from people who feel directly affected by the Trump administration's changes to immigration, government, education, taxes, foreign policy and the economy.
paras.zh: 他希望听到那些感到特朗普政府在移民、政府、教育、税收、外交政策和经济方面的改革直接受到影响的人们的意见。

paras.en: "Trump is not on the ballot but has urged voters to act as if he is, and given the consequential acts of his administration, voters are likely to respond as if he is," Inskeep said.
paras.zh: 因斯基普说：“特朗普没有参加投票，但他敦促选民像他参加投票一样行事，考虑到他的政府采取的后续行动，选民可能会做出像他参加投票一样的反应。”

paras.en: Michel Martin is headed to Ohio and Michigan, where some of the biggest questions are about political change in the Midwest. Ohio has competitive races for governor and Senate against a backdrop of economic anxiety. In Springfield, Martin will also look at how the end of temporary protected status for Haitians is affecting a community where Haitian immigrants make up a significant share of the population — and whether disagreements over immigration are changing how voters see their own parties.
paras.zh: 米歇尔·马丁将前往俄亥俄州和密歇根州，那里最大的问题是中西部的政治变革。在经济焦虑的背景下，俄亥俄州州长和参议院的竞选竞争激烈。在斯普林菲尔德，马丁还将研究海地人临时保护身份的终止如何影响海地移民在人口中占很大比例的社区，以及移民问题上的分歧是否正在改变选民对自己政党的看法。

paras.en: Michigan offers a different set of tests. Trump won the state narrowly in 2024, when anger over the Biden administration's handling of the war in Gaza was a major issue for some voters, particularly in Michigan's Arab American communities. The state also saw a sharp increase in young-voter turnout. This year, an open Senate seat and a governor's race offer another chance to see whether those shifts are carrying into the midterms — and what role younger and Black voters are playing in the Democratic coalition.
paras.zh: 密歇根州提供了一套不同的测试。特朗普在 2024 年以微弱优势赢得了该州，当时对拜登政府处理加沙战争的愤怒成为一些选民的主要问题，尤其是密歇根州的阿拉伯裔美国人社区。该州年轻选民的投票率也急剧增加。今年，参议院席位的空缺和州长竞选提供了另一个机会，看看这些转变是否会延续到中期选举，以及年轻选民和黑人选民在民主党联盟中扮演什么角色。

paras.en: Martin calls Ohio and Michigan "two big consequential states that have always told us a lot about where the rest of the country is, and is going."
paras.zh: 马丁称俄亥俄州和密歇根州为“两个重要的州，它们总是告诉我们很多关于该国其他地区的现状和发展方向。”

paras.en: In Michigan, she will be asking what is driving voters after the state has chosen both Democrats and Republicans in key races.
paras.zh: 在密歇根州，她将询问该州在关键竞选中同时选出民主党人和共和党人后，是什么在推动选民。

paras.en: "Are they mad? Sad? Or just exhausted? We hope to find out," Martin said.
paras.zh: “他们生气了吗？悲伤？还是只是精疲力尽？我们希望找出答案，”马丁说。

paras.en: Leila Fadel is reporting from Maine, where a Senate race could help determine control of the chamber. Republican Sen. Susan Collins is seeking another term against Democrat Troy Jackson. Immigration and trade are also part of the political conversation there.
paras.zh: 莱拉·法德尔从缅因州报道，参议院竞选可能有助于确定参议院​​的控制权。共和党参议员苏珊·柯林斯正在寻求连任，以对抗民主党特洛伊·杰克逊。移民和贸易也是那里政治对话的一部分。

paras.en: "I want to know what drives voters and how much party loyalty still plays a role," Fadel said. "Are their votes up for grabs? Or are they locked in along party lines?"
paras.zh: 法德尔说：“我想知道是什么在推动选民，以及政党忠诚度在多大程度上仍然发挥着作用。” “他们的选票是可供争夺的吗？还是他们被锁定在党派界限内？”

paras.en: Maine's long border with Canada also gives the trade war a different dimension, as tariffs and tensions over cross-border trade affect businesses and communities with close economic ties to Canada. The state has also been affected by the Trump administration's immigration crackdown. Fadel said she will be asking voters what they want from their candidates — and whether the party delivering that message matters.
paras.zh: 缅因州与加拿大的漫长边境也给贸易战带来了不同的层面，因为关税和跨境贸易紧张局势影响了与加拿大有密切经济联系的企业和社区。该州也受到特朗普政府移民镇压的影响。法德尔表示，她将询问选民对候选人的期望，以及传达这一信息的政党是否重要。

paras.en: A Martínez is heading to Texas, where Republicans are testing whether recent gains among Latino voters will hold. The state's U.S. Senate race has also put Texas in the national fight over control of the chamber.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯将前往德克萨斯州，那里的共和党人正在测试最近在拉丁裔选民中取得的进展是否会持续下去。该州的美国参议院竞选也让德克萨斯州陷入了全国性的参议院控制权之争。

paras.en: Republicans redrew five congressional districts to favor the Republican Party in the midterms, including three with more Latino voters. Martínez said that this makes the party's strategy around Latino voters one of the questions he wants to examine.
paras.zh: 共和党人重新划分了五个国会选区，以在中期选举中支持共和党，其中三个选区拥有更多拉丁裔选民。马丁内斯说，这使得该党围绕拉丁裔选民的策略成为他想要研究的问题之一。

paras.en: "What's behind the Texas GOP's big bet on Latino voters, and will it help Republicans keep control of the U.S. Senate?"
paras.zh: “德克萨斯州共和党对拉丁裔选民的大赌注背后是什么？这会帮助共和党保持对美国参议院的控制吗？”

paras.en: Over the next four weeks, Morning Edition will report from races and electorates across the U.S., asking many of the same questions: What matters to voters now, what has changed and where is the country headed next?
paras.zh: 在接下来的四个星期内，早间版将报道美国各地的竞选和选民，询问许多相同的问题：现在对选民来说什么最重要，发生了什么变化以及国家下一步将走向何方？

articles.title: Dems have edge in midterms, poll shows. And, Paramount-Warner Bros. merger to close
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Dems have edge in midterms, poll shows. And, Paramount-Warner Bros. merger to close
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，民主党在中期选举中具有优势。并且，派拉蒙与华纳兄弟的合并即将完成

paras.en: In four weeks, Election Day will be here, and a series of new polls show Democrats have a decided advantage in the midterms. They are favored to win the House with a narrow majority. Democrats need 218 seats for a majority, and the Cook Political Report forecasts a net gain of five to 15 seats, which would give them between 220 and 230 seats in January. The Senate has shifted more dramatically. Six seats have moved toward the Democrats' direction since June, according to Cook's ratings. Initially seen as a long shot for Democrats, the Senate is now within reach. These projections come as President Trump's approval rating is low.
paras.zh: 四个星期后，选举日就到了，一系列新的民意调查显示民主党在中期选举中拥有明显的优势。他们有望以微弱多数赢得众议院。民主党需要 218 个席位才能获得多数席位，库克政治报告预测净增加 5 至 15 个席位，这将使他们在 1 月份获得 220 至 230 个席位。参议院的转变更为剧烈。根据库克的支持率，自 6 月份以来，已有 6 个席位向民主党方向倾斜。最初被认为对民主党来说希望渺茫，但现在参议院已经触手可及。这些预测是在特朗普总统的支持率较低之际做出的。

paras.en: - 🎧 Polls are just one factor to consider for the midterms, NPR's Domenico Montanaro tells Up First. He notes that people should consider the importance of history, the national environment, political structure and money as factors as well. And people still have to vote in the elections, but even so, the momentum seems to be shifting toward Democrats, particularly in the Senate. Democratic gains in the House are uncertain, as the party's unpopularity and the fact that 25 of the 31 targeted districts are in areas Trump won in 2024 could make it hard to tip the scales in their favor, Montanaro says.
paras.zh: - 🎧 民意调查只是中期选举需要考虑的因素之一，NPR 的多梅尼科·蒙塔纳罗 (Domenico Montanaro) 告诉 Up First。他指出，人们还应该考虑历史、国家环境、政治结构和金钱等因素的重要性。人们仍然必须在选举中投票，但即便如此，势头似乎正在转向民主党，尤其是在参议院。蒙塔纳罗表示，民主党在众议院的进展存在不确定性，因为该党不受欢迎，而且 31 个目标选区中有 25 个位于特朗普在 2024 年获胜的地区，这可能导致局势很难向对他们有利的方向倾斜。

paras.en: - ➡️ If you haven't registered to vote yet, it isn't too late. Here's what you need to know about registration in your state.
paras.zh: - ➡️如果您还没有登记投票，现在还不算太晚。以下是您需要了解的有关在您所在州注册的信息。

paras.en: - ➡️ Find the latest election news from NPR and your local station on the NPR app.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 在 NPR 应用程序上查找 NPR 和您当地电台的最新选举新闻。

paras.en: A new era in Hollywood is set to arrive today as David Ellison's long-anticipated $111 billion merger with Paramount-Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery is expected to close. Despite facing months of public protests, the deal has cleared legal and regulatory challenges in the U.S. and Europe. The media conglomerate Skydance unites two film studios, Paramount Pictures and Warner Bros. Pictures, both more than 100 years old.
paras.zh: 随着大卫·埃里森 (David Ellison) 期待已久的与派拉蒙·斯凯丹斯 (Paramount-Skydance) 和华纳兄弟探索频道 (Warner Bros. Discovery) 的 1,110 亿美元合并预计即将结束，好莱坞的一个新时代即将到来。尽管面临数月的公众抗议，该交易还是清除了美国和欧洲的法律和监管挑战。媒体集团 Skydance 联合了派拉蒙影业和华纳兄弟影业这两家拥有 100 多年历史的电影制片厂。

paras.en: - 🎧 Ellison defended the merger against critics concerned about him having too much media power, NPR's Mandalit del Barco says. As part of a settlement to move the deal forward, Ellison agreed to produce 30 films a year with the combined studios, but critics remain skeptical. Concerns also linger about CNN's future, given that Ellison is an ally of Trump. To address these worries, Ellison promised to establish an independent oversight board to protect CNN from political interference. People who don't agree with the deal predict that viewers may soon see an increase in cost for streaming services and they could have fewer choices, according to del Barco.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的曼达利特·德尔·巴科 (Mandalit del Barco) 表示，埃里森为合并进行了辩护，反对批评者担心他拥有过多的媒体权力。作为推进交易的和解协议的一部分，埃里森同意与合并后的工作室每年制作 30 部电影，但批评者仍然持怀疑态度。鉴于埃里森是特朗普的盟友，人们对 CNN 未来的担忧也挥之不去。为了解决这些担忧，埃里森承诺建立一个独立的监督委员会，以保护 CNN 免受政治干预。德尔巴科表示，不同意该协议的人预计，观众可能很快就会看到流媒体服务的成本增加，而且他们的选择可能会减少。

paras.en: Catherine Sweeney from NPR network station WPLN was one of seven media witnesses to observe Tennessee's failed execution of Christa Pike, the first woman to face the death penalty in the state in nearly 200 years. Each witness sensed that the lethal injection might not proceed smoothly. Pike's attorneys had requested the Tennessee Supreme Court to allow hanging instead due to concerns that her platelet disorder and small veins would make the injection painful and ineffective. Sweeney describes what she saw and heard throughout that day.
paras.zh: NPR 网络电台 WPLN 的凯瑟琳·斯威尼 (Catherine Sweeney) 是田纳西州对克里斯塔·派克 (Christa Pike) 处决失败的七名媒体目击者之一。克里斯塔·派克是该州近 200 年来第一位面临死刑的女性。每个目击者都感觉到注射死刑可能不会顺利进行。派克的律师请求田纳西州最高法院允许绞刑，因为担心她的血小板紊乱和小静脉会导致注射疼痛且无效。斯威尼描述了她这一天的所见所闻。

paras.en: Russian authorities are urging people to remain calm after a worker at an infectious diseases institute in Siberia died from a mysterious illness, raising speculation about a potential plague outbreak. Last Tuesday, a 28-year-old female lab worker at the anti-plague Research Institute in Irkutsk fell ill and died two days later. Questions remain over the cause of her death. Here's what we do and don't know.
paras.zh: 西伯利亚一家传染病研究所的一名工作人员死于一种神秘疾病，引发了人们对可能爆发鼠疫的猜测，俄罗斯当局敦促人们保持冷静。上周二，伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所一名28岁的女性实验室工作人员患病，两天后死亡。关于她的死因仍然存在疑问。这是我们所做的和不知道的。

paras.en: by Majd Al-Waheidi, Morning Edition and Up First digital editor
paras.zh: 作者：Majd Al-Waheidi，Morning Edition 和 Up First 数字编辑

paras.en: Four weeks from now, the midterm election will help decide the balance of power in Congress. And ahead of Election Day, Morning Edition will be traveling to six states with some of the most competitive races to hear what voters say is shaping their decisions.
paras.zh: 四个星期后，中期选举将有助于决定国会的权力平衡。在选举日之前，《早间版》将前往六个州进行一些竞争最激烈的竞选，以了解选民的意见如何影响他们的决定。

paras.en: Steve Inskeep is reporting from North Carolina and Georgia. Michel Martin is headed to Ohio and Michigan. Leila Fadel is reporting from Maine. And A Martínez is heading to Texas.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·英斯基普从北卡罗来纳州和佐治亚州报道。米歇尔·马丁将前往俄亥俄州和密歇根州。莱拉·法德尔从缅因州报道。马丁内斯正前往德克萨斯州。

paras.en: Across the political divide, one concern keeps rising to the top: the cost of living and what it means for people's economic futures.
paras.zh: 在政治分歧中，有一个问题不断上升：生活成本及其对人们经济未来的影响。

paras.en: But voters are weighing more than their bills. Immigration and the rapid growth of massive data centers are also part of the conversation. So is the voting process itself, including new restrictions that are raising questions about how ballots will be cast, secured and counted.
paras.zh: 但选民权衡的不仅仅是他们的账单。移民和大型数据中心的快速增长也是讨论的一部分。投票过程本身也是如此，包括新的限制，这些限制引发了人们对如何投票、确保和计票的疑问。

paras.en: Over the next four weeks, Morning Edition will report from different races and electorates across the country, asking many of the same questions: What matters to voters now, what has changed and where is the country headed next?
paras.zh: 在接下来的四个星期内，《早间版》将报道全国各地不同种族和选民的情况，并提出许多相同的问题：现在对选民来说什么最重要，发生了什么变化以及国家下一步将走向何方？

paras.en: So what will our hosts be listening for when Morning Edition hits the road? We asked them. Here are four things on their minds:
paras.zh: 那么，当早间版上线时，我们的主持人会收听什么内容呢？我们问他们。他们的想法有以下四点：

paras.en: Steve Inskeep: "I am watching and listening for people who feel this election is personal. By which I mean that, beyond their general opinion of the state of the country, they feel they were directly affected by the events of the past two years — the Trump administration's dramatic moves to reshape immigration, government, education, science, research, the military, emergency management, taxes, foreign policy and the economy at large.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·英斯基普：“我正在观察和倾听那些认为这次选举是针对个人的人。我的意思是，除了他们对国家状况的总体看法之外，他们认为自己受到过去两年事件的直接影响——特朗普政府重塑移民、政府、教育、科学、研究、军事、应急管理、税收、外交政策和整个经济的重大举措。

paras.en: Michel Martin: "Ohio is also a key location for the Trump administration's mass deportation campaign, as well as a leading industrial and logistics hub, a place where we should be able to see how the administration's economic policies are playing out. Trump isn't on the ballot, but his policies are. So let's see how that's going.
paras.zh: 米歇尔·马丁：“俄亥俄州也是特朗普政府大规模驱逐行动的关键地点，也是领先的工业和物流中心，在这里我们应该能够看到政府的经济政策如何发挥作用。特朗普没有在选票上，但他的政策却在。所以让我们看看情况如何。

paras.en: "Michigan was once considered a big part of the Democrats' 'Blue Wall,' but in recent years has chosen both Democrats and Republicans in key races. And the Democratic base has had beef with the national party. So what's driving voters? Are they mad? Sad? Or just exhausted? We hope to find out."
paras.zh: “密歇根州曾经被认为是民主党‘蓝墙’的重要组成部分，但近年来在关键竞选中同时选择了民主党和共和党。民主党基地与国家党之间存在矛盾。那么是什么驱使选民呢？他们是生气了吗？悲伤？还是只是精疲力尽？我们希望找出答案。”

paras.en: Leila Fadel: "The path to controlling the Senate in part runs through Maine, and that's why we're reporting in the state before the midterm elections. I want to know what drives voters, and how much party loyalty still plays a role. Are their votes up for grabs? Or are they locked in along party lines?"
paras.zh: 莱拉·法德尔：“控制参议院的道路部分经过缅因州，这就是我们在中期选举前在该州进行报道的原因。我想知道是什么驱动了选民，以及政党忠诚度仍然发挥着作用。他们的选票是可以争夺的吗？还是按照党派路线锁定？”

paras.en: "This is a state that's seen some of the worst of the immigration crackdown; a man was killed by ICE. It has one of the longest borders with Canada, and so the trade war hits differently. The Democratic candidate Troy Jackson is facing incumbent Susan Collins, who has won her state five times before. So, we'll be asking what people want from their candidate and if it matters which party that resonating message comes from."
paras.zh: “这个州经历了最严重的移民镇压；一名男子被 ICE 杀害。该州与加拿大有最长的边境之一，因此贸易战的打击有所不同。民主党候选人特洛伊·杰克逊面对的是现任议员苏珊·柯林斯，她之前曾五次赢得该州。因此，我们将询问人们希望从他们的候选人那里得到什么，以及产生共鸣的信息来自哪个政党是否重要。”

paras.en: A Martínez: "Texas Republicans gerrymandered five congressional districts to favor the GOP in the upcoming midterms. In three of them, the new maps created more Latino voters."
paras.zh: A 马丁内斯：“德克萨斯州共和党人在即将到来的中期选举中对五个国会选区进行不公正划分，以支持共和党。在其中三个选区中，新地图创造了更多的拉丁裔选民。”

paras.en: "What's behind the Texas GOP's big bet on Latino voters, and will it help Republicans keep control of the U.S. Senate?"
paras.zh: “德克萨斯州共和党对拉丁裔选民的大赌注背后是什么？这会帮助共和党保持对美国参议院的控制吗？”

paras.en: A new NPR series is taking readers and listeners to breakfast tables around the world. In Munich, Germany, a Bavarian breakfast typically consists of boiled veal sausage, sweet mustard and a giant pretzel, all washed down with beer. Demetrios Kyriakides, who spent a year researching Bavarian breakfast joints in Munich, says the ambiance of Gemütlichkeit, which describes conviviality, is just as important as the food. A meal is often accompanied by brass oom-pah-pah music. This feast is usually finished before the church bells ring at midday, signaling that all good things must come to an end. Check out these photos of breakfast in Munich.
paras.zh: NPR 的新系列节目将带领读者和听众来到世界各地的早餐桌上。在德国慕尼黑，巴伐利亚早餐通常包括煮小牛肉香肠、甜芥末和一个巨大的椒盐卷饼，所有这些都与啤酒一起饮用。 Demetrios Kyriakides 花了一年时间研究慕尼黑的巴伐利亚早餐店，他表示，描述欢乐的 Gemütlichkeit 的氛围与食物一样重要。进餐时常常伴随着铜管乐。这个节日通常在中午教堂钟声敲响之前结束，这意味着所有美好的事情都必须结束。看看这些慕尼黑早餐的照片。

paras.en: - Under artistic director Robert Garland, Dance Theatre of Harlem is embarking on a new era by reviving its landmark 1982 production of Firebird for an international tour.
paras.zh: - 在艺术总监罗伯特·加兰 (Robert Garland) 的领导下，哈莱姆舞蹈剧院 (Dance Theatre of Harlem) 正在开启一个新时代，恢复其 1982 年里程碑式的作品《火鸟》(Firebird) 进行国际巡演。

paras.en: - Biologists at the University of Massachusetts Amherst have found what may potentially be the world's loudest birds, and they all live in Brazil. (via WBUR)
paras.zh: - 马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校的生物学家发现了可能是世界上声音最大的鸟类，它们都生活在巴西。 （通过 WBUR）

paras.en: - Scientist Olivia Sanderfoot wants to establish a new field called "smoke ecology," which studies the effects of wildfire smoke on wildlife and seeks ways to mitigate its impacts.
paras.zh: - 科学家奥利维亚·桑德福特希望建立一个名为“烟雾生态学”的新领域，该领域研究野火烟雾对野生动物的影响，并寻求减轻其影响的方法。

articles.title: Closer Mason Miller hits paternity list 45 minutes before the Padres' season is on the line

paras.en: San Diego Padres All-Star reliever Mason Miller will miss an elimination game against the Milwaukee Brewers after being placed on Major League Baseball’s paternity list ahead of Game 3 of the National League Division Series.
paras.zh: 圣地亚哥教士队全明星中继投手梅森·米勒在国家联盟分区系列赛第三场比赛之前被列入美国职业棒球大联盟的父亲名单，因此将错过对阵密尔沃基酿酒人队的淘汰赛。

paras.en: Miller couldn't have picked a worse time to step away, leaving San Diego without its top bullpen weapon right before a win-or-go-home Game 3. The team placed him on the paternity list 45 minutes before the start of the game.
paras.zh: 米勒选择离开的时间再糟糕不过了，在第三场比赛之前，圣地亚哥队失去了牛棚的顶级武器。比赛开始前 45 分钟，球队将他列入了亲子鉴定名单。

paras.en: Under MLB’s postseason paternity rules, Miller is allowed up to three days off.
paras.zh: 根据美国职业棒球大联盟的季后赛亲子鉴定规则，米勒最多可以休息三天。

paras.en: The Pads plugged that hole by putting veteran lefty Wandy Peralta on the active roster. If San Diego somehow manages to keep its season alive, Miller gets his spot back whenever he returns.
paras.zh: 护卫队通过将老将左撇子万迪·佩拉尔塔纳入现役名单来填补这个漏洞。如果圣地亚哥以某种方式设法保持赛季活力，那么米勒无论什么时候回归都会重新获得他的位置。

paras.en: Baseball fans couldn't help but draw comparisons to Yankees starter Max Fried, who finds himself in the exact same boat. Fried is slated to pitch a crucial Game 3 with his girlfriend due any day, but he publicly confirmed he isn't skipping his start for anything. Seeing Fried post up for his team while Miller sits out an elimination game brought the debate over playoff priorities right to the forefront.
paras.zh: 棒球迷忍不住将其与洋基队首发马克斯·弗里德进行比较，后者发现自己也处于同样的境地。弗里德计划在任何一天与他的女友进行一场关键的第三场比赛，但他公开证实他不会因为任何事情而缺席首发。弗里德为球队打内线，而米勒则缺席一场淘汰赛，这让关于季后赛优先顺序的争论走到了最前沿。

paras.en: Making matters worse, Miller’s last act on Sunday was a total disappointment. Trusted to secure a six-out save in Game 2, he unravelled with two outs and two strikes in the ninth, giving up a walk-off single to Jackson Chourio.
paras.zh: 更糟糕的是，米勒周日的最后表现完全令人失望。他被认为能够在第二场比赛中挽救六出局，但在第九局却以两次出局和两次好球的成绩被击败，将一垒安打让给了杰克逊·乔里奥(Jackson Chourio)。

paras.en: Congratulations are in order for the new dad, but if San Diego gets eliminated, fans won't be in much of a mood to celebrate.
paras.zh: 恭喜这位新爸爸，但如果圣地亚哥被淘汰，球迷们就没有太多庆祝的心情了。

paras.zh: 将您的想法发送给我们：alejandro.avila@outkick.com / 关注 X：@alejandroaveela

articles.title: Man pleads guilty to 2023 killing of Lauren Heike on Phoenix hiking trail

paras.en: Zion Teasley has pleaded guilty to the 2023 murder of Lauren Heike, who was found dead with multiple stab wounds along a trail in north Phoenix.
paras.zh: 锡安·蒂斯利 (Zion Teasley) 承认 2023 年谋杀劳伦·海克 (Lauren Heike) 的罪名，她被发现死在凤凰城北部的一条小路上，身上有多处刀伤。

paras.en: Teasley entered the plea last Friday to first-degree premeditated murder, as well as a separate sexual exploitation of a minor charge stemming from conduct dating to 2019, according to the Maricopa County Superior Court. Under the plea agreement, Teasley is expected to be sentenced to natural life in prison, and prosecutors will withdraw their pursuit of the death penalty. His sentencing is scheduled for Dec. 4.
paras.zh: 据马里科帕县高等法院称，蒂斯利于上周五对一级预谋谋杀以及一项源自 2019 年行为的轻微指控进行了单独的性剥削认罪。根据认罪协议，蒂斯利预计将被判处自然终身监禁，检察官将撤回对死刑的追求。他的宣判定于 12 月 4 日进行。

paras.en: He was also charged with aggravated assault with a deadly weapon and first-degree burglary in 2020, but prosecutors voluntarily dismissed those charges last week as part of the plea agreement.
paras.zh: 他还被指控在 2020 年使用致命武器进行严重袭击和一级入室盗窃，但作为认罪协议的一部分，检察官上周自愿驳回了这些指控。

paras.en: In the aftermath of Heike's killing, a police report revealed that Teasley had been struggling with his sexuality and gender identity, ABC 15 said. Police previously said they believed Heike's killing was a random attack, and investigators found no prior communication between Heike and Teasley, according to the outlet. He was also a former Marine recruit who was separated from recruit training just months after enlisting in 2019, the outlet said.
paras.zh: 据 ABC 15 台报道，海克被杀后，警方的一份报告显示，蒂斯利一直在与自己的性取向和性别认同作斗争。据该媒体报道，警方此前表示，他们认为海克的杀戮是一次随机袭击，调查人员发现海克和蒂斯利之间事先没有任何联系。该媒体称，他也是一名前海军陆战队新兵，在 2019 年入伍几个月后就退出了新兵训练。

paras.en: "Our records indicate that Zion W. Teasley entered recruit training at Marine Corps Recruit Training Depot San Diego on March 25, 2019. He was separated June 17, 2019, prior to completing boot camp," the U.S. Marine Corps told the outlet.
paras.zh: 美国海军陆战队告诉媒体：“我们的记录显示，锡安·W·蒂斯利于 2019 年 3 月 25 日在圣地亚哥海军陆战队新兵训练站开始了新兵训练。2019 年 6 月 17 日，他在完成新兵训练营之前就被分开了。”

paras.en: When questioned by the police, Teasley said Heike appeared to be "what I would want to look like," according to the outlet.
paras.zh: 据该媒体报道，在接受警方询问时，蒂斯利表示海克似乎是“我想要的样子”。

paras.en: Investigators also uncovered a screenshot that they believed shed light on Teasley's state of mind. It read, "When I see a beautiful woman and I'm a man," ABC 15 said.
paras.zh: 调查人员还发现了一张截图，他们认为这张截图可以揭示蒂斯利的精神状态。 ABC 15 台写道：“当我看到一个美丽的女人时，我就是一个男人。”

paras.en: The outlet added that Teasley was fired from one of his jobs for being "aggressive toward female employees" and was "suspected of stealing merchandise."
paras.zh: 该媒体补充说，蒂斯利因“对女性员工具有攻击性”并“涉嫌盗窃商品”而被解雇。

paras.en: Heike was killed in April 2023 when a resident found her body along a community trail, officials said. She was found with 15 stab wounds and injuries to her hands and forearms, police reported.
paras.zh: 官员称，海克于 2023 年 4 月被杀，当时一名居民在社区小道上发现了她的尸体。警方报告称，她被发现身上有 15 处刀伤，手部和前臂也受伤。

paras.en: Investigators said DNA, surveillance video and cellphone location evidence linked Teasley to the crime.
paras.zh: 调查人员表示，DNA、监控视频和手机定位证据表明蒂斯利与这起犯罪事件有关。

paras.en: Heike's family said they had supported prosecutors' initial decision to seek the death penalty but ultimately agreed with the plea agreement, which ensures Teasley will spend the rest of his life in prison without the possibility of release.
paras.zh: 海克的家人表示，他们支持检察官最初寻求死刑的决定，但最终同意认罪协议，这确保蒂斯利将在监狱中度过余生，不可能获释。

paras.en: Based on the condition of Heike's clothes and officials finding her belongings scattered along the trail, investigators believe Heike was chased over a barbed wire fence during the attack.
paras.zh: 根据海克的衣服状况和官员发现她的物品散落在小道上，调查人员认为海克在袭击期间被追过铁丝网。

paras.en: "The suspect ran after Lauren and then sprinted away before returning to the location where Lauren's body was found and climbing over the barbed wire," Teasley's probable cause statement read.
paras.zh: 蒂斯利的可能原因声明中写道：“嫌疑人追赶劳伦，然后跑开，然后返回劳伦尸体被发现的地方，并爬过铁丝网。”

paras.en: Fox News Digital's Sarah Rumpf-Whitten contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道的莎拉·伦普夫-惠滕 (Sarah Rumpf-Whitten) 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Federal judge blocks Trump administration fines of up to $1.8M for migrants

paras.en: A federal judge has blocked the Trump administration's attempts to fine migrants up to $1.8 million for failing to leave the country after receiving final deportation orders.
paras.zh: 一名联邦法官阻止了特朗普政府对那些在收到最终驱逐令后未能离开美国的移民处以最高 180 万美元罚款的尝试。

paras.en: U.S. District Judge George O'Toole in Boston issued the ruling on Monday in response to a class-action lawsuit filed last year by two of the thousands of migrants who have received civil penalties from the Department of Homeland Security.
paras.zh: 波士顿的美国地区法官乔治·奥图尔周一做出了这项裁决，以回应去年受到国土安全部民事处罚的数千名移民中的两人提起的集体诉讼。

paras.en: The judge granted preliminary relief to the plaintiffs, finding that the administration's process for imposing the fines violated federal law, and that migrants in the "economically precarious position" of addressing the fines could be pushed into "insolvency."
paras.zh: 法官对原告给予了初步救济，认为政府征收罚款的程序违反了联邦法律，并且在处理罚款时处于“经济不稳定”的移民可能会陷入“破产”。

paras.en: "The plaintiffs live in an economically precarious position even without the imposition of the government’s exorbitant fines," he wrote.
paras.zh: “即使没有政府处以高额罚款，原告的经济状况也岌岌可危，”他写道。

paras.en: "They face the possible garnishment of their already modest wages, loss of any vehicles and homes, federal collections lawsuits and other adverse collateral consequences," O’Toole added. "If they were ultimately successful in this suit, there is no indication that simply requiring the government to vacate their fine notices would –– or even could, at that point –– make the plaintiffs whole or return the circumstances to the status quo."
paras.zh: 奥图尔补充道：“他们可能面临着本已微薄的工资被扣押、车辆和房屋损失、联邦征收诉讼以及其他不利的附带后果。” “如果他们最终在这场诉讼中胜诉，没有迹象表明仅仅要求政府撤销他们的罚款通知就能——或者甚至可以——让原告完整或让情况恢复原状。”

paras.en: O’Toole, an appointee of former President Bill Clinton, described how the plaintiffs worked for low salaries and had come to the U.S. to escape political violence.
paras.zh: 前总统比尔·克林顿任命的奥图尔描述了原告如何以低薪工作并来到美国逃避政治暴力。

paras.en: "Nancy M. was fined over $1.8 million," O’Toole wrote, referring to one of the plaintiffs. "She is a laborer working over 60 hours a week with two jobs, and she reports feeling serious anxiety affecting her ability to sleep, eat and live a normal life."
paras.zh: “南希·M. 被罚款超过 180 万美元，”奥图尔写道，指的是其中一名原告。 “她是一名工人，每周工作 60 多个小时，从事两份工作，她报告说，她感到严重的焦虑，影响了她的睡眠、饮食和正常生活的能力。”

paras.en: The judge also found that the administration's fine notices violated the Administrative Procedure Act by failing to provide specific allegations explaining why an individual's conduct warranted a penalty.
paras.zh: 法官还认为，政府的罚款通知违反了《行政程序法》，因为没有提供具体指控来解释为什么个人的行为需要受到处罚。

paras.en: Fox News Digital reached out to DHS for comment.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字媒体联系了国土安全部征求意见。

paras.en: As recently as July, DHS said it had issued more than 103,000 fines to migrants totaling about $84 billion since President Donald Trump returned to the White House in January 2025.
paras.zh: 就在 7 月，国土安全部表示，自唐纳德·特朗普总统 2025 年 1 月重返白宫以来，它已向移民开出了 103,000 多张罚款，总额约为 840 亿美元。

paras.en: DHS has defended the penalties, saying people who refuse to leave the country after receiving a final order of removal could face fines of $998 per day.
paras.zh: 国土安全部为处罚措施进行了辩护，称在收到最终驱逐令后拒绝离开美国的人可能面临每天 998 美元的罚款。

paras.en: Although Congress authorized civil penalties under the Illegal Immigration Reform and Immigrant Responsibility Act of 1996, no administration had attempted to impose the fines until Trump's first term.
paras.zh: 尽管国会根据 1996 年《非法移民改革和移民责任法案》授权了民事处罚，但在特朗普第一个任期之前，没有任何政府试图实施罚款。

paras.en: Last year, the Trump administration began imposing fines of $998 per day for migrants who did not leave the country following a final order of deportation. The fines have been imposed retroactively for up to five years, with a maximum penalty of $1.8 million.
paras.zh: 去年，特朗普政府开始对最终驱逐令后未离开美国的移民处以每天 998 美元的罚款。罚款可追溯执行长达五年，最高罚款为 180 万美元。

paras.en: In July 2025, DHS and the Department of Justice implemented changes aimed at streamlining the assessment of fines by scrapping a 30-day notice period and shortening the process for challenging penalties.
paras.zh: 2025 年 7 月，国土安全部和司法部实施了旨在简化罚款评估的改革，取消了 30 天的通知期并缩短了质疑处罚的流程。

paras.en: The plaintiffs successfully challenged that policy and what they described as an Immigration and Customs Enforcement policy of issuing fines using boilerplate forms without independently assessing whether a person's failure to leave was "willful" or "voluntary."
paras.zh: 原告成功地质疑了这项政策以及他们所说的移民和海关执法政策，即使用样板表格发出罚款，而没有独立评估一个人未能离开是“故意”还是“自愿”。

paras.en: O’Toole also found that the administration had failed to comply with rulemaking processes in implementing its streamlined fine-imposition process because it did not offer the public a chance to first comment on the policy change.
paras.zh: 奥图尔还发现，政府在实施简化的罚款程序时未能遵守规则制定程序，因为它没有为公众提供首先对政策变化发表评论的机会。

paras.en: Congressional lawmakers have attempted to challenge the administration’s fines against migrants through the Immigration and Nationality Act. Sens. Alex Padilla, D-Calif., and Dick Durbin, D-Ill., urged DHS and DOJ to pause the "improper application of certain civil penalties" in the law to "law-abiding immigrants."
paras.zh: 国会议员试图通过《移民和国籍法》质疑政府对移民的罚款。加利福尼亚州民主党参议员亚历克斯·帕迪拉（Alex Padilla）和伊利诺伊州民主党参议员迪克·德宾（Dick Durbin）敦促国土安全部和司法部暂停法律中对“守法移民”“不当适用某些民事处罚”。

articles.title: Naval drone hits oil tanker off Russian resort city Sochi, triggering massive blaze
articles.author: Guardian staff and agencies

paras.en: An oil tanker off Russia’s Black Sea coast was struck by a naval drone, triggering a huge fire and black smoke cloud that blanketed parts of the resort city of Sochi, Russia’s transport ministry has said.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯交通部表示，俄罗斯黑海沿岸的一艘油轮被一架海军无人机击中，引发大火和黑烟云，覆盖了度假城市索契的部分地区。

paras.en: The transport ministry said a Liberian-flagged tanker had been attacked and that “crude oil is burning openly in the waters of the Black Sea”.
paras.zh: 交通部表示，一艘悬挂利比里亚国旗的油轮遭到袭击，“原油正在黑海水域公开燃烧”。

paras.en: “Firefighting efforts will begin once the fire’s intensity has subsided and rescue vessels can safely approach the tanker,” the ministry said.
paras.zh: 该部表示：“一旦火势减弱并且救援船只可以安全接近油轮，消防工作就会开始。”

paras.en: A crew of 23 – all Indian citizens – had been rescued, it added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说，23 名船员——全部是印度公民——已获救。

paras.en: Russia and Ukraine have targeted commercial shipping around the Black Sea since the conflict began, and Russia has recently attacked grain vessels carrying Ukrainian goods near the coast of Romania.
paras.zh: 自冲突开始以来，俄罗斯和乌克兰一直将黑海周围的商业航运作为目标，俄罗斯最近还袭击了罗马尼亚海岸附近运载乌克兰货物的粮船。

paras.en: There was no comment from Kyiv on the attack.
paras.zh: 基辅没有对此次袭击事件发表评论。

paras.en: Videos and photos circulated on social media from Sochi – a popular Black Sea resort city of almost 500,000 people – showed bright orange flames out at sea and a thick column of black smoke billowing into the sky.
paras.zh: 索契是一座拥有近 50 万人口的黑海度假胜地，社交媒体上流传的视频和照片显示，海上出现明亮的橙色火焰，浓浓的黑烟滚滚冲上天空。

paras.en: Local officials restricted access to the coast and beaches.
paras.zh: 当地官员限制人们进入海岸和海滩。

paras.en: Elsewhere on Tuesday, Bulgaria’s prime minister said that two commercial vessels were had been struck by drones in the first attack on shipping in the Nato member’s exclusive economic zone in the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 周二，保加利亚总理表示，两艘商船被无人机击中，这是北约成员国黑海专属经济区航运的首次袭击。

paras.en: Bulgarian authorities said that the origin of the drones was under investigation, but Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy blamed Russia for the drone strikes. Bulgarian prime minister Rumen Radev condemned the attack.
paras.zh: 保加利亚当局表示，无人机的来源正在调查中，但乌克兰总统泽连斯基将无人机袭击归咎于俄罗斯。保加利亚总理鲁门·拉德夫谴责了这次袭击。

paras.en: After an emergency government meeting, Radev said: “This is an unacceptable attack in Bulgaria’s exclusive economic zone. It is a blatant violation of international law and maritime law.” Radev said after an emergency government meeting.
paras.zh: 拉德夫在紧急政府会议后表示：“这是对保加利亚专属经济区的一次不可接受的袭击。这是对国际法和海事法的公然违反。”拉德夫在一次紧急政府会议后说道。

paras.en: Sea and aerial drones attacked the ships about 80 miles (128km) off Bulgaria’s coast, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，海上和空中无人机袭击了距离保加利亚海岸约 80 英里（128 公里）的船只。

paras.en: Zelenskyy warned in his nightly address on Tuesday that a “massive strike” from Russia was likely to come, and in the early hours of Wednesday Kyiv was attacked.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在周二的晚间讲话中警告称，俄罗斯可能会发动“大规模袭击”，周三凌晨基辅遭到袭击。

paras.en: Russian strikes damaged buildings and warehouses across the Ukrainian capital, Kyiv’s mayor Vitali Klitschko said on Telegram.
paras.zh: 基辅市长维塔利·克里琴科在 Telegram 上表示，俄罗斯的空袭摧毁了乌克兰首都的建筑物和仓库。

paras.en: Agence France-Presse reported multiple explosions in Kyiv, and Reuters reported two people were killed by Russian strikes.
paras.zh: 法新社报道基辅发生多起爆炸，路透社报道称俄罗斯空袭造成两人死亡。

paras.en: A separate Russian strike on Ukraine’s south-eastern city of Dnipro damaged an industrial facility, officials said, without giving details.
paras.zh: 官员们称，俄罗斯对乌克兰东南部城市第聂伯罗的另一次袭击损坏了一座工业设施，但没有透露细节。

paras.en: Kyiv has been under increased attack as winter approaches, with Russian airstrikes targeting energy infrastructure, rail and road transport, including bridges that connect the city over the Dnipro river. Air raid sirens have sounded almost constantly day and night, urging residents to take cover in basements, shelters and subway stations.
paras.zh: 随着冬季的临近，基辅受到的攻击越来越多，俄罗斯的空袭目标是能源基础设施、铁路和公路运输，包括连接该市跨第聂伯河的桥梁。空袭警报几乎日夜不停地响起，敦促居民躲进地下室、避难所和地铁站。

articles.title: Former bishop sentenced to more than six years in prison for sexually abusing young Aboriginal men
articles.author: Australian Associated Press

paras.en: A former high-ranking Catholic known for hosting boozy parties will spend at least four and a half years behind bars for sexually abusing two young Aboriginal men.
paras.zh: 一名因举办酗酒派对而闻名的前高级天主教徒因性虐待两名年轻原住民男子而将入狱至少四年半。

paras.en: The ex-bishop of Broome Christopher Alan Saunders, 76, was found guilty of 13 sex offences after a jury trial in the West Australian district court.
paras.zh: 76 岁的布鲁姆前主教克里斯托弗·艾伦·桑德斯 (Christopher Alan Saunders) 在西澳大利亚地区法院陪审团审判后被判犯有 13 项性犯罪罪。

paras.en: The offending between 2008 and 2019 included one count of sexual penetration without consent and a dozen unlawful and indecent assault charges.
paras.zh: 2008 年至 2019 年间的犯罪行为包括一项未经同意的性侵罪名和十几项非法和猥亵攻击指控。

paras.en: Saunders was sentenced on Wednesday to six years and six months’ imprisonment.
paras.zh: 桑德斯周三被判处六年零六个月监禁。

paras.en: He will be eligible for parole after serving four years and six months.
paras.zh: 服刑四年零六个月后，他将有资格获得假释。

paras.en: Unless acquitted on appeal, the long-serving bishop would be the highest-ranking Catholic in Australia convicted of sexual abuse over his time as a member of the clergy.
paras.zh: 除非上诉后被无罪释放，否则这位长期任职的主教将成为澳大利亚在担任神职人员期间被判犯有性虐待罪的最高级别的天主教徒。

paras.en: The late Cardinal George Pell was found guilty in 2018 but later acquitted by the high court of raping one choirboy and molesting another in 1996.
paras.zh: 已故红衣主教乔治·佩尔 (George Pell) 因 1996 年强奸一名唱诗班男孩并猥亵另一名男孩，于 2018 年被判有罪，但后来被高等法院无罪释放。

paras.en: Saunders was acquitted by the jury of six other charges, including two counts of indecently dealing with a child over 16 under his authority and four counts of unlawful and indecent assault.
paras.zh: 桑德斯被陪审团宣判其他六项指控无罪，其中包括两项猥亵其管辖下的 16 岁以上儿童的罪名以及四项非法和猥亵攻击罪。

paras.en: He was acquitted of a further seven similar charges during the trial due to the lack of evidence.
paras.zh: 由于缺乏证据，他在审判期间另外七项类似指控被无罪释放。

paras.en: The sentence was backdated to August when Saunders was convicted and taken into custody.
paras.zh: 该判决可追溯到八月份，当时桑德斯被定罪并被拘留。

paras.en: Prosecutors said Saunders, known as Brother B by his victims, put on alcohol-fuelled parties at Catholic church-owned properties to get access to Aboriginal boys and men so he could sexually assault them.
paras.zh: 检察官称，被受害者称为 B 兄弟的桑德斯在天主教堂拥有的财产中举办酒精派对，以接触原住民男孩和男子，以便对他们进行性侵犯。

paras.en: “The accused had a sexual interest in young Aboriginal men and a tendency to act on that interest when the opportunity presented itself,” the prosecutor, Adam Ebell, previously told the court.
paras.zh: “被告对年轻的原住民男性有性兴趣，并且当机会出现时倾向于根据这种兴趣采取行动，”检察官亚当·埃贝尔此前告诉法庭。

paras.en: Saunders was ordained as the second Broome bishop in 1996 and presided over 13 schools and nine parishes before stepping aside in 2020 when the sex abuse claims became public.
paras.zh: 桑德斯于 1996 年被任命为布鲁姆第二任主教，负责主持 13 所学校和 9 个教区，随后在 2020 年性虐待指控公开后辞职。

paras.en: Pope Francis accepted his resignation a year later.
paras.zh: 一年后，教皇方济各接受了他的辞呈。

paras.en: A church probe into the retired clergyman’s activities was suspended when the West Australian police started investigating him.
paras.zh: 当西澳大利亚警方开始调查这位退休牧师时，教堂对他的活动的调查被暂停。

paras.en: It will restart now the trial has finished.
paras.zh: 现在审判结束后它将重新启动。

paras.en: “Its findings will inform decisions in Rome about Christopher Saunders’ position in the church,” archbishop Timothy Costelloe said in August.
paras.zh: 大主教蒂莫西·科斯特洛 (Timothy Costelloe) 在八月份表示：“其调查结果将为罗马有关克里斯托弗·桑德斯 (Christopher Saunders) 在教会中的地位的决定提供信息。”

paras.en: Costelloe said the jury’s guilty verdict concerned crimes “that violate the dignity and betray the trust of victims and survivors”.
paras.zh: 科斯特洛表示，陪审团的有罪判决涉及“侵犯受害者和幸存者的尊严并背叛信任”的罪行。

paras.en: “The victims, survivors and other witnesses who came forward showed great courage and resilience throughout a long and difficult process,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在漫长而艰难的过程中，挺身而出的受害者、幸存者和其他目击者表现出了巨大的勇气和韧性。”

articles.title: Coalition MPs concede immigration pledge not fully costed by independent watchdog
articles.author: Tom McIlroy Political editor

paras.en: Coalition MPs concede the party’s newly released immigration policy has not been costed in full by the Parliamentary Budget Office (PBO), despite Angus Taylor defending the plan as “budget neutral”.
paras.zh: 联盟党议员承认，议会预算办公室（PBO）并未完全核算该党新发布的移民政策的成本，尽管安格斯·泰勒（Angus Taylor）捍卫该计划为“预算中性”。

paras.en: Taylor, and the deputy Liberal leader, Jane Hume, have said repeatedly the Coalition “worked closely” with the independent budget watchdog on its plan to reduce net overseas migration to 100,000 for two years.
paras.zh: 泰勒和自由党副党魁简·休姆 (Jane Hume) 多次表示，联盟党与独立预算监管机构“密切合作”，计划在两年内将海外净移民人数减少到 10 万。

paras.en: Announced on Tuesday, the policy would see net overseas migration rates of 130,000 in the third year and 160,000 in the fourth.
paras.zh: 周二宣布的该政策将使第三年海外净移民人数达到13万，第四年达到16万。

paras.en: Business and the university sector have warned the cuts are arbitrary, dangerous for the economy and likely to exacerbate shortages in key sectors, including health and aged care.
paras.zh: 商界和大学部门警告说，削减是任意的，对经济来说是危险的，并可能加剧包括医疗和老年护理在内的关键部门的短缺。

paras.en: Taylor’s office said they planned to have the policy costed before the next federal election, but have used internal analysis and existing costings during the design process. Coalition sources told Guardian Australia the PBO had not conducted a full analysis of the new policy before its release.
paras.zh: 泰勒办公室表示，他们计划在下次联邦选举之前计算该政策的成本，但在设计过程中使用了内部分析和现有成本计算。联盟消息人士告诉澳大利亚卫报，PBO 在新政策发布前并未对其进行全面分析。

paras.en: PBO officials are not allowed to discuss costings for members of parliament but can choose to clarify references in media reports if they are incorrect or misrepresent PBO work.
paras.zh: PBO 官员不得讨论议会成员的成本计算，但如果媒体报道中的参考内容不正确或歪曲 PBO 的工作，则可以选择澄清这些内容。

paras.en: The PBO declined to comment on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 国会预算办公室周三拒绝发表评论。

paras.en: “We’ve been working closely with the Parliamentary Budget Office on analysis of our initiatives and we are confident that this package is budget neutral,” Taylor said announcing the plan on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 泰勒周二宣布该计划时表示：“我们一直在与议会预算办公室密切合作，分析我们的举措，我们相信该计划不会影响预算。”

paras.en: He said the Coalition had “done exactly what the government does” and then accused Labor of not releasing modelling.
paras.zh: 他表示联盟党“完全按照政府的做法行事”，然后指责工党没有公布模型。

paras.en: Labor and One Nation both want to bring down international arrivals, seeking to capitalise on growing anti-migration sentiment and pressure on housing and essential services.
paras.zh: 工党和一国党都希望减少国际入境人数，寻求利用日益高涨的反移民情绪以及住房和基本服务面临的压力。

paras.en: A policy document said the Coalition had worked with the PBO to assess “the impact of the package on the budget”, finding it would generate a small positive return.
paras.zh: 一份政策文件称，联盟党已与议会预算办公室合作评估“该计划对预算的影响”，发现它将产生少量的正回报。

paras.en: Challenged over the release of PBO costings on Wednesday, Taylor told Channel Nine: “We’ve released the outcomes of that budget analysis that we’ve been doing …
paras.zh: 泰勒对周三公布的 PBO 成本计算提出质疑，他告诉第九频道：“我们已经发布了我们一直在做的预算分析结果......

paras.en: “We have released the figures, and we’ve said it’s budget neutral, and we’ve laid that out.”
paras.zh: “我们已经公布了这些数据，我们已经说过它是预算中性的，我们已经把这一点列出来了。”

paras.en: The acting prime minister, Richard Marles, warned that the Coalition plan would hurt agriculture, aged care and even defence.
paras.zh: 代理总理理查德·马勒斯警告说，联盟党的计划将损害农业、老年护理甚至国防。

paras.en: “What we see from the Liberal party is actually policy chasing One Nation rather than policy in the national interest,” he said during a visit to Perth.
paras.zh: “我们从自由党看到的实际上是追逐一国的政策，而不是符合国家利益的政策，”他在访问珀斯时表示。

paras.en: “Immigration is absolutely central to this. We need to get the numbers right. We do need to manage them down. That’s what our government’s doing, but we need to do it in a way which can maintain our economy and maintain vital sectors like the defence industry here in Western Australia.”
paras.zh: “移民绝对是其中的核心。我们需要得到正确的数字。我们确实需要控制它们。这就是我们政府正在做的事情，但我们需要以一种能够维持我们的经济和西澳大利亚国防工业等重要部门的方式来做这件事。”

paras.en: Australian Chamber of Commerce and Industry boss, Andrew McKellar, rejected the planned cuts, arguing Australia had a housing supply problem, not an immigration problem.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚工商会主席安德鲁·麦凯勒(Andrew McKellar)拒绝了削减计划，他认为澳大利亚面临的是住房供应问题，而不是移民问题。

paras.en: “When we look at what the Coalition has said, even when we look at what the government and One Nation have said, the problem is each of them are starting from the proposal that they’re targeting a net overseas migration figure. That’s the wrong place to start.”
paras.zh: “当我们看看联盟党所说的话，甚至当我们看看政府和一国党所说的话时，问题是他们每个人都是从他们的目标是净海外移民数字的提案开始的。这是一个错误的起点。”

articles.title: A beautiful Himalayan bird is changing its voice due to human activity, research shows

paras.en: A sharp increase in human activity is having an impact on the way a Himalayan bird lives and communicates, two studies by Indian researchers have found.
paras.zh: 印度研究人员的两项研究发现，人类活动的急剧增加正在对喜马拉雅鸟类的生活和交流方式产生影响。

paras.en: The monal, a pheasant native to Himalayan mountain forests, is deeply woven into the region's cultural, folklore and identity. The eye-catching monal - the male has distinctive green, blue and copper feathers - is the state bird of India's Uttarakhand state and the national bird of Nepal, reflecting its cultural significance across the Himalayas.
paras.zh: 雉鸡是一种原产于喜马拉雅山森林的雉鸡，它深深地融入了该地区的文化、民俗和身份。引人注目的虹鳟——雄性拥有独特的绿色、蓝色和铜色羽毛——是印度北阿坎德邦的州鸟和尼泊尔的国鸟，反映了它在喜马拉雅山脉的文化意义。

paras.en: But studies show that infrastructure development and tourism are squeezing its habitat, while increasing noise is altering how it communicates with potential mates and rivals.
paras.zh: 但研究表明，基础设施发展和旅游业正在挤压它的栖息地，而不断增加的噪音正在改变它与潜在配偶和竞争对手的沟通方式。

paras.en: Researchers from Uttarakhand conducted two separate studies over five years which flagged key threats to the bird.
paras.zh: 来自北阿坎德邦的研究人员在五年内进行了两项独立的研究，指出了对这种鸟的主要威胁。

paras.en: One study found that the birds are forced to move higher in the mountains as their natural habitat in the alpine meadows above the tree line get crowded. The other says the monal is changing its pitch to cut through human noise in a busy valley.
paras.zh: 一项研究发现，由于林线以上高山草甸的自然栖息地变得拥挤，鸟类被迫向山上更高的地方迁移。另一个人说，在繁忙的山谷中，monal 正在改变音调，以消除人类的噪音。

paras.en: "These two studies give a useful warning for other more vulnerable species - if the monal is forced to change both its voice and its address, how are the more sensitive species responding?" says Vishal Singh, an environmental practitioner working on ecology and climate issues in the Himalayas.
paras.zh: “这两项研究为其他更脆弱的物种提供了有用的警告——如果虹鳟被迫改变声音和地址，更敏感的物种会如何反应？”致力于喜马拉雅山生态和气候问题的环境从业者维沙尔·辛格（Vishal Singh）说道。

paras.en: Dr Rajeev Lochan, lead researcher of both studies, told the BBC that they chose to study the monal as the bird has a narrow habitat range - it moves seasonally between the lower montane zone - an ecological belt found on the lower slopes of the mountains - and high-elevation alpine zones. This, he says, makes it a key indicator of ecosystem health in the north-western Himalayas.
paras.zh: 这两项研究的首席研究员 Rajeev Lochan 博士告诉 BBC，他们选择研究斑鸫鸟，是因为这种鸟的栖息地范围很窄，它会季节性地在低山地带（在山脉低坡上发现的生态带）和高海拔高山带之间迁徙。他说，这使其成为喜马拉雅山西北部生态系统健康的关键指标。

paras.en: "If the species is facing issues on this particular landscape, there might be a chance that the ecological disturbances are affecting other birds too," said Lochan.
paras.zh: 洛坎说：“如果该物种在这一特定景观上面临问题，生态干扰也有可能影响其他鸟类。”

paras.en: The monal, researchers say, can be seen as a stand-in for the health of a fragile Himalayan ecosystem pushed to a tipping point due to unregulated tourism and heavy urbanisation.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，莫纳尔可以被视为脆弱的喜马拉雅生态系统健康的替代品，该生态系统由于不受监管的旅游业和严重的城市化而被推向临界点。

paras.en: While the region has always drawn tourists, trekkers and researchers given its scenic landscape and biodiversity, rapid infrastructure expansion in the past decade has made more places accessible, increasing footfall and disrupting the wildlife. This, coupled with mounting human pressures, suggests that climate change is emerging as another major threat to the region's already vulnerable biodiversity.
paras.zh: 尽管该地区因其优美的景观和生物多样性而一直吸引着游客、徒步旅行者和研究人员，但过去十年基础设施的快速扩张使更多的地方变得更加容易到达，增加了人流量并扰乱了野生动物。再加上不断增加的人类压力，表明气候变化正在成为该地区本已脆弱的生物多样性的另一个主要威胁。

paras.en: "There are a lot of factors at play but at a broader level, the problem is that the economic development of the region is not aligned to its ecological integrity," Singh said.
paras.zh: 辛格说：“影响因素有很多，但从更广泛的层面来看，问题在于该地区的经济发展与其生态完整性不相符。”

paras.en: According to the first study, climate change is projected to continue shrinking and destabilising the Himalayan monal's habitat across the Indian Himalayas through 2100 under multiple climate scenarios.
paras.zh: 根据第一项研究，预计到 2100 年，在多种气候情景下，气候变化将继续缩小和破坏印度喜马拉雅山脉喜马拉雅单鱼的栖息地。

paras.en: Currently, the birds are found in alpine meadows, located high in the mountains above the forests, which form some of the Himalayas' most important seasonal grazing and biodiversity-rich habitats.
paras.zh: 目前，这些鸟类被发现在高山草甸中，这些草甸位于森林上方的高山中，形成了喜马拉雅山一些最重要的季节性放牧和生物多样性丰富的栖息地。

paras.en: The researchers modelled how climate change could shift the monal's suitable habitat across the Indian Himalayan region in the states of Uttarakhand and Himachal Pradesh. It was based on the kind of global climate models and emissions scenarios used for assessments by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), the UN's climate science unit.
paras.zh: 研究人员模拟了气候变化如何改变印度喜马拉雅地区北阿坎德邦和喜马偕尔邦的虹鳟适宜栖息地。它基于联合国气候科学部门政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）评估所使用的全球气候模型和排放情景。

paras.en: "These birds are now slowly moving upwards in the Himalayas as the snow is melting and vegetation is growing, making the area accessible to them. They are anyway being pushed upwards as their natural habitats in alpine meadows are being encroached upon by humans," Lochan said.
paras.zh: “随着积雪融化和植被生长，这些鸟类现在正在喜马拉雅山缓慢向上移动，使它们能够进入该地区。无论如何，由于它们在高山草甸的自然栖息地被人类侵占，它们正在被向上移动，”洛坎说。

paras.en: The model assumes that the bird needs the current climate set-up that exists in alpine meadows in the future too, a reasonable but not certain assumption.
paras.zh: 该模型假设鸟类未来也需要高山草甸中存在的当前气候设置，这是一个合理但不确定的假设。

paras.en: The birds' seasonal migration may become increasingly difficult as changes in climate may force them to move to higher elevations on hills, to smaller and fragmented areas. Their population would be scattered in disconnected pockets, which reduces chances of breeding between groups and increases their risks of long-term decline or local extinction, which is already a threat, the study says.
paras.zh: 鸟类的季节性迁徙可能会变得越来越困难，因为气候变化可能迫使它们迁移到海拔更高的山上，迁移到更小、更分散的地区。研究称，它们的种群将分散在互不相连的区域，这减少了群体之间繁殖的机会，并增加了它们长期衰退或局部灭绝的风险，而这已经是一种威胁。

paras.en: The second study, also conducted by Lochan, Dinesh Kumar Sharma and Anand Kumar, who work at the Hemvati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University, focuses on the bird's behavioural changes. They conducted the study in two valleys in Kedarnath Musk Deer Sanctuary in Uttarakhand - at Chopta, a tourist spot with busy traffic and visitors, and the largely quiet Madmaheshwar.
paras.zh: 第二项研究也是由 Hemvati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal 大学的 Lochan、Dinesh Kumar Sharma 和 Anand Kumar 进行的，重点关注鸟类的行为变化。他们在北阿坎德邦 Kedarnath 麝香鹿保护区的两个山谷中进行了这项研究：交通繁忙、游客众多的旅游胜地 Chopta 和基本上安静的 Madmaheshwar。

paras.en: They recorded more than 700 monal calls across both sites using microphones and passive recording devices and then measured pitch, call length and background noise levels for a year from April 2023.
paras.zh: 他们使用麦克风和无源录音设备在两个站点记录了 700 多个单声道通话，然后测量了自 2023 年 4 月起一年内的音调、通话时长和背景噪音水平。

paras.en: Birds in noisy environments consistently produced calls with significantly higher peak frequencies compared with those in quieter habitats, the study said.
paras.zh: 研究称，与安静栖息地的鸟类相比，嘈杂环境中的鸟类始终发出峰值频率明显更高的叫声。

paras.en: The researchers found subtle changes in the monal's pitch that could be picked up by recording devices but might go unnoticed by the human ear.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，录音设备可以捕捉到莫纳尔音调的细微变化，但人耳可能不会注意到。

paras.en: "This does not mean that the species has undergone a permanent or evolutionary change in its vocal frequency; rather, our findings suggest behavioural flexibility in response to different acoustic environments," Lochan said.
paras.zh: 洛坎说：“这并不意味着该物种的声音频率发生了永久性或进化性的变化；相反，我们的研究结果表明，该物种能够灵活应对不同的声学环境。”

paras.en: Compared with the birds in Madmaheshwar valley, the monal in Chopta also produced shorter call durations likely to cut through low-frequency human noise from traffic and tourist footfall.
paras.zh: 与马德马赫什瓦尔山谷的鸟类相比，乔普塔的虹鳟鸟的叫声持续时间也较短，这可能会消除交通和游客人流带来的低频人类噪音。

paras.en: Bird calls are one of the most sophisticated forms of sound-based communication in the natural world, and significant changes can interfere with, among other things, their mating success.
paras.zh: 鸟叫声是自然界中最复杂的声音交流形式之一，重大变化可能会影响它们的交配成功。

paras.en: "When a species must raise its pitch to be heard over tourist traffic, or climb higher as meadows turn crowded, it reveals how human pressure is rewriting the rules of life in the Himalaya," says Anjal Prakash, a public policy professor at FLAME University and contributor to IPCC reports.
paras.zh: “当一个物种必须提高音调才能在旅游交通中被听到，或者随着草地变得拥挤而爬得更高时，这揭示了人类压力如何改写喜马拉雅山的生活规则，”FLAME 大学公共政策教授、IPCC 报告撰稿人安贾尔·普拉卡什 (Anjal Prakash) 说。

paras.en: Lochan says he and his team consider this a preliminary study and hope to expand the scope and depth of it.
paras.zh: 洛坎表示，他和他的团队认为这是一项初步研究，并希望扩大其范围和深度。

paras.en: The research comes with the caveat that it is not conclusive on ecological consequences, and more research is needed. But together, the two studies signal broader ecological stress across the Himalayas.
paras.zh: 这项研究提出了一个警告，即它对生态后果还没有定论，还需要更多的研究。但这两项研究共同表明了喜马拉雅山脉更广泛的生态压力。

paras.en: "In listening to the monal, we hear the Himalayas asking for space, silence and care," says Prakash.
paras.zh: 普拉卡什说：“在聆听莫纳尔的声音时，我们听到喜马拉雅山要求空间、安静和关怀。”

articles.title: Former Australian bishop jailed for sexually abusing young men

paras.en: Former Australian bishop Christopher Saunders has been jailed for sexually abusing two young Aboriginal men during his time as a Catholic cleric.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚前主教克里斯托弗·桑德斯因在担任天主教神职人员期间对两名年轻原住民男子进行性虐待而被判入狱。

paras.en: Saunders - who resigned as Bishop of Broome when first accused of wrongdoing in 2020 - was found guilty of one charge of rape and 12 counts of indecent assault in August.
paras.zh: 桑德斯在 2020 年首次被指控犯有不当行为后辞去了布鲁姆主教的职务，并于 8 月被判犯有一项强奸罪和 12 项非礼罪。

paras.en: The 76-year-old was on Wednesday sentenced to six and a half years in prison, but will be eligible for release on parole in February 2031.
paras.zh: 这位 76 岁的老人周三被判处六年半监禁，但将于 2031 年 2 月获得假释。

paras.en: He is one of the most senior Catholic leaders in the world to face sex abuse charges.
paras.zh: 他是世界上面临性虐待指控的最高级别天主教领袖之一。

paras.en: His trial in the state of Western Australia heard Saunders systematically groomed the two young men, inviting them to "shirts-off" gatherings and plying them with alcohol, often using church funds and church-owned properties to do so.
paras.zh: 桑德斯在西澳大利亚州的审判中得知，桑德斯系统地培养了这两名年轻人，邀请他们参加“赤裸裸”的聚会，并向他们喝酒，通常使用教会资金和教会拥有的财产来做到这一点。

paras.en: He was convicted of kissing and molesting the men between 2010 and 2019, and in one instance forcing oral sex on one of them.
paras.zh: 他被判在 2010 年至 2019 年间亲吻和猥亵这些男子，并在其中一次强迫其中一名男子口交。

paras.en: In a victim impact statement provided to the court, that young man said he still struggled to talk about what had happened.
paras.zh: 在向法庭提供的受害者影响陈述中，这名年轻人表示，他仍然很难谈论所发生的事情。

paras.en: "I was a toy that he was using," the victim wrote. "My head is pounding now, I'm in so much pain."
paras.zh: “我是他使用的一个玩具，”受害者写道。 “我的头现在很痛，我非常痛苦。”

paras.en: "I trusted him. I thought he wanted me to be a better person."
paras.zh: “我信任他。我以为他希望我成为一个更好的人。”

paras.en: During the trial several child sex abuse charges were discarded, and Saunders was acquitted by the jury of alleged offences against a third young man.
paras.zh: 在审判期间，几项儿童性虐待指控被驳回，陪审团宣告桑德斯对第三名年轻人的指控无罪。

paras.en: First ordained in 1976, Saunders spent most of his career in the remote Kimberley region in the nation's north-west corner, and was appointed Bishop of Broome in 1996.
paras.zh: 桑德斯于 1976 年首次任命，他的大部分职业生涯都在该国西北角偏远的金伯利地区度过，并于 1996 年被任命为布鲁姆主教。

paras.en: The diocese stretches about 770,000 sq km (297,000 sq miles) - an area roughly the size of Turkey - and encompasses some of the most remote parts of the country.
paras.zh: 该教区占地约 770,000 平方公里（297,000 平方英里），面积大约相当于土耳其的面积，涵盖了该国一些最偏远的地区。

paras.en: District Court Judge Martin Flynn said Saunders had professed to be an advocate for young Aboriginal men, but instead misused his authority and exploited their vulnerability.
paras.zh: 地区法院法官马丁·弗林表示，桑德斯自称是年轻原住民男性的倡导者，但实际上滥用了他的权威并利用了他们的脆弱性。

paras.en: He had "disregarded the dignity" of his victims and caused them lasting harm.
paras.zh: 他“无视受害者的尊严”，给他们造成了持久的伤害。

paras.en: In a statement, Archbishop of Perth Timothy Costelloe said the men who had come forward had shown great courage and resilience in pursuing justice.
paras.zh: 珀斯大主教蒂莫西·科斯特洛在一份声明中表示，挺身而出的人在追求正义的过程中表现出了巨大的勇气和韧性。

paras.en: "We are sorry for the pain and suffering that was inflicted on you. We are sorry that your trust was so directly and profoundly betrayed by a leader of the church," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们对给你们带来的痛苦和磨难感到抱歉。我们对教会领袖如此直接和深刻地背叛了你们的信任感到抱歉。”

paras.en: "No court sentence can undo the suffering that has been caused or restore all that each person has lost."
paras.zh: “任何法庭判决都无法消除已经造成的痛苦，也无法挽回每个人失去的一切。”

paras.en: The accusations were first aired in 2020, but the initial police investigation that followed was closed without charge.
paras.zh: 这些指控于 2020 年首次公开，但随后警方的初步调查在没有指控的情况下结束。

paras.en: However after a historic inquiry was ordered by the Pope, police began a new investigation.
paras.zh: 然而，在教皇下令进行历史性调查后，警方开始了新的调查。

paras.en: Costelloe has previously said the church's investigation into Saunders - paused when police resumed theirs - will restart.
paras.zh: 科斯特洛此前曾表示，教会对桑德斯的调查——在警方恢复调查后暂停——将重新启动。

paras.en: The church is under pressure to strip Saunders of his remaining title and ministry powers, a decision the Archbishop said would be determined by Rome.
paras.zh: 教会面临着剥夺桑德斯剩余头衔和事工权力的压力，大主教表示这一决定将由罗马决定。

paras.en: Only a handful of "Vos Estis Lux Mundi" - meaning "You Are the Light of the World" in Latin - inquiries have been undertaken around the world.
paras.zh: 只有少数“Vos Estis Lux Mundi”——拉丁语的意思是“你是世界之光”——在世界各地进行了调查。

paras.en: The investigations are commissioned by the pontiff and were introduced in 2019 to combat sexual abuse and hold bishops and other high-ranking Catholic Church officials accountable for their actions.
paras.zh: 这些调查由教皇委托于 2019 年启动，旨在打击性虐待行为，并追究主教和其他天主教会高级官员对其行为的责任。

paras.en: Aside from the late Cardinal George Pell, who was jailed and then acquitted, Saunders is the most senior Catholic official in the country to be charged with sex offences.
paras.zh: 除了已入狱后被无罪释放的已故红衣主教乔治·佩尔之外，桑德斯是该国被指控性犯罪的最高级别的天主教官员。

articles.title: US death row inmate Christa Pike awake and speaking after failed execution, lawyers say

paras.en: US death row inmate Christa Pike is "conscious and speaking" after surviving a failed execution attempt in Tennessee last week, her lawyers say.
paras.zh: 美国死囚克里斯塔·派克的律师表示，上周在田纳西州执行死刑失败后，她“意识清醒并能说话”。

paras.en: Pike, 50, continues to receive critical medical care while "handcuffed and shackled to the bed" in hospital, her lawyers said in a statement on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 派克的律师周二在一份声明中表示，50 岁的派克在医院“戴着手铐和脚镣”躺在床上，继续接受重症医疗护理。

paras.en: Pike, who was sentenced to death after murdering Colleen Slemmer with her then-boyfriend in 1995, survived two failed lethal injections last Wednesday in Tennessee.
paras.zh: 派克于 1995 年与当时的男友谋杀科琳·斯莱默后被判处死刑，上周三在田纳西州两次注射死刑均未成功。

paras.en: She was taken to hospital, where she remained unconscious for days as medical staff cleared her body of the injected chemical. Experts and her legal team say her apparent recovery is unprecedented.
paras.zh: 她被送往医院，在医护人员清除她体内注射的化学物质的过程中，她昏迷了好几天。专家和她的法律团队表示，她的康复情况是前所未有的。

paras.en: Pike is believed to be the only person to survive a lethal injection.
paras.zh: 派克被认为是唯一在注射死刑后幸存的人。

paras.en: Her lawyers said her prognosis remained unclear, but that "at a minimum, we expect a long recovery".
paras.zh: 她的律师表示，她的预后仍不清楚，但“至少，我们预计会长期康复”。

paras.en: Deborah Denno, a criminologist and professor at Fordham Law School, said she was "absolutely astonished" that Pike was conscious and speaking.
paras.zh: 福特汉姆法学院的犯罪学家兼教授黛博拉·丹诺 (Deborah Denno) 表示，派克居然还有意识并且能说话，这让她“非常惊讶”。

paras.en: There had been seven other cases where prisoners survived executions but in those cases, executioners were not able to inject anything into the inmates' veins, Denno told the BBC.
paras.zh: 丹诺告诉英国广播公司，还有另外七起囚犯在处决中幸存的案例，但在这些案例中，刽子手无法将任何东西注入囚犯的静脉中。

paras.en: Pike "is the only person for whom some kind of toxin has been injected", she said.
paras.zh: 她说，派克“是唯一被注射某种毒素的人”。

paras.en: "They did everything they were supposed to do as part of the execution process, and it simply didn't work," Denno said. "This has never happened before."
paras.zh: “作为执行过程的一部分，他们做了所有应该做的事情，但这根本不起作用，”丹诺说。 “这以前从未发生过。”

paras.en: Speaking to Radio 4's Today programme, a local journalist who witnessed the attempted execution said that he, too, did not know of "an exact precedent".
paras.zh: 一名目睹了处决未遂事件的当地记者在接受第四台“今日”节目采访时表示，他也不知道“确切的先例”。

paras.en: Steven Hale, a journalist for the Nashville Banner, said the case raised many questions, including "what must this be like for the victim's family, who for 30 years has been told we are gonna give you justice and justice is us executing Christa Pike".
paras.zh: 《纳什维尔旗帜报》的记者史蒂文·黑尔 (Steven Hale) 表示，此案引发了许多问题，包括“对于受害者的家人来说，这会是什么样子，他们 30 年来一直被告知我们会给你们伸张正义，正义就是我们处决克里斯塔·派克”。

paras.en: Authorities have not yet said whether they will try again to execute Pike. They have also not offered an explanation for what went wrong after twice injecting her with the chemical pentobarbital.
paras.zh: 当局尚未表示是否会再次尝试处决派克。他们也没有解释两次给她注射化学戊巴比妥后出现的问题。

paras.en: Tennessee Governor Bill Lee has suspended all executions for the rest of the year - and the head of prisons in the state said over the weekend that he planned to resign.
paras.zh: 田纳西州州长比尔·李已暂停今年剩余时间内的所有处决，该州监狱长周末表示，他计划辞职。

paras.en: Pike was 18 when she and her then-boyfriend, Tadaryl Shipp, beat, tortured and killed 19-year-old Slemmer, whom they had met at a job training camp for troubled teens.
paras.zh: 派克 18 岁时，和她当时的男友塔达里尔·希普 (Tadaryl Shipp) 殴打、折磨并杀害了 19 岁的斯莱默 (Slemmer)，他们是在一个问题青少年就业培训营中认识的。

paras.en: Shipp was 17 years old at the time, meaning that he was spared the death penalty for his part in the attack because he was not yet legally an adult at the time. He remains in prison.
paras.zh: 希普当时 17 岁，这意味着他因参与袭击而免于死刑，因为他当时在法律上尚未成年。他仍被关在监狱里。

paras.en: Pike's lawyers are scheduled to appear in court in Nashville on Wednesday. They also plan to hold a news conference outside the court.
paras.zh: 派克的律师定于周三在纳什维尔出庭。他们还计划在法庭外举行新闻发布会。

paras.en: In their latest update, they repeated their call for Lee to use his powers to commute Pike's sentence to the lower punishment of life in prison without parole.
paras.zh: 在最新的更新中，他们再次呼吁李利用他的权力将派克的刑期减刑为终身监禁且不得假释。

paras.en: Dr Joel Zivot, an anaesthesiologist advising Pike's defence team, said on Tuesday that the likelihood of recovering from lethal injection was low.
paras.zh: 为派克辩护团队提供咨询的麻醉师乔尔·齐沃特博士周二表示，从注射死刑中恢复的可能性很低。

paras.en: "Most people who get lethal injection die from it," he told the BBC. "In fact, pretty well everyone, except Christa. So, the fact that she survived it... was unusual."
paras.zh: “大多数注射死刑的人都会死于注射死刑，”他告诉英国广播公司。 “事实上，除了克里斯塔之外，每个人都很好。所以，她幸存下来的事实......很不寻常。”

paras.en: But there remains a lot of uncertainty and many unknowns, he said, including how much of the pentobarbital got into her system, what her blood levels were after the injection and what her recovery will look like.
paras.zh: 但他说，仍然存在很多不确定性和未知数，包括有多少戊巴比妥进入了她的系统，注射后她的血液浓度是多少，以及她的康复情况如何。

paras.en: "I would not, in any way, say at this point that all the big risks are behind her," he noted.
paras.zh: “无论如何，我现在不会说所有重大风险都已经过去了，”他指出。

paras.en: Zivot had previously said the two doses of pentobarbital she received last week would have been enough that, had it entered her bloodstream in normal circulation, "she would have surely died".
paras.zh: 齐沃特此前曾表示，她上周接受的两剂戊巴比妥就足够了，如果它进入她正常循环的血液，“她肯定会死”。

paras.en: Instead, Zivot said a possible explanation is that instead of entering Pike's bloodstream, the pentobarbital was more likely to have spread across the tissue under her skin.
paras.zh: 相反，齐沃特说，一种可能的解释是，戊巴比妥没有进入派克的血液，而是更有可能扩散到她的皮肤下的组织中。

paras.en: Pike's lawyers previously warned that her medical history and anatomy - including thrombocytosis (a blood-clotting condition) and small veins - meant there was a risk she would experience "unnecessary" pain and suffering during a lethal injection.
paras.zh: 派克的律师此前警告说，她的病史和解剖结构——包括血小板增多症（一种血液凝固疾病）和小静脉——意味着她在注射死刑期间有可能经历“不必要的”疼痛和痛苦。

paras.en: They said on Tuesday that she has endured "severe damage" to her arms.
paras.zh: 他们周二表示，她的手臂遭受了“严重伤害”。

paras.en: In 2022, more than a third of executions across the US were botched or highly problematic, according to the Death Penalty Information Center, which tracks information about such cases.
paras.zh: 根据跟踪此类案件信息的死刑信息中心的数据，2022 年，美国超过三分之一的处决都是拙劣的或存在严重问题的。

paras.en: For lethal injections, such incidents have typically occurred due to difficulty obtaining reliable IV access to the veins, though the underlying reason differs from person to person.
paras.zh: 对于注射死刑，此类事件通常是由于难以获得可靠的静脉注射通路而发生的，尽管根本原因因人而异。

paras.en: In cases the centre has documented, all failures happened before the lethal drugs could be administered. The last failed lethal injection that was tracked happened earlier this year - also in Tennessee.
paras.zh: 在该中心记录的案例中，所有失败都发生在使用致命药物之前。追踪到的最后一次失败的注射死刑发生在今年早些时候——同样是在田纳西州。

paras.en: The execution of Tony Carruthers, who was convicted of kidnapping and murdering three people in 1994, was postponed in May after staff were unable to find a vein for a lethal injection. He was granted a year's reprieve by the governor.
paras.zh: 托尼·卡拉瑟斯 (Tony Carruthers) 因 1994 年绑架和谋杀三人而被定罪，由于工作人员无法找到注射死刑的静脉，他的处决于 5 月被推迟。州长授予他一年缓刑。

articles.title: After Beyonce Controversy, Charley Crockett and Gavin Adcock Are All Good
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: After all the back and forth, the beef, and the bluster, Charley Crockett and Gavin Adcock are getting on just fine.
paras.zh: 经过一番来来回回、争吵和咆哮之后，查理·克罗克特和加文·阿德考克相处得很好。

paras.en: The country music artists locked horns last year, when leading several singers in the scene made disparaging comments about Beyoncé’s Cowboy Carter album.
paras.zh: 去年，乡村音乐艺术家们发生了争执，当时现场的几位领先歌手对碧昂斯的牛仔卡特专辑发表了贬低性的评论。

paras.en: Adcock was one of those critics, sharing his thoughts on Bey’s country turn during a concert and going on to suggest that his own career had benefited from his controversial comments.
paras.zh: 阿德科克就是这些批评者之一，他在一场音乐会上分享了他对贝伊乡村音乐转变的看法，并表示他自己的职业生涯受益于他有争议的评论。

paras.en: “I really don’t believe her album should be labeled as country music,” Adcock said soon after making his initial comments against Cowboy Carter. “It doesn’t sound country, it doesn’t feel country, and I just don’t think that people who have dedicated their whole lives to this genre and lifestyle should have to compete or watch that album just stay at the top just because she’s Beyoncé.” Adcock had another pop with a social post in July 2025, the same stretch in which he was named Billboard’s Country Rookie of the Month. “Thanks for the highest streaming week of my career,” he wrote.
paras.zh: “我真的不认为她的专辑应该被贴上乡村音乐的标签，”阿德科克在发表最初反对牛仔卡特的评论后不久说道。 “它听起来不像乡村音乐，也不像乡村音乐，我只是认为那些一生致力于这种流派和生活方式的人不应该仅仅因为她是碧昂丝就必须竞争或观看这张专辑，以保持领先地位。” 2025 年 7 月，阿德考克在社交帖子上再次流行，同一时期他被评为公告牌月度乡村新秀。 “感谢我职业生涯中流媒体播放量最高的一周，”他写道。

paras.en: Crockett came out swinging in Bey’s defense and her Grammy Award winning LP.
paras.zh: 克罗克特为贝的辩护和她获得格莱美奖的唱片做出了激烈的辩护。

paras.en: “Hey country folks. @beyonce ain’t the source of your discontent. It was 25 years of bro country. #1 country artist on earth listen’s to nothing but rap,” Crockett wrote in his lengthy Instagram message from August 2025. “Openly says he doesn’t really know any country music. Gotta respect his honesty. The machine points to a black woman who’s making a statement about marginalized people being removed from the conversation altogether, and somehow we all act like the entire pop industry didn’t just ambush roots music. These ‘country boys’ been *singing* over trap beats for years.”
paras.zh: “嘿，乡下人。@beyonce 不是你们不满的根源。兄弟乡村已经过去 25 年了。地球上排名第一的乡村艺术家只听说唱，”克罗克特在 2025 年 8 月的长篇 Instagram 消息中写道，“公开表示他并不真正了解任何乡村音乐。必须尊重他的诚实。机器指向一位黑人女性，她正在发表声明，称边缘化人群被完全排除在对话之外，不知何故，我们都表现得像整个流行音乐行业不仅仅埋伏着根源音乐，这些‘乡村男孩’多年来一直在用 trap 节奏“唱歌”。”

paras.en: He continued: “I don’t need to put down a black woman to advance my music,” Crockett. “That’s just embarrassing to the idea of America and I got no respect for it.”
paras.zh: 他继续说道：“我不需要贬低黑人女性来推动我的音乐发展，”克罗克特。 “这对美国的观念来说是令人尴尬的，我不尊重它。”

paras.en: Crockett and Adock have their differences, sure, but they’re apparently getting on just fine.
paras.zh: 当然，克罗克特和阿多克有分歧，但他们显然相处得很好。

paras.en: Adcock this week shared a picture of the two pair relaxing in a honky tonk, enjoying a cold one and a laugh. “We might not always see eye to eye but that don’t mean we can’t drop our pride and b—shit and be friends,” reads Adcock’s post, on which he tags Crockett.
paras.zh: 阿德科克本周分享了一张两人在酒吧里放松、享受冰凉和大笑的照片。 “我们可能并不总是意见一致，但这并不意味着我们不能放弃我们的骄傲和狗屎并成为朋友，”阿德科克的帖子中写道，他在帖子上标记了克罗克特。

paras.en: The friendly photos aren’t the only evidence that Crockett and Adcock have been making amends. Last August, Adcock posted a video to Instagram in which he showed off a large bouquet of roses and a copy of Crockett’s latest album Dollar a Day, and delivered a backhanded compliment.
paras.zh: 这些友好的照片并不是克罗克特和阿德科克一直在弥补的唯一证据。去年八月，阿德科克在 Instagram 上发布了一段视频，其中他展示了一大束玫瑰花和一本克罗克特的最新专辑《Dollar a Day》，并发表了讽刺性的赞美。

paras.en: “Apparently last night Charley Crockett was supposed to play the venue that we’re playing tonight, but he didn’t sell enough tickets, so he had to move to a smaller venue down the street — but before he left he sent me 60 roses and a $3 vinyl, so shout-out to Charley Crockett,” Adcock said with a smile. “I appreciate ya, buddy.”
paras.zh: “显然昨晚查理·克罗克特 (Charley Crockett) 本来应该在我们今晚要演出的场地演出，但他没有卖出足够的门票，所以他不得不搬到街上一个较小的场地——但在他离开之前，他给我送了 60 朵玫瑰和一张 3 美元的黑胶唱片，所以要向查理·克罗克特大喊一声，”阿德科克笑着说。 “我很感激你，伙计。”

paras.en: Despite the harsh words from some, Beyonce’s Cowboy Carter was a hit.
