articles.title: When streets become pharmacies: Booming illicit markets in Central Africa

paras.en: When streets become pharmacies: Booming illicit markets in Central Africa
paras.zh: 当街道变成药店：中部非洲蓬勃发展的非法市场

paras.en: Antibiotics, malaria treatments, painkillers, opioids. More than 250 tonnes of medical products were seized over six years in Central Africa. Behind those numbers is an illicit market that thrives not simply despite the region’s fragile health systems, but in part because of them.
paras.zh: 抗生素、疟疾治疗、止痛药、阿片类药物。六年来，中部非洲查获了 250 多吨医疗产品。这些数字的背后是一个非法市场的蓬勃发展，这不仅是因为该地区的卫生系统脆弱，而且部分原因在于卫生系统。

paras.en: When medicines are scarce, unaffordable or simply too far away, illicit sellers have proved adept at filling the void.
paras.zh: 当药品稀缺、价格昂贵或距离太远时，非法卖家就很擅长填补这一空白。

paras.en: That is the dynamic described in a new report released Tuesday by the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC). The illicit trade extends far beyond falsified drugs. It includes genuine medicines diverted from legitimate supply chains, unapproved products and drugs smuggled across borders.
paras.zh: 联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室（UNODC）周二发布的一份新报告描述了这一动态。非法贸易远远超出了假药范围。它包括从合法供应链转移的正品药品、未经批准的产品和跨境走私的药品。

paras.en: From 2020 through 2025, authorities seized 251 tonnes of medical products in Cameroon, Republic of Congo, Gabon, Central African Republic and Chad. Annual seizures rose from about five tonnes in 2020 to nearly 116 tonnes in 2024, before exceeding 97 tonnes in 2025.
paras.zh: 2020年至2025年，当局在喀麦隆、刚果共和国、加蓬、中非共和国和乍得查获了251吨医疗产品。年缉获量从 2020 年的约 5 吨增加到 2024 年的近 116 吨，2025 年将超过 97 吨。

paras.en: The United Nations cautioned against interpreting the increase as a straightforward measure of the trade’s growth. Larger seizures can reflect both greater trafficking and more aggressive enforcement, and the available data vary considerably among countries and from year to year.
paras.zh: 联合国警告不要将这一增长解读为贸易增长的直接衡量标准。缉获量的增加可以反映出贩运量的增加和执法力度的加大，而且不同国家和每年的可用数据差异很大。

paras.en: Still, the scale is striking. Cameroon accounted for nearly all of the seizures recorded in 2025, with 96 tonnes intercepted, compared with just 2.5 tonnes five years earlier. The products intercepted across the region range from antibiotics, antimalarial and anti-inflammatory drugs to painkillers and such psychoactive substances as tramadol and pregabalin.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，规模仍然惊人。喀麦隆几乎占据了 2025 年记录的全部缉获量，截获了 96 吨，而五年前仅为 2.5 吨。该地区截获的产品包括抗生素、抗疟药、抗炎药、止痛药以及曲马多和普瑞巴林等精神活性物质。

paras.en: “The report outlines a multimodal trafficking system that uses maritime, riverine, air and road routes and involves a broad range of actors,” said Sylvie Bertrand, UNODC’s regional representative for West and Central Africa.
paras.zh: 毒品和犯罪问题办公室西非和中非区域代表西尔维·贝特朗表示：“报告概述了一个多式联运贩运系统，该系统利用海上、河流、空中和公路路线，涉及广泛的参与者。”

paras.en: But the report, produced with the World Health Organization (WHO) and the Economic and Monetary Community of Central Africa (CEMAC), suggests that the roots of the trade are partly beyond the reach of law enforcement.
paras.zh: 但这份由世界卫生组织（WHO）和中部非洲经济货币共同体（CEMAC）共同编写的报告表明，这种贸易的根源部分超出了执法部门的管辖范围。

paras.en: Malaria, tuberculosis and HIV remain widespread across the region, while public health systems often struggle to provide treatment. In 2023, the WHO’s universal health-coverage index placed all six countries in the Central African economic bloc among the world’s poorest performers. Chad scored just 26 out of 100, compared with a global average of 71.
paras.zh: 疟疾、结核病和艾滋病毒在该地区仍然普遍存在，而公共卫生系统往往难以提供治疗。 2023年，世界卫生组织的全民健康覆盖指数将中非经济集团的所有六个国家列为世界上表现最差的国家。乍得的得分仅为 26 分（满分 100 分），而全球平均分为 71 分。

paras.en: Distance and cost compound the problem. In the Central African Republic and Chad, more than half the population lived at least two hours from a public hospital providing emergency care, according to data cited in the report. In Chad, a prefilled insulin syringe cost the equivalent of nearly 16 days’ wages for the lowest-paid government employee.
paras.zh: 距离和成本使问题变得更加复杂。报告引用的数据显示，在中非共和国和乍得，超过一半的人口居住在距离提供紧急护理的公立医院至少两小时路程的地方。在乍得，一个预充式胰岛素注射器的花费相当于收入最低的政府雇员近 16 天的工资。

paras.en: Under those circumstances, buying medicine on the street can become less an alternative to the formal health system than a necessity. Consumers in the Central African Republic told researchers that informal sellers allowed them to “buy one or two tablets for about 100 CFA francs” – roughly 20 cents – rather than “buy the medicines in a box of 12 [at a pharmacy]”.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，在街上买药可能不再是正规医疗系统的替代品，而是一种必需品。中非共和国的消费者告诉研究人员，非正式卖家允许他们“以大约 100 非洲法郎”（大约 20 美分）购买一两片药片，而不是“[在药店]购买一盒 12 片的药物”。

paras.en: The result is a marketplace where legitimate, falsified and substandard medicines can be difficult to distinguish.
paras.zh: 结果是市场上的合法药品、假药和不合格药品难以区分。

paras.en: From 2013 to 2025, WHO’s surveillance system recorded incidents involving 228 medical products in the Central African economic bloc. Of those, 71 per cent were classified as falsified and 11 per cent as substandard. Perhaps more troubling, a third of the incidents were detected in regulated supply chains, suggesting that buying medicine from an authorised outlet does not eliminate the risk.
paras.zh: 2013年至2025年，世卫组织监测系统记录了中非经济区涉及228种医疗产品的事件。其中，71% 被归类为伪造，11% 被归类为不合格。也许更令人不安的是，三分之一的事件是在受监管的供应链中发现的，这表明从授权商店购买药品并不能消除风险。

paras.en: In April 2025, the WHO reported falsified batches of amoxicillin in Cameroon and the Central African Republic that did not contain the active ingredient listed on their labels. In September 2026, Cameroonian authorities seized thousands of cartons in Yaoundé containing, among other things, counterfeit medicines, packaging materials used to repackage drugs and psychotropic substances.
paras.zh: 2025 年 4 月，世卫组织报告喀麦隆和中非共和国发现了一批伪造的阿莫西林，其标签上未列出活性成分。 2026 年 9 月，喀麦隆当局在雅温得查获了数千个纸箱，其中包括假药、用于重新包装药物和精神药物的包装材料。

paras.en: The trafficking routes largely follow the arteries of legitimate regional commerce. The ports of Apapa in Nigeria and Douala in Cameroon, along with river ports in Brazzaville and Bangui, were identified as major entry points. Authorities also seized 7.3 tonnes of medical products at airports across the region from 2020 through 2025.
paras.zh: 贩运路线主要沿着合法的区域商业动脉。尼日利亚的阿帕帕港和喀麦隆的杜阿拉港以及布拉柴维尔和班吉的河港被确定为主要入境点。 2020 年至 2025 年，当局还在该地区的机场查获了 7.3 吨医疗产品。

paras.en: The criminal networks behind the trade are equally varied. They include clandestine manufacturers, wholesalers, informal vendors, couriers, health care workers, corrupt public officials and online sellers.
paras.zh: 交易背后的犯罪网络同样多种多样。他们包括秘密制造商、批发商、非正规商贩、快递员、医护人员、腐败公职人员和网上卖家。

paras.en: Armed groups have also found ways to profit, according to the report, by looting health facilities, reselling medicines or collecting “taxes” from convoys crossing territory under their control.
paras.zh: 报告称，武装团体还找到了牟利的方法，包括抢劫医疗设施、倒卖药品或向穿越其控制领土的车队收取“税”。

paras.en: For patients, the consequences can be dire. Medicines containing the wrong ingredients or incorrect doses can cause poisoning, treatment failure and death. They can also contribute to antimicrobial resistance, allowing bacteria and other pathogens to evolve in ways that make existing medicines less effective.
paras.zh: 对于患者来说，后果可能是可怕的。含有错误成分或错误剂量的药物可能会导致中毒、治疗失败和死亡。它们还可能导致抗菌素耐药性，使细菌和其他病原体以降低现有药物疗效的方式进化。

paras.en: The illicit market is responding to a demand the formal health system has failed to meet
paras.zh: 非法市场正在满足正规卫生系统未能满足的需求

paras.en: In 2023, 12 children in Cameroon died after taking a pediatric syrup containing contaminated ingredients, according to UNODC.
paras.zh: 据毒品和犯罪问题办公室称，2023 年，喀麦隆有 12 名儿童在服用含有受污染成分的儿科糖浆后死亡。

paras.en: Yet, the same weaknesses that expose patients to illicit medicines also complicate efforts to stamp out the trade.
paras.zh: 然而，让患者接触非法药物的同样弱点也使取缔非法药物的努力变得更加复杂。

paras.en: “No State can tackle this transnational challenge alone,” said Ms. Bertrand, the agency’s regional representative.
paras.zh: “没有一个国家能够单独应对这一跨国挑战，”该机构的区域代表伯特兰女士说。

paras.en: The report calls for countries to harmonise their laws, strengthen controls and improve cross-border cooperation. But, it also argues for expanding access to safe and affordable medicines, for the illicit market is responding to a demand the formal health system has failed to meet.
paras.zh: 报告呼吁各国协调法律、加强管控并改善跨境合作。但是，它也主张扩大获得安全和负担得起的药物的机会，因为非法市场正在满足正规卫生系统未能满足的需求。

paras.en: Cutting off illegal supplies without addressing the shortages, high prices and distances that drive patients toward them risks leaving the market for illicit medicines largely intact.
paras.zh: 如果不解决药品短缺、价格高昂和患者就医的距离问题，就切断非法药品供应，这可能会导致非法药品市场基本完好无损。

articles.title: Djibouti faces ‘overlapping emergencies’ as Yemen’s refugee exodus continues

paras.en: Djibouti faces ‘overlapping emergencies’ as Yemen’s refugee exodus continues
paras.zh: 随着也门难民继续逃亡，吉布提面临“重叠的紧急情况”

paras.en: Djibouti is facing “overlapping emergencies” as refugees fleeing the conflict in Yemen arrive on its shores while migrants continue to travel in the opposite direction, the UN migration agency (IOM) warned on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 联合国移民机构（IOM）周二警告说，吉布提正面临“重叠的紧急情况”，逃离也门冲突的难民抵达吉布提海岸，而移民则继续朝相反方向迁移。

paras.en: More than 3,700 refugees have reached the Horn of Africa nation in the past three weeks after a dangerous crossing of the Red Sea, said Alexandre Coissac, head of IOM’s mission in the country, briefing journalists in Geneva by video link.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织驻该国代表团团长亚历山大·科瓦萨克 (Alexandre Coissac) 在日内瓦通过视频连线向记者介绍情况时表示，过去三周内，超过 3,700 名难民在危险穿越红海后抵达这个非洲之角国家。

paras.en: At the same time, IOM has recorded more than 20,000 journeys made from Ethiopia since 10 September, as migrants on the east African route continue to head for Yemen, in the hopes of finding work in the Gulf.
paras.zh: 与此同时，自 9 月 10 日以来，国际移民组织记录了超过 20,000 趟从埃塞俄比亚出发的旅程，东非航线上的移民继续前往也门，希望在海湾地区找到工作。

paras.en: Another 539 Ethiopian migrants have arrived from Yemen on their way home.
paras.zh: 另有 539 名埃塞俄比亚移民从也门抵达回国途中。

paras.en: “Djibouti is therefore confronting movement in both directions: people fleeing Yemen are arriving as refugees, migrants continue travelling towards Yemen, and other migrants are returning,” Mr. Coissac said.
paras.zh: “因此，吉布提面临着双向流动：逃离也门的人们作为难民抵达，移民继续前往也门，而其他移民正在返回，”科瓦萨克先生说。

paras.en: Between 20 and 30 September, more than 3,000 stranded migrants were observed along migratory routes in Djibouti, facing dehydration, exhaustion and shortages of food and water.
paras.zh: 9 月 20 日至 30 日期间，超过 3,000 名移民被困在吉布提的迁徙路线上，他们面临脱水、精疲力竭以及食物和水短缺的问题。

paras.en: Mr. Coissac said IOM had received reports of migrants dying in the desert near the border with Ethiopia.
paras.zh: 科伊萨克表示，国际移民组织收到了有关移民在埃塞俄比亚边境附近的沙漠中死亡的报告。

paras.en: The agency is providing food and water and helping those who request assisted voluntary return – but migrants are increasingly using secondary routes, making them harder to reach.
paras.zh: 该机构正在提供食物和水，并帮助那些要求协助自愿返回的人，但移民越来越多地使用次要路线，这使得他们更难到达。

paras.en: He said most migrants bound for Yemen were unaware of the grave situation as fighting between Government and Houthi forces intensifies, and that many aim to reach Saudi Arabia and other Gulf States.
paras.zh: 他说，随着政府和胡塞武装之间的战斗加剧，大多数前往也门的移民都没有意识到局势的严重性，许多人的目标是前往沙特阿拉伯和其他海湾国家。

paras.en: The Djiboutian authorities have responded rapidly, he said, but the scale and complexity of needs are stretching resources. He called for more support for new arrivals, migrants in distress and the host communities in Obock.
paras.zh: 他说，吉布提当局反应迅速，但需求的规模和复杂性正在耗尽资源。他呼吁为新移民、陷入困境的移民和奥博克的收容社区提供更多支持。

paras.en: “The country is now responding to people moving in different directions, for different reasons, but often facing the same immediate reality: they need safety, protection and basic assistance,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“国家现在正在应对因不同原因而走向不同方向的人们，但往往面临同样的直接现实：他们需要安全、保护和基本援助。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, news outlets on Tuesday reported that Yemen’s Saudi-backed Government forces say they have re-taken control of the Bab al-Mandab Strait, at the mouth of the Red Sea, after launching a major offensive against the Iran-backed Houthis who control much of Yemen, including the capital.
paras.zh: 与此同时，新闻媒体周二报道称，沙特支持的也门政府军表示，在对控制也门大部分地区（包括首都）的伊朗支持的胡塞武装发动大规模攻势后，他们已重新控制了红海口的曼德海峡。

articles.title: From drought to deluge: ‘Super’ El Niño’s expanding reach

paras.en: From drought to deluge: ‘Super’ El Niño’s expanding reach
paras.zh: 从干旱到洪水：“超级”厄尔尼诺现象的影响范围不断扩大

paras.en: Across Papua New Guinea, water sources are drying up, crops are failing and food prices are rising months before the worst agricultural impacts are expected. Behind those warning signs is an El Niño whose Pacific Ocean temperatures have already surpassed the equivalent measurements during the historic 1997 and 2015 events – part of an unfolding climate pattern being dubbed a “Super El Niño” by some climate watchers.
paras.zh: 在巴布亚新几内亚各地，水源正在枯竭，庄稼歉收，粮食价格在预计最严重的农业影响出现之前几个月就在上涨。这些警告信号的背后是厄尔尼诺现象，其太平洋温度已经超过了 1997 年和 2015 年历史性事件期间的同等测量值，这是正在展开的气候模式的一部分，被一些气候观察家称为“超级厄尔尼诺现象”。

paras.en: More than 347 million children in nearly 100 countries and territories are expected to experience unusually wet or dry conditions between October and December 2026 due to El Niño, increasing the risk of extreme floods and droughts with potentially devastating consequences, according to latest UNICEF data.
paras.zh: 根据联合国儿童基金会的最新数据，由于厄尔尼诺现象，预计 2026 年 10 月至 12 月期间，近 100 个国家和地区的超过 3.47 亿儿童将经历异常潮湿或干燥的情况，从而增加极端洪水和干旱的风险，并可能造成灾难性后果。

paras.en: Here are highlights of the risks facing children:
paras.zh: 以下是儿童面临的风险的要点：

paras.en: - As extreme weather events become more widespread, youngsters could face increased risks of family separation, violence, exploitation and child marriage
paras.zh: - 随着极端天气事件变得更加普遍，青少年可能面临更大的家庭离散、暴力、剥削和童婚的风险

paras.en: - Colombia, Fiji, Papua New Guinea and the Philippines are among those expected to experience drier conditions that could likely to lead to drought and water scarcity, increasing displacement and worsening acute malnutrition
paras.zh: - 哥伦比亚、斐济、巴布亚新几内亚和菲律宾等国预计将经历更加干旱的天气，这可能导致干旱和缺水、流离失所人数增加和急性营养不良恶化

paras.en: - In the Greater Horn of Africa, wetter-than-normal conditions could trigger flash flooding, spread water-borne diseases and disrupt schooling
paras.zh: - 在大非洲之角，比正常情况更潮湿的天气可能会引发山洪、传播水传播疾病并扰乱学校教育

paras.en: - In crisis and conflict-affected countries such as Afghanistan and Chad, El Niño can be a direct threat to survival, worsening hunger and malnutrition among already vulnerable children
paras.zh: - 在阿富汗和乍得等受危机和冲突影响的国家，厄尔尼诺现象可能对生存构成直接威胁，加剧本已脆弱儿童的饥饿和营养不良

paras.en: - Every $1 invested in disaster risk reduction and prevention can save up to $15 in recovery costs, yet less than one per cent of humanitarian funding currently goes to anticipatory action
paras.zh: - 在减少和预防灾害风险方面每投资 1 美元，最多可节省 15 美元的恢复成本，但目前用于预防性行动的人道主义资金不足 1%

paras.en: The 2026-2027 El Niño is forecast to become one of the strongest on record, threatening to intensify drought, floods and other weather extremes across countries already grappling with food insecurity, displacement and economic pressures.
paras.zh: 预计 2026 年至 2027 年的厄尔尼诺现象将成为有记录以来最强烈的厄尔尼诺现象之一，有可能加剧本已面临粮食不安全、流离失所和经济压力的国家的干旱、洪水和其他极端天气情况。

paras.en: El Niño can shift rainfall patterns thousands of kilometres from the tropical Pacific, leaving some regions facing drought and water shortages while others contend with heavier rains, flooding and heightened disease risks.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象可以使降雨模式偏离热带太平洋数千公里，导致一些地区面临干旱和缺水，而另一些地区则面临大雨、洪水和疾病风险增加的问题。

paras.en: More than 347 million children in nearly 100 countries and territories could be exposed to unusually dry or wet conditions between October and December because of El Niño, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) warns in a new analysis.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会 (UNICEF) 在一份新分析中警告称，由于厄尔尼诺现象，近 100 个国家和地区的超过 3.47 亿儿童可能在 10 月至 12 月期间面临异常干燥或潮湿的环境。

paras.en: “For children, El Niño is far more than a weather pattern. It can mean increased displacement, malnutrition, water shortages and disease outbreaks,” said UNICEF Executive Director Catherine Russell. “Children are also at risk of schools closing, while families could experience added financial hardship.”
paras.zh: “对于儿童来说，厄尔尼诺现象不仅仅是一种天气模式。它可能意味着流离失所、营养不良、水资源短缺和疾病爆发的增加，”联合国儿童基金会执行主任凯瑟琳·拉塞尔说。 “儿童还面临学校关闭的风险，而家庭可能会遇到更多的经济困难。”

paras.en: Already, 1.1 billion children – nearly half of the world’s children – are already exposed to at least three overlapping climate-related hazards such as drought, extreme heat or floods.
paras.zh: 目前，11 亿儿童（近世界儿童的一半）已经面临至少三种与气候相关的重叠灾害，例如干旱、酷热或洪水。

paras.en: In Papua New Guinea, impact is already here
paras.zh: 在巴布亚新几内亚，影响已经显现

paras.en: Some of those consequences are already visible in Papua New Guinea, a mountainous Pacific island nation where remote terrain and difficult logistics have complicated responses to previous droughts. El Niño conditions have been present since mid-2026 and are forecast to peak between October and December.
paras.zh: 其中一些后果在巴布亚新几内亚已经显现出来。巴布亚新几内亚是一个多山的太平洋岛国，该国地形偏远，物流困难，使得应对之前的干旱变得更加复杂。厄尔尼诺现象自 2026 年中期以来一直存在，预计在 10 月至 12 月期间达到顶峰。

paras.en: In September, the Niño 3.4 index – a measure of sea-surface temperatures in the tropical Pacific used to track El Niño – surpassed those recorded during every previous El Niño event, including 1997 and 2015.
paras.zh: 9月，尼诺3.4指数——用于追踪厄尔尼诺现象的热带太平洋海面温度的衡量标准——超过了之前历次厄尔尼诺事件（包括1997年和2015年）记录的指数。

paras.en: The Government, which declared the event in June, has established a dedicated task force and approved a $112 million supplementary budget.
paras.zh: 政府于 6 月宣布举办这一活动，并成立了专门工作组并批准了 1.12 亿美元的补充预算。

paras.en: Some 1.2 million people are estimated to require direct food relief, with water shortages, crop losses, dwindling food reserves and higher prices already reported. Schools are being disrupted and concerns are growing over health, nutrition and bushfires.
paras.zh: 据报道，水资源短缺、农作物减产、粮食储备减少和价格上涨，估计约有 120 万人需要直接粮食救济。学校受到干扰，人们对健康、营养和丛林大火的担忧日益加剧。

paras.en: The largest impacts on agriculture and food security are expected from November.
paras.zh: 预计从 11 月份起，农业和粮食安全将受到最大影响。

paras.en: What dries out one part of the world can bring deluges to another.
paras.zh: 世界某一地区的干旱可能会给另一地区带来洪水。

paras.en: Across the Greater Horn of Africa, wetter-than-normal conditions could raise the risk of river and flash flooding, increase the spread of waterborne diseases and disrupt schooling.
paras.zh: 在整个大非洲之角，比正常情况更潮湿的天气可能会增加河流和山洪爆发的风险，增加水传播疾病的传播并扰乱学校教育。

paras.en: In the wider region – including Yemen, Sudan and Afghanistan – children living amid conflict and displacement face particularly acute risks because El Niño can magnify existing hunger, malnutrition and difficulties accessing essential services.
paras.zh: 在更广泛的地区——包括也门、苏丹和阿富汗——生活在冲突和流离失所中的儿童面临着特别严重的风险，因为厄尔尼诺现象会加剧现有的饥饿、营养不良和获得基本服务的困难。

paras.en: For governments, the forecasts offer something disasters often do not: time.
paras.zh: 对于政府来说，预测提供了灾难通常无法提供的东西：时间。

paras.en: Asia and the Pacific is expected to bear a particularly large share of the exposure, with some 190 million children – more than half of the global total identified by UNICEF – living in areas forecast to experience unusually wet or dry conditions between October and December.
paras.zh: 亚太地区预计将承受特别大的风险，约有 1.9 亿儿童（超过联合国儿童基金会确定的全球儿童总数的一半）生活在预计 10 月至 12 月期间将经历异常潮湿或干燥天气的地区。

paras.en: The World Food Programme (WFP) is urging countries across the region to strengthen social protection systems that can rapidly expand when droughts, floods or economic shocks threaten household food security.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署（粮食计划署）敦促该地区各国加强社会保障体系，以便在干旱、洪水或经济冲击威胁家庭粮食安全时迅速扩大社会保障体系。

paras.en: “A flood, drought, or sudden economic shock can wipe out a family’s progress in a matter of days,” said Samir Wanmali, WFP Regional Director for Asia and the Pacific. “Social protection systems that are inclusive, nutrition-sensitive and ready to expand during a crisis can prevent a temporary shock from becoming a lasting setback.”
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署亚太区域主任萨米尔·万马利表示：“洪水、干旱或突然的经济冲击可能会在几天内毁掉一个家庭的进步。” “具有包容性、对营养敏感并准备在危机期间扩大的社会保护体系可以防止暂时的冲击变成持久的挫折。”

paras.en: The urgency is sharpened by lessons from earlier El Niño episodes.
paras.zh: 早期厄尔尼诺现象的教训加剧了这一紧迫性。

paras.en: In analysis published in May, the UN Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (ESCAP) pointed to the 2015-16 event as a warning of how climate extremes can cascade through economies and societies.
paras.zh: 在 5 月发布的分析中，联合国亚洲及太平洋经济社会委员会 (ESCAP) 指出 2015-16 年的事件是对极端气候如何在经济和社会中蔓延的警告。

paras.en: More than 70 per cent of Southeast Asia’s land area experienced drought during that episode, exposing more than 200 million people to severe drought at its peak.
paras.zh: 在那次事件中，东南亚70%以上的陆地面积经历了干旱，最严重时使2亿多人遭受严重干旱。

paras.en: The pressures this time are unfolding against tighter government finances, elevated debt and persistent economic uncertainty and supply chain worries, potentially reducing the ability of governments and households to absorb another shock.
paras.zh: 这次的压力来自政府财政紧缩、债务增加、持续的经济不确定性和供应链担忧，可能会降低政府和家庭承受另一次冲击的能力。

paras.en: Meanwhile, climate change is raising the baseline risk. Higher temperatures accelerate the loss of moisture from soil and vegetation, potentially intensifying drought when rainfall falls short.
paras.zh: 与此同时，气候变化正在提高基线风险。气温升高会加速土壤和植被水分的流失，当降雨量不足时，可能会加剧干旱。

paras.en: For governments, that means preparing for extremes in both directions – from failing rains, water shortages and crop losses to intense rainfall, flooding and landslides. The challenge is to turn forecasts into decisions before harvests fail, reservoirs run low or floods force families from their homes.
paras.zh: 对于政府来说，这意味着要为两个方向的极端情况做好准备——从降雨不足、水资源短缺和农作物损失到强降雨、洪水和山体滑坡。面临的挑战是在收成歉收、水库水位下降或洪水迫使家庭逃离家园之前将预测转化为决策。

paras.en: That will be the focus of a regional El Niño exchange beginning on next week in Bangkok, bringing governments, meteorological experts, UN agencies and frontline practitioners together to compare emerging impacts and lessons from previous crises.
paras.zh: 这将是下周在曼谷开始的区域厄尔尼诺交流的重点，各国政府、气象专家、联合国机构和一线从业人员将齐聚一堂，比较新出现的影响和以往危机的教训。

paras.en: For Papua New Guinea, however, the warning period is already giving way to impact.
paras.zh: 然而，对于巴布亚新几内亚来说，警告期已经让位于影响。

paras.en: Water shortages, damaged crops and rising prices offer an early glimpse of what an exceptional El Niño could mean far beyond the warming waters of the Pacific.
paras.zh: 水资源短缺、农作物受损和价格上涨让人们初步了解了异常的厄尔尼诺现象在太平洋变暖的水域之外可能意味着什么。

articles.title: Should 'cracking kid' Bamber be awarded England call-up?

paras.en: Ethan Bamber for England? Should Warwickshire seamer be considered for spot in Test cricket bowling attack?
paras.zh: 伊桑·班伯代表英格兰队？沃里克郡缝合器是否应该被考虑参加测试板球保龄球进攻？

paras.en: Ethan Bamber took 69 wickets at an average below 20 as Warwickshire won the County Championship in 2026; Michael Atherton says of Bamber: "He's somebody who wants to get absolutely the most out of every little bit of talent he's got"; Chris Woakes calls Jofra Archer leader of Test attack
paras.zh: 伊森·班伯 (Ethan Bamber) 拿下 69 个三柱门，平均得分低于 20 个，帮助沃里克郡赢得 2026 年郡锦标赛；迈克尔·阿瑟顿 (Michael Atherton) 评价班伯 (Bamber)：“他绝对想充分利用自己所拥有的每一点天赋”；克里斯·沃克斯 (Chris Woakes) 称 Jofra Archer 为测试攻击的领导者

paras.en: Should England add Ethan Bamber to their battery of seam bowlers in Test cricket?
paras.zh: 英格兰是否应该将伊森·班伯（Ethan Bamber）加入到他们的板球测试赛中的接缝投球手阵容中？

paras.en: The Warwickshire star, 27, was the leading County Championship wicket-taker in the country in 2026, with his 69 scalps at an average of 19.39 helping the Bears to the Division One title.
paras.zh: 这位 27 岁的沃里克郡球星是 2026 年全国郡锦标赛三柱门的领先者，他以 69 次头皮得分，平均得分为 19.39 帮助熊队夺得一级冠军。

paras.en: Bamber is an Ollie Robinson figure as opposed to a Jofra Archer one, relying on skill and nagging accuracy rather than pace and hostility.
paras.zh: 班伯是奥利·罗宾逊式的人物，而不是乔弗拉·阿切尔式的人物，他依靠的是技巧和烦人的准确性，而不是速度和敌意。

paras.en: - Latest Sky Sports deals or stream no contract with NOW
paras.zh: - 最新的天空体育交易或与 NOW 签订无合同

paras.en: - Listen to latest episode of the Sky Sports Cricket Podcast
paras.zh: - 收听天空体育板球播客的最新一集

paras.en: - Latest England cricket news, views and match reports
paras.zh: - 最新的英格兰板球新闻、观点和比赛报道

paras.en: But with it now in vogue for wicketkeepers to stand up close to the stumps to seamers wobbling the ball, perhaps Bamber has a chance of a maiden international call-up?
paras.zh: 但现在流行让守门员站在靠近树桩的地方让接球手晃动球，也许班伯有机会首次入选国家队？

paras.en: Bamber for England? 'Never say never...'
paras.zh: 班伯代表英格兰队？ '永不说永不...'

paras.en: Sky Sports' Michael Atherton said on the England prospects of the former Middlesex man, who has 308 scalps in 89 first-class matches at an average below 27: "A few years ago, you'd have said no - a bowler of 78, 80 miles an hour, wobbling it about.
paras.zh: 天空体育的迈克尔·阿瑟顿在谈到这位前米德尔塞克斯球员的英格兰前景时表示，他在 89 场一流比赛中打出了 308 次头皮，平均得分低于 27 分：“几年前，你可能会说不——一个时速 78 英里、时速 80 英里、摇摇晃晃的投球手。

paras.en: "But now everybody's keen on the wobble seam and the wicketkeeper standing up. So never say never. I wouldn't imagine so but I see him as a very, very good county bowler.
paras.zh: “但现在每个人都热衷于摆动接缝和站起来的守门员。所以永远不要说永远。我不会这么想，但我认为他是一个非常非常好的县投球手。

paras.en: "England have got Ollie Robinson there at the moment and they'll always have one of those fellas in the mix, won't they?
paras.zh: “英格兰现在有奥利·罗宾逊，他们总会有这样的人之一，不是吗？

paras.en: "Whether it's Robinson or Sam Cook, who seems to be kind of Robinson's understudy at the moment, so you could see Bamber maybe in that role.
paras.zh: “无论是罗宾逊还是萨姆·库克，他目前似乎是罗宾逊的替补，所以你可以看到班伯可能扮演这个角色。

paras.en: "He's a cracking kid and somebody who wants to get absolutely the most out of every little bit of talent that he's got.
paras.zh: “他是一个出色的孩子，并且绝对希望充分利用他所拥有的每一点天赋。

paras.en: "He moved to Warwickshire with ambitions to go to a club that's challenging for things and is making the most of what he's got."
paras.zh: “他搬到沃里克郡的野心是去一家充满挑战的俱乐部，并充分利用他所拥有的一切。”

paras.en: Bamber brushed off the likelihood of international honours while speaking to Cricinfo at the recent Professional Cricketers' Association awards in London, saying: "If that ship was ever in the harbour, it's definitely sailed now.
paras.zh: 班伯最近在伦敦举行的职业板球运动员协会颁奖典礼上接受 Cricinfo 采访时，对获得国际荣誉的可能性不屑一顾，他说：“如果那艘船曾经停泊在港口，那么它现在肯定已经航行了。

paras.en: "What I'm thinking of is how I can contribute next year for Warwickshire, and try to help us continue to be successful moving forward. That's really what makes me a bit nervous and excited."
paras.zh: “我想到的是明年如何为沃里克郡做出贡献，并努力帮助我们继续成功前进。这确实让我有点紧张和兴奋。”

paras.en: 'Archer at peak of his powers - now the leader of the attack'
paras.zh: “弓箭手正处于力量巅峰——现在是进攻的领导者”

paras.en: England's attack starred during the 3-0 rout of Pakistan this summer, with Robinson bagging 21 wickets at an average below nine and Archer 12 at 26.66.
paras.zh: 英格兰队在今年夏天 3-0 击败巴基斯坦的比赛中表现出色，罗宾逊攻入 21 个三柱门，平均得分低于 9 个，阿切尔则攻入 12 个三柱门，平均得分为 26.66。

paras.en: Gus Atkinson and Josh Tongue also played their part, while Cook, Sonny Baker and Matthew Fisher are back-up options.
paras.zh: 格斯·阿特金森和乔什·汤格也发挥了作用，而库克、桑尼·贝克和马修·费舍尔则是替补。

paras.en: The quicks will return to red-ball cricket from December 17, live on Sky Sports, for a three-Test series in South Africa - Stephen Fleming's first assignment as head coach.
paras.zh: 快队将从 12 月 17 日起重返红球板球比赛，天空体育直播，在南非进行三场测试系列赛，这是史蒂芬·弗莱明作为主教练的第一次任务。

paras.en: Former England seamer Chris Woakes, speaking at the launch of the ECB's 'Cricket for Teachers' initiative, told Sky Sports News: "The bowling attack looks great, plenty of depth.
paras.zh: 前英格兰队球员克里斯·沃克斯在欧洲央行“教师板球”倡议启动仪式上发表讲话时告诉天空体育新闻：“保龄球进攻看起来很棒，有足够的深度。

paras.en: "Robinson has come back in and done fantastically well - South Africa will be a different challenge but he has the skills to succeed.
paras.zh: “罗宾逊已经回归并表现出色——南非将是一个不同的挑战，但他有能力取得成功。

paras.en: "The beauty of Jofra is that he has played a lot of cricket over the last few years and stayed injury-free - he looks as fit as ever and is kind of the leader of the attack now.
paras.zh: “乔弗拉的美妙之处在于，他在过去几年里打了很多板球并且没有受伤——他看起来和以前一样健康，现在是进攻的领导者。

paras.en: "He has matured a lot as a bowler and a person. He is at the peak of his powers and wants to be playing his best Test cricket.
paras.zh: “作为一名投球手和一个人，他已经成熟了很多。他正处于能力的顶峰，希望打出最好的板球测试赛。

articles.title: Worcester and Sedgefield feature on Wednesday

paras.en: Today on Sky Sports Racing: Worcester and Sedgefield feature on Wednesday
paras.zh: 今天天空体育赛车：周三伍斯特和塞奇菲尔德专题

paras.en: Dartan and Snipe lock horns in today's feature contest from Worcester, live on Sky Sports Racing; Sedgefield also opens its gates for National Hunt action, with six races scheduled from 1.50pm
paras.zh: 达坦和斯奈普在今天由天空体育赛车直播的伍斯特专题比赛中展开较量；塞奇菲尔德也为全国狩猎活动敞开大门，下午 1 点 50 分开始将举行六场比赛

paras.en: National Hunt action comes from Worcester and Sedgefield on Tuesday, live on Sky Sports Racing.
paras.zh: 全国狩猎行动将于周二在伍斯特和塞奇菲尔德举行，由天空体育赛车直播。

paras.en: 1.05 Worcester - Dartan and Snipe contest strong handicap chase
paras.zh: 1.05伍斯特-达坦和斯奈普较量强让分追逐

paras.en: The 130-rated Dartan takes the drop-in class after being tailed off in a handicap hurdle at Haydock in April. He has since had wind surgery which could bring about some much-needed improvement, given his chase record currently reads zero from four. Champion jockey Sean Bowen retains the ride.
paras.zh: 评分为 130 分的达坦在 4 月份在海多克 (Haydock) 的障碍赛中被淘汰后，参加了临时补习班。此后他接受了风力手术，这可能会带来一些急需的进步，因为他的追逐记录目前从四中为零。冠军骑师肖恩·鲍文 (Sean Bowen) 保留了这一骑术。

paras.en: Snipe - trained by champion trainer Dan Skelton - is far more exposed over fences than Dartan, having won four times in 24 over the larger obstacles. He was beaten in a three-runner race at Warwick last month by a short head and drops in trip today to two miles and seven furlongs.
paras.zh: Snipe 由冠军教练丹·斯凯尔顿 (Dan Skelton) 训练，在越过栅栏时比达坦 (Dartan) 暴露得多，在 24 场跨越较大障碍的比赛中，他赢得了 4 次胜利。上个月，他在沃里克举行的三人赛中因短头而被击败，今天的行程下降了两英里七弗隆。

paras.en: - Gihan Arnolda: Britain's first black trainer hoping to inspire next generation
paras.zh: - Gihan Arnolda：英国第一位黑人教练，希望激励下一代

paras.en: King Roly is two from four at Worcester, with the most recent of those victories coming on his penultimate start over today's distance. He bolted up at 5/1 under James Bowen that day but is now 6lbs above that mark.
paras.zh: 罗利国王在伍斯特的四场比赛中排名第二，最近的一场胜利是在他今天距离的倒数第二场比赛中取得的。那天，他在詹姆斯·鲍文 (James Bowen) 的带领下以 5 比 1 的体重猛增，但现在比这个标准高出了 6 磅。

paras.en: 1.50 Sedgefield - Interesting Arms Park makes hurdle debut
paras.zh: 1.50 Sedgefield - Interesting Arms Park 首次跨栏

paras.en: Arms Park is an interesting runner in our opening Mowden Park RFC Maiden Hurdle, making his debut over obstacles.
paras.zh: Arms Park 是我们开幕的 Mowden Park RFC Maiden Hurdle 中一位有趣的跑步者，他首次跨越障碍。

paras.en: This son of Walk In The Park is lightly raced after picking up one victory from three bumpers, where he travelled strongly to make all under James Bowen at Taunton. He tanked through the race in eye-catching style that day and he arrives as an exciting prospect for the upcoming season. Interestingly enough, Act Of Innocence won this race in 2025 before going on to score in the Sidney Banks prior to producing a career best in the Turners Novices' Hurdle at Cheltenham.
paras.zh: 这匹“Walk In The Park”的儿子在三场比赛中获得一场胜利后，在汤顿的詹姆斯·鲍文（James Bowen）的带领下表现强劲，取得了全部胜利。那天他以引人注目的方式在比赛中表现不佳，并成为即将到来的赛季的令人兴奋的新星。有趣的是，“Act Of Innocence”在 2025 年赢得了这场比赛，然后在悉尼银行赛中得分，然后在切尔滕纳姆的特纳新手跨栏赛中创造了职业生涯最佳成绩。

paras.en: Dunstall Star is the most experienced in here but disappointed last time at Worcester and will need to be better to compete with Arms Park. Military Cross chased home a potentially nice horse of Gordon Elliott's in a Cartmel maiden hurdle the last day and could serve it up to Arms Park.
paras.zh: 邓斯托尔·斯塔 (Dunstall Star) 是这里经验最丰富的球员，但上次在伍斯特感到失望，他需要做得更好才能与阿姆斯公园队竞争。军事克罗斯在最后一天在卡特梅尔处女栏中追回了戈登·埃利奥特的一匹潜在的好马，并可以将其送至阿姆斯公园。

paras.en: 2.50 Sedgefield - Jet Of Dreams attempts to defy 7lb penalty
paras.zh: 2.50 Sedgefield - Jet Of Dreams 试图违抗 7 磅的处罚

paras.en: Jet Of Dreams will attempt to defy the penalty given to him in the Jodie Standings Point-To-Point Recruits Handicap Chase.
paras.zh: Jet Of Dreams 将尝试无视在 Jodie 积分榜点对点新兵让分追逐赛中受到的处罚。

paras.en: Warren Greatrex's eight-year-old followed up his seasonal reappearance with a nice victory over course and distance last Tuesday, being nursed into the race before winning well. If he produces a similar display today, he could be hard to beat.
paras.zh: 沃伦·格雷特雷克斯 (Warren Greatrex) 的八岁马继赛季回归后，上周二在赛道和距离上取得了不错的胜利，在比赛中得到了很好的照顾，最终取得了好成绩。如果他今天能打出类似的表现，他可能很难被击败。

paras.en: Kientzheim - owned by JP McManus - hasn't taken to fences thus far but her peak hurdling rating of 121 suggests Ben Haslam's mare has plenty of ability if she can rectify her jumping. Kevin Brogan comes in for the ride, replacing Harry Cobden.
paras.zh: 金茨海姆 (Kientzheim) 的所有者是 JP 麦克马纳斯 (JP McManus)，到目前为止还没有参加过栏杆比赛，但她的最高跨栏评级为 121 分，这表明本·哈斯拉姆 (Ben Haslam) 的母马如果能够纠正跳跃能力，则拥有足够的能力。凯文·布罗根 (Kevin Brogan) 接替哈里·科布登 (Harry Cobden)。

paras.en: Neigh Botha was pulled up at Worcester in July but had notched up three wins from his four starts prior. This Greenall and Guerriero runner will have benefitted from a break and if fit, could be right in the mix. Lady Kara completes the quartet and looks to be on the up, having only been beaten two lengths by Jet Of Dreams over this course and distance last month.
paras.zh: Neigh Botha 于 7 月份在伍斯特被拉下场，但在之前的四场比赛中取得了三场胜利。这位格林纳尔和格雷罗的跑步者将从休息中受益，如果身体健康，可能会加入其中。 Lady Kara 完成了四重奏，看起来正在上升，上个月在这条路线和距离上只被 Jet Of Dreams 击败了两个马位。

paras.en: Perfect Pitch, a Wootton Bassett colt with an entry in the Criterium International, runs in Chantilly's Prix du Grand Vivier at 11.17am. He was a tad disappointing on debut at Saint-Cloud but should progress today in the Juddmonte colours.
paras.zh: Perfect Pitch 是一匹伍顿巴塞特 (Wootton Bassett) 的小马，曾参加过国际马术赛 (Criterium International)，将于上午 11 点 17 分参加尚蒂伊 (Chantilly) 的 Grand Vivier 大奖赛。他在圣克劳德的首秀有点令人失望，但今天在朱德蒙特的比赛中应该会取得进步。

paras.en: Worcester's 2.35pm CopyBet Supporting UK Horse Racing Fillies' Juvenile Maiden Hurdle sees Miss Moffett - a half-sister to Nube Negra - make her debut for the Skelton team. After failing to fire on the Flat, Big Orange's half-sister Miss Malone To You tackles hurdles for the first time.
paras.zh: 伍斯特下午 2.35 点的 CopyBet 支持英国赛马母马少年少女跨栏，努贝·内格拉 (Nube Negra) 同父异母的妹妹莫菲特小姐 (Miss Moffett) 首次代表斯克尔顿队 (Skelton team) 亮相。在向公寓射击失败后，大橙子同父异母的妹妹马龙小姐向你首次挑战障碍。

paras.en: At Sedgefield, Sam England's Littletown Lad goes for the hat-trick in the 3.50pm Winning Connections Conference Hire Handicap Hurdle.
paras.zh: 在塞奇菲尔德，Sam England 的 Littletown Lad 在下午 3.50 的 Winning Connections Conference Hire Handicap Hurdle 中上演帽子戏法。

articles.title: Hamilton: Ferrari have to catch up with rivals on power

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton insists Ferrari must 'catch up' with rivals on power unit performance for 2027 F1 season
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿坚称法拉利必须在 2027 年 F1 赛季的动力装置性能上“赶上”竞争对手

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton has dropped more than 100 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli amid Ferrari's inability to match Mercedes' power; watch F1's first ever Singapore Grand Prix Sprint weekend live on Sky Sports F1, with Sprint Qualifying at 1pm on Friday
paras.zh: 由于法拉利无法与梅赛德斯相匹敌，刘易斯·汉密尔顿 (Lewis Hamilton) 落后积分榜领先者基米·安东内利 (Kimi Antonelli) 100 多分；在天空体育 F1 上观看 F1 首个新加坡大奖赛冲刺周末直播，冲刺排位赛将于周五下午 1 点举行

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton is urging Ferrari to improve the performance of their power unit for the 2027 Formula 1 season as the 41-year-old eyes a shot at a record eighth world championship next year.
paras.zh: 41 岁的刘易斯·汉密尔顿 (Lewis Hamilton) 敦促法拉利在 2027 年一级方程式赛季中提高动力装置的性能，这位 41 岁的刘易斯·汉密尔顿 (Lewis Hamilton) 有望在明年夺得创纪录的第八个世界冠军。

paras.en: A first Ferrari grand prix victory for Hamilton in Barcelona in June provided hope that he could launch a 2026 title challenge, but an underwhelming run after the summer break saw his deficit to Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli grow beyond 100 points.
paras.zh: 6 月在巴塞罗那举行的汉密尔顿首场法拉利大奖赛胜利为他发起 2026 年冠军挑战带来了希望，但暑假后的表现平平，导致他与梅赛德斯积分榜领先者基米·安东内利的差距扩大到了 100 分以上。

paras.en: Hamilton ended a streak of six races without a podium by finishing third at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia on Sunday, with only a poor choice of starting tyre costing him the chance to use his impressive pace to battle Red Bull's Max Verstappen for victory.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿周日在马来西亚举行的巴林大奖赛上获得第三名，结束了连续六场比赛没有登上领奖台的记​​录，但由于起步轮胎的选择不佳，他失去了利用自己令人印象深刻的速度与红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘争夺胜利的机会。

paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: Following that encouraging display, he explained why he has confidence in his team going into next year.
paras.zh: 在令人鼓舞的表现之后，他解释了为什么他对球队明年充满信心。

paras.en: Hamilton told Sky Sports F1: "I think fundamentally we've got a great car, and that's down to an amazing group of people back at the factory, who are really intelligent and have made the right decisions.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿告诉天空体育F1：“我认为从根本上来说，我们拥有一辆很棒的赛车，这要归功于工厂里一群了不起的人，他们非常聪明，做出了正确的决定。

paras.en: "As I've said before, we have been innovators this year. We've had things on the car that everyone else has often followed.
paras.zh: “正如我之前所说，今年我们一直是创新者。我们在车上安装了其他人经常效仿的东西。

paras.en: "It's just that we know we're down on power, and that's something that we just live with. We have to catch up for next year. We live with that deficit for the rest of this year."
paras.zh: “只是我们知道我们的电力不足，而这是我们只能忍受的事情。我们必须在明年迎头赶上。今年剩下的时间里，我们将忍受这种赤字。”

paras.en: With seven rounds of the 2026 season remaining, starting with a first ever Sprint event in Singapore this weekend, Hamilton is hopeful he'll have the pace to compete for more victories.
paras.zh: 2026 年赛季还剩七轮比赛，从本周末在新加坡举行的首场短距离赛开始，汉密尔顿希望他能有足够的速度争取更多胜利。

paras.en: "But still, the car is improving, and I think we've got races coming up ahead that hopefully we'll still be able to get maybe a little bit closer," he added.
paras.zh: “但是，赛车仍在进步，我认为我们接下来还有比赛，希望我们仍然能够更接近一点，”他补充道。

paras.en: "We just keep trying. And I'm enjoying the racing still. I still feel fit, still feel focused."
paras.zh: “我们只是继续努力。我仍然享受比赛。我仍然感觉健康，仍然感到专注。”

paras.en: Hamilton hopeful 'negative chatter' goes away
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿希望“负面言论”消失

paras.en: The build-up to the Bahrain Grand Prix was dominated by speculation over Ferrari team principal Frederic Vasseur's future, after former Red Bull chief Christian Horner had expressed an interest in the position.
paras.zh: 在前红牛车队主席克里斯蒂安·霍纳表达了对该职位的兴趣后，对巴林大奖赛的准备工作主要是对法拉利车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔未来的猜测。

paras.en: Ferrari publicly backed Vasseur ahead of the event, while Hamilton criticised a "negative narrative" around the team.
paras.zh: 法拉利在赛事前公开支持瓦塞尔，而汉密尔顿则批评了围绕车队的“负面叙述”。

paras.en: Asked whether he thought a strong overall result, which saw team-mate Charles Leclerc finish a place behind him in fourth, would reduce negativity, Hamilton added: "I hope it's not too negative chatter after Malaysia.
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否认为强劲的整体成绩（队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔以第四名落后于他）会减少负面情绪时，汉密尔顿补充道：“我希望马来西亚赛后不会有太负面的言论。

paras.en: "We still got good points with third and fourth."
paras.zh: “我们仍然获得了第三和第四的好成绩。”

paras.en: Vasseur retained a philosophical outlook as he said it was easy reacting to a strong performance, but more important to ensure the team remain "solid" when things don't go to plan.
paras.zh: 瓦瑟尔保留了一种哲学观点，因为他表示，对强劲表现做出反应很容易，但更重要的是，当事情没有按计划进行时，确保团队保持“稳固”。

paras.en: "You know perfectly the weekends are much easier to manage when you are doing a strong performance," Vasseur said.
paras.zh: “你完全知道，当你表现出色时，周末会更容易管理，”瓦瑟尔说。

paras.en: "The most important thing is to be solid when it's not the case. Sometimes it won't be the case.
paras.zh: “最重要的是，当情况并非如此时，要保持坚定。有时情况并非如此。

paras.en: "It will happen to everybody. It was a tough weekend for McLaren. They came with a lot of expectations. It was difficult for them.
paras.zh: “这会发生在每个人身上。对于迈凯伦来说，这是一个艰难的周末。他们带着很多期望而来。这对他们来说很困难。

paras.en: "But it's also in this situation that you have to react as a team and to stay together.
paras.zh: “但正是在这种情况下，你必须作为一个团队做出反应并保持团结。

paras.en: "It's always easy to deal with a good weekend."
paras.zh: “度过一个美好的周末总是很容易的。”

articles.title: Trump says he plans to speak with Putin about possible pneumonic plague case in Russia
articles.author: Raquel Coronell Uribe

paras.en: President Donald Trump said Tuesday that he has a call scheduled with Russian President Vladimir Putin to discuss the pneumonic plague, after the death of a female staffer at a Russian anti-plague lab that’s sparked public health fears worldwide.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周二表示，他计划与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京通电话，讨论肺鼠疫问题，此前俄罗斯抗鼠疫实验室一名女工作人员死亡引发了全球公共卫生担忧。

paras.en: Asked whether he had spoken with Putin about the matter, Trump told reporters on the White House South Lawn that he had a “call scheduled” and that it would take place “very soon.”
paras.zh: 当被问及是否已与普京谈过此事时，特朗普在白宫南草坪告诉记者，他已“安排好通话”，并将“很快”进行。

paras.en: The Russian Embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Trump’s remarks.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯驻华盛顿大使馆没有立即回应对特朗普言论发表评论的请求。

paras.en: Trump had told reporters Monday that he was willing to help Russia, calling the pneumonic plague “a rough disease.”
paras.zh: 特朗普周一告诉记者，他愿意帮助俄罗斯，称肺鼠疫是“一种严重的疾病”。

paras.en: “I hate to see them having it,” Trump said. “Anybody that has that kind of a problem, we’re always willing to help.”
paras.zh: “我讨厌看到他们拥有它，”特朗普说。 “任何遇到此类问题的人，我们总是愿意提供帮助。”

paras.en: A Russian health watchdog said last week that Darya Shipilova, 28, a staffer at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East, had died from a “pneumonia of undetermined” origin.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯卫生监督机构上周表示，28 岁的西伯利亚和远东伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所工作人员达里娅·希皮洛娃 (Darya Shipilova) 死于“不明原因肺炎”。

paras.en: The watchdog concluded that plague was not found among the staffer’s contacts, saying only that they found two cases of Covid and one of rhinovirus.
paras.zh: 监管机构得出的结论是，在该工作人员的接触者中没有发现鼠疫，只是说他们发现了两例新冠病例和一例鼻病毒病例。

paras.en: A State Department official told NBC News earlier Tuesday that the U.S. had been in contact with the Russian government regarding the incident since as early as Friday, following reports of Shipilova’s death.
paras.zh: 周二早些时候，美国国务院一名官员告诉 NBC 新闻，在希皮洛娃死亡的报道发布后，美国早在周五就已就这一事件与俄罗斯政府进行了接触。

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Tuesday that Russia should share more information with the world, but asked the public not to jump to conclusions.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿卢比奥周二表示，俄罗斯应该与世界分享更多信息，但要求公众不要急于下结论。

paras.en: “Maybe, you know, there’s nothing there. Maybe it’s bigger than we thought. We don’t know,” Rubio told reporters during a news conference in Iceland. “But I think it would be reckless at this moment, given the limited information we still have, to speculate about what this might or might not be or what this is or what this isn’t.”
paras.zh: “也许，你知道，那里什么都没有。也许它比我们想象的要大。我们不知道，”卢比奥在冰岛举行的新闻发布会上告诉记者。 “但我认为，鉴于我们仍然掌握的信息有限，目前猜测这可能是什么或可能不是什么，这是什么或这不是什么，是鲁莽的。”

paras.en: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention said Tuesday it was aware of and monitoring reports of the death, which it called “a suspected case of pneumonic plague in the Irkutsk region of Russia.”
paras.zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心周二表示，已了解并正在监测这起死亡事件的报告，称其为“俄罗斯伊尔库茨克地区疑似肺鼠疫病例”。

paras.en: “At this time, there is no indication of a broader threat to the United States, but CDC and our interagency partners are prepared and will continue to monitor the situation closely,” the CDC wrote on X.
paras.zh: CDC 在 X 上写道：“目前没有迹象表明美国面临更广泛的威胁，但 CDC 和我们的跨机构合作伙伴已做好准备，并将继续密切监视局势。”

articles.title: Indonesia's VP likely didn't finish high school and it could cost him his job
articles.author: Hellena Souisa

paras.en: Indonesia's Constitutional Court has handed down what may have been one of the country's most closely watched rulings.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚宪法法院做出了可能是该国最受关注的裁决之一。

paras.en: On Tuesday night, the court dismissed a legal challenge over Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka's educational eligibility to contest the 2024 presidential election.
paras.zh: 周二晚，法院驳回了针对副总统吉布兰·拉卡布明·拉卡 (Gibran Rakabuming Raka) 参加 2024 年总统选举的教育资格提出的法律质疑。

paras.en: The decision followed three days of lengthy and heated hearings, during which the court heard evidence from expert witnesses and representatives from several government institutions, including education and cultural attachés from Indonesia's embassies in Australia and Singapore.
paras.zh: 该决定是在为期三天的漫长而激烈的听证会之后做出的，听证会期间，法庭听取了专家证人和多个政府机构代表的证据，其中包括印度尼西亚驻澳大利亚和新加坡大使馆的教育和文化专员。

paras.en: Indonesia's election law states that presidential and vice-presidential candidates must have completed senior high school or hold an equivalent qualification.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚选举法规定，总统和副总统候选人必须完成高中学业或持有同等资格。

paras.en: The petitioners in the case argued that Mr Gibran, who is the son of former president Joko Widodo, submitted education documents that should not have been accepted by election officials at the time.
paras.zh: 该案的请愿者辩称，前总统佐科维多多的儿子纪伯伦提交了当时不应该被选举官员接受的教育文件。

paras.en: The applicants said the document Mr Gibran submitted was not a graduation certificate, but a supporting letter issued by Indonesia's Ministry of Education, based on a Certificate of Attendance and an academic transcript from UTS College in Sydney, previously known as UTS Insearch.
paras.zh: 申请人表示，纪伯伦提交的文件不是毕业证书，而是印度尼西亚教育部根据悉尼科技大学学院（以前称为UTS Insearch）的出勤证书和成绩单签发的证明信。

paras.en: The applicants included 12 parties, including the Independent Election Monitoring Committee (KIPP), the Islamist Ummah Party, former deputy law minister Denny Indrayana and the Indonesian Military Retired Personnel Forum.
paras.zh: 申请者包括独立选举监督委员会（KIPP）、伊斯兰乌玛党、前司法部副部长丹尼·英德拉亚纳（Denny Indrayana）和印尼军人退休人员论坛等12个政党。

paras.en: The applicants also challenged exemptions in the election regulations, including the provision allowing candidates who completed their schooling overseas to submit an alternative to a secondary school graduation certificate.
paras.zh: 申请人还对选举规定中的豁免提出质疑，包括允许在海外完成学业的候选人提交中学毕业证书替代材料的规定。

paras.en: "There was a structured, systematic and deliberate process concealed through manipulation," the applicants' lawyer, Bambang Widjojanto, told the court.
paras.zh: 申请人的律师班邦·维乔扬托 (Bambang Widjojanto) 告诉法庭：“这是一个通过操纵而隐藏起来的结构化、系统性和故意的过程。”

paras.en: The Constitutional Court dismissed the application, saying the matter could no longer be resolved through a presidential election dispute process because Mr Gibran had already been sworn in as Vice-President in October 2024.
paras.zh: 宪法法院驳回了该申请，称此事无法再通过总统选举争议程序解决，因为吉布兰先生已于 2024 年 10 月宣誓就任副总统。

paras.en: It also said the election result could only be challenged by presidential and vice-presidential candidates.
paras.zh: 它还表示，选举结果只能受到总统和副总统候选人的质疑。

paras.en: "Although the court found no convincing evidence that Gibran has a foreign diploma equivalent to having completed senior high school, or another equivalent school as stipulated in Election Law, the court cannot annul or disqualify him as requested by the petitioners," Judge Adies Kadir said, according to a Reuters report.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，法官阿迪斯·卡迪尔表示：“尽管法院没有发现令人信服的证据证明纪伯伦拥有相当于完成高中学业的外国文凭，或选举法规定的另一所同等学校，但法院不能按照请愿者的要求取消或取消他的资格。”

paras.en: Judge Adies said the court also found that the authority to address the issue of Mr Gibran's eligibility to be vice-president due to the absence of his graduation certificate fell under the authority of other institutions, without providing further details.
paras.zh: 阿迪斯法官表示，法院还认为，解决纪伯伦因没有毕业证书而成为副总统的资格问题的权力属于其他机构的权力，但没有提供更多细节。

paras.en: Mr Gibran attended Orchid Park Secondary School in Singapore and UTS Insearch in Sydney, a college that prepares mostly international students for entry to UTS degrees.
paras.zh: Gibran 先生就读于新加坡 Orchid Park 中学和悉尼 UTS Insearch，该学院主要为国际学生升读 UTS 学位做准备。

paras.en: However, neither is considered high school.
paras.zh: 然而，两者都不被视为高中。

paras.en: The ABC contacted UTS College to verify Mr Gibran's enrolment and seek comment, but the institution declined, citing Australian privacy laws.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚广播公司联系了悉尼科技大学以核实吉布兰先生的入学情况并寻求评论，但该机构以澳大利亚隐私法为由拒绝了。

paras.en: Although the application was dismissed, constitutional law expert Zainal Arifin Mochtar from Gadjah Mada University said the legal proceedings identified substantive issues.
paras.zh: 尽管申请被驳回，但加札马达大学的宪法专家扎纳尔·阿里芬·莫赫塔尔表示，法律程序确定了实质性问题。

paras.en: "The Constitutional Court is essentially saying the violation exists, it is real and visible, but the applicants do not have legal standing to challenge it, and there is a separate constitutional mechanism for resolving it," Professor Mochtar told ABC.
paras.zh: 莫赫塔尔教授告诉美国广播公司：“宪法法院本质上是说违法行为存在，它是真实的、可见的，但申请人没有法律地位来质疑它，并且有一个单独的宪法机制来解决它。”

paras.en: He said the findings could also have broader implications.
paras.zh: 他表示，研究结果还可能产生更广泛的影响。

paras.en: "The court acknowledged that Gibran does not have evidence showing he graduated from senior high school," he said.
paras.zh: “法院承认纪伯伦没有证据表明他高中毕业，”他说。

paras.en: "That means it would be practically impossible for Gibran to nominate himself in the 2029 election because he does not have a senior secondary school certificate, unless he can produce one and have it independently verified."
paras.zh: “这意味着纪伯伦实际上不可能在 2029 年的选举中提名自己，因为他没有高中毕业证书，除非他能出示一份并进行独立验证。”

paras.en: Professor Mochtar argued the court's findings also raised questions about whether Mr Gibran had misrepresented his qualifications and whether there had been collusion between electoral authorities and education officials.
paras.zh: 莫赫塔尔教授辩称，法院的调查结果还引发了人们的疑问，即纪伯伦先生是否歪曲了自己的资格，以及选举当局和教育官员之间是否存在勾结。

paras.en: "That enters the realm of misconduct and could open the door to impeachment,"
paras.zh: “这属于不当行为的范畴，可能会打开弹劾之门，”

paras.en: Under Indonesia's constitution, a president or vice-president can be impeached for serious legal violations, including treason, corruption, bribery or other major crimes, or for no longer meeting the constitutional requirements to hold office.
paras.zh: 根据印度尼西亚宪法，总统或副总统可能因严重违法行为而受到弹劾，包括叛国、腐败、贿赂或其他重大犯罪，或不再符合宪法规定的任职要求。

paras.en: However, Mr Indrayana, the former deputy law minister and one of the applicants, argued Mr Gibran never met all the requirements in the first place, so the impeachment provisions were not used in this case.
paras.zh: 然而，申请人之一、前司法部副部长因德拉亚纳先生辩称，纪伯伦先生从一开始就没有满足所有要求，因此弹劾条款没有在本案中使用。

paras.en: The ABC has approached Mr Gibran's office for comment.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚广播公司已联系吉布兰先生的办公室寻求评论。

paras.en: Constitutional law expert Feri Amsari from Andalas University said Mr Gibran's future cannot simply be determined by the Constitutional Court.
paras.zh: 安达拉斯大学宪法专家费里·阿姆萨里表示，纪伯伦的未来不能简单地由宪法法院决定。

paras.en: "While this ruling raises questions about the validity of Gibran's position, any process to remove him from office would still need to proceed through impeachment and involve the House of Representatives (DPR), the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) and the Constitutional Court," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“虽然这项裁决对纪伯伦立场的有效性提出了质疑，但任何罢免他的程序仍需要通过弹劾进行，并涉及众议院（DPR）、人民协商会议（MPR）和宪法法院。”

paras.en: Professor Mochtar, the constitutional law expert, said Mr Gibran should consider resigning following the court's finding that there was no evidence he had completed senior high school.
paras.zh: 宪法专家莫赫塔尔教授表示，法院裁定没有证据表明吉布兰先生完成了高中学业，他应该考虑辞职。

paras.en: "In these circumstances, he should resign … resignation would be the morally responsible thing to do,"
paras.zh: “在这种情况下，他应该辞职……辞职是道义上负责任的事情。”

paras.en: Mr Amsari said the case should also serve as a warning about the importance of safeguarding the integrity of Indonesia's electoral system.
paras.zh: 安萨里先生表示，此案还应警示人们维护印度尼西亚选举制度完整性的重要性。

paras.en: "Every stage of the electoral process must comply with the law," he said.
paras.zh: “选举过程的每个阶段都必须遵守法律，”他说。

paras.en: "Responsibility does not rest solely with Gibran's camp, but with everyone involved, including election organisers."
paras.zh: “责任不仅仅在于纪伯伦阵营，还在于所有参与者，包括选举组织者。”

articles.title: Criminals banned from using character references under proposed SA law reform

paras.en: The SA government is proposing abolishing the use of good character references during sentencing for all criminal offences in the state's courts.
paras.zh: 南澳政府提议在州法院对所有刑事犯罪进行量刑时废除使用良好品格证明。

paras.en: A survivor advocate who campaigned for the change, says hearing good character references in court is "dehumanising" for victims.
paras.zh: 一位倡导这一变革的幸存者权益倡导者表示，在法庭上听到良好的品格对受害者来说是“非人性化”的。

paras.en: The proposed new laws will be released for consultation, and the state government expects to introduce a new bill next year.
paras.zh: 拟议的新法律将公布征求意见，州政府预计明年将推出新法案。

paras.en: South Australia is proposing a ban on the use of good character references for all convicted criminals during sentencing, following a nationwide campaign to abolish their use in courts.
paras.zh: 继全国范围内开展废除法庭使用良好品格证明的运动之后，南澳大利亚州提议禁止所有被定罪的罪犯在量刑期间使用良好品格证明。

paras.en: Survivor advocate Harrison James co-founded the Your Reference Ain't Relevant campaign to push for governments to ban the use of good character references in child sex offence cases four years ago, and says the proposed laws would make a tangible difference for victim-survivors.
paras.zh: 四年前，幸存者倡导者哈里森·詹姆斯 (Harrison James) 与人共同发起了“你的参考资料不相关”运动，推动政府禁止在儿童性犯罪案件中使用良好品格参考资料，并表示拟议的法律将为受害者幸存者带来切实的改变。

paras.en: "There is nothing more dehumanising than sitting in the courtroom, hearing the person who harmed you described as 'kind, generous and a good person',"
paras.zh: “没有什么比坐在法庭上，听到伤害你的人被描述为‘善良、慷慨和好人’更不人性的了，”

paras.en: "Imagine surviving the worst thing somebody has ever done to you, only to sit in court and hear about the best things they've ever done for everyone else."
paras.zh: “想象一下，你在别人对你做过的最糟糕的事情中幸存下来，却坐在法庭上，听到他们为其他人做过的最好的事情。”

paras.en: The state government says current SA laws allow an offender to tender evidence of their good character or call friends, family or employers to give evidence to support arguments for leniency in sentencing.
paras.zh: 州政府表示，现行的南澳法律允许罪犯提供良好品格的证据，或致电朋友、家人或雇主提供证据，支持宽大量刑的论点。

paras.en: The existing laws prevent judges from considering good character evidence while sentencing child sex offenders, when their suggested "good character" assisted them to commit the offence.
paras.zh: 现行法律禁止法官在对儿童性犯罪者量刑时考虑良好品格证据，因为他们认为“良好品格”有助于他们实施犯罪。

paras.en: However, the current laws allow the evidence to be considered if the offending occurred without the air of their good character, or if they had a lack of prior convictions.
paras.zh: 然而，现行法律允许在犯罪行为不具有良好品格或之前没有定罪的情况下考虑证据。

paras.en: Attorney-General Kyam Maher says consultation on the reforms would begin in the coming days, with a new bill to be introduced to parliament in the first half of next year.
paras.zh: 总检察长凯姆·马赫 (Kyam Maher) 表示，有关改革的磋商将在未来几天开始，新法案将于明年上半年提交议会。

paras.en: He said a review of the laws, was one of the recommendations from the Royal Commission into Domestic, Family and Sexual Violence, and would bring SA in line with other states, including New South Wales and Western Australia.
paras.zh: 他说，对法律进行审查是家庭暴力和性暴力皇家委员会的建议之一，将使南澳与包括新南威尔士州和西澳大利亚州在内的其他州保持一致。

paras.en: "Child sex offenders are some of the most horrific crimes and have profound and lasting impact on the victim-survivors," Mr Maher said.
paras.zh: “儿童性犯罪者是最可怕的犯罪行为之一，对受害者幸存者产生深远而持久的影响，”马赫先生说。

paras.en: "Victim-survivors of children sex abuse should not have to be re-traumatised during the court process while hearing friends and family of the offender describe them as a 'good person' to try and minimise their sentence.
paras.zh: “儿童性虐待的受害者幸存者不应该在法庭审理过程中再次受到创伤，同时听到罪犯的朋友和家人将他们描述为‘好人’，以尽量减少刑罚。

paras.en: "If you have been found guilty of an offence, your sentence should not be minimised because you have managed to deceive some people into believing you are a person of 'good character'."
paras.zh: “如果你被判有罪，你的刑期不应该被减轻，因为你成功地欺骗了一些人，让他们相信你是一个‘品行良好’的人。”

paras.en: A review of the Your Reference Ain’t Relevant campaign by the NSW Sentencing Council recommended good character references should be abolished in sentencing for all types of offences, not just child sex offences.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州量刑委员会对“你的推荐信不相关”活动进行的审查建议，在对所有类型的犯罪（而不仅仅是儿童性犯罪）的量刑中应废除良好品格推荐。

paras.en: It also recommended courts retain the ability to consider factors such as an offender's prospects of rehabilitation, prior convictions and likelihood of reoffending.
paras.zh: 它还建议法院保留考虑罪犯改过自新的前景、先前定罪和再次犯罪的可能性等因素的能力。

paras.en: Mr James said the campaign was not about discounting personal circumstances and did not aim to abolish those objective and relevant sentencing considerations, but the subjective description of offenders.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯先生表示，这项运动并不是要忽视个人情况，也不是为了废除那些客观和相关的量刑考虑因素，而是要废除对罪犯的主观描述。

paras.en: He said offenders "should not be able to weaponise their reputation to minimise the consequences of their violent offending".
paras.zh: 他说，犯罪者“不应该利用自己的声誉来减少暴力犯罪的后果”。

paras.en: "The fact that somebody was a wonderful colleague, neighbour or football coach doesn't make what they did to their victim any less serious and a survivor shouldn't have to compete with an offender's reputation in the courtroom," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“某人是一位出色的同事、邻居或足球教练，这一事实并不能减轻他们对受害者所做的事情的严重性，幸存者不应该在法庭上与罪犯的声誉竞争。”

paras.en: "Your reputation should never be a discount on your sentence."
paras.zh: “你的名誉永远不应该因为你的刑期而打折扣。”

articles.title: Mint unveils new coins chronicling iconic Australian inventions

paras.en: What do a jaffle maker, a baby safety capsule and a black box have in common?
paras.zh: 果酱机、婴儿安全舱和黑匣子有什么共同点？

paras.en: Not only are they Australian inventions, but they will soon feature on $1 coins as part of the Royal Australian Mint's new Bright Ideas collection.
paras.zh: 它们不仅是澳大利亚的发明，而且很快将作为澳大利亚皇家造币厂新的 Bright Ideas 系列的一部分出现在 1 美元硬币上。

paras.en: The collection chronicles five of Australia's most decorated inventions, including the stump jump plough, jaffle maker, black box flight recorder, baby safety capsule and high-speed Wireless LAN (WLAN) technology.
paras.zh: 该系列记录了澳大利亚五项最受装饰的发明，包括树桩跳犁、jafflemaker、黑匣子飞行记录器、婴儿安全舱和高速无线局域网（WLAN）技术。

paras.en: Mint chief executive Emily Martin said the coins gave Australians "a chance to stop, look again and celebrate the people who thought differently".
paras.zh: 造币厂首席执行官艾米丽·马丁表示，这些硬币让澳大利亚人“有机会停下来，重新审视并庆祝那些有不同想法的人们”。

paras.en: "I've used four of the five inventions celebrated in Bright Ideas without necessarily stopping to think about the Australian ingenuity behind them," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“我已经使用了《聪明创意》中庆祝的五项发明中的四项，但没有必要停下来思考它们背后澳大利亚的独创性。”

paras.en: "That's what I love about this collection. These aren't inventions sitting behind glass in a museum — they're ideas that have become part of Australian life."
paras.zh: “这就是我喜欢这个藏品的原因。这些不是博物馆玻璃后面的发明——它们是已经成为澳大利亚生活一部分的想法。”

paras.en: One of the five coin designs features the stump jump plough, a piece of machinery that revolutionised the way farmers tended to their land.
paras.zh: 五种硬币设计之一的特色是树桩跳犁，这是一种彻底改变了农民耕种土地方式的机械。

paras.en: It was designed in 1876 by South Australian farmer Richard Smith and was adopted worldwide, hailed as a cornerstone of farming technology.
paras.zh: 它由南澳大利亚农民理查德·史密斯于 1876 年设计，并在全世界范围内采用，被誉为农业技术的基石。

paras.en: In 1949, Dr Ernest Smithers invented the jaffle maker, which went on to become a classic culinary staple in many Australian kitchens.
paras.zh: 1949 年，欧内斯特·史密瑟斯 (Ernest Smithers) 博士发明了 jaffles 机，后来成为许多澳大利亚厨房的经典烹饪主食。

paras.en: Appliance giant Breville later re-imagined the device into an electronic toaster, cementing its position in modern gastronomic Australia.
paras.zh: 家电巨头布雷维尔后来将该设备重新设计成电子烤面包机，巩固了其在现代澳大利亚美食界的地位。

paras.en: A few years later, Defence scientist Dr David Warren invented the black box flight recorder, which collect data from cockpits and help investigators assess the causes of plane crashes.
paras.zh: 几年后，国防科学家大卫·沃伦博士发明了黑匣子飞行记录器，它可以从驾驶舱收集数据并帮助调查人员评估飞机失事的原因。

paras.en: Adelaide trio Bill Bowtell, Bob Heath and Colin Nagel founded the Safe-n-Sound baby safety capsule in 1984 in response to flailing safety precautions for infants travelling in cars.
paras.zh: 阿德莱德三人组 Bill Bowtell、Bob Heath 和 Colin Nagel 于 1984 年创立了 Safe-n-Sound 婴儿安全舱，以应对婴儿乘车安全预防措施的缺失。

paras.en: The final invention featuring in the collection came about in the 1990s, when scientists from the CSIRO helped develop WLAN technology, which allowed devices to connect with each other without being tied to cables. The invention went on to pave the groundwork for Wi-fi.
paras.zh: 该系列中的最后一项发明诞生于 20 世纪 90 年代，当时 CSIRO 的科学家帮助开发了 WLAN 技术，该技术允许设备无需连接电缆即可相互连接。这项发明为 Wi-Fi 奠定了基础。

paras.en: The collection has five $1 coins, each featuring one of the inventions.
paras.zh: 该系列有五枚 1 美元硬币，每枚都印有一项发明。

paras.en: Also available for purchase is a $2 proof coin featuring all five of the inventions in its design.
paras.zh: 还可以购买一枚 2 美元的精制硬币，其设计中包含所有五项发明。

paras.en: The coins will be available from Thursday, October 8, from the Royal Australian Mint in Canberra and participating newsXpress stores around the country.
paras.zh: 这些硬币将于 10 月 8 日星期四起在堪培拉的澳大利亚皇家造币厂和全国各地参与活动的 newsXpress 商店发售。

paras.en: Numismatists are also being urged to check their change, with a special $2 Bright Ideas coin entering circulation from Thursday.
paras.zh: 钱币学家也被敦促检查他们的零钱，一枚价值 2 美元的 Bright Ideas 特殊硬币从周四开始流通。

articles.title: Eva Marie Saint, Oscar-winning On the Waterfront actor, dead at 102

paras.en: Eva Marie Saint, Oscar-winning On the Waterfront actor, dead at 102
paras.zh: 奥斯卡获奖演员伊娃·玛丽·森特 (Eva Marie Saint) 去世，享年 102 岁

paras.en: Hollywood star also featured opposite Cary Grant in North by Northwest
paras.zh: 好莱坞明星还在《西北偏北》中与加里·格兰特演对手戏

paras.en: Eva Marie Saint, the pale, willowy actor who won an Academy Award for her first movie, On the Waterfront, and starred opposite Cary Grant in the Alfred Hitchcock thriller North by Northwest, has died. She was 102.
paras.zh: 伊娃·玛丽·森特 (Eva Marie Saint) 去世，她是一位脸色苍白、身材苗条的演员，她的第一部电影《海滨》获得了奥斯卡金像奖，并在阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克的惊悚片《西北偏北》中与加里·格兰特演对手戏。她102岁了。

paras.en: Saint, whose acting work lasted well into her 90s, died at her home in Los Angeles on Tuesday, confirmed family representative Jeff Sanderson.
paras.zh: 圣特的演艺工作一直持续到了 90 多岁，她的家庭代表杰夫·桑德森 (Jeff Sanderson) 证实，她于周二在洛杉矶的家中去世。

paras.en: Saint had one of the most spectacular debuts in Hollywood history as the love interest of Marlon Brando's tormented Terry Malloy in On the Waterfront, and her first trip to the Academy Awards was memorable, too. Pregnant with her first child, Saint accepted her Oscar from Frank Sinatra and smilingly murmured a unique winner's speech: "I think I may have the baby right here." (Her son, Darrell, was born two days later.)
paras.zh: 圣女在《海滨》中饰演马龙·白兰度 (Marlon Brando) 饰演的备受折磨的特里·马洛伊 (Terry Malloy) 的爱人，这是好莱坞历史上最精彩的处女作之一，她的第一次奥斯卡颁奖典礼之旅也令人难忘。圣特怀着她的第一个孩子，从弗兰克·西纳特拉手中接过了奥斯卡奖，并微笑着低声发表了一段独特的获奖感言：“我想我可能会在这里生下孩子。” （两天后，她的儿子达雷尔出生了。）

paras.en: The award for the 1954 classic made her an instant star, but she soon astonished Hollywood with a firm independence that would mark her career. She refused offers of studio contracts and declined chances to follow up on her great success, explaining that she was taking time off to become acquainted with her new son. (A daughter, Laurette, was born in 1958.)
paras.zh: 1954 年的经典之作让她一举成名，但她很快就以坚定的独立性震惊了好莱坞，这也成为了她职业生涯的标志。她拒绝了工作室的合同，并拒绝了继续她巨大成功的机会，解释说她正在抽出时间来熟悉她的新儿子。 （女儿 Laurette 出生于 1958 年。）

paras.en: In her first decade in Hollywood, Saint appeared in a mere seven films. She declined such top-level productions as The Man in the Gray Flannel Suit with Gregory Peck, Summer and Smoke with Laurence Harvey and The Rainmaker with Burt Lancaster. She credited her husband, TV and stage director Jeffrey Hayden, with persuading her to star in Hitchcock's North by Northwest, the classic 1959 thriller in which Saint plays a spy who seduces Grant's character, but ends up falling for him.
paras.zh: 在进入好莱坞的第一个十年里，圣特只出演了七部电影。她拒绝了诸如与格利高里·派克合作的《穿灰色法兰绒西装的男人》、与劳伦斯·哈维合作的《夏日与烟雾》以及与伯特·兰卡斯特合作的《造雨人》等顶级制作。她将自己的功劳归功于她的丈夫、电视和舞台导演杰弗里·海登（Jeffrey Hayden）说服她出演希区柯克 1959 年的经典惊悚片《西北偏北》，圣特在片中扮演一名间谍，引诱格兰特扮演的角色，但最终爱上了他。

paras.en: In her first decade in Hollywood, Saint appeared in a mere seven films. (Keystone Features/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 在进入好莱坞的第一个十年里，圣特只出演了七部电影。 （梯形特征/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: "I vividly remember him saying, 'Honey, I think you should find a quiet spot. I'll take care of the children and I want you to really think about this and reread this script,"' she told Vanity Fair in 2014. "He was so right. And that's what husbands are for."
paras.zh: “我清楚地记得他说，‘亲爱的，我认为你应该找一个安静的地方。我会照顾孩子，我希望你认真考虑一下并重读这个剧本，’”她在 2014 年告诉《名利场》。“他说得太对了。这就是丈夫的职责。”

paras.en: Instead of being put off by her selectivity, studios continued offering her starring roles in such films as Exodus (with Newman), Raintree County (with Elizabeth Taylor and Montgomery Clift) and All Fall Down, with Warren Beatty.
paras.zh: 电影公司并没有因为她的选择性而推迟，而是继续让她在《出埃及记》（与纽曼合作）、《雨树县》（与伊丽莎白·泰勒和蒙哥马利·克利夫特合作）以及与沃伦·比蒂合作的《倾城》等电影中担任主演。

paras.en: She turned more to television in the 1970s and enjoyed renewed popularity in the 1980s as the mother of Cybill Shepherd in the hit sitcom Moonlighting and as Tom Hanks's mother in the comedy film Nothing in Common. She won an Emmy for the 1990 miniseries People Like Us, and had roles in such 21st-century movies as Because of Winn-Dixie, Superman Returns and Winter's Tale, the latter of which was adapted from Mark Helprin's novel of the same name. In 2021, she played Marisa Tomei's aunt in the brief audio play The Bus Ride, part of The Pack Podcast.
paras.zh: 她在 20 世纪 70 年代更多地转向电视，并在 1980 年代再次受到欢迎，她在热门情景喜剧《月光男孩》中饰演西比尔·谢泼德的母亲，并在喜剧电影《无名之辈》中饰演汤姆·汉克斯的母亲。她凭借 1990 年迷你剧《像我们一样的人》获得艾美奖，并在《因为温迪克西》、《超人归来》和《冬天的故事》等 21 世纪电影中扮演角色，后者改编自马克·赫尔普林的同名小说。 2021 年，她在 The Pack Podcast 的简短音频剧《The Bus Ride》中扮演玛丽莎·托梅 (Marisa Tomei) 的阿姨。

paras.en: Saint was married to Hayden for 65 years, until his death in 2016.
paras.zh: Saint 与 Hayden 结婚 65 年，直至 2016 年去世。

paras.en: Saint, left, and husband, Jeffrey Hayden, attend an event in Los Angeles in October 1957. Saint was married to Hayden for 65 years, until his death in 2016. (Harold P. Matosian/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 1957 年 10 月，Saint（左）和丈夫 Jeffrey Hayden 出席在洛杉矶举行的一次活动。Saint 与 Hayden 结婚 65 年，直至 2016 年去世。（Harold P. Matosian/美联社）

paras.en: When Saint emerged in the public consciousness, many believed her theatrical-sounding name must have been invented. She was born with it on July 4, 1924, in Newark, N.J. The family moved to Delmar, a small town near Albany, N.Y., where her father was a Goodrich Rubber Co. manager. Saint's goal was to become a third-grade teacher like her mother, but at Bowling Green State University in Ohio she tried out for a play and won the leading role.
paras.zh: 当圣女出现在公众意识中时，许多人相信她这个听起来很戏剧化的名字一定是被发明的。她于 1924 年 7 月 4 日出生在新泽西州纽瓦克。全家搬到了纽约州奥尔巴尼附近的一个小镇德尔马，她的父亲在那里担任古德里奇橡胶公司的经理。圣特的目标是像她母亲一样成为一名三年级老师，但在俄亥俄州鲍灵格林州立大学，她尝试了一部戏剧并赢得了主角。

paras.en: After graduation she lived with her parents in Flushing, Long Island, and began hunting for acting jobs in Manhattan. After a fruitless year, she landed a two-line role as a telephone operator on a radio drama and soon was working steadily on soap operas and nighttime dramas, appearing for two years as Claudia on One Man's Family. Network television was booming in the early 1950s, and her looks and dramatic sense made her a favourite with casting people and producers.
paras.zh: 毕业后，她与父母住在长岛法拉盛，并开始在曼哈顿寻找演艺工作。经过一年无果而终的一年后，她在一部广播剧中扮演了电话接线员的两线角色，并很快开始在肥皂剧和夜间剧中稳定工作，并在《一个男人的家庭》中饰演克劳迪娅两年。网络电视在 20 世纪 50 年代初蓬勃发展，她的外表和戏剧感使她深受选角人员和制片人的喜爱。

paras.en: A critical turn in Saint's career came when she auditioned before Elia Kazan and was accepted into the Actors Studio, which shaped a generation of method-actor stars. She credited acting coach Lee Strasberg with helping her overcome her shyness.
paras.zh: 当圣特在埃利亚·卡赞面前试镜并被演员工作室录取时，她的职业生涯发生了一个关键的转折，这塑造了一代方法派演员明星。她感谢表演教练李·斯特拉斯伯格帮助她克服了害羞。

paras.en: "Lee Strasberg, when he got to know me a little bit, gave me a scene to do where I had to cry in front of my peers," she told the Santa Barbara Independent in 2009. "I worried about it, I worked on it, I tried to use what I was learning at the studio. I finally did the scene, and I cried, and my peers were crying with me. It was just an incredible moment for me."
paras.zh: “李·斯特拉斯伯格对我有了一点了解后，给了我一个让我不得不在同龄人面前哭泣的场景，”她在 2009 年告诉《圣巴巴拉独立报》。“我很担心，我努力去做，我尝试运用我在工作室学到的东西。我终于完成了这个场景，我哭了，我的同龄人也和我一起哭。这对我来说是一个不可思议的时刻。”

paras.en: Saint was rejected for the single female role in the play Mister Roberts, but was hired to understudy the actor chosen, Jocelyn Brando, Marlon's sister. In six frustrating months, Saint never got to substitute for Brando. She finally made it to Broadway in A Trip to Bountiful, which she had played on television.
paras.zh: 圣特因在剧《罗伯茨先生》中扮演单身女性角色而被拒绝，但被聘为替补演员，马龙的妹妹乔斯林·白兰度。在令人沮丧的六个月里，圣特从未能够替代白兰度。她最终在电视上演出的《丰盛之旅》中登上了百老汇。

paras.en: Kazan invited her to try out for the female lead in On the Waterfront by improvising a scene with Marlon Brando. She was told to try to stop a young man from entering her apartment. She told the Los Angeles Times in 2001: "All I know is that Marlon got in the door and turned on the music. We started dancing. He flicked my skirt. Kazan saw the sparks fly, and that's how I got the part."
paras.zh: 卡赞邀请她与马龙·白兰度即兴表演《海滨》中的女主角。她被告知要试图阻止一名年轻人进入她的公寓。 2001 年，她告诉《洛杉矶时报》：“我只知道马龙进门并打开音乐。我们开始跳舞。他弹开了我的裙子。卡赞看到火花四溅，这就是我得到这个角色的原因。”

articles.title: FAA investigating after Delta plane 'clipped' Air Canada aircraft at LAX

paras.en: FAA investigating after Delta plane 'clipped' Air Canada aircraft at LAX
paras.zh: 达美航空飞机在洛杉矶国际机场“撞毁”加拿大航空飞机后，美国联邦航空局正在调查

paras.en: Incident occurred as Delta plane was taxiing and Air Canada plane was being towed
paras.zh: 事件发生时达美航空飞机滑行，加拿大航空飞机被拖走

paras.en: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) says it is investigating after a Delta Air Lines plane "clipped" an Air Canada aircraft at Los Angeles International Airport on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 表示，周二，达美航空的一架飞机在洛杉矶国际机场“撞毁”了加拿大航空的一架飞机，目前正在对此进行调查。

paras.en: The aviation agency says the incident occurred around 10:30 a.m. local time as the Delta plane was taxiing for departure, and the Air Canada plane was being towed toward the gate.
paras.zh: 该航空机构表示，事件发生在当地时间上午 10 点 30 分左右，当时达美航空的飞机正在滑行准备起飞，加拿大航空的飞机则被拖向登机口。

paras.en: An Air Canada spokesperson says there are no reported injuries.
paras.zh: 加拿大航空发言人表示，目前没有人员受伤的报告。

paras.en: Sean Davidson says in a statement that Air Canada Flight 785 had arrived from Toronto before "an aircraft operated by another airline made contact with its tail."
paras.zh: 肖恩·戴维森 (Sean Davidson) 在一份声明中表示，加拿大航空 785 号航班在“另一家航空公司运营的飞机与其机尾接触之前”已从多伦多抵达。

paras.en: He says the plane will be taken out of service for inspection and repairs.
paras.zh: 他说，这架飞机将停止服务进行检查和维修。

paras.en: The U.S. agency says the Delta plane's left wingtip clipped the Air Canada aircraft's horizontal stabilizer, a wing-likestructure at the tail of a plane.
paras.zh: 美国机构表示，达美航空飞机的左翼尖撞到了加拿大航空飞机的水平稳定器，这是飞机尾部的一个类似机翼的结构。

articles.title: Trump says call scheduled with Putin to discuss possible plague death in Russia

paras.en: Trump says call scheduled with Putin to discuss possible plague death in Russia
paras.zh: 特朗普表示计划与普京通话讨论俄罗斯可能发生的鼠疫死亡事件

paras.en: WHO says Siberia case presents a 'very low' risk outside Russia
paras.zh: 世卫组织称西伯利亚病例在俄罗斯以外地区的风险“非常低”

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday said he has a call scheduled with Russian President Vladimir Putin to discuss a possible case of plague at a Siberian research institute.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周二表示，他计划与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京通话，讨论西伯利亚一家研究所可能发生的鼠疫病例。

paras.en: Speaking to reporters at the White House, Trump said he would be talking with Putin about the case "very soon." Health authorities are investigating after the death of an employee at an anti-plague institute, which authorities attributed to pneumonia with an unknown cause.
paras.zh: 特朗普在白宫对记者表示，他将“很快”与普京讨论此案。卫生当局正在调查一家抗鼠疫研究所一名员工的死亡事件，当局将其归因于不明原因的肺炎。

paras.en: Asked what the U.S. intelligence community was saying about the case, Trump said the U.S. is in "very deep discussions" on the topic. "We'll be able to report about it, probably tomorrow," Trump said.
paras.zh: 当被问及美国情报界对此案有何看法时，特朗普表示，美国正在就该话题进行“非常深入的讨论”。特朗普说：“我们可能会在明天报告此事。”

paras.en: The World Health Organization on Tuesday said the case presents a "very low" risk outside Russia. The United Nations agency said it was in contact with Russian authorities following reports of the death last week of a woman who worked at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织周二表示，该病例在俄罗斯境外的风险“非常低”。联合国机构表示，在上周有报道称一名在西伯利亚和远东伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所工作的妇女死亡后，它正在与俄罗斯当局联系。

paras.en: On Monday, Trump said the U.S. would be willing to help Russia with the situation.
paras.zh: 特朗普周一表示，美国愿意帮助俄罗斯解决这一问题。

paras.en: The call also comes as the Trump administration faces an Oct. 18 deadline to decide which Russian entities, if any, it will sanction under the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, which Trump signed into law on Sept. 18.
paras.zh: 这一呼吁发布之际，特朗普政府面临着 10 月 18 日的最后期限，要决定根据《林赛·格雷厄姆制裁俄罗斯和伊朗法案》对哪些俄罗斯实体（如果有的话）进行制裁，该法案于 9 月 18 日被特朗普签署成为法律。

paras.en: Ukraine has given the administration and Congress a wish list of Russian companies, vessels and individuals it would like to see hit with U.S. sanctions under that law.
paras.zh: 乌克兰已向政府和国会提交了一份希望美国根据该法律实施制裁的俄罗斯公司、船只和个人的愿望清单。

articles.title: Tigray war may spill over to Eritrea — helped by Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's rhetoric

paras.en: Amid escalating conflict in Ethiopia's northernmost Tigray region, Abiy Ahmed has been sworn in for another term as Prime Minister of Ethiopia.
paras.zh: 在埃塞俄比亚最北端提格雷地区的冲突不断升级之际，阿比·艾哈迈德宣誓连任埃塞俄比亚总理。

paras.en: Shortly after the ceremony on Monday afternoon, Abiy reiterated his will to work toward giving the landlocked country direct access to the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 周一下午的仪式结束后不久，阿比重申了他致力于让这个内陆国家直接进入红海的意愿。

paras.en: "Based on the principle of give and take, we will work diligently to ensure that Ethiopia has an outlet to the sea," Abiy said, a remark that risks exacerbating tensions with neighboring Eritrea. The two countries have been at odds over Ethiopia's desire to control Eritrea's port of Assab.
paras.zh: 阿比说：“基于互惠互利的原则，我们将努力确保埃塞俄比亚拥有出海口。”这一言论有可能加剧与邻国厄立特里亚的紧张关系。两国在埃塞俄比亚控制厄立特里亚阿萨布港的愿望上一直存在分歧。

paras.en: DW correspondent Solomon Muchie, who followed the swearing-in ceremony in Addis Ababa, said despite the renewed mandate, Abiy faces challenging times ahead.
paras.zh: 德国之声记者所罗门·穆奇在亚的斯亚贝巴观看了宣誓就职仪式后表示，尽管获得了新的授权，阿比仍面临着充满挑战的时期。

paras.en: "The new term gives Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed stronger political authority," Solomon said. "But the country's complex internal and regional challenges could make it difficult to translate the authority into lasting stability."
paras.zh: 所罗门说：“新任期赋予总理阿比·艾哈迈德更强的政治权威。” “但该国复杂的内部和地区挑战可能使其难以将权威转化为持久稳定。”

paras.en: Sunday's meeting in Cairo of countries that opposed Ethiopia was a case in point, Munchie said. "The leaders of Egypt, Eritrea, Somalia and Sudan discussed regional issues, but Ethiopia was excluded from this meeting, so this is also what Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's government will face in his tenure in the coming years."
paras.zh: 蒙奇说，反对埃塞俄比亚的国家周日在开罗举行的会议就是一个很好的例子。 “埃及、厄立特里亚、索马里和苏丹领导人讨论了地区问题，但埃塞俄比亚被排除在本次会议之外，因此这也是阿比·艾哈迈德总理政府在未来几年的任期内将面临的问题。”

paras.en: Ethiopia still eyeing Eritrea's port of Assab
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚仍在关注厄立特里亚的阿萨布港

paras.en: For analyst Abdurahman Sayed, who leads the London-based Horn of Africa Center for Regional Integration, Eritrea now faces an imminent threat of entering the war in Tigray. This comes after a three-year Ethiopian campaign to gain control of the port of Assab.
paras.zh: 伦敦非洲之角区域一体化中心的领导者阿卜杜拉赫曼·赛义德认为，厄立特里亚现在面临着加入提格雷战争的迫在眉睫的威胁。在此之前，埃塞俄比亚为控制阿萨布港进行了三年的战役。

paras.en: "Eritrea has legitimate concern of Ethiopia's intentions to occupy [the country] if it can, and then if not, then at least take the port of Assab, which is a very important port, not only for commercial purposes but also strategically," Sayed said.
paras.zh: 赛义德说：“如果可以的话，厄立特里亚对埃塞俄比亚占领[该国]的意图有合理的担忧，如果不能，那么至少占领阿萨布港，这是一个非常重要的港口，不仅出于商业目的，而且具有战略意义。”

paras.en: "It oversees the Bab el Mandeb [Strait], which is the southern entrance to the Red Sea. Now, without that port, Eritrea's strategic significance would be reduced to almost nil, so there wouldn't be any importance of Eritrea."
paras.zh: “它监管着曼德海峡，这是红海的南部入口。现在，如果没有这个港口，厄立特里亚的战略意义将几乎为零，因此厄立特里亚就不会有任何重要性。”

paras.en: Last week, Ethiopia severed its diplomatic ties with Eritrea and Egypt. According to Sayed, this might be a sign that the government is determined to pursue its push for the Red Sea port by force.
paras.zh: 上周，埃塞俄比亚断绝了与厄立特里亚和埃及的外交关系。赛义德表示，这可能表明政府决心以武力推进红海港口。

paras.en: The renewed fighting in Tigray might point in that direction. Just days ago, the Ethiopian National Defence Forces took control of Tigray's capital, Mekelle.
paras.zh: 提格雷重新爆发的战斗可能会指向这个方向。就在几天前，埃塞俄比亚国防军控制了提格雷首府梅克莱。

paras.en: On Monday, a pro-government media outlet reported that the Ethiopian army had begun mobilizing its troops towards the Eritrean border, following a movement of the opposed Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) retreating to the area near Adigrat, an important gateway to Eritrea and the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 周一，一家亲政府媒体报道称，在反对派提格雷人民解放阵线（TPLF）撤退到阿迪格拉特附近地区后，埃塞俄比亚军队已开始向厄立特里亚边境动员部队，阿迪格拉特是通往厄立特里亚和红海的重要门户。

paras.en: "The Tigrayan people have cultural, linguistic and religious links with those in southern Eritrea," Sayed said. "In fact, the ones in power in Eritrea have many more similarities with those in Tigray."
paras.zh: 赛义德说：“提格雷人与厄立特里亚南部的人有着文化、语言和宗教联系。” “事实上，厄立特里亚的当权者与提格雷的当权者有更多相似之处。”

paras.en: He added that there could be a spillover effect, especially now that the TPLF is out of Mekelle, and they might be out of major towns as well. "So they might go for a kind of ragtag fighting tactic."
paras.zh: 他补充说，这可能会产生溢出效应，特别是现在 TPLF 已经离开了默克莱，而且他们也可能离开了主要城镇。 “所以他们可能会采取一种乌合之众的战斗策略。”

paras.en: According to Sayed, the Ethiopian government and army are only waiting for Eritrea to enter the war.
paras.zh: 赛义德表示，埃塞俄比亚政府和军队只等厄立特里亚参战。

paras.en: "They've already been making allegations without substantiating them, without any evidence, that the Eritrean army is already in Ethiopia fighting against the Ethiopian government. Although the truth is the Ethiopian rebel movements, they are quite well experienced in fighting, and they have plenty of armaments and so on," Sayed said.
paras.zh: 赛义德说：“他们已经在没有证实、没有任何证据的情况下提出指控，称厄立特里亚军队已经在埃塞俄比亚与埃塞俄比亚政府作战。虽然事实是埃塞俄比亚叛乱运动，但他们战斗经验丰富，而且拥有充足的武器等等。”

paras.en: "So there is not much need for the Eritrean army to be there physically to support them. But the Ethiopians would love to see that, so they can justify their attack on Eritrea by claiming that they were the first one to be attacked, and therefore they were now responding to that attack."
paras.zh: “因此，厄立特里亚军队没有太大必要亲自到那里支持他们。但埃塞俄比亚人希望看到这一点，这样他们就可以通过声称他们是第一个受到攻击的国家来证明他们对厄立特里亚的攻击是正当的，因此他们现在正在对那次袭击做出反应。”

paras.en: While allegiances in the Horn of Africa region and the Near East have been much debated in the context of the recent crisis, actors from the global North have remained relatively silent — though experts like Abdurahman Sayed have welcomed a statement by the United States for diplomatic efforts to be renewed.
paras.zh: 尽管在最近的危机背景下，非洲之角地区和近东地区的效忠问题引发了很多争论，但北半球国家的行动者却保持相对沉默——尽管阿卜杜拉赫曼·赛义德等专家对美国关于恢复外交努力的声明表示欢迎。

paras.en: One decisive factor, then, might revolve around access to Djibouti, the one Horn of Africa country with which Ethiopia has long been on good terms. At a recent webinar by the independent conflict monitor ACLED, the institution's senior East Africa analyst, Dr. Jalale Getachew Birru, elaborated on this.
paras.zh: 那么，一个决定性因素可能围绕进入吉布提这一非洲之角国家，埃塞俄比亚长期以来一直保持着良好的关系。在独立冲突监测机构 ACLED 最近举办的网络研讨会上，该机构的东非高级分析师 Jalale Getachew Birru 博士详细阐述了这一点。

paras.en: "Ethiopia's main trade route is through Djibouti, and that is why we're seeing one of the fronts being within [Ethiopia's adjacent region] Afar. Just like in the previous war, the TPLF wants to control the main route from Djibouti to Addis Ababa," Jalale said.
paras.zh: “埃塞俄比亚的主要贸易路线是通过吉布提，这就是为什么我们看到其中一条战线位于阿法尔[埃塞俄比亚的邻近地区]。就像在之前的战争中一样，TPLF希望控制从吉布提到亚的斯亚贝巴的主要路线，”贾拉勒说。

paras.en: She also said that, since Israel officially recognized Somalia's autonomous Somaliland region as an independent state, the past year has brought a new dynamic to diplomatic relations in the Horn.
paras.zh: 她还表示，自从以色列正式承认索马里兰自治地区为独立国家以来，过去的一年给非洲之角的外交关系注入了新的活力。

paras.en: "This also includes Djibouti sometimes aligning with Eritrea, Egypt and so on, but they're also trying to remain neutral," Jalale said.
paras.zh: 贾拉勒说：“这还包括吉布提有时与厄立特里亚、埃及等国结盟，但他们也试图保持中立。”

paras.en: At the moment, however, both Ethiopia and Djibouti seem to be determined to maintain the trade from which they both profit.
paras.zh: 然而，目前埃塞俄比亚和吉布提似乎都决心维持双方都从中获利的贸易。

paras.en: "There is also hyperinflation in Ethiopia," Abdurahman Sayed said. "And if there is a shortage of supplies and oil, that can cause major pressure on the Ethiopian government between yesterday and today."
