articles.title: Did a Russian lab worker die from pneumonic plague? What we know — and don't know
articles.author: Nick Logan

paras.en: Did a Russian lab worker die from pneumonic plague? What we know — and don't know
paras.zh: 俄罗斯实验室工作人员死于肺鼠疫吗？我们所知道的和不知道的

paras.en: Dozens quarantined, but Russia says no indication 28-year-old's death connected to pathogens she worked with
paras.zh: 数十人被隔离，但俄罗斯表示没有迹象表明28岁女子的死亡与她接触过的病原体有关

paras.en: An unnerving story has emerged from southeastern Russia involving the death of 28-year-old woman from pneumonia and fears that she may have been exposed to a form of plague at the lab where she worked.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯东南部出现了一个令人不安的故事，一名 28 岁女性死于肺炎，人们担心她可能在她工作的实验室感染了某种鼠疫。

paras.en: Yes, plague — specifically, pneumonic plague.
paras.zh: 是的，鼠疫——具体来说，是肺鼠疫。

paras.en: Few details are confirmed. Russian authorities say there is currently no evidence that the illness was connected to any of the pathogens she worked with at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East.
paras.zh: 确认的细节很少。俄罗斯当局表示，目前没有证据表明这种疾病与她在西伯利亚和远东伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所研究的任何病原体有关。

paras.en: But the governor of a neighbouring region fuelled speculation over the weekend when he posted on Telegram suggesting the woman had died of plague, later altering his comment to include "maybe."
paras.zh: 但周末，邻近地区的州长在 Telegram 上发帖称这名妇女死于鼠疫，引发了人们的猜测，后来又修改了评论，加入了“也许”。

paras.en: People have been quarantined at the hospital where she died last week; many others who came in contact with her were put under medical supervision, according to Anna Popova, Russia's public health agency.
paras.zh: 人们已在她上周去世的医院被隔离；俄罗斯公共卫生机构安娜·波波娃表示，许多其他与她接触过的人都受到医疗监督。

paras.en: There are, however, questions about Russian authorities' transparency, along with general shock at the thought of someone dying from an illness associated with the Middle Ages — and that many don't realize still exists.
paras.zh: 然而，人们对俄罗斯当局的透明度存在质疑，人们普遍对有人死于与中世纪有关的疾病感到震惊，而许多人没有意识到这种疾病仍然存在。

paras.en: Here's what we know and what we don't know about the situation in the Siberian city of Irkutsk, the lab worker who died and what Russian and other global officials are saying about the case.
paras.zh: 以下是我们对西伯利亚城市伊尔库茨克的情况、死亡的实验室工作人员以及俄罗斯和其他全球官员对此案的看法的了解和不了解。

paras.en: Russian state-run news agency TASS reported that the employee was "diagnosed with pneumonia of unknown etiology."
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国营通讯社塔斯社报道称，该员工“被诊断患有不明原因肺炎”。

paras.en: Local media reports have identified her as laboratory technician Darya Shipilova, saying she died on Friday.
paras.zh: 当地媒体报道称她是实验室技术员 Darya Shipilova，并于周五去世。

paras.en: The lab, which was established under the former Soviet Union in 1934, carries out scientific research on plague control, vaccine development and epidemic prevention, as well as work on other dangerous infectious diseases like cholera, brucellosis and anthrax.
paras.zh: 该实验室于1934年在前苏联建立，主要从事鼠疫控制、疫苗研制和防疫等科学研究，以及霍乱、布鲁氏菌病和炭疽等其他危险传染病的工作。

paras.en: CBC News has not independently confirmed Shipilova's identity or details about her work.
paras.zh: CBC 新闻尚未独立证实希皮洛娃的身份或有关她工作的详细信息。

paras.en: Russian-language reports say that Shipilova went to a hospital in Shelekhov, about 20 kilometres southwest of Irkutsk, days before her death.
paras.zh: 俄语报道称，希皮洛娃去世前几天去了伊尔库茨克西南约 20 公里处谢列霍夫的一家医院。

paras.en: Per Ria Novosti, another state-run outlet, Irkutsk Region Governor Igor Kobzev announced on Friday that a resident had been diagnosed with a "a particularly dangerous infection" of an undetermined nature.
paras.zh: 另据俄新社报道，伊尔库茨克州州长伊戈尔·科布泽夫周五宣布，一名居民被诊断出患有性质不明的“特别危险的感染”。

paras.en: "Importantly, over the past few days, no new cases of staff from the Anti-Plague Institute seeking medical attention have been identified," Kobzev said.
paras.zh: 科布泽夫说：“重要的是，过去几天没有发现抗鼠疫研究所工作人员寻求医疗救助的新病例。”

paras.en: Plague, which came to be known as the Black Death when it ravaged Europe in the 1300s, is an infectious disease caused by a bacterium known as Yersinia pestis, or Y. pestis. It is carried by small mammals and generally spread by the fleas that feed off them.
paras.zh: 鼠疫在 1300 年代肆虐欧洲时被称为黑死病，是一种由鼠疫耶尔森菌 (Yersinia pestis) 或鼠疫耶尔森氏菌 (Y. pestis) 细菌引起的传染病。它由小型哺乳动物携带，通常由以它们为食的跳蚤传播。

paras.en: Those fleas can transmit Y. pestis to humans and other large mammals.
paras.zh: 这些跳蚤可以将鼠疫耶尔森氏菌传播给人类和其他大型哺乳动物。

paras.en: There are three forms of plague: bubonic, septicemic and pneumonic.
paras.zh: 鼠疫有三种形式：腺鼠疫、败血症和肺炎。

paras.en: Bubonic plague, the most common form, causes buboes — painful, inflammed lymph nodes near the site of a flea bite. Symptoms usually come on after three to seven days, and can include fever, chills, headache and extreme exhaustion.
paras.zh: 腺鼠疫是最常见的形式，会引起腹股沟淋巴结炎——跳蚤叮咬部位附近出现疼痛、发炎的淋巴结。症状通常在三到七天后出现，可能包括发烧、发冷、头痛和极度疲惫。

paras.en: Septicemic plague happens when bubonic plague infections aren't treated and spread to the bloodstream and other parts of the body. It can cause vomiting, diarrhea, multiple organ failures and septic shock.
paras.zh: 当腺鼠疫感染未经治疗并扩散到血液和身体其他部位时，就会发生败血性鼠疫。它可导致呕吐、腹泻、多器官衰竭和感染性休克。

paras.en: Pneumonic plague is when Y. pestis infects the lungs, making it much more of a risk because it can then be transmitted between people through airborne droplets.
paras.zh: 肺鼠疫是指鼠疫耶尔森氏菌感染肺部，这使得它的风险更大，因为它可以通过空气中的飞沫在人与人之间传播。

paras.en: Symptoms — including high fever, cough, coughing up blood and difficulty breathing — can occur within one to three days of inhalation. It can be fatal if left untreated.
paras.zh: 吸入后一到三天内可能会出现症状，包括高烧、咳嗽、咳血和呼吸困难。如果不及时治疗可能会致命。

paras.en: Plague is easily treated with antibiotics, which did not exist during the Black Death, Dr. Malick Gibani, a clinical associate professor at Imperial College London, told CBC News.
paras.zh: 伦敦帝国理工学院临床副教授马利克·吉巴尼博士告诉加拿大广播公司新闻，鼠疫很容易用抗生素治疗，而黑死病期间还不存在抗生素。

paras.en: But people do still die from it, he says, though that's generally restricted to certain geographic areas, often due to conditions that attract rodents, or the fact that they are remote.
paras.zh: 但他说，人们仍然会死于这种疾病，尽管这种情况通常仅限于某些地理区域，通常是由于吸引啮齿动物的条件，或者是由于地处偏远。

paras.en: Between 2019 and 2025, the World Health Organization (WHO) recorded 3,847 suspected cases and 423 deaths in 10 countries. Most of those infections occurred in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar.
paras.zh: 2019年至2025年间，世界卫生组织（WHO）记录了10个国家的3,847例疑似病例和423例死亡。其中大部分感染发生在刚果民主共和国和马达加斯加。

paras.en: In 2017, a pneumonic plague outbreak in the latter country affected more than 2,400 people and killed 209 people.
paras.zh: 2017年，后者爆发了肺鼠疫，影响了2,400多人，并导致209人死亡。

paras.en: But Gibani notes that plague infections can occur in other parts of the world like parts of Russia, as well as in South America and and parts of the western U.S.
paras.zh: 但吉巴尼指出，鼠疫感染也可能发生在世界其他地区，例如俄罗斯部分地区、南美洲和美国西部部分地区。

paras.en: Siberia was the location of the first known prehistoric human outbreak of plague.
paras.zh: 西伯利亚是已知史前人类首次爆发鼠疫的地点。

paras.en: While there are still many unanswered questions, this possible outbreak is nothing like the COVID-19 pandemic because plague is "a much different pathogen," said Angela Rasmussen, a virologist at the University of Saskatchewan.
paras.zh: 萨斯喀彻温大学病毒学家安吉拉·拉斯穆森 (Angela Rasmussen) 表示，虽然仍有许多问题尚未解答，但这次可能的爆发与 COVID-19 大流行完全不同，因为鼠疫是“一种截然不同的病原体”。

paras.en: Even before they become sick, infected people are "constantly shedding" the virus that causes COVID-19, she said, which is how it spread so far.
paras.zh: 她说，即使在患病之前，感染者就“不断地散发”导致 COVID-19 的病毒，这就是迄今为止病毒的传播方式。

paras.en: "You're not going to be walking around feeling fine, shedding Yersinia pestis everywhere for everybody else to breathe in," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“你不会在四处走动时感觉良好，将鼠疫耶尔森氏菌传播到各处，让其他人呼吸。”

paras.en: In fact, you should be more concerned about coming into contact with an infected rodent than getting an infection potentially from a lab in Siberia, she says.
paras.zh: 她说，事实上，你应该更担心接触受感染的啮齿动物，而不是从西伯利亚的实验室感染潜在的病毒。

paras.en: Even though it's not been officially confirmed that Shipilova died of pneumonic plague, Gibani says a rapid response is key to controlling the spread in any situation like this.
paras.zh: 尽管希皮洛娃死于肺鼠疫尚未得到官方证实，但吉巴尼表示，在任何此类情况下，快速反应是控制疫情蔓延的关键。

paras.en: He says that can include contact tracing and offering antibiotics to those who may have been identified as being at risk of exposure.
paras.zh: 他说，这可能包括追踪接触者以及向那些可能被确定有接触风险的人提供抗生素。

paras.en: Russian officials have sought to quell fears about a possible outbreak.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯官员试图平息对可能爆发疫情的担忧。

paras.en: But some countries, such as Kazakhstan, aren't taking chances and are raising alerts or implementing quarantine at border crossings. Tajikistan, Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan have implemented similar measures even though they don't share borders with Russia.
paras.zh: 但哈萨克斯坦等一些国家并没有冒险，而是在边境口岸发出警报或实施检疫。塔吉克斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦和吉尔吉斯斯坦尽管与俄罗斯不接壤，但也实施了类似措施。

paras.en: The WHO is in contact Russian health authorities and has offered support if needed, a spokesperson said in a statement to CBC News.
paras.zh: 世卫组织发言人在给加拿大广播公司新闻的一份声明中表示，世卫组织正在与俄罗斯卫生当局联系，并在需要时提供支持。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump also said his administration would also offer assistance.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普也表示，他的政府也将提供援助。

paras.en: "Anybody that has that kind of a problem, we're always willing to help," Trump told reporters as he left the White House for a trip to Nebraska, calling the possible outbreak a "big problem for Russia."
paras.zh: 特朗普在离开白宫前往内布拉斯加州时对记者表示：“任何遇到此类问题的人，我们总是愿意提供帮助。”他称可能的疫情爆发是“俄罗斯的大问题”。

paras.en: Health Canada told CBC it is also monitoring the situation, though it sees no risk to Canada at this time. According to the agency, the last recorded human case of plague in this country was in 1939.
paras.zh: 加拿大卫生部告诉加拿大广播公司，它也在监测局势，但目前认为加拿大没有风险。据该机构称，该国最后一次有记录的人类鼠疫病例是在 1939 年。

paras.en: With files from CBC's Christine Birak, Reuters and The Associated Press
paras.zh: 来自 CBC 的 Christine Birak、路透社和美联社的文件

articles.title: U.S. Coast Guard identifies all 6 people aboard missing Canadian air ambulance

paras.en: U.S. Coast Guard identifies all 6 people aboard missing Canadian air ambulance
paras.zh: 美国海岸警卫队确认了加拿大失踪空中救护车上全部 6 人的身份

paras.en: Safety Board of Canada will be leading the investigation into the incident
paras.zh: 加拿大安全委员会将领导对该事件的调查

paras.en: The U.S. Coast Guard has named all six people, including four Canadians, who were aboard an Ontario-based air ambulance that went missing off the coast of Massachusetts on Saturday.
paras.zh: 美国海岸警卫队已公布了周六在马萨诸塞州海岸失踪的一架安大略空中救护车上所有六人的姓名，其中包括四名加拿大人。

paras.en: The four Canadian crew, employed by Ontario-based Latitude Air Ambulance, were Philip Gregory Childerhose, Thomas Henry Farquhar, Sarah Jane Paton and Jolene Beth Weir. The two Bermudian passengers are Marilyn Lavonne Bean and Sergio Wayne Lottimore.
paras.zh: 总部位于安大略省的纬度空中救护公司雇用的四名加拿大机组人员是菲利普·格雷戈里·查尔德霍斯、托马斯·亨利·法夸尔、莎拉·简·佩顿和乔琳·贝丝·威尔。这两名百慕大乘客是玛丽莲·拉沃纳·比恩和塞尔吉奥·韦恩·洛蒂摩尔。

paras.en: "During this incredibly difficult time, our heartfelt condolences go out to the families and friends impacted by this tragic incident," Rear Adm. Matthew Lake, Commander of the U.S. Coast Guard Northeast District, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 美国海岸警卫队东北区司令马修·莱克少将在一份声明中表示：“在这个极其困难的时刻，我们向受这一悲惨事件影响的家人和朋友表示衷心的哀悼。”

paras.en: - 'Heartbreaking reality': Crew, passengers of downed medical transport jet are likely dead, company says
paras.zh: -“令人心碎的现实”：公司表示，被击落的医疗运输机的机组人员和乘客可能已经死亡

paras.en: - 4 Canadians aboard missing Ontario-based air ambulance flying from Bermuda
paras.zh: - 从百慕大飞往安大略省的失踪空中救护车上有 4 名加拿大人

paras.en: "We are grateful to the crews and partner agencies who quickly responded to this incident, and we will continue to support our Canadian partners as they conduct their investigation."
paras.zh: “我们感谢对这一事件迅速做出反应的工作人员和合作伙伴机构，我们将继续支持我们的加拿大合作伙伴进行调查。”

paras.en: It was announced earlier Monday that the Transportation and Safety Board of Canada will be leading the investigation into the incident, something the Coast Guard statement confirmed.
paras.zh: 周一早些时候宣布，加拿大运输和安全委员会将领导对这一事件的调查，海岸警卫队的声明证实了这一点。

paras.en: The air ambulance was flying to Boston from Bermuda when it went missing on Saturday.
paras.zh: 这架空中救护车周六失踪时正从百慕大飞往波士顿。

paras.en: Officials have said the two Bermudians were being airlifted to Boston when the plane lost contact with air-traffic control early Saturday.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，周六早些时候，这架飞机与空中交通管制中心失去联系，两名百慕大人正被空运到波士顿。

paras.en: Air traffic control audio shows the pilot reported electrical problems and declared an emergency as the jet approached the coast.
paras.zh: 空中交通管制音频显示，当飞机接近海岸时，飞行员报告了电气问题并宣布进入紧急状态。

paras.en: The coast guard says debris from the plane was found 32 kilometres off Nantucket and suspended its search on Sunday after scouring roughly 7,000 kilometres of ocean.
paras.zh: 海岸警卫队表示，在距楠塔基特岛 32 公里处发现了飞机残骸，并在搜寻了大约 7,000 公里的海洋后于周日暂停了搜索。

paras.en: "It is with profound sadness that we acknowledge the decision by the United States Coast Guard to conclude active search and rescue operations and transition to recovery efforts," Latitude Air Ambulance, the Hamilton-based company that operated the aircraft, said in a statement on Sunday.
paras.zh: 运营这架飞机的总部位于汉密尔顿的纬度空中救护公司周日在一份声明中表示：“我们非常悲伤地承认美国海岸警卫队决定结束积极的搜救行动并过渡到恢复工作。”

paras.en: "Given the information shared by authorities and the conclusion of the search and rescue phase, we must now face the heartbreaking reality that the four members of our Latitude team, our patient and the patient's family escort, who were aboard … are presumed to have died."
paras.zh: “鉴于当局分享的信息以及搜救阶段的结束，我们现在必须面对令人心碎的现实，即船上的四名 Latitude 团队成员、我们的患者和患者家属护送人员……据推测已经死亡。”

articles.title: Iran poised to exploit security vacuum as US leaves Iraq

paras.en: The end of the US military mission in Iraq has created a dangerous security vacuum for the semi-autonomous Kurdish region.
paras.zh: 美国在伊拉克军事行动的结束给半自治的库尔德地区造成了危险的安全真空。

paras.en: Politicians in Baghdad celebrated the withdrawal, with Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi officially declaring October 1 a "Day of Sovereignty and Independence."
paras.zh: 巴格达政界人士庆祝撤军，伊拉克总理阿里·扎伊迪正式宣布 10 月 1 日为“主权和独立日”。

paras.en: Tehran, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), and Iranian-backed Shiite militias also cheered the move.
paras.zh: 德黑兰、伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）和伊朗支持的什叶派民兵也对此举表示欢呼。

paras.en: But in Erbil, the capital of Iraq's Kurdish region, the mood is markedly more anxious.
paras.zh: 但在伊拉克库尔德地区首府埃尔比勒，人们的情绪明显更加焦虑。

paras.en: Having relied on Washington's protection for two decades, the Kurdistan Region of Iraq (KRI) now faces intertwined crises, including mounting pressure from Baghdad to centralize power and escalating military threats from its neighbors, most notably Iran.
paras.zh: 二十年来一直依赖华盛顿的保护，伊拉克库尔德斯坦地区（KRI）现在面临着相互交织的危机，包括巴格达要求集权的压力越来越大，以及邻国（尤其是伊朗）不断升级的军事威胁。

paras.en: The immediate threat to the Kurdistan region isn't a full-scale military invasion, but rather a slow, calculated chipping away of its autonomy, said Hesam Dastpish, a Middle East analyst based in Brussels.
paras.zh: 驻布鲁塞尔的中东分析师赫萨姆·达斯特皮什表示，库尔德斯坦地区面临的直接威胁不是全面的军事入侵，而是缓慢、有计划地削弱其自治权。

paras.en: He describes Tehran's overarching strategy toward Erbil as hostile and heavily focused on containment.
paras.zh: 他将德黑兰对埃尔比勒的总体战略描述为敌对且高度关注遏制。

paras.en: The Islamic Republic ultimately wants to strip the KRI of its political clout, reducing it to a purely administrative body, the expert stressed.
paras.zh: 这位专家强调，伊斯兰共和国最终希望剥夺 KRI 的政治影响力，将其简化为纯粹的行政机构。

paras.en: "Tehran's goal is to turn the Kurdistan region into an institution with absolutely no room to maneuver," Dastpish told DW, pointing to Iran's repeated strikes in the region, supposedly targeting camps of Iranian Kurdish opposition groups.
paras.zh: 达斯特皮什对德国之声表示：“德黑兰的目标是将库尔德斯坦地区变成一个绝对没有回旋余地的机构。”他指出伊朗在该地区多次发动袭击，据称袭击目标是伊朗库尔德反对派组织的营地。

paras.en: Salahuddin Khadiw, a political analyst based in Mahabad in Iran's Kurdish region, said that neighboring states don't necessarily want to wipe out Kurdish autonomy completely.
paras.zh: 伊朗库尔德地区马哈巴德的政治分析家萨拉赫丁·卡迪夫表示，邻国不一定想完全消除库尔德人的自治权。

paras.en: Instead, he underscored, Tehran envisions a "controlled and weak" Kurdistan.
paras.zh: 相反，他强调，德黑兰设想的是一个“受控制的、软弱的”库尔德斯坦。

paras.en: By dealing separately with the rival power centers in Erbil and Sulaymaniyah, he argued, Iran has maintained influence across the KRI while seeking to prevent any single Kurdish authority from emerging as a dominant power on its western border.
paras.zh: 他认为，通过分别与埃尔比勒和苏莱曼尼亚的敌对权力中心打交道，伊朗在整个库尔德自治区保持了影响力，同时试图阻止任何一个库尔德政权在其西部边境成为主导力量。

paras.en: Internal fragmentation remains a fatal flaw
paras.zh: 内部碎片仍然是致命缺陷

paras.en: Despite the external challenges, the Iraqi Kurdish region's most critical vulnerability comes from within.
paras.zh: 尽管面临外部挑战，伊拉克库尔德地区最严重的脆弱性来自内部。

paras.en: The legacy of the 1990s civil war lives on through the deeply entrenched rivalry between the two main ruling factions: the Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP) and the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK).
paras.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代内战的遗产通过库尔德斯坦民主党 (KDP) 和库尔德斯坦爱国联盟 (PUK) 这两个主要统治派别之间根深蒂固的竞争得以延续。

paras.en: Hiwa Mahmoud Osman, an analyst on Iraqi and Kurdish affairs in the Middle East, pointed out that Tehran leans heavily on this internal friction. "Iran has spent decades mastering political influence inside Iraq," he told DW. "The Kurds' biggest hurdle is their own fragmentation. Without a united front, foreign powers simply have more room to operate."
paras.zh: 伊拉克和中东库尔德事务分析师希瓦·马哈茂德·奥斯曼指出，德黑兰严重依赖这种内部摩擦。他告诉德国之声：“伊朗花了几十年的时间掌握伊拉克境内的政治影响力。” “库尔德人最大的障碍是他们自身的分裂。如果没有统一战线，外国势力就有更多的运作空间。”

paras.en: Ardeshir Pashang, a Middle East researcher in Tehran, warned that if Kurdish leaders fail to patch up their political quarrels, this disunity could ultimately lead to the collapse of the Kurdistan region as a political entity.
paras.zh: 德黑兰中东问题研究员阿德什尔·帕尚警告说，如果库尔德领导人不能弥合政治分歧，这种不团结最终可能导致库尔德斯坦地区作为一个政治实体的崩溃。

paras.en: A particularly thorny issue is the presence of Iranian Kurdish opposition outfits taking refuge in the KRI.
paras.zh: 一个特别棘手的问题是伊朗库尔德反对派在 KRI 避难。

paras.en: These groups, which have historically clashed with Iranian state forces, are now under immense pressure to disarm and relocate.
paras.zh: 这些组织历来与伊朗国家军队发生冲突，现在面临着解除武装和搬迁的巨大压力。

paras.en: Their presence provides Iran with a convenient pretext to launch drone and missile strikes across the border, said Dastpish.
paras.zh: 达斯特皮什说，它们的存在为伊朗提供了一个便利的借口，可以越过边境发动无人机和导弹袭击。

paras.en: But he doesn't expect Erbil to offer "total surrender," as maintaining a balance with these groups is crucial for the KRI's domestic legitimacy and foreign relations.
paras.zh: 但他并不期望埃尔比勒提出“彻底投降”，因为与这些团体保持平衡对于 KRI 的国内合法性和对外关系至关重要。

paras.en: Kasra Qaredaghi, a political science researcher based in the US, argues that these groups are now more vulnerable than ever.
paras.zh: 美国政治学研究员卡斯拉·卡雷达吉 (Kasra Qaredag​​hi) 认为，这些群体现在比以往任何时候都更加脆弱。

paras.en: If Iran was able to strike their sanctuaries while US forces were still fully deployed — culminating in a 2023 border security pact between Baghdad and Tehran — Erbil's leverage is now practically non-existent, giving Tehran significantly more power to force concessions, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，如果伊朗能够在美军仍全面部署的情况下袭击他们的庇护所——最终在巴格达和德黑兰之间达成2023年边境安全协议——埃尔比勒的影响力现在几乎不存在，这让德黑兰有更大的权力迫使他们让步。

paras.en: Dollar diplomacy is the United States' hidden weapon
paras.zh: 美元外交是美国的暗器

paras.en: While US troops may have left, Washington's leverage in Iraq has not entirely disappeared. It has simply transitioned toward global financial networks. Qaredaghi describes this as a "realignment of power," where the US, Turkey, and Saudi Arabia act as natural counterweights to Iran's growing reach.
paras.zh: 尽管美军可能已经离开，但华盛顿在伊拉克的影响力并未完全消失。它只是转向了全球金融网络。卡雷达吉将此描述为“权力重组”，美国、土耳其和沙特阿拉伯自然而然地制衡了伊朗日益扩大的影响力。

paras.en: Osman echoed this view, highlighting Iraq's deep financial reliance on the US dollar. This economic tether allows the US Treasury to indirectly influence Baghdad's internal affairs, right down to ensuring salaries are paid to KRI civil servants.
paras.zh: 奥斯曼赞同这一观点，强调伊拉克在金融上对美元的严重依赖。这种经济束缚使美国财政部能够间接影响巴格达的内政，甚至确保向 KRI 公务员支付工资。

paras.en: Khadiw similarly characterizes this strategic pivot as America transitioning from a "military balancer" to a "powerful economic observer."
paras.zh: 卡迪夫同样将这一战略支点描述为美国从“军事平衡者”转变为“强大的经济观察者”。

paras.en: But as internal and external pressures mount, the analysts said, Iraq's Kurdish region may have little choice but to heal its internal divides and present a united front to preserve its autonomy and limit Iran's strategic gains in the region.
paras.zh: 但分析人士表示，随着内部和外部压力的增加，伊拉克库尔德地区可能别无选择，只能弥合内部分歧，建立统一战线，以维护其自治并限制伊朗在该地区的战略利益。

articles.title: Merz, Macron seek tougher EU measures against unfair trade

paras.en: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and French President Emmanuel Macron sent a joint appeal to the European Commission on Monday, calling for tougher EU measures against unfair trade practices by other states.
paras.zh: 德国总理默茨和法国总统马克龙周一向欧盟委员会发出联合呼吁，呼吁欧盟对其他国家的不公平贸易行为采取更严厉的措施。

paras.en: They said that the existing instruments at the EU's disposal were no longer sufficient.
paras.zh: 他们表示，欧盟现有的工具已经不够了。

paras.en: The appeal did not name any specific country but it seemed most clearly tied to Chinese trade policy, the EU's vast deficit with China, and its dependence on certain key raw materials. The other apparent candidate would be the US, not least under the current unpredictable trade policy stewardship of tariff-loving President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 该呼吁没有点名任何具体国家，但它似乎与中国的贸易政策、欧盟对中国的巨额逆差及其对某些关键原材料的依赖密切相关。另一个明显的候选者是美国，尤其是在热爱关税的唐纳德·特朗普总统当前不可预测的贸易政策管理下。

paras.en: It also came just a few days before the EU's trade commissioner, Maros Sefcovic, is set to visit Beijing.
paras.zh: 就在几天前，欧盟贸易专员马罗斯·塞夫科维奇(Maros Sefcovic)即将访问北京。

paras.en: The joint letter to European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen called for two new measures to be introduced in Brussels.
paras.zh: 致欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩的联合信呼吁在布鲁塞尔采取两项新措施。

paras.en: One would aim at ensuring diversification and preventing companies from becoming too dependent on suppliers from individual companies.
paras.zh: 其目标是确保多元化并防止公司过于依赖个别公司的供应商。

paras.en: The other would allow another country to be excluded from access to the European single market on an expedited basis if exceptional circumstances made this necessary.
paras.zh: 另一种是允许在特殊情况下迅速排除另一个国家进入欧洲单一市场。

paras.en: Merz and Macron wrote that this could be used in cases "where third countries deliberately seek to undermine the restoration of a level playing field and fair market conditions through political or economic means, leading to serious and systematic distortions of our single market."
paras.zh: 默茨和马克龙写道，这可以用于“第三国通过政治或经济手段故意破坏公平竞争环境和公平市场条件的恢复，从而导致我们单一市场严重和系统性扭曲的情况”。

paras.en: The French and German leaders, both struggling to balance economic growth and public spending, said the EU's struggles to maintain global competitiveness and its dependencies on certain suppliers of core materials led to "geoeconomic risks."
paras.zh: 法国和德国领导人都在努力平衡经济增长和公共支出，他们表示，欧盟维持全球竞争力的努力及其对某些核心材料供应商的依赖导致了“地缘经济风险”。

paras.en: "The open and rules-based trading system is being massively compromised by the instrumentalization of trade, systemic market-distorting practices and global macroeconomic imbalances," they wrote. "All this undermines the level competitive playing field for our companies, our position as a sovereign core industrial producer and our capacity for innovations, which leads to increasing dependencies and geoeconomic risks."
paras.zh: 他们写道：“开放和基于规则的贸易体系正在受到贸易工具化、系统性市场扭曲行为和全球宏观经济失衡的严重损害。” “所有这些都破坏了我们公司的公平竞争环境、我们作为主权核心工业生产商的地位以及我们的创新能力，从而导致依赖性和地缘经济风险的增加。”

paras.en: Appeal comes ahead of EU China visit, and EU leaders' summit
paras.zh: 在欧盟中国访问和欧盟领导人峰会之前发出呼吁

paras.en: Monday's letter is what's known in EU diplomatic circles as a "non-paper." These are nonbinding, informal documents shared between EU member states and institutions that are supposed to propose ideas and initiate discussions without officially committing to a position.
paras.zh: 周一的信被欧盟外交界称为“非文件”。这些是欧盟成员国和机构之间共享的不具约束力的非正式文件，这些文件应该提出想法并发起讨论，但不正式承诺立场。

paras.en: It recommends authorizing the Commission to exclude a country from single market access in extreme situations if it sees the need — currently a complicated process that would take some time to arrange and requires approval from member states.
paras.zh: 它建议授权欧盟委员会在认为有必要的情况下，在极端情况下将一个国家排除在单一市场准入之外——目前这是一个复杂的过程，需要一些时间来安排，并需要得到成员国的批准。

paras.en: It suggests reversing this process: allowing the Commission to take the step independently, but with member states then having the chance to block it with a qualified majority vote, which the EU currently defines as a vote by a minimum of 55% of member states that also represents a minimum of 65% of the bloc's total population.
paras.zh: 它建议扭转这一过程：允许欧盟委员会独立采取这一步骤，但成员国有机会通过合格多数票来阻止这一决定，欧盟目前将其定义为至少 55% 的成员国投票，这些成员国也至少代表欧盟总人口的 65%。

paras.en: The EU's trade deficit with China is vast and growing. The EU put the figure at around €360 billion (roughly $400 billion) in 2025, though China's statisticians reached a more modest tally of $292 billion.
paras.zh: 欧盟对中国的贸易逆差巨大且不断增长。欧盟预计 2025 年这一数字约为 3,600 亿欧元（约合 4,000 亿美元），但中国统计人员得出的数字更为温和，为 2,920 亿美元。

paras.en: The bloc is also particularly dependent on China for a number of raw materials, not least rare earths, and is increasingly reliant on both the US and China for high-tech imports and services, particularly in computing and the so-called AI sector.
paras.zh: 该集团还特别依赖中国的一些原材料，尤其是稀土，并且越来越依赖美国和中国的高科技进口和服务，特别是在计算和所谓的人工智能领域。

paras.en: The EU's trade commissioner, Maros Sefcovic, visits China this week for talks, ahead of an EU leaders' summit next week, on October 15-16. Sefcovic said earlier this year that he hoped to see "tangible results by October" on the question of trade with China, although whether these will materialize is an open question.
paras.zh: 欧盟贸易专员马罗斯·塞夫科维奇 (Maros Sefcovic) 将于下周（10 月 15 日至 16 日）举行欧盟领导人峰会之前于本周访问中国进行会谈。塞夫科维奇今年早些时候表示，他希望在与中国的贸易问题上“在十月份之前看到切实的成果”，尽管这些成果是否会实现还是一个悬而未决的问题。

paras.en: Beijing has warned that it could retaliate with changes of its own after learning of the EU's plans, if it perceives a need to.
paras.zh: 北京警告说，如果它认为有必要，在了解欧盟的计划后，它可能会做出自己的改变进行报复。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Australia's migrant policy offers lessons for EU and US

paras.en: Nations that send asylum seekers to third countries for offshore processing and holding could spend billions, only to face accusations of human rights abuses and financial mismanagement, as in Australia.
paras.zh: 将寻求庇护者送往第三国进行离岸处理和扣押的国家可能会花费数十亿美元，却会面临侵犯人权和财务管理不善的指控，就像澳大利亚那样。

paras.en: The European Union (EU) has nevertheless been considering the idea, and the United States (US) has already made similar third-country deals, but Australia has been processing or relocating people outside the country where they seek protection for more than two decades.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，欧盟（EU）一直在考虑这个想法，美国（US）也已经与第三国达成了类似的协议，但澳大利亚二十多年来一直在处理或重新安置寻求保护的国外人员。

paras.en: Former Australian Prime Minister John Howard introduced the so-called "Pacific Solution" in 2001, targeting immigrants who arrived by boat, and establishing Australian migration processing centers with the help from governments in Papua New Guinea (PNG) and the tiny island nation of Nauru .
paras.zh: 澳大利亚前总理约翰·霍华德于2001年提出所谓“太平洋解决方案”，针对乘船抵达的移民，在巴布亚新几内亚和小岛国瑙鲁政府的帮助下建立澳大利亚移民处理中心。

paras.en: Thousands sent to islands under Australia's 'Pacific Solution'
paras.zh: 根据澳大利亚的“太平洋解决方案”，数千人被送往岛屿

paras.en: Center-left and center-right governments described the policy as a deterrent, saying people were less likely to attempt dangerous ocean crossings or pay smugglers if arriving by boat did not provide a route to Australia. In his 2001 election policy speech, Howard said the famous line, frequently quoted since: "We will decide who comes to this country and the circumstances in which they come."
paras.zh: 中左翼和中右翼政府将这项政策描述为一种威慑，称如果乘船抵达无法提供前往澳大利亚的路线，人们就不太可能尝试危险的越洋或付钱给走私者。霍华德在 2001 年的选举政策演讲中说了一句此后经常被引用的名言：“我们将决定谁来到这个国家以及他们来到的环境。”

paras.en: In 2008, a newly elected Labor Party government phased out the practice, saying it was a cynical, costly, and ultimately unsuccessful exercise.
paras.zh: 2008年，新当选的工党政府逐步取消了这种做法，称这是一种愤世嫉俗、成本高昂且最终不成功的做法。

paras.en: But faced with more deaths at sea, a Labor government under Prime Minister Julia Gillard started sending maritime arrivals to Nauru and Manus again in 2012, after an expert panel recommended reopening the centers.
paras.zh: 但面对更多海上死亡事件，在专家小组建议重新开放瑙鲁和马努斯中心后，朱莉娅·吉拉德总理领导的工党政府于 2012 年再次开始向瑙鲁和马努斯派遣海上救援人员。

paras.en: "I'm not going to play politics or look at political scoreboards when too many lives have been lost," Gillard said at the time.
paras.zh: 吉拉德当时表示：“当太多人丧生时，我不会玩弄政治或关注政治记分牌。”

paras.en: Between 2013 and 2014, the number of people transferred offshore peaked to more than 3,000.
paras.zh: 2013年至2014年间，海外转移人数高峰达到3000多人。

paras.en: Journalists have been mostly barred from the centers on Nauru and Manus Island. Graham Thom, Advocacy Coordinator for the Refugee Council of Australia (RCOA), told DW that this lack of access and independent oversight meant many Australians accepted the narrative that the policy was working.
paras.zh: 记者大多被禁止进入瑙鲁和马努斯岛的中心。澳大利亚难民委员会（RCOA）倡导协调员格雷厄姆·汤姆（Graham Thom）告诉德国之声，缺乏准入和独立监督意味着许多澳大利亚人接受了该政策正在发挥作用的说法。

paras.en: People without a legal right to remain in the EU could face deportation to third countries as soon as 2027, with Rwanda and Uzbekistan reportedly under consideration as third-party countries, as well as Uganda.
paras.zh: 没有合法权利留在欧盟的人最早可能会在 2027 年面临被驱逐到第三国的情况，据报道，卢旺达和乌兹别克斯坦以及乌干达都被视为第三方国家。

paras.en: The European Parliament in June approved new rules that would pave the way for so-called "return hubs" outside the EU's borders.
paras.zh: 欧洲议会六月批准了新规则，为欧盟境外所谓的“退货中心”铺平道路。

paras.en: Denmark's Minister for Immigration and Integration, Morten Bodskov, told reporters last month the hubs would not be detention and deportation centers.
paras.zh: 丹麦移民和融合部长莫滕·博德斯科夫上个月告诉记者，这些中心不会是拘留和驱逐中心。

paras.en: "We are not talking about camps," Bodskov said, describing the scheme instead as "a new chance to have a life in a partner country."
paras.zh: “我们不是在谈论难民营，”博德斯科夫说，他将该计划描述为“在伙伴国家生活的新机会”。

paras.en: Denmark, alongside Germany, Austria, Greece, and the Netherlands, known collectively as the Group of Five, said in September they had agreed on steps towards a deal with a non-EU country, without naming it.
paras.zh: 丹麦与德国、奥地利、希腊和荷兰（统称为五国集团）去年 9 月表示，他们已就与某个非欧盟国家达成协议的步骤达成一致，但未具体说明具体国家。

paras.en: The group was to speak with the United Nations (UN) body, the International Organization for Migration, and the UN Refugee Agency about their next steps.
paras.zh: 该小组将与联合国机构、国际移民组织和联合国难民署讨论下一步行动。

paras.en: The proposal allows for harsh penalties for those who refuse to be removed to the hubs, including detention for up to 30 months pending deportation from the EU and entry bans.
paras.zh: 该提案允许对那些拒绝被转移到中心的人实施严厉处罚，包括在被驱逐出欧盟之前拘留长达 30 个月并禁止入境。

paras.en: US already has a third country migration scheme
paras.zh: 美国已有第三国移民计划

paras.en: The US government has already made deals with at least 30 third countries in Africa and Latin America. In June, Amnesty International said some agreements had been revealed through the US Freedom of Information Act, while others "remain secret."
paras.zh: 美国政府已经与非洲和拉丁美洲至少30个第三国达成了协议。六月，国际特赦组织表示，一些协议已通过美国《信息自由法》披露，而其他协议“仍然保密”。

paras.en: The US Supreme Court ruled late last month that the second Trump administration could resume deportations under the third-country scheme, after a US appeals court ruled that immigrants must receive effective notice of their intended destination and an opportunity to challenge removal if they fear persecution or torture.
paras.zh: 美国最高法院上个月末裁定，特朗普第二届政府可以根据第三国计划恢复驱逐出境，此前美国上诉法院裁定，移民必须收到有关其预定目的地的有效通知，并且如果他们担心受到迫害或酷刑，则必须有机会质疑驱逐出境。

paras.en: The first deportations from the US under the third-country removal scheme were of immigrants convicted of crimes, but more recently, foreign nationals not accused of any crime have also been deported.
paras.zh: 根据第三国驱逐计划，第一批被驱逐出境的是被判有罪的移民，但最近，没有被指控犯有任何罪行的外国人也被驱逐出境。

paras.en: Asylum seekers and human rights advocates have repeatedly alleged human rights abuses in Australia's offshore migration processing program, with Thom describing the policy as a "medieval idea."
paras.zh: 寻求庇护者和人权倡导者一再指控澳大利亚离岸移民处理计划侵犯人权，汤姆将该政策描述为“中世纪的想法”。

paras.en: A group of asylum seekers formerly detained on Manus Island reached a AU$70 million (€43.47 million/$48.47 million) settlement in 2017 after filing charges for abuse and unlawful detention.
paras.zh: 一群曾被拘留在马努斯岛的寻求庇护者在提出虐待和非法拘留指控后，于 2017 年达成了 7000 万澳元（4347 万欧元/4847 万美元）的和解。

paras.en: In February, an Australian Senate inquiry heard first-hand witness accounts of neglect, untreated health conditions, and serious concerns for the safety and dignity of camps inhabitants — especially of women being kept on Nauru. Prior to the hearing, 73 UN member states had publicly raised concerns about Australia's migration policies.
paras.zh: 今年二月，澳大利亚参议院的一项调查听取了第一手目击者的证词，讲述了难民营居民的忽视、健康状况未得到治疗以及对安全和尊严的严重担忧——尤其是被关押在瑙鲁的妇女。听证会之前，73个联合国成员国公开表达了对澳大利亚移民政策的担忧。

paras.en: Brazil, China, Finland, Germany, Serbia, Switzerland and Turkey called for an end to offshore processing of asylum claims.
paras.zh: 巴西、中国、芬兰、德国、塞尔维亚、瑞士和土耳其呼吁结束庇护申请的离岸处理。

paras.en: Australia has yet to officially comment on the recommendations, but successive governments have said offshore processing helps deter dangerous boat journeys, with former Prime Minister Tony Abbott describing the policy during his term as "decent, humane and compassionate."
paras.zh: 澳大利亚尚未对这些建议正式发表评论，但历届政府均表示离岸加工有助于阻止危险的乘船旅行，前总理托尼·阿博特将其任期内的政策描述为“体面、人道和富有同情心”。

paras.en: The effect of offshore processing is difficult to isolate from other policy measures, especially the practice of turning back asylum boats. This "turnback" policy was introduced and reintroduced under conservative governments in 2001 and 2013 respectively, but with inconsistent data on incidents.
paras.zh: 离岸处理的影响很难与其他政策措施分开，特别是遣返庇护船的做法。这种“折返”政策分别于 2001 年和 2013 年在保守党政府时期引入和重新引入，但事件数据不一致。

paras.en: As in the US, offshore migration processing for Australia has expanded beyond its original scope, with Nauru recently agreeing to accept convicted foreign nationals from Australia who can't legally be returned to their countries of origin, at a cost of AU$2.5 billion over the next 30 years. Australia had already spent more than AU$13 billion on offshore detention since 2012.
paras.zh: 与美国一样，澳大利亚的离岸移民处理范围已经超出了原来的范围，瑙鲁最近同意接受来自澳大利亚、无法合法返回原籍国的被定罪的外国人，未来 30 年内将花费 25 亿澳元。自 2012 年以来，澳大利亚在离岸拘留方面已经花费了超过 130 亿澳元。

paras.en: Measuring the success of Australia's model is difficult, but its significant long-term costs and legal and human rights concerns may serve as a warning for other countries considering similar policies.
paras.zh: 衡量澳大利亚模式的成功是困难的，但其巨大的长期成本以及法律和人​​权问题可能会对其他考虑类似政策的国家起到警示作用。

articles.title: Secessionist party wins Quebec election in Canada

paras.en: The secessionist Parti Quebecois has won the most seats in Quebec’s election and will form the next government in the predominantly French-speaking Canadian province, according to media reports.
paras.zh: 据媒体报道，分裂主义魁北克党在魁北克省选举中赢得了最多席位，并将在这个以法语为主的加拿大省组建下一届政府。

paras.en: The result on Monday revives the question of whether the province should leave Canada, testing Prime Minister Mark Carney’s message of national unity.
paras.zh: 周一的结果再次引发了该省是否应该离开加拿大的问题，考验了总理马克·卡尼的民族团结信息。

paras.en: Paul St-Pierre Plamondon, the party’s leader, is set to become premier.
paras.zh: 该党领袖保罗·圣皮埃尔·普拉蒙东 (Paul St-Pierre Plamondon) 将成为总理。

paras.en: During the campaign, he promised a third referendum on leaving Canada during his first term, although he said he would wait until US President Donald Trump leaves office in January 2029.
paras.zh: 在竞选期间，他承诺在第一个任期内就离开加拿大进行第三次公投，尽管他表示他会等到美国总统唐纳德·特朗普于 2029 年 1 月卸任。

paras.en: It was not yet clear whether the party had reached the 64 seats needed for a majority in the 127-seat National Assembly.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚该党是否已在 127 个席位的国民议会中获得多数席位所需的 64 个席位。

paras.en: If it falls short, it would lead a minority government and need support from opposition lawmakers to pass major legislation and survive confidence votes.
paras.zh: 如果达不到目标，它将领导一个少数派政府，并需要反对派议员的支持才能通过重大立法并在信任投票中幸存。

paras.en: The Parti Quebecois, or PQ, last governed the province from 2012 to 2014.
paras.zh: 魁北克党（PQ）最后一次统治该省是在 2012 年至 2014 年之间。

paras.en: Monday’s victory marks a sharp recovery for the PQ, which won just three seats in the 2022 provincial election.
paras.zh: 周一的胜利标志着人民党的急剧复苏，该党在 2022 年省选举中仅赢得了三个席位。

paras.en: Its return also ends eight years in power for the Coalition Avenir Quebec, or CAQ, a centre-right Quebec nationalist party that does not support independence.
paras.zh: 它的回归也结束了魁北克未来联盟（CAQ）八年的执政，该联盟是一个不支持独立的中右魁北克民族主义政党。

paras.en: Daniel Beland, a political science professor at McGill University in Montreal, told The Associated Press news agency that the victory reflects Quebec’s multiparty system, where support is divided among several parties, rather than a surge in secessionist sentiment.
paras.zh: 蒙特利尔麦吉尔大学政治学教授丹尼尔·贝兰德告诉美联社，这次胜利反映了魁北克的多党制，支持率分散在多个政党之间，而不是分裂主义情绪高涨。

paras.en: Support for independence remains at about 30 percent, low by historical standards, he said.
paras.zh: 他表示，对独立的支持率仍约为 30%，按历史标准来看较低。

paras.en: Still, Beland said a secessionist government in Quebec represents a new national-unity challenge for Carney, particularly with another independence-related vote approaching in Alberta.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，贝兰德表示，魁北克省的分裂主义政府对卡尼来说是一个新的民族团结挑战，特别是在阿尔伯塔省即将举行另一场与独立相关的投票的情况下。

paras.en: “Seeing that a pro-independence party won in Quebec barely two weeks before an independence-related referendum takes place in Alberta might suggest to the Trump administration that national unity remains a major issue in Canada despite the popularity of Mark Carney,” Beland said.
paras.zh: 贝兰德说：“在阿尔伯塔省举行独立公投前两周，一个支持独立的政党在魁北克获胜，这可能会向特朗普政府表明，尽管马克·卡尼很受欢迎，但民族团结仍然是加拿大的一个主要问题。”

paras.en: Quebec held two previous referendums on independence, in 1980 and 1995, and voters rejected secession both times.
paras.zh: 魁北克曾于1980年和1995年举行过两次独立公投，两次都被选民否决。

paras.en: The second vote was decided by a narrow margin, but there has been no further referendum in the three decades since.
paras.zh: 第二次投票以微弱优势决定胜负，但此后三十年没有再举行过公投。

articles.title: Erling Haaland faces injury scare ahead of Man City vs Liverpool

paras.en: Norway coach Stale Solbakken has revealed that he had a “heart-to-heart conversation” with Erling Haaland regarding concerns about the striker’s heavy workload ahead of a Nations League loss to Portugal, in which the Manchester City star asked to be substituted.
paras.zh: 挪威队主教练索尔巴肯透露，他与埃尔林·哈兰德进行了“交心谈话”，讨论了对这位前锋在国联输给葡萄牙之前的繁重工作量的担忧，在这场比赛中，这位曼城球星要求被替换下场。

paras.en: Haaland gestured to Norway’s bench that he needed to come off and was replaced in the 67th minute of the 2-1 defeat in Porto on Sunday.
paras.zh: 周日1-2负于波尔图的比赛中，哈兰德向挪威替补席示意他需要下场，并在第67分钟被换下。

paras.en: He was seen limping on the field in advance of the substitution, raising concerns about his fitness before his return to City — a club under heavy scrutiny as the subject of a huge financial scandal in the Premier League.
paras.zh: 在换人之前，有人看到他一瘸一拐地出现在球场上，这引发了人们对他返回曼城之前的健康状况的担忧——曼城作为英超重大财务丑闻的对象而受到严格审查。

paras.en: Speaking after the Portugal match, Solbakken did not say Haaland had sustained an injury but talked about the heavy workload the striker had been facing after playing the full game in each of Norway’s first three Nations League fixtures — a win over Denmark and losses to Portugal and Wales.
paras.zh: 在与葡萄牙的比赛后发表讲话时，索尔巴肯并没有说哈兰德受伤，但谈到了这位前锋在挪威前三场国家联赛比赛中踢满比赛后所面临的繁重工作量——战胜丹麦，输给葡萄牙和威尔士。

paras.en: That came after a busy start to the English season with City, after reaching the World Cup quarterfinals with Norway over the summer.
paras.zh: 此前，曼城队在英格兰赛季的开局非常忙碌，并且在夏天与挪威队一起进入了世界杯四分之一决赛。

paras.en: “He [Haaland] was tired against Wales. That’s why we had a heart-to-heart conversation yesterday. We went through the possible options,” Solbakken said in quotes carried in the Norwegian media.
paras.zh: “他（哈兰德）在对阵威尔士的比赛中感到疲倦。这就是为什么我们昨天进行了一次心与心的交谈。我们考虑了可能的选择，”索尔巴肯在挪威媒体引用的引述中说道。

paras.en: “He might have played the last 45 minutes against Portugal. That was a discussion. But he has very bad vibes and feelings about it … I am very pleased that he managed to pull out 60 good minutes.”
paras.zh: “他可能在对阵葡萄牙的比赛中踢了最后 45 分钟。这是一个讨论。但他对此有非常糟糕的情绪和感觉……我很高兴他能够打出 60 分钟的精彩比赛。”

paras.en: Haaland did not score on Sunday or against Wales on Thursday — the two games Norway has played since the verdict by an independent commission on City’s financial case was published. He had scored in the first two games in this international break and is on a record 65 goals in 59 appearances for his country.
paras.zh: 哈兰德在周日和周四对阵威尔士的比赛中都没有进球——自从独立委员会对曼城财务案件的裁决公布以来，挪威队已经参加了这两场比赛。他在本次国际比赛日的前两场比赛中都取得了进球，并在为国家队出场的 59 场比赛中攻入了创纪录的 65 粒进球。

paras.en: Haaland is the only senior, out-and-out striker in City’s squad whose first match back after the internationals is at Liverpool on Sunday.
paras.zh: 哈兰德是曼城队中唯一一位资深的、不折不扣的前锋，他在国际比赛后的第一场比赛是周日对阵利物浦的比赛。

paras.en: “He plays pretty much everything on the club team,” Solbakken said.
paras.zh: “他几乎在俱乐部队中扮演了所有角色，”索尔巴肯说。

articles.title: Widowed twice: A Gaza mother’s story of loss and survival

paras.en: Gaza City, Gaza — For three years, Nisreen Touman has gone to bed every night in tears, remembering all she has lost since the start of Israel’s war on Gaza in October 2023.
paras.zh: 加沙加沙城——三年来，尼斯林·图曼每天晚上都含泪入睡，回想起自 2023 年 10 月以色列对加沙战争爆发以来她所失去的一切。

paras.en: By the time Nisreen was 34, she had been widowed twice. First, she lost her husband and her two children in June 2024. Then in July 2025, eight months after she remarried, Nisreen lost her second husband while she was pregnant.
paras.zh: 尼斯琳 34 岁时，她已两次丧偶。首先，她在 2024 年 6 月失去了丈夫和两个孩子。然后在 2025 年 7 月，即她再婚八个月后，尼斯琳在怀孕期间失去了第二任丈夫。

paras.en: Before Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza, Nisreen lived a happy and stable life in her home in Nuseirat, central Gaza, with her husband, Sami, 35, and their two children, Mahmoud and Laith, who were aged five and two at the time of their deaths.
paras.zh: 在以色列对加沙发动种族灭绝战争之前，尼斯林与她 35 岁的丈夫萨米以及两个孩子马哈茂德和莱斯（死时分别为五岁和两岁）在加沙中部努塞拉特的家中过着幸福稳定的生活。

paras.en: “I had a home and a complete family. I got along with my husband, and we were friends,” she says, fighting back her tears.
paras.zh: “我有一个家，一个完整的家庭。我和我的丈夫和睦相处，我们是朋友，”她强忍着泪水说道。

paras.en: On June 8, 2024, Nisreen was returning home with her husband and children after visiting extended family, who had been displaced to al-Mawasi in Khan Younis.
paras.zh: 2024 年 6 月 8 日，尼斯琳 (Nisreen) 与丈夫和孩子在拜访了流离失所到汗尤尼斯 (Khan Younis) 的马瓦西 (al-Mawasi) 的大家庭后，正与丈夫和孩子一起回家。

paras.en: “We arrived and the children were playing in the street. Everything was normal. I was upstairs with my husband when suddenly we started hearing heavy, very close, bombing and gunfire.”
paras.zh: “我们到达时，孩子们在街上玩耍。一切都很正常。我和丈夫在楼上，突然我们开始听到很近的轰鸣声和枪声。”

paras.en: Her husband rushed outside to bring their children and his brother’s and sister’s children inside, where 25 members of her family were staying.
paras.zh: 她的丈夫冲到外面，把他们的孩子和他兄弟姐妹的孩子带进屋，她的家人有 25 人。

paras.en: He then went outside again to see what was happening, as aircraft flew overhead.
paras.zh: 然后，当飞机从头顶飞过时，他再次走到外面看看发生了什么事。

paras.en: “That was the last time I saw him. I later learned that he had been killed by a gunshot to the head from a quadcopter that was flying over the area that day,” she said.
paras.zh: “那是我最后一次见到他。后来我​​得知，他是被那天飞越该地区的四轴飞行器头部开枪打死的，”她说。

paras.en: Minutes later, while trying to calm the children as the bombing and gunfire continued, the house was targeted by an Israeli aircraft.
paras.zh: 几分钟后，当爆炸和枪声仍在继续时，当试图安抚孩子们时，这所房子遭到了一架以色列飞机的袭击。

paras.en: “I lost consciousness for a few moments, then woke up to thick dust that completely blocked my view,” she said.
paras.zh: “我有一段时间失去了知觉，然后醒来时发现厚厚的灰尘完全挡住了我的视线，”她说。

paras.en: “As the dust began to clear, I started to understand our place was bombed. I heard the family screaming and saw blood and body parts. I started shouting, ‘My children, my children.’”
paras.zh: “随着尘埃开始散去，我开始明白我们的地方遭到了轰炸。我听到家人的尖叫声，看到血迹和尸体残骸。我开始大喊，‘我的孩子们，我的孩子们。’”

paras.en: Nisreen breaks down as she recalls seeing her two children lying on the ground. One had suffered severe head injuries, while the other appeared to be sleeping.
paras.zh: 当尼斯琳回忆起看到两个孩子躺在地上时，她崩溃了。其中一人头部严重受伤，另一人似乎正在睡觉。

paras.en: “I knew from that moment that I had lost them. It was clear that they were dead,” she says, recalling how she was unable to move from the shock.
paras.zh: “从那一刻起，我就知道我失去了他们。很明显，他们已经死了，”她回忆起自己当时的震惊，无法动弹。

paras.en: Her husband’s brother came and placed the children in her arms.
paras.zh: 她丈夫的哥哥过来把孩子们抱在她怀里。

paras.en: “I could not speak. I was completely unable to speak, just tears running silently,” she said. “Everyone around me was screaming and crying.”
paras.zh: “我说不出话来。我完全说不出话来，只是默默流泪，”她说。 “我周围的每个人都在尖叫和哭泣。”

paras.en: For two hours, Nisreen held her children in her arms as the family, including those who were injured, remained trapped in the damaged home as gunfire and bombing continued.
paras.zh: 在两个小时的时间里，尼斯林将孩子们抱在怀里，而包括受伤者在内的家人仍被困在受损的房屋中，枪声和爆炸仍在继续。

paras.en: After repeated requests to the International Committee of the Red Cross for help, the family were eventually evacuated to a hospital.
paras.zh: 在多次向红十字国际委员会请求帮助后，一家人最终被疏散到医院。

paras.en: The killing of Nisreen’s family came on one of the bloodiest days of Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza. On June 8, 2024, Israeli forces launched a military operation in the Nuseirat refugee camp, central Gaza, to rescue four Israeli captives who had been held following the Hamas-led attacks on southern Israel on October 7, 2023.
paras.zh: 尼斯林一家被杀发生在以色列对加沙的种族灭绝战争最血腥的日子之一。 2024 年 6 月 8 日，以色列军队在加沙中部努塞拉特难民营发起军事行动，营救 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击以色列南部后被关押的四名以色列俘虏。

paras.en: The United Nations said 89 inhabited houses and residential buildings were targeted in nearly four hours of bombing. Gaza’s Health Ministry said that 274 Palestinians were killed and 698 wounded on that day alone.
paras.zh: 联合国表示，在近四个小时的轰炸中，89栋有人居住的房屋和住宅楼成为目标。加沙卫生部表示，仅当天就有 274 名巴勒斯坦人死亡、698 人受伤。

paras.en: Eighteen members of Nisreen’s husband’s family were killed, including her husband and children, her sister Sabreen, 36, her mother-in-law, two of her husband’s brothers and their children, as well as members of the extended family.
paras.zh: Nisreen 丈夫的 18 名家人被杀，包括她的丈夫和孩子、她 36 岁的妹妹 Sabreen、她的婆婆、她丈夫的两个兄弟和他们的孩子，以及大家庭的成员。

paras.en: Nisreen returned alone to her family’s tent in al-Mawasi south of Gaza, where she struggled with the trauma and grief of losing her family. Four and a half months later, Nisreen found herself facing a difficult decision when her late sister’s husband, who was also her first husband’s brother, proposed to her.
paras.zh: 尼斯琳独自回到位于加沙南部马瓦西的家人帐篷，在那里她与失去家人的创伤和悲伤作斗争。四个半月后，尼斯琳发现自己面临着一个艰难的决定，她已故姐姐的丈夫，也是她第一任丈夫的兄弟，向她求婚。

paras.en: He wanted to marry Nisreen and have her help take care of their four children, who had lost their mother.
paras.zh: 他想与尼斯琳结婚，并让她帮助照顾失去母亲的四个孩子。

paras.en: “I strongly opposed it at first. I did not want to start a family or get married,” Nisreen said. She eventually agreed because she wanted to care for her departed sister’s children, especially the youngest, who was only one year old.
paras.zh: “我一开始强烈反对。我不想组建家庭或结婚，”尼斯林说。她最终同意了，因为她想照顾已故姐姐的孩子，尤其是最小的，只有一岁。

paras.en: Nisreen does not hide the fact that there were no romantic feelings behind her second marriage. “I had lost my husband, and he had lost his wife. I had lost my children, and the four children had lost their mother,” she said.
paras.zh: 尼斯琳并不隐瞒她第二次婚姻背后并没有浪漫感情的事实。 “我失去了我的丈夫，他也失去了他的妻子。我失去了我的孩子，四个孩子也失去了他们的母亲，”她说。

paras.en: The marriage allowed two people to fill the roles of the ones they lost. Nisreen found in her sister’s children a small comfort for the absence of her own.
paras.zh: 这段婚姻让两个人填补了他们失去的角色。尼斯琳在姐姐的孩子身上找到了一些安慰，因为她没有自己的孩子。

paras.en: But her new life came with significant challenges, especially during the first months. She was still grieving her first husband and her children, as she and her new husband attempted to adjust to each other.
paras.zh: 但她的新生活面临着巨大的挑战，尤其是在最初的几个月里。当她和她的新丈夫试图适应彼此时，她仍然对她的第一任丈夫和孩子们感到悲伤。

paras.en: Their different personalities and the new situation presented challenges, but gradually their lives became more stable. Nisreen even considered having another child.
paras.zh: 不同的性格和新的处境给他们带来了挑战，但他们的生活逐渐变得更加稳定。尼斯林甚至考虑再要一个孩子。

paras.en: “I used to see my children who had died, in my dreams every day. I would drift into thoughts about them, and they never left my mind,” she said. “So, with encouragement from my mother, I decided to become pregnant and experience motherhood again.”
paras.zh: “我以前每天都会在梦中看到死去的孩子。我会不自觉地想起他们，他们从未离开过我的脑海，”她说。 “所以，在妈妈的鼓励下，我决定怀孕，再次体验做母亲的感觉。”

paras.en: But eight months later, on July 8, 2025, Nisreen faced something she had never imagined: the loss of her second husband.
paras.zh: 但八个月后，即 2025 年 7 月 8 日，尼斯琳面临着她从未想象过的事情：失去了第二任丈夫。

paras.en: “Mohammed woke up, had breakfast with the children and said he was going to see a friend. A few moments later, we heard a huge explosion,” she said.
paras.zh: “穆罕默德醒来，和孩子们一起吃早餐，并说他要去见一位朋友。过了一会儿，我们听到了巨大的爆炸声，”她说。

paras.en: Shortly after, Nisreen was told by a neighbour that Mohammed had been killed in a strike on a group of people near al-Awda Hospital in Nuseirat.
paras.zh: 不久之后，尼斯林的邻居告诉他，穆罕默德在努塞拉特阿尔奥达医院附近的一群人的袭击中丧生。

paras.en: For Nisreen, this second loss was even harder to bear than the first. After believing she had finally settled into a new sense of stability, her life was once again turned upside down.
paras.zh: 对于尼斯林来说，第二次失败比第一次更加难以承受。在相信自己终于找到了一种新的稳定感后，她的生活再次发生了翻天覆地的变化。

paras.en: “I felt like I was back at zero again,” she said. “I thought about the baby who had not yet been born, the children of my sister who had now lost both their mother and father, and the new loss I was living through.”
paras.zh: “我感觉自己又回到了零，”她说。 “我想到了尚未出生的婴儿，我姐姐现在失去了父母的孩子，以及我正在经历的新的损失。”

paras.en: The remaining months of her pregnancy were heavy for Nisreen. Four months after Mohammed’s death, she gave birth to their daughter, Sidra.
paras.zh: 怀孕的最后几个月对尼斯琳来说是沉重的。穆罕默德去世四个月后，她生下了他们的女儿西德拉。

paras.en: Sidra’s birth brought back to Nisreen the pain of everything she had lost – her two children, her first husband and Mohammed.
paras.zh: 西德拉的出生让尼斯林重新感受到了她失去的一切的痛苦——她的两个孩子、她的第一任丈夫和穆罕默德。

paras.en: While her daughter, who turns one in October, has brought Nisreen a “little compensation” for three years of sadness, it pains her that she will grow up without a father.
paras.zh: 虽然她的女儿即将满一岁，但她为尼斯琳三年的悲伤带来了“一点补偿”，但让她痛苦的是，她将在没有父亲的情况下长大。

paras.en: “Becoming a mother again brought me joy, but that feeling was deeply incomplete. She was a little compensation,” she said
paras.zh: “再次成为母亲给我带来了喜悦，但那种感觉很不完整。她只是一点补偿。”她说

paras.en: Caring for Sidra has become Nisreen’s main priority.
paras.zh: 照顾 Sidra 已成为 Nisreen 的首要任务。

paras.en: “I have become more isolated. I prefer to stay quiet for hours and focus on my daughter,” Nisreen says. “I am afraid of making any new choices or trying to start another life after everything that happened to me.”
paras.zh: “我变得更加孤立。我更喜欢安静地呆上几个小时，专注于我的女儿，”尼斯林说。 “在发生了这一切之后，我害怕做出任何新的选择或尝试开始另一种生活。”

paras.en: Nisreen now lives with Sidra at her family’s home in Gaza, while her late sister’s four children are being cared for by their grandfather. She visits them from time to time.
paras.zh: 尼斯琳现在与西德拉住在加沙的家中，而她已故姐姐的四个孩子则由祖父照顾。她时常去看望他们。

paras.en: No matter how much time passes, she says she is unable to overcome the series of tragedies that have shaped her life.
paras.zh: 她说，无论时间过去多久，她都无法克服塑造她生活的一系列悲剧。

paras.en: “I never imagined I would go through all of this in my life. Sometimes it feels like I’m in an Indian film because of everything that has happened,” she said. “But under the war, unfortunately, anything is possible.”
paras.zh: “我从未想过我的一生会经历这一切。有时，因为发生的一切，我感觉自己就像在一部印度电影中，”她说。 “但不幸的是，在战争下，一切皆有可能。”

articles.title: FBI arrests a woman accused of spying on Taiwan leader's family for China
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: FBI arrests a woman accused of spying on Taiwan leader's family for China
paras.zh: 美国联邦调查局（FBI）逮捕一名涉嫌为中国监视台湾领导人家人的女子

paras.en: BANGKOK — The FBI arrested a woman at Los Angeles International Airport as she was leaving the country and accused her of spying on the Taiwan president's family for China.
paras.zh: 曼谷——联邦调查局在洛杉矶国际机场逮捕了一名准备离开中国的妇女，并指控她为中国监视台湾总统的家人。

paras.en: Wanying Zhang, also know as Heather, surveilled the Taiwanese president's son and his family for the Chinese government while in the United States, according to the FBI.
paras.zh: 据联邦调查局称，张婉莹（又名希瑟）在美国期间为中国政府监视了台湾总统的儿子及其家人。

paras.en: Zhang, 34, was arrested on charges for working for China as an unregistered agent, Assistant U.S. State Attorney Bill Essayli announced on social media. Zhang took photos and videos of her targets and sent license plate information to Chinese officials, he said.
paras.zh: 美国助理州检察官比尔·埃萨利 (Bill Essayli) 在社交媒体上宣布，34 岁的张因被指控以未注册特工身份为中国工作而被捕。他说，张拍摄了目标的照片和视频，并将车牌信息发送给中国官员。

paras.en: Zhang was arrested as she was departing for a flight to China. Her nationality was not clear, and an attorney who represents her could not be determined. She was due to appear Monday in federal court in Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 张在准备飞往中国的航班时被捕。她的国籍尚不清楚，也无法确定代表她的律师。她定于周一在洛杉矶联邦法院出庭。

paras.en: Taiwan's Presidential Office confirmed President Lai Ching-te's relatives were the targets, without specifying if it was the president's son, saying that "this is a classic case of transnational repression."
paras.zh: 台湾总统府证实，目标是赖清德总统的亲属，但没有具体说明是否是总统的儿子，称“这是跨国镇压的典型案例”。

paras.en: "Taiwan condemns in the strongest terms such barbaric acts — which disregard human rights and national sovereignty and aim to suppress, threaten, or even harm individuals advocating for freedom and democracy or their families — as such behavior should not be tolerated in the civilized world," spokesperson Karen Kuo said in a statement.
paras.zh: 发言人郭明錤在一份声明中表示：“台湾最强烈地谴责这种野蛮行径，这些行径无视人权和国家主权，旨在镇压、威胁甚至伤害主张自由民主的个人或其家人，因为文明世界不应该容忍这种行为。”

paras.en: The Chinese Embassy in the U.S. did not immediately respond to a request for comment Monday and the Foreign Ministry in Beijing was closed for holidays.
paras.zh: 中国驻美国大使馆周一没有立即回应置评请求，北京外交部也因假期休息。

paras.en: Taiwan and China split after a civil war in 1949, but Beijing claims the island as part of its own territory. Lai, who was voted into office in 2024, has said that Taiwan and Beijing do not belong to each other and that the "People's Republic of China has no right to represent Taiwan."
paras.zh: 1949 年内战后，台湾和中国分裂，但北京声称该岛是其领土的一部分。 2024年当选的赖清德表示，台湾和北京互不属于彼此，“中华人民共和国无权代表台湾”。

paras.en: China considers him a separatist and has called him a "destroyer of peace."
paras.zh: 中国认为他是分裂分子，并称他为“和平破坏者”。

paras.en: While in office, Lai has stepped up spending on defense for Taiwan, notably pledging to increase defense spending from 3% to 5% of the GDP, and pushing through a special budget for the construction of a T-Dome air defense system.
paras.zh: 赖在任期间加大了台湾的国防开支，特别是承诺将国防开支占GDP的比例从3%增加到5%，并推动通过建设T-Dome防空系统的特别预算。

articles.title: Drones buzz overhead, troops hunker underground in Ukraine's hellish kill zone
articles.author: Greg Myre

paras.en: Drones buzz overhead, troops hunker underground in Ukraine's hellish kill zone
paras.zh: 无人机在头顶嗡嗡作响，部队蹲守在乌克兰地狱般的杀戮区地下

paras.en: KYIV, Ukraine — The front line in the Russia-Ukraine war stretches the entire length of this country, from north to south. It has barely budged in four years and is sometimes compared to the static, deadlocked, trench warfare of World War I.
paras.zh: 乌克兰基辅——俄罗斯-乌克兰战争的前线从北到南横跨整个国家。四年来几乎没有任何变化，有时会被比作第一次世界大战中静态、僵局的堑壕战。

paras.en: Yet straddling this front line is the kill zone, dominated by constantly evolving drone technology that's defining this conflict — and the future of warfare.
paras.zh: 然而，横跨前线的是杀伤区，由不断发展的无人机技术主导，它定义了这场冲突以及战争的未来。

paras.en: "This kill zone is a belt of territory which is full of Russian drones, Russian mines and also artillery. It's nonstop reconnaissance and surveillance," said Ukraine's Sr. Lt. Taras Myshak, the spokesman for Ukraine's 59th Separate Assault Brigade. He spoke with NPR on Zoom, just a few miles from the front line in eastern Ukraine.
paras.zh: 乌克兰第 59 独立突击旅发言人、乌克兰中尉塔拉斯·米沙克 (Taras Myshak) 表示：“这个杀伤区是一片布满俄罗斯无人机、俄罗斯地雷和大炮的地带。这是不间断的侦察和监视。”他在距离乌克兰东部前线仅几英里的地方通过 Zoom 接受了 NPR 的采访。

paras.en: Ukraine has a similar arsenal threatening the Russian forces that are dug in on the other side of the line.
paras.zh: 乌克兰也拥有类似的武库，威胁着驻扎在防线另一边的俄罗斯军队。

paras.en: The most important thing to know about the kill zone is that any sign of movement — just sticking your head out of a foxhole for fresh air — can get you noticed, and attacked, by the drones constantly buzzing overhead.
paras.zh: 关于杀伤区最重要的一点是，任何移动的迹象——只要把你的头伸出散兵坑呼吸新鲜空气——都会让你被头顶上不断嗡嗡作响的无人机注意到并攻击。

paras.en: Myshak says even routine movements, like rotating troops in and out of this zone, is a nightmare.
paras.zh: 米沙克说，即使是例行行动，比如轮调部队进出该地区，也是一场噩梦。

paras.en: "Not far from where we are talking today, we have a group that moved through the kill zone, and they will walk four hours just to go 1 kilometer," he said. "Because all the time they hear the drone, and they have to hide and wait. Then the drone passes, and they can move."
paras.zh: 他说：“距离我们今天谈话的地方不远，我们有一队人穿过杀伤区，他们要步行四个小时才能走一公里。” “因为他们总是听到无人机的声音，他们必须躲起来等待。然后无人机过去，他们就可以移动了。”

paras.en: Nightfall doesn't make it any safer to move because the drones have thermal cameras that detect body heat and make it even harder to hide.
paras.zh: 夜幕降临并没有让行动变得更安全，因为无人机配备的热感摄像头可以检测体温，让隐藏变得更加困难。

paras.en: "In the night, it's even more dangerous," he said.
paras.zh: “到了晚上，就更危险了，”他说。

paras.en: When Russia launched its full-scale invasion in February 2022, it advanced rapidly in conventional fashion with large columns of troops in armored vehicles. Later that fall, Ukraine's counteroffensive drove the Russians back in some places.
paras.zh: 当俄罗斯于2022年2月发动全面入侵时，它以常规方式快速推进，派出大批装甲车部队。那年秋天晚些时候，乌克兰的反攻在一些地方将俄罗斯人击退。

paras.en: Since then, the two armies have settled in, and the front line has moved only incrementally, mostly with limited gains by Russia. This line now stretches more than 700 miles. On either side of the line, the kill zone is a band roughly 10 to 20 miles wide and dominated by drones.
paras.zh: 从那时起，两军已经安顿下来，前线也只是逐步移动，其中俄罗斯的收获大多有限。这条线现在绵延超过 700 英里。这条线的两侧都是杀伤区，宽约 10 到 20 英里，主要由无人机控制。

paras.en: "The kill zone is basically a product of drone warfare," said Rob Lee, a U.S. Marine veteran who now lives in Ukraine and monitors the war for the Foreign Policy Research Institute of Philadelphia.
paras.zh: “杀伤区基本上是无人机战争的产物，”现居住在乌克兰并为费城外交政策研究所监测战争的美国海军陆战队退伍军人罗布·李 (Rob Lee) 说。

paras.en: Because Ukraine has far fewer troops and relies heavily on drones, it has a remarkably small presence on the front line.
paras.zh: 由于乌克兰的军队数量少得多，并且严重依赖无人机，因此它在前线的存在非常小。

paras.en: Lee said that in many places, Ukraine has fewer than 10 soldiers per mile, in small groups, spaced out hundreds of yards apart.
paras.zh: 李说，在许多地方，乌克兰每英里只有不到 10 名士兵，他们分成小群，相距数百码。

paras.en: "Those infantrymen are maybe two positions where it's two to four people," said Lee. "They're underground for the most part. They're trying to remain hidden."
paras.zh: “这些步兵可能有两个阵地，有两到四个人，”李说。 “他们大部分时间都在地下。他们试图保持隐藏。”

paras.en: These troops are not really trying to hold back advancing Russian soldiers, he added. They act more as spotters, relaying Russian movements to Ukrainian drone operators behind the front lines, who then track down the Russian intruders from the air.
paras.zh: 他补充说，这些部队并不是真的想阻止俄罗斯士兵的前进。他们更多地充当观察员，将俄罗斯的动向转发给前线后方的乌克兰无人机操作员，然后由他们从空中追踪俄罗斯入侵者。

paras.en: Lee says the front line is so saturated with drones that it's virtually impossible for either side to pull together a large ground force without being detected and drawing fire.
paras.zh: 李说，前线充斥着无人机，任何一方几乎不可能在不被发现和招致火力的情况下聚集大量地面部队。

paras.en: Military vehicles like tanks and armored personnel carriers are even easier to spot and attack.
paras.zh: 坦克和装甲运兵车等军用车辆更容易被发现和攻击。

paras.en: "Because of such a high density of drones, it became very difficult to bring vehicles near the front line at all," he said.
paras.zh: “由于无人机密度如此之高，将车辆运送到前线附近变得非常困难，”他说。

paras.en: Ukraine had no real drone industry at the start of the full-scale invasion in 2022. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says the country will make 10 million this year.
paras.zh: 2022 年全面入侵之初，乌克兰还没有真正的无人机产业。总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基 (Volodymyr Zelenskyy) 表示，该国今年将生产 1000 万架无人机。

paras.en: Russia has ramped up its own drone production. It's expected to make more than 7 million this year, including jet-powered aircraft that are often evading Ukraine's defenses.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯已经提高了自己的无人机产量。预计今年的产量将超过 700 万架，其中包括经常躲避乌克兰防御的喷气式飞机。

paras.en: When Dima Putiata joined Ukraine's military four years ago, he knew nothing about drones and didn't think this was a manly way to wage war.
paras.zh: 四年前，当迪马·普蒂亚塔加入乌克兰军队时，他对无人机一无所知，也不认为这是一种有男子气概的发动战争的方式。

paras.en: "When I saw that we have drones, I was not smart enough. I said, 'No, we don't need to have it. Let's fight like men.' I was a little bit maybe romantic in this way," said Putiata.
paras.zh: “当我看到我们有无人机时，我不够聪明。我说，‘不，我们不需要拥有它。让我们像男人一样战斗吧。’”在这方面我可能有点浪漫，”普蒂亚塔说。

paras.en: In addition to skeptics like Putiata, few Ukrainian troops were trained to use these new weapons.
paras.zh: 除了像普蒂亚塔这样的怀疑论者之外，很少有乌克兰军队接受过使用这些新武器的训练。

paras.en: "No one had drone operators," he recalled. "It's just, 'Oh, you're a driver? You can use it.' Or, 'Oh, can I use a drone? You can try.'"
paras.zh: “没有人拥有无人机操作员，”他回忆道。 “只是，‘哦，你是司机？你可以使用它。’或者，‘哦，我可以使用无人机吗？你可以试试。’”

paras.en: By the time he left the military in May, Putiata, a sergeant, was commanding 26 drone crews in and around the kill zone in northeastern Ukraine.
paras.zh: 5 月份离开军队时，普蒂亚塔是一名中士，他正在乌克兰东北部的杀伤区及其周围指挥 26 名无人机机组人员。

paras.en: Both sides have rapidly embraced the technology even if they don't know where it's headed next, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，双方都迅速接受了这项技术，即使他们不知道它下一步的发展方向。

paras.en: "They understand how to use it here and right now, maybe not really understanding how to use it in the future," he noted. "My point is, you just need to keep going and adapting."
paras.zh: “他们现在就知道如何使用它，但也许并不真正了解将来如何使用它，”他指出。 “我的观点是，你只需要继续前进并适应。”

paras.en: Two years ago, Ukraine became the first country to establish drones as an independent branch of its military.
paras.zh: 两年前，乌克兰成为第一个将无人机作为其军队的独立军种的国家。

paras.en: This innovation now includes the widespread use of ground drones, which look like trollies and perform a wide range of tasks that have become too dangerous for troops.
paras.zh: 这项创新现在包括地面无人机的广泛使用，它们看起来像手推车，可以执行对部队来说过于危险的各种任务。

paras.en: The robots deliver food, medicine and ammunition to the front line. The robots can be loaded with machine guns that now carry out regular attacks.
paras.zh: 机器人向前线运送食物、药品和弹药。这些机器人可以装载机枪，现在可以进行定期攻击。

paras.en: The ground robots are also being used to evacuate wounded soldiers from the kill zone. But drone operators and combat medics have separate skills, and it turns out you need both.
paras.zh: 地面机器人还被用来从杀伤区疏散受伤士兵。但无人机操作员和战地医务人员拥有不同的技能，事实证明两者都需要。

paras.en: "The drone operator doesn't know how to properly evacuate a wounded soldier, and the medic doesn't know how to operate a ground robot," said Lyuba Shipovich, a Ukrainian American who heads a private group, Dignitas, that trains troops on drones.
paras.zh: “无人机操作员不知道如何正确疏散受伤士兵，医务人员也不知道如何操作地面机器人，”乌克兰裔美国人柳巴·希波维奇（Lyuba Shipovich）说，他领导着一个私人团体“尊严”（Dignitas），该团体用无人机训练部队。

paras.en: "So now we're trying to create combined program that will train both the medic and the robot operator," she said.
paras.zh: “所以现在我们正在尝试创建一个综合项目来培训医务人员和机器人操作员，”她说。

paras.en: Media coverage tends to focus on long-range airstrikes that Russia and Ukraine are inflicting deep inside each other's territory.
paras.zh: 媒体报道往往集中于俄罗斯和乌克兰在对方领土深处发动的远程空袭。

paras.en: But the vast majority of the fighting is in the kill zone, with drones now responsible for 80% of all casualties, according to Rob Lee and other military analysts.
paras.zh: 但据罗布·李 (Rob Lee) 和其他军事分析人士称，绝大多数战斗发生在杀伤区，目前 80% 的伤亡都是由无人机造成的。

paras.en: Dima Putiata, the former Ukrainian soldier, says what started in this war has already spread to other conflicts.
paras.zh: 前乌克兰士兵迪马·普蒂亚塔 (Dima Putiata) 表示，这场战争引发的问题已经蔓延到其他冲突。

paras.en: "With drones, this is the cheapest flying munition that can be massively produced. You can destroy a lot of stuff," he said. "It's much cheaper than it used to be to have a war, unfortunately."
paras.zh: “对于无人机来说，这是可以大规模生产的最便宜的飞行弹药。你可以摧毁很多东西，”他说。 “不幸的是，战争比以前便宜得多。”

paras.en: A kind of war, he predicts, that the world will see more often.
paras.zh: 他预测，世界将会更频繁地发生这样的战争。

paras.en: NPR's Hanna Palamarenko contributed to this story.
paras.zh: NPR 的汉娜·帕拉马连科 (Hanna Palamarenko) 对本文做出了贡献。
