articles.title: The “glue” holding your cells together has a surprising second job

paras.en: The âglueâ holding your cells together has a surprising second job
paras.zh: 将细胞粘合在一起的“胶水”还有令人惊讶的第二项作用

paras.en: - Scientists have discovered that E-cadherin, a protein best known as the âglueâ holding cells and tissues together, has a surprising second job: helping epithelial cells swallow nearby dead cells. Using live zebrafish and mouse embryos, researchers found that cells can dramatically reshape their lower surfaces to engulf cellular debris while keeping their upper surfaces stable, allowing protective barriers to remain sealed.
paras.zh: - 科学家发现，E-钙粘蛋白（一种以将细胞和组织粘合在一起的“粘合剂”而闻名）具有令人惊讶的第二项功能：帮助上皮细胞吞噬附近的死亡细胞。研究人员利用活体斑马鱼和小鼠胚胎发现，细胞可以显着重塑其下表面以吞噬细胞碎片，同时保持其上表面稳定，从而使保护屏障保持密封。

paras.en: A protein best known for helping cells and tissues stay connected has another unexpected role. Researchers have found that it also helps epithelial cells, which form continuous sealed layers throughout the body, engulf nearby dead cells.
paras.zh: 一种以帮助细胞和组织保持连接而闻名的蛋白质还有另一个意想不到的作用。研究人员发现，它还有助于上皮细胞吞噬附近的死亡细胞，上皮细胞在全身形成连续的密封层。

paras.en: The discovery could have implications for chronic inflammation. Debris from dying cells is a major contributor to inflammatory responses, so understanding how tissues remove that material may reveal new clues about what happens when the cleanup process fails.
paras.zh: 这一发现可能对慢性炎症产生影响。垂死细胞的碎片是炎症反应的主要原因，因此了解组织如何清除这些物质可能会揭示清理过程失败时会发生什么的新线索。

paras.en: The study, published in Nature Communications, focuses on the E-cadherin complex. This molecular system includes E-cadherin along with three additional proteins. Together, they connect epithelial cells lining areas such as the skin, gut and airways, giving tissues the structural strength they need to remain intact. In these tissues, each cell connects to E-cadherin molecules on neighboring cells.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《自然通讯》上，重点关注 E-钙粘蛋白复合物。该分子系统包括 E-钙粘蛋白以及三种其他蛋白质。它们共同连接皮肤、肠道和气道等区域的上皮细胞，为组织提供保持完整所需的结构强度。在这些组织中，每个细胞都与邻近细胞上的 E-钙粘蛋白分子相连。

paras.en: A team led by Verena Ruprecht examined epithelial tissues in living zebrafish and mouse embryos. They found that the same molecular machinery also gathers at the exact location where a dying cell comes into contact with the tissue.
paras.zh: 维雷娜·鲁普雷希特 (Verena Ruprecht) 领导的研究小组检查了活体斑马鱼和小鼠胚胎的上皮组织。他们发现，相同的分子机制也聚集在垂死细胞与组织接触的确切位置。

paras.en: The researchers wanted to know whether E-cadherin and its partners were attaching to the dying cell in the same way they normally attach neighboring epithelial cells. To test that possibility, they carried out two experiments.
paras.zh: 研究人员想知道E-钙粘蛋白及其伙伴是否以与通常附着邻近上皮细胞相同的方式附着在垂死细胞上。为了测试这种可能性，他们进行了两项实验。

paras.en: First, they presented the tissue with dying cells that had been stripped of E-cadherin. The epithelial tissue removed those cells just as effectively as it removed normal dying cells. Next, the team introduced fat droplets that contained no protein at all but carried a signal normally displayed on the surface of dying cells. The epithelial cells engulfed those droplets as well.
paras.zh: 首先，他们向组织提供了已被去除 E-钙粘蛋白的垂死细胞。上皮组织清除这些细胞的效果与清除正常垂死细胞的效果一样。接下来，研究小组引入了完全不含蛋白质但携带通常在死亡细胞表面显示的信号的脂肪滴。上皮细胞也吞噬了这些液滴。

paras.en: "We were intrigued to find out that epithelial cells repurpose their molecular adhesion machinery -- the 'glue' that normally holds them together -- to engulf dying cells," says ICREA Research Professor Verena Ruprecht, senior author of the study.
paras.zh: 该研究的资深作者、ICREA 研究教授 Verena Ruprecht 表示：“我们很感兴趣地发现，上皮细胞重新利用其分子粘附机制（通常将它们粘合在一起的‘胶水’）来吞噬垂死的细胞。”

paras.en: How Cells Eat Without Breaking the Barrier
paras.zh: 细胞如何在不打破屏障的情况下进食

paras.en: Engulfing something roughly the size of another cell presents a difficult mechanical problem. Epithelial cells are tightly packed into barriers that often need to remain sealed, even while individual cells reshape themselves to remove debris.
paras.zh: 吞噬大约另一个细胞大小的物体会带来一个困难的机械问题。上皮细胞紧密地堆积成屏障，通常需要保持密封，即使单个细胞重塑自身以去除碎片也是如此。

paras.en: Live imaging revealed how they accomplish this. The upper and lower surfaces of the same epithelial cell can behave differently from one another. The lower surface stretches and bends around the dead cell, while the opposite side remains relatively unchanged.
paras.zh: 实时成像揭示了他们是如何实现这一目标的。同一上皮细胞的上表面和下表面可以表现出彼此不同的行为。下表面围绕死细胞拉伸和弯曲，而另一侧保持相对不变。

paras.en: That upper surface, which may face the outside environment or an open space such as the inside of a lumen, continues maintaining the tissue barrier. Measurements taken before, during and after engulfment showed that the area of the upper surface changed very little. By contrast, the lower surface underwent substantial deformation during the 'eating' process.
paras.zh: 该上表面可以面向外部环境或开放空间（例如管腔内部），继续维持组织屏障。在吞没之前、期间和之后进行的测量表明，上表面的面积变化很小。相比之下，下表面在“吃”的过程中经历了很大的变形。

paras.en: Ruprecht compares the behavior to a row of dancers standing with their arms linked. Their upper bodies remain steady while their feet perform increasingly complicated movements when a dying cell appears. "It's the same dancer with a different choreography," she says.
paras.zh: 鲁普雷希特将这种行为比作一排双臂相连的舞者。当垂死的细胞出现时，他们的上半身保持稳定，而他们的脚会做出越来越复杂的动作。 “这是同一个舞者，但编舞不同，”她说。

paras.en: The researchers also examined the mechanics that allow the cells to perform this cleanup.
paras.zh: 研究人员还研究了细胞进行这种清理的机制。

paras.en: One protein in the E-cadherin complex acted much like a rope. It connected the molecular assembly to the cell's internal skeleton, allowing force to be transmitted across the surface of the material being engulfed. When cells lacked this tethering protein, or lacked the specific region that attaches it to the skeleton, they could no longer swallow dead cells.
paras.zh: E-钙粘蛋白复合物中的一种蛋白质的作用很像一根绳子。它将分子组件连接到细胞的内部骨架，使力能够在被吞噬的材料表面传递。当细胞缺乏这种束缚蛋白，或者缺乏将其附着在骨骼上的特定区域时，它们就无法再吞噬死细胞。

paras.en: Another component behaved more like a brake on the cell's contractile machinery. Surprisingly, removing this brake did not make the cleanup process more effective. Instead, the cell became too stiff and lost its ability to properly remove dying cells.
paras.zh: 另一种成分的作用更像是细胞收缩机制的制动器。令人惊讶的是，移除这个制动器并没有使清理过程更加有效。相反，细胞变得太僵硬，失去了正确去除垂死细胞的能力。

paras.en: The team next investigated whether the process extends beyond zebrafish.
paras.zh: 研究小组接下来调查了这个过程是否扩展到斑马鱼之外。

paras.en: In early mouse embryos, blocking E-cadherin caused dying cells to remain uncleared. This matched the results seen in zebrafish and suggests that the mechanism is shared among vertebrates.
paras.zh: 在早期小鼠胚胎中，阻断E-钙粘蛋白会导致垂死的细胞保持不被清除的状态。这与在斑马鱼中观察到的结果相匹配，表明该机制在脊椎动物之间是共享的。

paras.en: The new work builds on earlier research from Ruprecht showing that embryos can use epithelial tissues to cooperatively remove dying cells. That behavior represents a form of early innate immune defense.
paras.zh: 这项新工作建立在鲁普雷希特早期研究的基础上，该研究表明胚胎可以利用上皮组织合作去除垂死的细胞。这种行为代表了早期先天免疫防御的一种形式。

paras.en: Embryos are particularly useful for studying these events because they are transparent. Researchers can observe living cells and tissues directly at a level of detail that cannot currently be achieved inside the human body.
paras.zh: 胚胎对于研究这些事件特别有用，因为它们是透明的。研究人员可以直接以目前在人体内无法实现的细节水平观察活细胞和组织。

paras.en: Could the Same Process Work in Adult Tissues?
paras.zh: 相同的过程可以在成人组织中发挥作用吗？

paras.en: An important question remains unanswered. Researchers do not yet know whether this same E-cadherin dependent mechanism operates in adult zebrafish or mice, or in any type of human tissue.
paras.zh: 一个重要的问题仍然没有答案。研究人员尚不清楚这种相同的 E-钙粘蛋白依赖性机制是否在成年斑马鱼或小鼠或任何类型的人体组织中起作用。

paras.en: There are reasons to think it could. Epithelial tissues in adults are already known to remove dying cells in places including the retina, colon, airways and mammary gland. E-cadherin is also found throughout epithelial tissues in the body, and its structure has remained remarkably similar across species. Those characteristics make it a strong candidate for a more broadly used cleanup mechanism.
paras.zh: 有理由认为它可以。众所周知，成人的上皮组织可以清除视网膜、结肠、气道和乳腺等部位的垂死细胞。 E-钙粘蛋白也存在于体内的整个上皮组织中，并且其结构在不同物种之间仍然非常相似。这些特性使其成为更广泛使用的清理机制的有力候选者。

paras.en: The potential medical importance comes from what can happen when dead cells are not removed efficiently. Dying cells that remain in tissues can eventually rupture and release their contents, contributing to chronic inflammation.
paras.zh: 潜在的医学重要性来自于当死亡细胞未被有效去除时可能发生的情况。留在组织中的垂死细胞最终会破裂并释放其内容物，从而导致慢性炎症。

paras.en: The findings suggest that successful cleanup depends on more than receiving the correct chemical signal to engulf apoptotic debris. Cells must also be physically capable of changing shape, applying force and wrapping around dead material without compromising themselves or the surrounding tissue.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，成功的清理不仅仅取决于接收正确的化学信号来吞噬凋亡碎片。细胞还必须能够在物理上改变形状、施加力并包裹死物质，而不会损害自身或周围组织。

paras.en: "Studying the mechanisms of how dying cells can be removed efficiently from tissues is of very high relevance to human health," concludes Ruprecht.
paras.zh: 鲁普雷希特总结道：“研究如何有效地将垂死细胞从组织中清除的机制与人类健康密切相关。”

paras.en: The work was led by joint first authors Hanna-Maria Häkkinen, Marta Batet Palau and Laura F. Bianchi and supervised by Verena Ruprecht. It was funded by the Spanish Ministry of Science and Innovation, the Human Frontier Science Program, the European Union's Horizon Europe program, and the "la Caixa" Foundation, with additional support from the European Social Fund. It made use of the CRG Core Facilities for Advanced Light Microscopy, Tissue Engineering and Protein Technologies.
paras.zh: 这项工作由联合第一作者 Hanna-Maria Häkkinen、Marta Batet Palau 和 Laura F. Bianchi 领导，并由 Verena Ruprecht 监督。它由西班牙科学与创新部、人类前沿科学计划、欧盟地平线欧洲计划和“la Caixa”基金会资助，并得到欧洲社会基金的额外支持。它利用 CRG 核心设施进行先进光学显微镜、组织工程和蛋白质技术。

articles.title: LMT Group and Novaspace partner to develop strategy for 5G/6G satellite communications hub in Latvia
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Noordwijk, the Netherlands | September 22, 2026 – During the international Industry Space Days 2026 event at the European Space Agency’s ESTEC facility in Noordwijk, the Netherlands, the Latvian Mobile Telephone (LMT) Group and the globally leading space consultancy Novaspace signed a cooperation agreement on the development of a concept for telecommunications innovation platform for Latvia to link the national connectivity sector with the international satellite industry. The initiative follows the successful ESA 5G/6G Non-Terrestrial Network Hub model and will explore Latvia’s potential role within this network.
paras.zh: 荷兰诺德韦克 | 2026 年 9 月 22 日 – 在欧洲航天局位于荷兰诺德韦克的 ESTEC 设施举行的 2026 年国际工业航天日活动期间，拉脱维亚移动电话 (LMT) 集团和全球领先的航天咨询公司 Novaspace 签署了一项合作协议，为拉脱维亚开发电信创新平台概念，以将国家连接部门与国际卫星行业连接起来。该举措遵循成功的 ESA 5G/6G 非地面网络中心模型，并将探索拉脱维亚在该网络中的潜在作用。

paras.en: Signing the agreement marks a pivotal step toward creating a hub for developing an internationally competitive telecommunications sector in Latvia. The hub will strategically bring LMT into the space industry and impact the emergence of a wider Latvia’s space innovation ecosystem in next-generation satellite technologies, products, and services tailored to commercial applications, resilient critical infrastructure, security, digitalization and green transition. Essentially, the hub will attract national and international cooperation, funding and talent.
paras.zh: 该协议的签署标志着拉脱维亚在创建一个发展具有国际竞争力的电信行业的中心方面迈出了关键一步。该中心将战略性地将 LMT 引入航天工业，并影响拉脱维亚更广泛的航天创新生态系统的出现，包括针对商业应用、弹性关键基础设施、安全、数字化和绿色转型量身定制的下一代卫星技术、产品和服务。从本质上讲，该中心将吸引国内和国际合作、资金和人才。

paras.en: The next generation of mobile communications is closely linked to the rapid growth of the space economy globally. The space infrastructure is already gradually enhancing terrestrial networks, and the 6G era of telecommunications will seamlessly link terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks. The rationale for such development is efficient and resilient connectivity, especially essential in scenarios involving severe weather, power outages or physical infrastructure disruptions.
paras.zh: 下一代移动通信与全球航天经济的快速增长密切相关。太空基础设施已经在逐步增强地面网络，电信的6G时代将无缝连接地面和非地面网络。这种开发的理由是高效且有弹性的连接，在涉及恶劣天气、停电或物理基础设施中断的情况下尤其重要。

paras.en: This initiative builds upon LMT Group’s strategic expansion of its track record in connectivity innovation. LMT is already collaborating with ESA and satellite operator Sateliot to pioneer energy efficient dual-mode satellite Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity, enabled by Latvia’s associate membership in ESA. The hardware and software to be developed will cover the current market gap in devices that can seamlessly switch between terrestrial and satellite networks. The planned 5G/6G NTN hub is a natural next step in scaling LMT’s technological footprint within Europe’s space ecosystem.
paras.zh: 这一举措建立在 LMT 集团对其连接创新业绩进行战略扩展的基础上。 LMT 已经与 ESA 和卫星运营商 Sateliot 合作，在拉脱维亚作为 ESA 准会员的支持下，率先推出节能双模卫星物联网 (IoT) 连接。即将开发的硬件和软件将弥补目前可在地面和卫星网络之间无缝切换的设备的市场空白。计划中的 5G/6G NTN 中心是扩大 LMT 在欧洲太空生态系统中技术足迹的自然下一步。

paras.en: “LMT has long evolved beyond traditional mobile operations into a full-scale technology innovator. As we prepare for the 6G era, integrating satellite communications into our infrastructure and service portfolio is essential. Our goal is to ensure resilient, secure communications for new commercial services and for critical infrastructure under any circumstances, to produce exportable space technologies and develop services that contribute to digitalization and green transition. Partnering with Novaspace will allow us to define Latvia’s unique value proposition within the European space ecosystem and expand local high-tech expertise,” Ingmārs Pūķis, VP & Member of the Management Board at LMT.
paras.zh: “LMT 早已超越传统的移动运营，成为全面的技术创新者。在我们为 6G 时代做准备时，将卫星通信集成到我们的基础设施和服务组合中至关重要。我们的目标是确保在任何情况下为新的商业服务和关键基础设施提供弹性、安全的通信，以生产可出口的空间技术并开发有助于数字化和绿色转型的服务。与 Novaspace 的合作将使我们能够在欧洲空间生态系统中定义拉脱维亚的独特价值主张，并扩展当地的高科技专业知识。” Ingmārs Pūķis，LMT 副总裁兼管理委员会成员。

paras.en: The agreement was signed under the EU-funded FIERCE Ecosystem Building Programme, in which LMT participates as an innovation intermediary and Novaspace provides strategic support and space-market expertise. Through the programme, Novaspace will work directly with LMT to define and validate the concept, guiding LMT towards a Latvian 5G/6G terrestrial and non-terrestrial network (TN/NTN) hub. The joint effort will focus on identifying Latvia’s distinctive regional value proposition and connecting the future hub with the wider European 5G/6G and NTN ecosystem, rather than replicating existing European initiatives.
paras.zh: 该协议是在欧盟资助的 FIERCE 生态系统建设计划下签署的，LMT 作为创新中介参与其中，Novaspace 提供战略支持和太空市场专业知识。通过该计划，Novaspace 将直接与 LMT 合作定义和验证这一概念，指导 LMT 建设拉脱维亚 5G/6G 地面和非地面网络 (TN/NTN) 中心。此次共同努力将侧重于确定拉脱维亚独特的区域价值主张，并将未来的枢纽与更广泛的欧洲 5G/6G 和 NTN 生态系统连接起来，而不是复制现有的欧洲举措。

paras.en: “At Novaspace, we are delighted to partner with LMT Group through the FIERCE project. The strength of Europe’s space sector depends on active participation across all Member States, and Latvia is well positioned both to benefit from and contribute to Europe’s growing space economy. Flagship European programmes such as Copernicus, Galileo, EGNOS and IRIS² are creating new opportunities for innovation, resilient connectivity and commercial growth. Drawing on Novaspace’s global market expertise, we look forward to supporting LMT in defining a distinctive role for Latvia within Europe’s 5G/6G and non-terrestrial network ecosystem,” Gabrielle Brophy, Senior Manager at Novaspace.
paras.zh: “在 Novaspace，我们很高兴通过 FIERCE 项目与 LMT 集团合作。欧洲航天领域的实力取决于所有成员国的积极参与，而拉脱维亚处于有利地位，既能从欧洲不断增长的航天经济中受益，又能为欧洲不断增长的航天经济做出贡献。哥白尼、伽利略、EGNOS 和 IRIS² 等欧洲旗舰项目正在为创新、弹性连接和商业增长创造新的机会。利用 Novaspace 的全球市场专业知识，我们期待支持 LMT 定义一个独特的Novaspace 高级经理 Gabrielle Brophy 表示：“拉脱维亚在欧洲 5G/6G 和非地面网络生态系统中发挥着重要作用。”

paras.en: The planned hub will be developed together with research and industry partners in the region. This collaborative framework will help retain and grow specialized engineering and scientific competencies in the Baltic region.
paras.zh: 规划中的中心将与该地区的研究和行业合作伙伴共同开发。这一合作框架将有助于保留和发展波罗的海地区的专业工程和科学能力。

paras.en: The signing ceremony in Noordwijk was attended by representatives of the European Space Agency, Novaspace, the Latvian embassy in the Netherlands, the Ministry of Education and Science of the Republic of Latvia, the Investment and Development Agency of Latvia, Novaspace in representation of the FIERCE project and LMT.
paras.zh: 欧洲航天局、Novaspace、拉脱维亚驻荷兰大使馆、拉脱维亚共和国教育和科学部、拉脱维亚投资和发展局、代表 FIERCE 项目的 Novaspace 和 LMT 的代表出席了在诺德韦克举行的签字仪式。

articles.title: Rethinking risk with electronics for space
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Mike Gruss speaks with Ken Stoler, the space business development lead for Arrow. They discuss how spacecraft designers and operators have changed their attitudes toward risk, how the move toward massive megaconstellations has started to impact purchasing behavior in the space supply chain and the challenges and constraints of adding more AI-enabling computing power to spacecraft.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 与 Arrow 太空业务开发主管 Ken Stoler 进行了交谈。他们讨论了航天器设计者和运营商如何改变对风险的态度，向巨型星座的转变如何开始影响航天供应链中的购买行为，以及为航天器增加更多支持人工智能的计算能力的挑战和限制。

paras.en: Arrow Electronics is a Fortune 500-ranked distributor of electronic components and enterprise computing products that helps thousands of leading manufacturers and service providers turn technology ideas into market-ready solutions. From concept and design through sourcing, integration, manufacturing, and lifecycle management, Arrow comes alongside innovators with deep engineering expertise, comprehensive supply chain services and one of the industry’s most extensive product portfolios. Whether helping enable next-generation aerospace and defense systems, AI-driven applications, industrial automation, robotics platforms or connected devices, Arrow helps its customers accelerate innovation, solve complex design challenges, and bring mission-critical technologies to market faster.
paras.zh: Arrow Electronics 是财富 500 强电子元件和企业计算产品分销商，帮助数千家领先制造商和服务提供商将技术理念转化为市场就绪的解决方案。从概念和设计到采购、集成、制造和生命周期管理，Arrow 与拥有深厚工程专业知识、全面供应链服务和业界最广泛产品组合之一的创新者并肩作战。无论是帮助实现下一代航空航天和国防系统、人工智能驱动的应用、工业自动化、机器人平台还是互联设备，Arrow 都可以帮助客户加速创新、解决复杂的设计挑战，并更快地将关键任务技术推向市场。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join David Ariosto, Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 David Ariosto、Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

paras.en: Watch a new episode every Thursday on SpaceNews.com and on our YouTube, Spotify and Apple channels.
paras.zh: 每周四在 SpaceNews.com 以及我们的 YouTube、Spotify 和 Apple 频道上观看新剧集。

paras.en: Be the first to know when new episodes drop! Enter your email, and we’ll make sure you get exclusive access to each episode as soon as it goes live!
paras.zh: 成为第一个知道新剧集何时发布的人！输入您的电子邮件，我们将确保您在每集上线后立即获得独家访问权限！

paras.en: Note: By registering, you consent to receive communications from SpaceNews and our partners.
paras.zh: 注意：注册即表示您同意接收来自 SpaceNews 和我们合作伙伴的通信。

articles.title: World Space Week 2026 Celebrates the “Rocket Revolution”
articles.author: World Space Week Association

paras.en: HOUSTON, Texas (September 30, 2026)— World Space Week events, beginning October 4 in 100 nations, will celebrate how launch innovation has stimulated the rapidly-growing space economy and enabled new uses of space to help the world.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州休斯顿（2026 年 9 月 30 日）——世界太空周活动将于 10 月 4 日在 100 个国家开始，庆祝发射创新如何刺激快速增长的太空经济，并实现太空的新用途来帮助世界。

paras.en: “This year’s theme is the Rocket Revolution,” said Dennis Stone, World Space Week Association President. “It recognizes how increased space access and falling launch prices have stimulated the space ecosystem and exciting new space applications,” he said. The rocketry theme will also be used to inspire student interest in STEM, he added.
paras.zh: “今年的主题是火箭革命，”世界太空周协会主席丹尼斯·斯通说。他说：“它认识到太空准入的增加和发射价格的下降如何刺激了太空生态系统并令人兴奋的新太空应用。”他补充说，火箭主题还将用于激发学生对 STEM 的兴趣。

paras.en: Planned World Space Week 2026 activities include:
paras.zh: 2026 年世界空间周计划活动包括：

paras.en: ESA and The Pokémon Company International will celebrate World Space Week 2026 with a Europe-wide family exhibition combining real space science with Pokémon, alongside special Pokémon GO activities at participating museums.
paras.zh: ESA 和 Pokémon Company International 将为庆祝 2026 年世界太空周举办一场欧洲范围内的家庭展览，将真实的太空科学与 Pokémon 相结合，并在参与的博物馆举办特别的 Pokémon GO 活动。

paras.en: NASA Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex will host a World Space Week Expo featuring Space Shuttle Atlantis, highlighting the Rocket Revolution and its impact on space exploration and access.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局肯尼迪航天中心游客中心将举办世界航天周博览会，以亚特兰蒂斯号航天飞机为主题，突出火箭革命及其对太空探索和进入的影响。

paras.en: Students and rocket clubs around the world will put the Rocket Revolution into action by launching model rockets. In the U.S., enthusiasts will launch Vulcan model rockets provided by United Launch Alliance and Estes.
paras.zh: 世界各地的学生和火箭俱乐部将通过发射模型火箭将火箭革命付诸实践。在美国，爱好者将发射由联合发射联盟和 Estes 提供的 Vulcan 模型火箭。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Education and SUPARCO, Pakistan’s national space agency, will lead large-scale national celebrations, with thousands of schools and events engaging students and the public in World Space Week.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯教育部和巴基斯坦国家航天局 SUPARCO 将领导大规模的全国庆祝活动，数千所学校和活动将吸引学生和公众参与世界空间周。

paras.en: UN-declared World Space Week, the largest space event on Earth, last year was celebrated by 50,000 events held by space agencies, schools, aerospace companies, and others according to the Association. World Space Week is held each October 4-10.
paras.zh: 据该协会称，联合国宣布的世界空间周是地球上最大的太空活动，去年由太空机构、学校、航空航天公司和其他机构举办了 50,000 场活动来庆祝。世界空间周于每年 10 月 4 日至 10 日举行。

paras.en: John Elbon, former ULA Interim CEO, serves as Honorary Chair of World Space Week 2026 to help showcase the launch industry. Tory Bruno, President of Blue Origin National Security, will serve as Honorary Chair in 2027 with the theme “To the Moon.”
paras.zh: ULA 前临时首席执行官 John Elbon 担任 2026 年世界太空周名誉主席，帮助展示发射行业。蓝色起源国家安全总裁托里·布鲁诺 (Tory Bruno) 将担任 2027 年名誉主席，主题为“To the Moon”。

paras.en: “We encourage students and the public to celebrate space in their own way next week as part of the biggest space event in the world,” Stone said. The public can see what’s planned in their area at worldspaceweek.org.
paras.zh: 斯通说：“我们鼓励学生和公众下周以自己的方式庆祝太空，作为世界上最大的太空活动的一部分。”公众可以在 worldspaceweek.org 上查看他们所在地区的计划。

paras.en: The largest space event on Earth, UN-declared World Space Week is celebrated October 4–10 annually. It is an international celebration of the contribution of space science and technology to the betterment of the human condition. World Space Week consists of numerous space-related events held by space agencies, aerospace companies, schools, planetaria, museums, astronomy clubs, and others in a common timeframe to achieve greater student and public impact through synchronization. In 2025, 50,000 events were reported in 102 countries.
paras.zh: 联合国宣布的世界空间周是地球上最大的太空活动，每年 10 月 4 日至 10 日举行庆祝活动。这是一次国际性庆祝空间科学技术对改善人类状况所做贡献的活动。世界空间周由航天机构、航空航天公司、学校、天文馆、博物馆、天文学俱乐部和其他机构在同一时间范围内举办的众多与太空相关的活动组成，以通过同步实现更大的学生和公众影响。 2025 年，102 个国家报告了 50,000 起事件。

paras.en: World Space Week Association is the global coordinator of World Space Week. As an international non-government, non-profit organization, it serves as a permanent observer on the UN Committee on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space and is supported by voluntary contributions from sponsors including Blue Origin, United Launch Alliance, Texas Instruments, Firefly Aerospace, L3 Harris, BAE Systems, Black Sky, Airbus, Club for the Future, Cesium Astro, Space Foundation, Gaia Horizons, and Space News. The Association was founded in 1982 and is one of the world’s oldest space advocacy organizations.
paras.zh: 世界空间周协会是世界空间周的全球协调机构。作为一个国际非政府、非营利组织，它是联合国和平利用外层空间委员会的常任观察员，并得到了赞助商的自愿捐款支持，这些赞助商包括蓝色起源、联合发射联盟、德州仪器、Firefly Aerospace、L3 Harris、BAE Systems、Black Sky、空客、未来俱乐部、Cesium Astro、太空基金会、Gaia Horizo​​ns 和 Space News。该协会成立于 1982 年，是世界上历史最悠久的太空倡导组织之一。

paras.en: Dennis Stone, dstone@worldspaceweek.org (USA)
paras.zh: 丹尼斯·斯通，dstone@worldspaceweek.org（美国）

paras.en: Alma Okpalefe, aokpalefe@worldspaceweek.org (Nigeria)
paras.zh: Alma Okpalefe，aokpalefe@worldspaceweek.org（尼日利亚）

paras.zh: Ilayda Edali，iedali@worldspaceweek.org（荷兰）

articles.title: World News in Brief: Marshall Islands nuclear legacy, FlyDubai attack condemned, Ukraine update, breast cancer treatment expanded in West Bank

paras.en: World News in Brief: Marshall Islands nuclear legacy, FlyDubai attack condemned, Ukraine update, breast cancer treatment expanded in West Bank
paras.zh: 世界新闻简讯：马绍尔群岛核遗产、迪拜航空袭击受到谴责、乌克兰最新情况、约旦河西岸扩大乳腺癌治疗

paras.en: Addressing the impact of 67 known tests conducted between 1946 and 1958, UN deputy rights chief Awa Dabo said that it lives on in the bodies of Marshallese people, in “lands poisoned and communities displaced” today.
paras.zh: 在谈到 1946 年至 1958 年间进行的 67 次已知测试的影响时，联合国副人权事务主管阿瓦·达博 (Awa Dabo) 表示，这种影响至今仍然存在于马绍尔人民的体内，存在于“被毒害的土地和流离失所的社区”。

paras.en: Justice must be served for the people unable to return to the atolls – or coral islands – contaminated by the detonations, Ms. Dabo insisted. she also highlighted the devastating health consequences of repeated nuclear testing, an issue highlighted this week at a high-level General Assembly meeting.
paras.zh: 达博女士坚持认为，必须为那些无法返回被爆炸污染的环礁或珊瑚岛的人们伸张正义。她还强调了重复核试验对健康造成的破坏性后果，这是本周在大会高级别会议上强调的一个问题。

paras.en: “Virtually every Marshallese family has been touched by the enduring health consequences of the nuclear testing, which include elevated rates of cancer,” she said.
paras.zh: “几乎每个马绍尔家庭都受到核试验带来的持久健康后果的影响，其中包括癌症发病率上升，”她说。

paras.en: Marshallese women and their family members carry painful memories of miscarriages, stillbirths and severe congenital conditions.
paras.zh: 马绍尔妇女及其家人对流产、死产和严重先天性疾病有着痛苦的记忆。

paras.en: Today, communities affected by harmful nuclear radiation face social stigma and are called “poison people”, Ms. Dabo noted.
paras.zh: 达博女士指出，如今，受有害核辐射影响的社区面临着社会耻辱，被称为“毒害人”。

paras.en: “Marshallese communities have the right to an effective remedy for the harm caused by the nuclear tests,” she stressed, in a call on US authorities to declassify information about data on radiation exposure and testing records.
paras.zh: 她强调：“马绍尔社区有权就核试验造成的伤害获得有效补救。”她呼吁美国当局解密有关辐射暴露和测试记录数据的信息。

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has expressed deep concern over the violent incident on board a Tel Aviv-bound FlyDubai flight on Wednesday, which saw a co-pilot reportedly attempt to crash the aircraft, killing everyone on board.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯对周三飞往特拉维夫的 FlyDubai 航班上发生的暴力事件表示深切关注，据报道，一名副驾驶试图撞毁飞机，导致机上所有人死亡。

paras.en: The alleged attacker stabbed the pilot, causing the plane to plunge more than 17,000 feet in less than 30 seconds, according to media reports.
paras.zh: 据媒体报道，袭击者刺伤了飞行员，导致飞机在不到 30 秒的时间内坠落超过 17,000 英尺。

paras.en: The flight’s crew and passengers entered the cockpit, overpowered the co-pilot and the aircraft made an emergency landing in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 该航班的机组人员和乘客进入驾驶舱，制服了副驾驶，飞机紧急降落在沙特阿拉伯塔布克。

paras.en: Mr. Guterres, in a statement on Thursday, said he was “relieved that tragedy was averted”.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯在周四的一份声明中表示，他“对避免悲剧感到欣慰”。

paras.en: He strongly condemned any act that places civilians lives and the safety of civil aviation at risk.
paras.zh: 他强烈谴责任何危及平民生命和民航安全的行为。

paras.en: The UN chief also expressed gratitude to authorities for ensuring the safety of all passengers and for conducting investigations.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长还对当局确保所有乘客的安全并进行调查表示感谢。

paras.en: “We will continue to monitor all developments related to this incident,” the UN chief’s spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长发言人表示：“我们将继续关注与这一事件有关的所有事态发展。”

paras.en: Ukraine: Winterisation efforts need to speed up
paras.zh: 乌克兰：防冻工作需要加快

paras.en: Aid teams in Ukraine say that winterisation efforts need to speed up amid ongoing Russian attacks on energy networks across the country.
paras.zh: 乌克兰的援助小组表示，在俄罗斯持续袭击全国能源网络的情况下，防冻工作需要加快。

paras.en: In an alert on Thursday, UN humanitarians warned that last winter, millions of people went without heating, water or essential health services for prolonged periods, while temperatures remained well below freezing.
paras.zh: 联合国人道主义人员在周四的警报中警告说，去年冬天，数百万人长期没有暖气、水或基本卫生服务，而气温仍远低于冰点。

paras.en: Populations in frontline and other areas that have come under attack recently face particularly severe consequences, marked by repeated displacement, damaged housing and limited resilience more than four and a half years since Russia’s full-scale invasion.
paras.zh: 自俄罗斯全面入侵四年半以来，前线和其他遭受袭击地区的民众面临着特别严重的后果，其特点是反复流离失所、住房受损和恢复能力有限。

paras.en: In an update, the UN health agency WHO highlighted the impact of increasing attacks on logistics and warehouse infrastructure, particularly those used to store food around Kyiv and other major distribution hubs.
paras.zh: 联合国卫生机构世卫组织在最新消息中强调了物流和仓库基础设施遭受攻击日益增多的影响，特别是那些用于在基辅和其他主要配送中心周围储存食品的基础设施。

paras.en: Increasing disruption to electricity, heating, water supply and health services are also expected over the winter, it said.
paras.zh: 报告称，预计冬季电力、供暖、供水和医疗服务的中断也会加剧。

paras.en: In the first six months of 2026 in Ukraine, attacks killed nearly 1,400 civilians and injured almost 8,000. That’s 37 per cent higher than in the same period last year.
paras.zh: 2026 年前六个月，乌克兰发生的袭击事件造成近 1,400 名平民死亡、近 8,000 人受伤。这比去年同期高出 37%。

paras.en: Attacks on healthcare have also seen an alarming increase so far in 2026, with 325 recorded attacks, causing 142 injuries and 16 deaths.
paras.zh: 2026 年迄今为止，针对医疗保健的袭击也出现了惊人的增长，已记录了 325 起袭击事件，造成 142 人受伤和 16 人死亡。

paras.en: West Bank: New era for breast cancer diagnosis
paras.zh: 西岸：乳腺癌诊断的新时代

paras.en: The World Health Organisation (WHO) is supporting authorities in the occupied West Bank to strengthen breast cancer services in two governates in Hebron and Jenin in the Occupied Palestinian Territory.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）正在支持被占领西岸当局加强巴勒斯坦被占领土希伯伦和杰宁两个省的乳腺癌服务。

paras.en: Through the initiative, two centres are being equipped with advanced technologies that can improve the accuracy and speed of diagnosis, including 3D digital mammography systems, specialised biopsy software, computer-aided detection tools and vacuum-assisted breast biopsy devices.
paras.zh: 通过该计划，两个中心配备了可以提高诊断准确性和速度的先进技术，包括 3D 数字乳房 X 线摄影系统、专用活检软件、计算机辅助检测工具和真空辅助乳腺活检设备。

paras.en: They are the first devices of their kind in these areas, representing a significant advancement in breast cancer diagnostics. Procurement has been completed for both centres.
paras.zh: 它们是这些领域的首款同类设备，代表了乳腺癌诊断的重大进步。两个中心的采购工作均已完成。

paras.en: In Dura, renovation works and equipment installation have been completed, and the centre was officially handed over in August 2026.
paras.zh: 在杜拉，改造工程和设备安装已经完成，中心于2026年8月正式移交。

paras.en: To help to ensure women receive high-quality care, a physician and an oncology nurse also completed specialised training at the King Hussein Cancer Centre in Jordan.
paras.zh: 为了帮助确保妇女获得高质量的护理，一名医生和一名肿瘤护士还在约旦侯赛因国王癌症中心完成了专门培训。

paras.en: In Jenin, the equipment has already been delivered while renovation of the facility is ongoing, with services expected to begin in early 2027.
paras.zh: 在杰宁，设备已交付，同时设施改造正在进行中，预计将于 2027 年初开始提供服务。

paras.en: Beyond providing equipment, WHO is investing in the people who will care for patients every day. Twenty primary health care physicians are being trained in advanced mammography interpretation followed by specialised training for 16 radiology technicians.
paras.zh: 除了提供设备外，世卫组织还在对每天照顾患者的人员进行投资。 20 名初级卫生保健医生正在接受高级乳房 X 线摄影解读培训，随后对 16 名放射技术人员进行了专门培训。

paras.en: Once operational, these centres will help more women to access earlier diagnosis and timely referral to treatment and reducing the need to travel long distances.
paras.zh: 一旦投入运营，这些中心将帮助更多女性获得早期诊断和及时转诊治疗，并减少长途旅行的需要。

articles.title: ‘He felt heard’: How a film brought a UN report to life in Xochimilco

paras.en: ‘He felt heard’: How a film brought a UN report to life in Xochimilco
paras.zh: “他感觉自己被倾听了”：一部电影如何在霍奇米尔科生动呈现联合国报告

paras.en: A documentary drawn from United Nations University research was screened at the COP30 climate conference and film festivals across Europe. Its most important journey, though, was the one back to the Mexico City canals where it was filmed.
paras.zh: 一部取自联合国大学研究成果的纪录片在 COP30 气候会议和欧洲各地的电影节上放映。不过，它最重要的旅程是返回拍摄地墨西哥城运河的旅程。

paras.en: Scientific reports rarely leave the shelf. Sometimes, though, the research itself becomes a real story that sparks conversations far beyond academia.
paras.zh: 科学报告很少离开货架。但有时，研究本身会成为一个真实的故事，引发学术界以外的对话。

paras.en: That is what happened in Xochimilco, in Mexico City.
paras.zh: 这就是墨西哥城霍奇米尔科发生的事情。

paras.en: In 2025, the UN University Institute for Environment and Human Security (UNU-EHS) published a report on interconnected risks.
paras.zh: 2025年，联合国大学环境与人类安全研究所（UNU-EHS）发布了一份关于相互关联的风险的报告。

paras.en: It asked why societies struggle to make the changes needed to tackle climate change, biodiversity loss and pollution. One conclusion: societies must think beyond the short term and weigh the wellbeing of future generations.
paras.zh: 它询问为什么社会努力做出应对气候变化、生物多样性丧失和污染所需的改变。结论之一：社会的思考必须超越短期，并权衡子孙后代的福祉。

paras.en: To bring that idea to life, the researchers turned to Xochimilco. For centuries, its chinamperos have cultivated chinampas – fertile plots built on wetlands that produce food while preserving knowledge handed down through generations.
paras.zh: 为了将这个想法变为现实，研究人员转向霍奇米尔科。几个世纪以来，中国的 chinamperos 一直在种植 chinampas——在湿地上建造的肥沃土地，生产食物，同时保存代代相传的知识。

paras.en: Today that living heritage faces urbanization, environmental degradation, climate change and a shifting relationship between young people and the land.
paras.zh: 如今，活态遗产面临着城市化、环境退化、气候变化以及年轻人与土地之间关系的转变。

paras.en: The result was a documentary, Chinamperos: Preserving Ancestral Farming Practices in Mexico City, directed by Mexican filmmaker Rodrigo Jardón Galeana and shot in San Gregorio Atlapulco.
paras.zh: 其成果是一部纪录片《Chinamperos：保护墨西哥城的祖传农业实践》，由墨西哥电影制片人 Rodrigo Jardón Galeana 执导，在圣格雷戈里奥阿特拉普尔科拍摄。

paras.en: The aim was simple – take a scientific report off the page and show what it means for people at the centre of it in real terms.
paras.zh: 目的很简单——将一份科学报告从纸面上拿出来，并以实际的方式展示它对处于其中心的人们意味着什么。

paras.en: Mariana Páez, one of those featured, shared the film on social media expecting family, friends and neighbours to watch. Instead, she also heard from people she had not spoken to in years.
paras.zh: 其中一位主角玛丽安娜·佩斯 (Mariana Páez) 在社交媒体上分享了这部电影，期待家人、朋友和邻居观看。相反，她还收到了多年未曾联系过的人的来信。

paras.en: Among them were Karen Ramírez and Abel Bastida, former schoolmates on different career paths who shared a fascination with the place where they grew up. A video call planned for 20 or 30 minutes ran to nearly two hours – farming, food, traditions, water, the problems they saw around them.
paras.zh: 其中包括凯伦·拉米雷斯 (Karen Ramírez) 和阿贝尔·巴斯蒂达 (Abel Bastida)，他们是曾经的校友，有着不同的职业道路，但都对自己长大的地方充满着迷恋。原本计划 20 或 30 分钟的视频通话变成了近两个小时——农业、食物、传统、水以及他们在周围看到的问题。

paras.en: “We couldn’t stop talking,” Ms. Páez recalls.
paras.zh: “我们无法停止交谈，”帕埃斯女士回忆道。

paras.en: That conversation led the three to found the Permanent Seminar on Xochimilco Studies, or SEPEX, to open up dialogue about the territory and its culture. A film meant to communicate research had sparked a local conversation nobody had seen coming.
paras.zh: 这次谈话导致三人成立了霍奇米尔科研究常设研讨会（SEPEX），以开启有关该地区及其文化的对话。一部旨在传达研究成果的电影引发了当地一场没人预见到的对话。

paras.en: The documentary has since been screened at COP30 in Brazil and at festivals in Spain, Greece, Türkiye and the Czech Republic. Our colleagues in the UN News Spanish team also told the chinamperos’ story in April 2025.
paras.zh: 这部纪录片随后在巴西举行的 COP30 会议以及西班牙、希腊、土耳其和捷克共和国的电影节上放映。 2025 年 4 月，我们联合国新闻西班牙团队的同事也讲述了 chinamperos 的故事。

paras.en: For Ms. Páez, though, the most important effects were closer to home. In her own family, the film brought greater recognition to work and Indigenous knowledge that had not always been valued like other professions.
paras.zh: 不过，对帕埃斯女士来说，最重要的影响发生在离家较近的地方。在她自己的家庭中，这部电影给工作和土著知识带来了更多的认可，而这些知识并不总是像其他职业那样受到重视。

paras.en: One of those featured, chinampero Samuel Avelino, died earlier this year. Ms. Páez later discovered that a screenshot of the UN News story carrying his testimony was among the last things he shared on Facebook.
paras.zh: 其中一位主角是奇纳佩罗·塞缪尔·阿维利诺 (chinampero Samuel Avelino)，他于今年早些时候去世。帕埃兹女士后来发现，载有他证词的联合国新闻报道的截图是他在 Facebook 上分享的最后内容之一。

paras.en: That matters, she explains, because the everyday lives of chinamperos rarely reach beyond their own circles. Outsiders rarely ask what a day working the land is like.
paras.zh: 她解释说，这很重要，因为奇纳佩罗人的日常生活很少超出他们自己的圈子。外人很少问在这片土地上工作的一天是什么样的。

paras.en: More than a year on, the film returned to Mexico. SEPEX helped organize a visit to Xochimilco for representatives of the University and the UN in Mexico, and screenings followed at the National Centre for the Arts and the Metropolitan Autonomous University.
paras.zh: 一年多后，这部电影回到了墨西哥。 SEPEX 帮助组织了该大学和墨西哥联合国代表对霍奇米尔科的访问，随后在国家艺术中心和大都会自治大学进行了放映。

paras.en: Residents, researchers, students, UN staff and city officials came together. The aim was not just to show a film, but to let the community speak directly to researchers and decision makers.
paras.zh: 居民、研究人员、学生、联合国工作人员和城市官员齐聚一堂。目的不仅仅是放映一部电影，而是让社区直接与研究人员和决策者对话。

paras.en: “Xochimilco is a living territory,” said Allegra Baiocchi, the UN Resident Coordinator in Mexico – a place where biodiversity, water management, climate adaptation, food security and ancestral knowledge all converge.
paras.zh: “霍奇米尔科是一个生机勃勃的领土，”联合国墨西哥驻地协调员阿莱格拉·拜奥奇 (Allegra Baiocchi) 说，这里是生物多样性、水资源管理、气候适应、粮食安全和祖先知识的汇聚之地。

paras.en: For Shen Xiaomeng, Vice-Rector of the University in Europe and Director of UNU-EHS, the trip was a chance to give something back.
paras.zh: 对于欧洲大学副校长兼UNU-EHS主任沉晓萌来说，这次旅行是一次回馈社会的机会。

paras.en: Meeting chinampero Eric Enríquez, she noted the pride with which he spoke about his work. Farmers’ survival, she said, depends on how much society values them – but everyone else depends on those who grow our food.
paras.zh: 在见到奇纳佩罗·埃里克·恩里克斯时，她注意到他在谈论自己的工作时充满自豪。她说，农民的生存取决于社会对他们的重视程度，但其他人都取决于那些为我们种植粮食的人。

paras.en: Ms. Ramírez sees the film not as a solution but as a “window”. It’s a way of looking at what may lie ahead before deciding what to do. She wants it screened in more neighbourhoods and public spaces across Xochimilco, with children joining the conversations.
paras.zh: 拉米雷斯女士认为这部电影不是一个解决方案，而是一个“窗口”。这是一种在决定做什么之前审视未来可能发生的事情的方法。她希望该影片在霍奇米尔科的更多社区和公共场所放映，让孩子们加入对话。

paras.en: Mr. Bastida stresses that Xochimilco is not simply a landscape in need of preservation. People live there, with different needs and different visions of its future.
paras.zh: 巴斯蒂达先生强调，霍奇米尔科不仅仅是一个需要保护的景观。人们生活在那里，有着不同的需求和对未来的不同愿景。

paras.en: The documentary does not resolve those differences. But it has done something less visible, and perhaps necessary before any solution can emerge: created a place where people can meet on common ground and talk about them.
paras.zh: 这部纪录片没有解决这些分歧。但它做了一些不太明显的事情，也许在任何解决方案出现之前都是必要的：创建一个人们可以在共同点上见面并讨论问题的地方。

articles.title: Beyond the Moon: Space Week around the world

paras.en: Beyond the Moon: Space Week around the world
paras.zh: 超越月球：世界各地的太空周

paras.en: Right after the Soviet Union launched Sputnik in 1957, UNOOSA, the UN Office for Outer Space Affairs, was established and has since been monitoring developments across more than 77 successful lunar missions and other journeys while also taking a lead role in the annual World Space Week, which runs from 4 to 10 October.
paras.zh: 1957 年苏联发射人造卫星后，联合国外层空间事务办公室 (UNOOSA) 成立，此后一直在监测超过 77 次成功的登月任务和其他旅程的进展，同时还在 10 月 4 日至 10 日举行的年度世界空间周中发挥主导作用。

paras.en: - This year’s theme, Rocket revolution, focuses on the rapid transformation of how we reach space – now expanding through commercial launch providers, reusable rockets, university teams, and other innovators
paras.zh: - 今年的主题“火箭革命”，重点关注我们到达太空方式的快速转变——现在通过商业发射提供商、可重复使用的火箭、大学团队和其他创新者进行扩展

paras.en: - More than 50,000 events are planned in more than 100 countries
paras.zh: - 计划在 100 多个国家举办 50,000 多场活动

paras.en: - The week represents the world’s largest space event
paras.zh: - 本周代表世界上最大的太空活动

paras.en: Early this year, the UN hosted four astronauts who just returned from outer space, carrying out the farthest human spaceflight in history when they travelled beyond the far side of the Moon.
paras.zh: 今年年初，联合国接待了四名刚从外太空返回的宇航员，进行了历史上最远的载人航天飞行，飞越了月球背面。

paras.en: But, the UN has been involved in space affairs for decades. The General Assembly created a committee in 1959 to govern the exploration and use of space for the benefit of all – focused around peace, security and development.
paras.zh: 但是，联合国参与太空事务已有几十年了。联合国大会于 1959 年成立了一个委员会，负责管理太空探索和利用，以造福所有人，重点关注和平、安全与发展。

paras.en: Instrumental in creating the five treaties and principles governing outer space, the Committee on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space (COPUOS) has mandated duties that include keeping pace with rapid technological advances.
paras.zh: 和平利用外层空间委员会（COPUOS）在制定管理外层空间的五项条约和原则方面发挥了重要作用，其规定的职责包括跟上快速技术进步的步伐。

paras.en: Since then, space science and technology and their applications are increasingly being used to support a wide range of UN activities. At least 25 UN entities use them.
paras.zh: 从那时起，空间科学技术及其应用越来越多地被用来支持联合国的广泛活动。至少 25 个联合国实体使用它们。

paras.en: Cosmic crops: The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) and the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) sent seeds to the International Space Station in November 2022 to test how harsh space conditions alter plant genetics for climate resilience on Earth
paras.zh: 宇宙作物：国际原子能机构 (IAEA) 和粮食及农业组织 (FAO) 于 2022 年 11 月向国际空间站发送种子，以测试恶劣的太空条件如何改变植物遗传学以增强地球上的气候适应能力

paras.en: Satellite tele-medicine: The World Health Organization (WHO) collaborated with UNOOSA to apply space science and satellite technology to help solve global health challenges
paras.zh: 卫星远程医疗：世界卫生组织（WHO）与联合国外空司合作，应用空间科学和卫星技术帮助解决全球健康挑战

paras.en: Space junk: The UN Environment Programme (UNEP) helps to promote long-term sustainability in Earth’s orbit given the 130 million pieces of debris in circulation – from satellite fragments to abandoned spacecraft
paras.zh: 太空垃圾：联合国环境规划署 (UNEP) 帮助促进地球轨道的长期可持续性，鉴于循环中存在 1.3 亿块碎片（从卫星碎片到废弃航天器）

paras.en: “Like entering a dream state,” one astronaut recalled.
paras.zh: “就像进入梦境一样，”一名宇航员回忆道。

paras.en: In 1990, 17 astronauts shared their out-of-this-world experiences in Our Planet Earth, a timeless documentary produced for the UN by Lemle Pictures, Inc. with cooperation of the Association for Space Explorers and the Canadian International Development Agency.
paras.zh: 1990 年，17 名宇航员在《我们的地球》中分享了他们在地球之外的经历，这是一部由 Lemle Pictures, Inc. 与太空探索者协会和加拿大国际开发署合作为联合国制作的永恒纪录片。

paras.en: “It was the greatest feeling I ever had in my entire life,” said one astronaut. “Seeing the black sky and the bright sun. This is really impossible, but I saw it.”
paras.zh: “这是我一生中最伟大的感觉，”一位宇航员说。 “看到黑色的天空和明亮的太阳。这确实是不可能的，但我看到了。”

paras.en: Another said he tried clumsily manoeuvring in a state of weightlessness, finding himself awkwardly jammed against a window when he was awestruck by both the view and the magnificence of Earth.
paras.zh: 另一个人说，他尝试在失重状态下笨拙地操纵，当他对地球的景色和壮丽感到惊叹时，发现自己尴尬地被卡在窗户上。

paras.en: One summed up a commonly shared feeling among the space travellers.
paras.zh: 有人总结了太空旅行者的一种共同感受。

paras.en: “I felt a love for all the inhabitants of the Earth,” he said. “I just wanted to love them all.”
paras.zh: “我感受到了对地球上所​​有居民的爱，”他说。 “我只是想爱他们所有人。”

articles.title: Humphries savours 'special' win after ending run of major near-misses

paras.en: World Grand Prix Darts: Luke Humphries relieved to end losing streak in major finals after comeback win over Gerwyn Price
paras.zh: 世界飞镖大奖赛：卢克·汉弗莱斯 (Luke Humphries) 复出战胜格文·普莱斯 (Gerwyn Price)，结束了大满贯决赛的连败，松了口气

paras.en: Luke Humphries produced one of the greatest fightbacks in World Grand Prix history to defeat Gerwyn Price 6-4 in the final; Humphries won the double-start event for a second time and extended Price's wait too claim another ranked TV title
paras.zh: 卢克·汉弗莱斯 (Luke Humphries) 在决赛中以 6-4 击败格文·普莱斯 (Gerwyn Price)，创造了世界大奖赛历史上最伟大的反击之一；汉弗莱斯第二次赢得双开始赛事，并延长了普莱斯的等待时间，也获得了另一个排名电视冠军

paras.en: Luke Humphries was relieved to end his run of near-misses in TV major finals after delivering a sensational comeback victory over Gerwyn Price at the World Grand Prix.
paras.zh: 卢克·汉弗莱斯 (Luke Humphries) 在世界大奖赛上以惊人的方式逆转战胜格温·普莱斯 (Gerwyn Price)，结束了自己在电视大满贯决赛中险些失利的连续纪录，这让卢克·汉弗莱斯 (Luke Humphries) 松了口气。

paras.en: Humphries reached a record-breaking fourth consecutive final at the double-start tournament, where he battled back from 3-0 down to win six of the next seven sets in an impressive 6-4 win over the Welshman.
paras.zh: 汉弗莱斯在双发赛中连续第四次进入决赛，打破纪录，他在0-3落后的情况下奋起反击，赢得了接下来七盘中的六盘，最终以6-4战胜了威尔士人。

paras.en: Victory at Leicester's Mattioli Arena followed his win over Price in the 2023 final and makes him just the fourth player ever to claim multiple World Grand Prix titles, with Humphries' latest success securing him the £150,000 first prize.
paras.zh: 继 2023 年决赛中击败普莱斯之后，他在莱斯特马蒂奥利竞技场取得胜利，使他成为有史以来第四位多次获得世界大奖赛冠军的选手，汉弗莱斯最近的成功为他赢得了 15 万英镑的冠军奖金。

paras.en: Humphries' victory is his first ranked TV major title since the Winmau World Masters in February 2025, with 'Cool Hand' pleased for his streak of runner-up finishes to end.
paras.zh: 汉弗莱斯的胜利是他自 2025 年 2 月的 Winmau 世界大师赛以来首次获得排名电视大满贯冠军，“酷手”对他连续获得亚军的纪录感到高兴。

paras.en: "I'm just happy to get one back," said Humphries, who was second at the World Grand Prix, European Championship and Grand Slam of Darts last year before starting 2026 with runner-up finishes at the Winmau World Masters and Premier League.
paras.zh: 汉弗莱斯说：“我很高兴能重新获得一枚飞镖。”汉弗莱斯去年在飞镖世界大奖赛、欧洲锦标赛和飞镖大满贯中获得第二名，随后在 2026 年开始，在 Winmau 世界大师赛和英超联赛中获得亚军。

paras.en: "It's nice to have that run of losses in major finals off my back. It feels really special - this really means the world to me.
paras.zh: “很高兴能在重大决赛中连续输掉比赛。这种感觉真的很特别——这对我来说真的意味着整个世界。

paras.en: "I needed this to give me a bit of confidence. It's been a torrid 15 or 18 months for myself losing so many major finals."
paras.zh: “我需要这给我一点信心。这 15 或 18 个月对我来说是非常痛苦的，我输掉了这么多重要的决赛。”

paras.en: Humphries needed to take out a 105 finish in a final-leg decider to avoid going 4-0 down against Price, who missed set darts to move 5-4 up before losing a topsy-turvy contest.
paras.zh: 汉弗莱斯需要在最后一回合的决胜局中打出105分，才能避免0-4落后普莱斯，普莱斯错过了定点飞镖，以5-4领先，但最终输掉了一场混乱的比赛。

paras.en: "I worked incredibly hard from 3-0 down there, showed a lot of grit and determination," Humphries added. "These wins are more sweet than the ones you win with ease.
paras.zh: 汉弗莱斯补充道：“从 3-0 的比分开始，我就非常努力地工作，表现出了很大的勇气和决心。” “这些胜利比你轻松赢得的胜利更甜蜜。

paras.en: "I felt like I had not much to give tonight [Sunday]. I just didn't want to lose 6-0 and I wanted to give the fans something to be happy with, and all of a sudden I find myself 4-3 up.
paras.zh: “我觉得今晚（周日）我没有什么可以给予的。我只是不想以 6-0 输掉比赛，我想给球迷一些值得高兴的东西，突然间我发现自己已经 4-3 领先了。

paras.en: "I'm looking forward to taking the trophy home to my son, who can finally see his dad have another trophy and it not be a runners-up one!"
paras.zh: “我期待着把奖杯带回家给我的儿子，他终于可以看到他的父亲又获得了一座奖杯，而且不是亚军！”

paras.en: Humphries back Price to end major drought 'soon'
paras.zh: 汉弗莱斯支持普莱斯“很快”结束严重干旱

paras.en: Price remains without a major title since 2022 after a third consecutive runner-up finish, having also finished second at the World Matchplay to Luke Littler and at the World Series Finals to Ross Smith, with the Ice Man also having three other semi-final appearances in majors this year.
paras.zh: 普莱斯在连续三次获得亚军后，自 2022 年以来一直没有获得大满贯冠军，他还在世界比洞赛中不敌卢克·利特勒 (Luke Littler) 获得第二名，在世界系列赛决赛中不敌罗斯·史密斯 (Ross Smith)，冰人今年还另外三次闯入大满贯赛半决赛。

paras.en: "Gezzy was amazing for those first three sets, absolutely insane," Humphries insisted. "He is going to win a major title soon. It's written in the stars for him, he can't keep playing this well and not win."
paras.zh: “Gezzy 在前三盘中表现得非常出色，绝对是疯狂的，”汉弗莱斯坚持道。 “他很快就会赢得一个大满贯冠军。这对他来说是写在星星上的，他不能继续打得这么好而不赢。”

paras.en: Price opened with a 132.62 average in the opening set, which he completed in just 34 darts to post the best three-dart set average in tournament history, although now has three runner-up finishes at the World Grand Prix since his 2020 success.
paras.zh: 普莱斯在首盘比赛中以 132.62 分的平均成绩开局，他仅用了 34 镖就完成了比赛，创造了锦标赛历史上最好的三镖盘平均成绩，尽管自 2020 年成功以来，他现在已经在世界大奖赛上获得了 3 次亚军。

paras.en: "I don't want to win a major, do I?!" Price told Sky Sports. "It's gutting I lost another one - I'm not bothered, but I am bothered.
paras.zh: “我不想赢得大满贯，不是吗？！”普莱斯告诉天空体育。 “我又失去了一个，这让我很伤心——我不介意，但我很介意。

paras.en: "Luke played brilliantly in the middle part of the game, but I still squandered so many opportunities to put him under a bit of pressure. I felt like it was a fantastic game - I thought I played brilliantly, and Luke played brilliantly."
paras.zh: “卢克在比赛中段打得非常出色，但我还是浪费了很多机会，让他承受了一些压力。我觉得这是一场精彩的比赛——我认为我打得非常出色，卢克也打得非常出色。”

paras.en: Mardle: Humphries didn't succumb under pressure
paras.zh: 马德尔：汉弗莱斯没有在压力下屈服

paras.en: "Humphries was in trouble, then a bit more and then a bit more - so to get out of it was an incredible effort. The last two sets were his best. He was under the cosh for more than an hour but didn't succumb. He stood up to everything Gezzy [Price] threw at him, which was a lot!
paras.zh: “汉弗莱斯遇到了麻烦，然后越来越多，然后越来越多——所以要摆脱困境是一项令人难以置信的努力。最后两盘是他最好的。他在绳子下呆了一个多小时，但没有屈服。他勇敢地面对了盖兹[普莱斯]向他扔来的一切，这是很多！

paras.en: "When you have won before, which Luke has done many times and in many, ways, there is that belief of, 'I'm under pressure, but let's just see as I know my game can win', rather than 'oh no, I am going to get beat'. He played his game and he won.
paras.zh: “当你以前赢过的时候，卢克已经在很多方面做到了很多次，你会相信，‘我承受着压力，但让我们看看我知道我的比赛能赢’，而不是‘哦，不，我会被打败’。他打出了自己的比赛，他赢了。

paras.en: "Gezzy tightened up after a great start. He says things in the spur of the moment but the way he competes, he wants it. You can't play like he did this evening if you don't care!
paras.zh: “在一个良好的开局后，盖兹变得更加紧张。他一时冲动地说了一些话，但他比赛的方式，他想要它。如果你不在乎，你就不能像他今晚那样打球！”

paras.en: "It is disheartening and disappointing when you are 3-0 up and don't win, but he has lost enough finals to know nothing is a given. He is still a young man and will get many more opportunities. He knows he is good enough."
paras.zh: “当你以3-0领先却没有获胜时，这是令人沮丧和失望的，但他已经输掉了足够多的决赛，知道一切都不是理所当然的。他仍然是一个年轻人，将会得到更多的机会。他知道自己足够好。”

paras.en: The European Tour season continues with the Swiss Darts Trophy (October 9-11) and the Dutch Darts Championship (October 16-18) before the European Championship takes place in Dortmund, Germany from October 22-25.
paras.zh: 欧洲巡回赛赛季将继续进行瑞士飞镖杯赛（10 月 9 日至 11 日）和荷兰飞镖锦标赛（10 月 16 日至 18 日），然后欧洲锦标赛将于 10 月 22 日至 25 日在德国多特蒙德举行。

articles.title: Gihan Arnolda: Britain's first black trainer hoping to inspire next generation

paras.en: Gihan Arnolda: Britain's first black trainer hoping to inspire next generation
paras.zh: 吉汉·阿诺达：英国第一位黑人教练，希望激励下一代

paras.zh: 请使用Chrome浏览器以获得更方便的视频播放器

paras.en: Gihan Arnolda is believed to be the first Black or Asian licenced trainer in Britain. He's based at Cadland Cottage Stables in Newmarket and sent out his first runner in May 2026, securing his first winner a month later.
paras.zh: 吉汉·阿诺达 (Gihan Arnolda) 被认为是英国第一位黑人或亚裔持照教练。他居住在纽马克特的 Cadland Cottage Stables，并于 2026 年 5 月派出了他的第一匹赛马，并在一个月后获得了他的第一个冠军。

articles.title: Zhuri chases a first success at Yarmouth

paras.en: Today on Sky Sports Racing: Wolverhampton and Yarmouth
paras.zh: 今日天空体育赛车：伍尔弗汉普顿和雅茅斯

paras.en: In today’s feature, the beautifully-bred Zhuri looks to get off the mark on her second start in a potentially hot maiden at Yarmouth; we also have competitive All-Weather action from Wolverhampton, live on Sky Sports Racing from 1.15pm.
paras.zh: 在今天的专题中，出身美丽的朱里在雅茅斯的第二场比赛中看起来很出色，她是一位潜在的性感少女。我们还提供来自伍尔弗汉普顿的全天候比赛，天空体育赛车从下午 1.15 开始直播。

paras.en: We have a busy day’s racing on Monday with flat action from Wolverhampton and Yarmouth, live on Sky Sports Racing...
paras.zh: 周一我们将进行忙碌的一天比赛，伍尔弗汉普顿和雅茅斯的比赛表现平平，天空体育赛车直播......

paras.en: 2.25 Yarmouth - Legacy Link's sister Zhuri takes on Never An Angel
paras.zh: 2.25 雅茅斯 - Legacy Link 的妹妹 Zhuri 对阵 Never An Angel

paras.en: Legacy Link's full-sister Zhuri takes on debutant Never An Angel for Ed Walker who cost 460,000gns as a yearling.
paras.zh: Legacy Link 的全姐妹 Zhuri 对阵 Ed Walker 的首次亮相的 Never An Angel，后者一岁鸽售价为 460,000gns。

paras.en: The well-related filly Zhuri comes here for her second racecourse start, this time dropping to seven-furlongs after shaping well without seeing out the trip, dropping back in distance looks to suit her.
paras.zh: 关系密切的母马“朱里”来到这里，这是她第二次在赛马场出发，这一次，她在没有参加比赛的情况下，体形良好，身长下降到了七弗隆，在远距离的外观上又下降到适合她的程度。

paras.en: Ed Walker is 15 per cent with his two-year-olds this year and comes here with the 460,000gns No Nay Never-filly Never An Angel, with Kieran Shoemark taking the ride.
paras.zh: 艾德·沃克 (Ed Walker) 今年带着他的两岁孩子获得了 15% 的成功率，他带着 460,000gns 的“No Nay Never-filly Never An Angel”来到这里，基兰·舒马克 (Kieran Shoemark) 搭上了顺风车。

paras.en: - 'What a horse!' - Scott celebrates Prix Dollar triumph
paras.zh: - “多好的一匹马啊！” - 斯科特庆祝大奖赛胜利

paras.en: - Caballo De Mar upsets Scandinavia in Cadran clash
paras.zh: - Caballo De Mar 在卡德兰冲突中击败斯堪的纳维亚半岛

paras.en: Baaeed has made a bright start to his stallion career and is represented here by the William Haggas-trained filly Faithful who is from a good family, being a half-sister to Italy for Aidan O'Brien and Bowmark, who shares the same connections.
paras.zh: 巴伊德的种马生涯有了一个光明的开端，他的代表马是威廉·哈加斯 (William Haggas) 训练的母马“忠实”(Faithful)，它出身于一个良好的家庭，是艾丹·奥布莱恩 (Aidan O'Brien) 和鲍马克 (Bowmark) 的同父异母的姐妹，拥有同样的血统。

paras.en: Another beautifully bred runner, Lady Jemima is the most experienced in the field, with three starts to her name already, latterly producing an encouraging effort at Newmarket and she should progress again for the James Owen team.
paras.zh: 另一位出身优秀的赛跑运动员杰米玛女士是该领域最有经验的选手，她已经参加了三场比赛，最近在纽马基特取得了令人鼓舞的成绩，她应该会为詹姆斯·欧文队再次进步。

paras.en: 8.30 Wolverhampton - Powder Monkey looks to complete a hat-trick
paras.zh: 8.30 狼队 - Powder Monkey 有望完成帽子戏法

paras.en: Powder Monkey looks to complete a hat-trick in the Race & Rest - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Handicap, after wins at Wolverhampton and Lingfield.
paras.zh: 在战胜伍尔弗汉普顿和林菲尔德之后，Powder Monkey 有望在比赛和休息 - 伍尔弗汉普顿假日酒店让分盘中完成帽子戏法。

paras.en: He returned to the track after a break with a win at Lingfield Park in August, off a mark of 69. That victory pushed him up to 74 and he since went on to defy favouritism readily in the hands of Billy Loughnane. He is up to a mark of 78 today and the champion jockey-elect takes the ride again.
paras.zh: 八月份，他在林菲尔德公园休息后重返赛场，取得了 69 分的好成绩。这场胜利将他的成绩提升到了 74 分，此后他继续挑战比利·洛南 (Billy Loughnane) 的偏袒。他今天的成绩达到了 78 分，当选冠军骑师再次上马。

paras.en: Dublin Bay won by seven lengths here back in May and was slapped with a ten-pound penalty for the effort. He has run with credit in deeper company on two starts since but will do well to overcome stall 12 off the same mark.
paras.zh: 今年五月，都柏林湾队在这里以七马位的优势获胜，并因此被罚款十磅。此后，他在两场比赛中都在更深的连队中表现出色，但他将很好地克服同样的分数12号隔间。

paras.en: The top-weight Alfra Whiteburd landed a hat-trick at Pontefract in the summer for the Ivan Furtado team and hasn't lost much in defeat in two starts since but he returns to the All-Weather this evening and his four wins on this surface give him a chance.
paras.zh: 顶级重量级阿尔弗拉·怀特伯德 (Alfra Whiteburd) 今年夏天为伊万·弗塔多 (Ivan Furtado) 车队在庞特弗拉克特 (Pontefract) 上演了帽子戏法，此后两场比赛并没有在失利中损失太多，但今晚他将重返全天候赛场，他在该赛场上的四场胜利给了他机会。

paras.en: 4.05 Yarmouth - Box To Box and Cuff It take on eight rivals
paras.zh: 4.05 雅茅斯 - Box To Box and Cuff It 与八个对手较量

paras.en: Top-rated Box To Box and Cuff It will take on eight rivals in this competitive Haven Seashore Holiday Park Handicap.
paras.zh: 顶级的 Box To Box and Cuff It 将在这场竞争激烈的避风港海滨假日公园让分赛中与八个对手较量。

paras.en: Box To Box is without a win in his last five starts and is down to a mark of 87 but looked to have the race at his mercy last time at Chester, striking the front at the furlong pole before being run down close to home. Another bold show can be expected.
paras.zh: Box To Box在过去的五场比赛中没有取得一场胜利，得分跌至87分，但上一次在切斯特的比赛中，他在弗隆杆上取得了领先，然后在离家很近的地方被撞倒。可以期待另一场大胆的表演。

paras.en: Cuff It is the most unexposed in here, just four career starts to his name. He had his handicap debut last time out at York in a competitive class two contest but found that company too hot. Back in a class four event today, he could run well.
paras.zh: 袖口是这里最不曝光的，他的名字只有四个职业生涯开始。上次他在约克的一场竞争激烈的二级比赛中首次亮相，但发现那家公司太热了。今天回到四级比赛，他跑得很好。

paras.en: Lucky Hero is in-form, having won two of his last three runs, his hat-trick bid was thwarted last time out as he was beaten a short margin into third after winning at Newmarket. Another big effort can't be dismissed.
paras.zh: Lucky Hero状态良好，在过去的三场比赛中赢得了两场，但他的帽子戏法在上一次比赛中被挫败，因为他在纽马克特获胜后以微弱优势进入第三名。另一项重大努力不容忽视。

paras.zh: 1.50 雅茅斯 - Awwjaan，爱尔兰 1000 坚尼参赛选手回归。

paras.zh: 3.35 雅茅斯 - 伍顿·巴塞特母马无尽的任务开始了她的职业生涯。

paras.en: 4.05 Yarmouth - Box To Box and Cuff It lock horns.
paras.zh: 4.05 雅茅斯 - Box To Box 和 Cuff It 锁定喇叭。

paras.zh: 4.26 伍尔弗汉普顿 - 有趣的上帝之狮首次亮相。

articles.title: Early indications suggest Flydubai co-pilot acted alone in attack, officials say
articles.author: Paul Goldman

paras.en: TEL AVIV — Early indications suggest the Flydubai co-pilot accused of attacking his captain and trying to seize control of an Israel-bound plane acted alone, rather than as part of a larger organization or on behalf of a foreign government, multiple U.S. officials briefed on the investigation and a former Israeli security official told NBC News.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫——多位了解调查情况的美国官员和一名前以色列安全官员告诉 NBC 新闻，初步迹象表明，被指控袭击机长并试图夺取一架飞往以色列飞机控制权的迪拜航空副机长是单独行动，而不是作为更大组织的一部分或代表外国政府。

paras.en: The U.S. officials cautioned that the investigation into Wednesday’s midair attack remains at an early stage.
paras.zh: 美国官员警告称，对周三空中袭击事件的调查仍处于早期阶段。

paras.en: “The assessment is that he operated alone. Right now, it looks like a case of ‘lone wolf’ terrorism inspired by content found online,” said Shalom Ben Hanan, a former official in the Shin Bet, Israel’s domestic security agency.
paras.zh: 以色列国内安全机构欣贝特 (Shin Bet) 前官员沙洛姆·本·哈南 (Shalom Ben Hanan) 表示：“据评估，他是单独行动。目前，这看起来像是一起受网上内容启发的‘独狼’恐怖主义案件。”

paras.en: “We still need to wait for the final investigation results to determine whether an organization or a state is behind it,” he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“我们仍需等待最终调查结果，才能确定幕后黑手是否是某个组织或国家。”

paras.en: Emirati authorities, who are leading the investigation, said Saturday that the co-pilot attacked the captain with a crash ax and attempted to take control of the aircraft’s flight controls in an attempted terrorist attack.
paras.zh: 负责调查的阿联酋当局周六表示，副驾驶用一把坠毁斧袭击了机长，并试图控制飞机的飞行控制系统，这是一次未遂的恐怖袭击。

paras.en: The flight was carrying 174 mostly Israeli passengers from Dubai to Tel Aviv. A crash was averted when crew members and passengers entered the cockpit and subdued the attacker, according to eyewitnesses and Israeli officials.
paras.zh: 这架航班载有 174 名乘客，其中大部分是以色列乘客，从迪拜飞往特拉维夫。据目击者和以色列官员称，机组人员和乘客进入驾驶舱并制服了袭击者，事故才得以避免。

paras.en: NBC News has identified the suspect as Omani citizen Hamam al-Hammami, based on information from multiple sources from three agencies briefed on the investigation and a diplomat in the Middle East. Authorities have not released his identity.
paras.zh: NBC 新闻根据来自三个了解调查情况的机构和一名中东外交官的多个消息来源的信息，确认嫌疑人为阿曼公民哈马姆·哈马米 (Hamam al-Hammami)。当局尚未公布他的身份。

paras.en: UAE Attorney General Hamad Saif Al Shamsi said Saturday that investigators were working to establish the incident’s “full circumstances, motives, and any links.”
paras.zh: 阿联酋总检察长哈马德·赛义夫·沙姆西周六表示，调查人员正在努力查明该事件的“全部情况、动机和任何联系”。

paras.en: The preliminary assessment comes after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Friday that investigators were examining whether the attacker had been sent by someone.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡周五表示，调查人员正在调查袭击者是否是由某人派出的，随后进行了初步评估。

paras.en: President Donald Trump also raised the possibility of Iranian involvement Thursday, threatening renewed strikes against Iran if it was behind the attack. A senior U.S. official briefed on the Israeli investigation previously told NBC News there were no indications that Iran directed or was involved in the attack.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周四也提出了伊朗参与其中的可能性，并威胁称，如果伊朗是此次袭击的幕后黑手，将对其发动新一轮打击。一位了解以色列调查情况的美国高级官员此前告诉美国全国广播公司新闻，没有迹象表明伊朗指挥或参与了这次袭击。

paras.en: The flight captain, Indian national Smit Machchhar, said Friday from a hospital in Abu Dhabi that he had been severely injured and could sense the aircraft descending before he managed to open the cockpit door, allowing passengers and crew to intervene.
paras.zh: 机长、印度国民斯密特·马赫恰尔 (Smit Macchhar) 周五在阿布扎比一家医院表示，他受了重伤，在他设法打开驾驶舱门、让乘客和机组人员进行干预之前，他能感觉到飞机正在下降。

paras.en: “I was acting for my own life, but at the same time, I knew I couldn’t let all of them die,” he said on a video call released by India’s Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
paras.zh: “我是在为自己的生命而行动，但同时，我知道我不能让他们所有人死去，”他在印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪发布的视频通话中说道。

paras.en: Raf Sanchez and Paul Goldman reported from Tel Aviv and Tom Winter from New York.
paras.zh: 拉夫·桑切斯和保罗·戈德曼从特拉维夫报道，汤姆·温特从纽约报道。

articles.title: U.S. Air Force removes all bombers from British air base targeted in a suspected terrorist plot
articles.author: Courtney Kube

paras.en: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Air Force has brought home all of its bombers stationed at RAF Fairford, a U.S.-run military air base in England used to strike Iran, following an investigation into a planned terrorist attack at the base.
paras.zh: 华盛顿——在对英国皇家空军费尔福德基地计划进行的恐怖袭击事件进行调查后，美国空军已将驻扎在英国皇家空军费尔福德基地的所有轰炸机带回国。该基地是美国在英格兰运营的军事空军基地，曾用于打击伊朗。

paras.en: A Defense Department official told NBC News that all bombers that had been deployed to the base “have been re-deployed to their home stations in the United States.”
paras.zh: 一名国防部官员告诉 NBC 新闻，所有部署到该基地的轰炸机“都已重新部署到美国的基地”。

paras.en: “The Airmen that operate America’s bomber force, including B-1s, B-2s, and B-52s, remain ready to deliver precision global strike capabilities — including through operations that launch and recover from the continental United States — anywhere, anytime,” the official said.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示：“操作美国轰炸机部队（包括 B-1、B-2 和 B-52）的空军人员随时准备提供精确的全球打击能力，包括通过从美国本土起飞和回收的行动，随时随地进行打击。”

paras.en: The rushed withdrawal of at least 12 bombers included several that had just arrived as part of a rotation to the base, two Pentagon officials told NBC News.
paras.zh: 两名五角大楼官员告诉 NBC 新闻，至少 12 架轰炸机被紧急撤出，其中包括几架刚刚抵达基地轮换的轰炸机。

paras.en: Aviation watchers, such as the Military Air Tracking Alliance, have observed dozens of B-52 and B-1 bombers operating out of RAF Fairford since the opening days of the Iran war. Observers noticed a host of B-1 bombers flying out of the base Sunday.
paras.zh: 自伊朗战争爆发以来，军事空中追踪联盟等航空观察者观察到数十架 B-52 和 B-1 轰炸机在英国皇家空军费尔福德基地飞行。周日，观察家注意到许多 B-1 轰炸机从基地飞出。

paras.en: President Donald Trump is weighing options for his war on Iran — including new strikes — despite his initial promises to Americans that the campaign would last a matter of weeks.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统正在权衡对伊朗战争的选择，包括新的打击，尽管他最初向美国人承诺，这场战争将持续几周。

paras.en: “We have decisions that I’ll make about Iran. Iran’s been decimated. So the only question is — it’ll either be the easy way, or the hard way,” Trump told reporters Saturday as he left the White House for a rally in Ohio.
paras.zh: “我们将就伊朗问题做出决定。伊朗已经遭到重创。所以唯一的问题是——这要么是简单的方法，要么是困难的方法，”特朗普周六离开白宫前往俄亥俄州参加集会时告诉记者。

paras.en: A dual British-Iranian national was arrested in central London last week on suspicion of plotting a terrorist attack following a security incident at RAF Fairford in late September. In total, six people have been taken into custody and released on bail during the investigation.
paras.zh: 一名拥有英国和伊朗双重国籍的公民上周在伦敦市中心被捕，原因是他涉嫌在 9 月底英国皇家空军费尔福德发生安全事件后策划恐怖袭击。调查期间，共有六人被拘留并被保释。

paras.en: British authorities have linked the incident to Tehran. Iran has denied involvement.
paras.zh: 英国当局已将此事件与德黑兰联系起来。伊朗否认参与其中。

paras.en: American bombers have used the air base, 100 miles west of London, during decades of conflicts in the Middle East.
paras.zh: 在中东数十年的冲突期间，美国轰炸机曾使用过伦敦以西 100 英里的空军基地。

paras.en: The U.S. military still maintains a sizable presence in the Middle East. On Thursday, a U.S. official said the recently deployed USS Theodore Roosevelt aircraft carrier and the USS Malkin Island amphibious readiness group — a group of ships that together carry over 7,000 sailors and 2,000 Marines — are heading for the region. The official said the move could have three carriers in the region as early as the end of October.
paras.zh: 美国军队在中东仍然保持着相当大的存在。周四，一名美国官员表示，最近部署的西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰和马尔金岛号两栖战备大队——这群舰艇总共载有 7,000 多名水兵和 2,000 名海军陆战队员——正在前往该地区。该官员表示，此举最早可能于 10 月底在该地区拥有 3 家运营商。

articles.title: Australia's Rugby League World Cup squad is a sign of the changing times
articles.author: Nick Campton

paras.en: Fri, 11 Sept, 7:50 pm, Final score, Rabbitohs 10, Knights 20
paras.zh: 9 月 11 日星期五，晚上 7:50，最终比分，Rabbitohs 10，Knights 20

paras.en: The depths of Australia's star power means the Kangaroos will always name squads oozing with class and Kevin Walters's combination for this year's World Cup is no exception.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚明星力量的深厚意味着袋鼠队总是会选出充满魅力的球队，凯文·沃尔特斯今年世界杯的组合也不例外。

paras.en: It's a side with major success stories, young and old and in-between.
paras.zh: 这是一支拥有重大成功故事的球队，无论年轻的、年长的还是介于两者之间的。

paras.en: James Tedesco's return three years after his last Test caps the 33-year old's resurrection and after he ran the ball to hell and back in the grand final to win the Clive Churchill Medal, there can be no doubt that, at an age where many players best days are only just a memory, he is once again the best fullback in the world.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·特德斯科在上次测试三年后回归，为这位 33 岁的球员带来了复活，在他在总决赛中带球跑进地狱并返回并赢得了克莱夫·丘吉尔奖章后，毫无疑问，在许多球员最好的日子只是回忆的年龄，他再次成为世界上最好的后卫。

paras.en: The inclusion of Dolphins flyer Jack Bostock, who will almost certainly see a Test debut in the World Cup opener given the side's shortage of wingers, heralds the start of a new generation wearing green and gold.
paras.zh: 海豚队飞人杰克·博斯托克（Jack Bostock）的加盟，预示着新一代身着绿色和金色球衣的开始，鉴于球队边锋短缺，他几乎肯定会在世界杯揭幕战中首次亮相。

paras.en: At 26, David Fifita is no longer a youngster in rugby league terms but his looming Australian debut is both a long time coming and well-earned following his strong finish to the year with Souths.
paras.zh: 26 岁的大卫·菲菲塔 (David Fifita) 在橄榄球联盟中不再是一名年轻人，但他即将在澳大利亚首次亮相，这既是一场漫长的等待，也是他在索斯队 (Souths) 取得优异成绩后应​​得的。

paras.en: The one-time prodigy has longed seemed a player of limitless possibilities but only now, eight years after his NRL debut and three years since he last played for Queensland, will he get the chance to be a Kangaroo.
paras.zh: 这位曾经的神童一直渴望成为一名拥有无限可能性的球员，但直到现在，在他首次亮相 NRL 八年后，距离他上次为昆士兰队效力三年后，他才有机会成为一名袋鼠。

paras.en: But the Australian squad also reveals the new truths about representative football, that the disconnect between State and Origin and Test matches is wider than ever before and may never be stitched back together again.
paras.zh: 但澳大利亚队也揭示了代表足球的新真相，即州比赛和起源比赛和测试比赛之间的脱节比以往任何时候都更大，并且可能永远不会再缝合在一起。

paras.en: It's a process that began with Origin's gradual but unmistakeable rise past Test football as rugby league's biggest stage then continued when a host of players chose to represent Pasifika nations over Australia while retaining their Origin eligibility.
paras.zh: 这个过程始于 Origin 逐渐但不容置疑地超越测试橄榄球，成为橄榄球联盟最大舞台的过程，然后，当许多球员选择代表太平洋岛民国家对阵澳大利亚，同时保留他们的 Origin 资格时，这一过程继续进行。

paras.en: The final change came earlier this year when the NRL allowed players to represent New Zealand or England and still being available for Origin selection.
paras.zh: 最后的改变发生在今年早些时候，当时 NRL 允许球员代表新西兰或英格兰，但仍然可以参加原籍选拔。

paras.en: Both of those eligibility changes reflect the changing face of rugby league and the people who play it and the game is better for them.
paras.zh: 这两项资格变化都反映了橄榄球联盟的面貌以及参加橄榄球比赛的人的变化，而且这项运动对他们来说变得更好了。

paras.en: But it does require a reset of over a century's worth of thinking that interstate football is the pathway to national selection.
paras.zh: 但这确实需要重新审视一个多世纪以来的思想，即州际足球是国家选拔的途径。

paras.en: This has not been true for some years now, but there's a reason old habits have a hard time dying.
paras.zh: 多年来情况并非如此，但旧习惯难以改掉是有原因的。

paras.en: And while Australia will never be hard up for talent, some of the more eyebrow-raising picks prove this old adage is as antiquated as Kangaroo tours that travel to England by boat.
paras.zh: 尽管澳大利亚永远不会缺乏人才，但一些更令人惊讶的选择证明，这句古老的格言和乘船前往英国的袋鼠之旅一样过时。

paras.en: Not one of the Queensland outside backs is in the side at all. Kalyn Ponga, Robert Toia, Jojo Fifita, Hamiso Tabuai-Fidow all would be, but they're playing for other nations while Selwyn Cobbo is injured.
paras.zh: 昆士兰队的外后卫没有一个在场上。卡林·蓬加、罗伯特·托亚、乔乔·菲菲塔、哈米索·塔布艾-菲多都可以，但他们在塞尔温·科博受伤时为其他国家队效力。

paras.en: That's how we end up with Brisbane's Kotoni Staggs, a fine centre who had a tough year, making the side despite being dropped by New South Wales for the Origin decider after a horror night in Game II at the MCG.
paras.zh: 这就是我们最终得到布里斯班的科托尼·斯塔格斯的原因，他是一名优秀的中锋，经历了艰难的一年，尽管在MCG的第二场比赛中经历了一个恐怖的夜晚后被新南威尔士州淘汰出局，但仍进入了球队。

paras.en: Latrell Mitchell missed the entire series through injury and has only started one match in the past five months but he's made it, while Tom Trbojevic is a likely starter on one wing despite not having played rep football for two years and not playing a match on the flank since 2018.
paras.zh: 拉特雷尔·米切尔因伤缺席了整个系列赛，在过去五个月里只首发了一场比赛，但他做到了，而汤姆·特尔博耶维奇很可能成为一侧翼的首发球员，尽管他已经两年没有踢过代表足球了，而且自 2018 年以来就没有参加过一场边路比赛。

paras.en: Likewise of the 12 men who played in the forwards for New South Wales, only Blayke Brailey, Isaah Yeo, Liam Martin and Cameron Murray have made the squad.
paras.zh: 同样，在新南威尔士州的 12 名前锋中，只有布莱克·布雷利、伊萨·杨、利亚姆·马丁和卡梅伦·穆雷入选了球队。

paras.en: Hudson Young and Payne Haas are both out with injury, but Haumole Olakau'atu and Addin Fonua-Blake will both line up for Tonga while Victor Radley is with England.
paras.zh: 哈德森·杨和佩恩·哈斯都因伤缺阵，但哈莫勒·奥拉卡图和阿丁·福努阿-布莱克都将代表汤加队出场，而维克多·拉德利则代表英格兰队。

paras.en: So Reuben Cotter makes the squad despite an underwhelming season with the Cowboys and a lacklustre series for Queensland.
paras.zh: 因此，尽管牛仔队的赛季表现平平，昆士兰队的系列赛也表现平平，鲁本·科特还是入选了球队。

paras.en: His selection over Dolphins hardman Max Plath, who does a similar job with similar attributes whilst offering the same versatility and is coming off a far superior season for club and state, is perhaps the hardest pick to understand.
paras.zh: 他选择了海豚队的硬汉马克斯·普拉斯（Max Plath），后者从事类似的工作，具有相似的属性，同时提供相同的多才多艺，并且在俱乐部和州队中度过了一个远为出色的赛季，这可能是最难理解的选择。

paras.en: Plath, along with Newcastle's Fletcher Sharpe and South Sydney's Tallis Duncan can count himself most aggrieved at missing out but it's hard to take up too much issue with Walters's squad, even if it's short of wingers.
paras.zh: 普拉斯、纽卡斯尔联的弗莱彻·夏普和南悉尼的塔利斯·邓肯都对自己的缺席感到最委屈，但很难对沃尔特斯的球队提出太多问题，即使球队缺少边锋。

paras.en: This is the hand the Australian coach has been dealt for his final tournament before he departs to take over Super League side St Helens.
paras.zh: 这是这位澳大利亚教练在接手超级联赛球队圣海伦斯队之前在最后一场比赛中所拿到的牌。

paras.en: The eligibility changes and the fact that Test football misses out on players who pick up injuries during club seasons that are getting longer and longer all the time means sometimes his options are a bit more limited than he would have liked.
paras.zh: 资格的变化以及测试足球错过了在俱乐部赛季中受伤的球员的事实，而俱乐部赛季的时间越来越长，这意味着有时他的选择比他希望的要有限一些。

paras.en: Australia are still the pick to win the World Cup and will be warm favourites in every game they play, beginning with their tournament opener against New Zealand next Thursday night in Sydney.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚仍然是赢得世界杯的热门人选，并且在每场比赛中都将成为热门热门，从下周四晚上在悉尼对阵新西兰的揭幕战开始。

paras.en: Walters is attempting to solve a puzzle no other Kangaroos coach has ever had to face and there is no one-size-fits-all philosophy in the battle between fitness, function and form when it comes to selecting a player.
paras.zh: 沃尔特斯试图解决其他袋鼠队教练从未遇到过的难题，并且在选择球员时，在体能、功能和状态之间的斗争中不存在一刀切的哲学。

paras.en: But when numbers are scarce, and for the Kangaroos they're a lot shorter than they used to be, the first two are more important than the last.
paras.zh: 但是，当数量稀少，并且对于袋鼠来说，它们比以前矮很多时，前两个比后一个更重要。

articles.title: Runner honours mother in epic Perth to Sydney relay for DV awareness

paras.en: Runners complete 4,000km relay from Cottesloe to Bondi for domestic violence awareness
paras.zh: 跑步者完成从科特斯洛到邦迪的 4,000 公里接力，以提高家庭暴力意识

paras.en: Six ultra-endurance athletes have run a 4,000 kilometre relay from Cottesloe Beach in WA to Bondi Beach in NSW to raise awareness about domestic violence.
paras.zh: 六名超耐力运动员从西澳科茨洛海滩到新南威尔士州邦迪海滩进行了 4,000 公里的接力赛，以提高人们对家庭暴力的认识。

paras.en: The runners took shifts to complete the trek across the Nullarbor in 15 days.
paras.zh: 跑步者们轮流在 15 天内完成了穿越纳拉伯河的跋涉。

paras.en: Funds raised as part of the initiative will go towards Beyond DV.
paras.zh: 该计划筹集的资金将用于 Beyond DV。
